title: Senior Associate- Recruitment
description:
**About Solinas:**

Solinas, a deep-tech startup incubated at IIT Madras, is India’s pioneering asset management venture transforming the water and sanitation sector. Recognized and commended by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Solinas is on a mission to tackle pressing challenges such as manual scavenging, water accessibility, and the prevention of floods and sewer overflows. At the core of our vision lies a commitment to developing homegrown, affordable robotics and AI solutions for pipeline inspections, manhole and septic tank cleaning, and underground asset management.  Since 2018, we have transformed operations across 30+ cities, earning accolades such as Best On-Campus Startup by the Economic Times, an appearance on Shark Tank India, and partnerships with industry leaders like Ashirvad Pipes and The/Nudge Institute. On the global stage, Solinas has been named Best Southeast Asian Startup by Imagine H2O — a testament to our innovation, impact, and purpose-driven growth.

**About the Role:**

This is a hands-on recruitment role responsible for managing the complete hiring lifecycle across multiple business functions with speed, quality, and cost efficiency. The ideal candidate should be passionate about talent acquisition, possess exceptional sourcing capabilities, and thrive in a high-growth startup environment. This role demands ownership of hiring across Corporate, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Field Services, Leadership, and Campus Recruitment without dependency on external recruitment consultants. If you enjoy solving hiring challenges, building talent pipelines, and closing niche as well as high-volume roles, this opportunity is for you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

●
**End-to-End Talent Acquisition:**
Own the complete recruitment lifecycle from manpower requisition to successful onboarding. Collaborate with hiring managers to understand business needs, define hiring strategies, and ensure timely closures while delivering an exceptional candidate experience and maintaining high standards of quality.

●
**Strategic Talent Sourcing:**
Develop and execute innovative sourcing strategies through Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, employee referrals, social media, professional networks, and niche job portals. Build sustainable talent pipelines for both immediate and future hiring requirements while minimizing dependency on external recruitment consultants.

 ●
**Multi-Functional Hiring:**
Drive recruitment across diverse business functions including Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, Operations, Corporate Functions, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Quality, Field Services, and Leadership roles. Manage hiring across all experience levels, from interns and entry-level professionals to managers and functional heads.

 ●
**Manufacturing, Operations & Workforce Hiring:**
Lead recruitment for manufacturing facilities, field operations, and pan-India grey-collar workforce. Coordinate contractual and outsourced hiring through manpower partners, ensuring timely deployment, workforce availability, quality of hires, and compliance with organizational standards.

 ●
**Campus Recruitment & Early Talent Development:**
Build strong relationships with engineering colleges, universities, and technical institutions to strengthen the organization's early talent pipeline. Plan and execute campus recruitment drives, internship programs, placement activities, and employer engagement initiatives across Chennai and other locations.

 ●
**Walk-in Drives & Recruitment Campaigns:**
Plan and execute walk-in drives, recruitment events, and large-scale hiring campaigns to support business growth. Coordinate end-to-end event logistics, interview panels, candidate communication, and post-event follow-ups to maximize hiring outcomes and candidate engagement.

 ●
**Candidate Assessment & Interview Coordination:**
Conduct comprehensive resume screening, HR interviews, behavioural assessments, and preliminary evaluations to identify candidates with the right technical capabilities and cultural fit. Coordinate interview schedules, gather timely feedback from stakeholders, and ensure a structured and efficient selection process.

**● Recruitment Operations & ATS Management**
: Ensure accurate maintenance of candidate records, recruitment documentation, interview feedback, and hiring workflows within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Generate recruitment dashboards, maintain data integrity, and ensure adherence to organizational recruitment processes and compliance standards.

**Required Skills:**

● 3–4 years of experience in end-to-end recruitment across Corporate, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Leadership functions.

● Strong sourcing expertise using Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean Search, X-Ray Search, referrals, and other talent platforms.

● Proven ability to manage multiple hiring mandates and consistently achieve recruitment targets within defined timelines.

● Hands-on experience in campus hiring, walk-in drives, contractual staffing, vendor management, and pan-India workforce hiring.

● Excellent stakeholder management, interviewing, negotiation, and communication skills with a business partnering approach.

 ● Proficient in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), recruitment analytics, MIS reporting, and recruitment KPI management.

● Fluent verbal and written communication in English and Tamil is mandatory; proficiency in Hindi will be an added advantage.

**Educational Qualification:**
Any Bachelor's Degree, MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Human Resources is preferred. We value your passion, curiosity, and ability to find exceptional talent even more than your degree. If recruitment excites you and building great teams is what you love, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Established in 1999, the firm has expanded to include multiple partners and associates across different locations, serving clients ranging from small private enterprises to large multinational companies. The firm emphasizes high professional standards, strong ethics, integrity, and confidentiality while offering technically sound and innovative advice. RVKS And Associates follows a proactive, value-added approach guided by the S.A.V.E framework (Solutions, Accessibility, Value, Education) to support clients in achieving their personal and corporate goals. Services are tailored to the specific needs of each client, with a focus on practical business and tax advice along with robust compliance support.
  
**Role Description**
The Articled Assistant will support audit, assurance, taxation, and accounting engagements under the guidance of senior team members. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting in statutory and tax audits, preparing working papers and documentation, performing ledger scrutiny, and supporting the preparation of financial statements and tax returns. title: Head of Partnerships
description:
**About Us:**

Solinas, a deep-tech startup incubated at IIT Madras, is India’s pioneering asset management venture

transforming the water and sanitation sector. Recognized and commended by Prime Minister Narendra

Modi, Solinas is on a mission to tackle pressing challenges such as manual scavenging, water

accessibility, and the prevention of floods and sewer overflows. At the core of our vision lies a

commitment to developing homegrown, affordable robotics and AI solutions for pipeline inspections,

manhole and septic tank cleaning, and underground asset management.

Since 2018, we have transformed operations across 30+ cities, earning accolades such as Best On-

Campus Startup by the Economic Times, an appearance on Shark Tank India, and partnerships with

industry leaders like Ashirvad Pipes and The/Nudge Institute. On the global stage, Solinas has been

named Best Southeast Asian Startup by Imagine H2O — a testament to our innovation, impact, and

purpose-driven growth

**About the role:**

Solinas Integrity has successfully deployed its technologies across the Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene

(WASH) sector in more than 30 cities across India. Our products and solutions have demonstrated strong

market adoption, and strategic partnerships play a critical role in accelerating growth, expanding market

access, and driving ecosystem impact. This role has been created to lead and scale these efforts.

We are looking for a seasoned partnerships leader to build, own, and scale one of Solinas' most strategic

and commercially important functions—partnerships, ecosystem engagement, and stakeholder

management. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of business

development, strategic alliances, and market expansion.

This role carries direct revenue responsibility and ownership of partnership-driven business outcomes.

You will manage the complete partnership lifecycle—from identifying opportunities and originating

partnerships to structuring engagements, driving execution, and securing renewals. The role reports

directly to the CEO and offers the opportunity to shape a key growth engine for the company.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Corporate & institutional partnerships**

a. Build and deepen strategic relationships with large corporations, industry bodies, and

government entities across the water and urban infrastructure landscape to expand

Solinas’ footprint and revenue base.

b. Partner with EPC companies to co-develop and orchestrate large-scale infrastructure

projects — embedding Solinas' technology as the innovation layer within complex, high-

value water and sanitation project delivery.

c. Manage the full partnership lifecycle: prospecting, structuring, negotiation, agreement

closure, renewals, and account expansion.

d. Lead the structuring and closure of high-value agreements — tenders, B2B2G accounts,

MoUs, and CSR partnerships — working in close coordination with the operations and

commercial teams.

e. Structure and close partnership agreements — including tenders, B2B2G accounts, and

MoUs — collaborating closely with operations and commercial teams.

**2. Startup & innovation ecosystem**

a. Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with startups, academic institutions, and

technology partners in high-potential areas — NRW reduction, IoT sensors, hydraulic

modelling, and beyond.

b. Scout and engage co-innovation opportunities that can be packaged as joint solutions

for government and industrial buyers.

c. Represent Solinas across accelerators, incubators, and government-backed innovation

programmes to keep the company visible and connected within the startup ecosystem.

**3. Stakeholder community building**

a. Build and nurture a strong ecosystem of stakeholders — including investors, NGOs,

MNCs, think tanks, government ministries, and startups — focused on Water, WASH,

Climate, and Urban Resilience.

b. Develop and execute a community strategy through content, industry convenings, and

strategic collaborations to position Solinas as the most credible and connected player in

the Indian water-tech ecosystem.

c. Establish and deepen strategic relationships with key ecosystem stakeholders to drive

partnerships, policy engagement, and market access opportunities.

d. Create structured pipelines to convert community engagement and ecosystem

partnerships into commercial opportunities and long-term business growth.

**4. Team leadership**

a. Manage and mentor a small partnerships team, setting clear goals, processes, and KPIs

to ensure consistent delivery and growth.

**Qualification:**

● 8+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or ecosystem roles, ideally across

climate, water, urban infrastructure, social impact, or deep-tech sectors.

● A proven dealmaker with experience in structuring and closing complex agreements involving

corporates, government bodies, or development-sector organizations.

title: Senior Analyst - SAM
description:
**Role:**
Senior SAM Licensing Consultant / Software License Compliance Specialist

**Experience:**
4–8 years overall, with at least 4 years of hands-on SAM and software licensing experience

**Location:**
India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

1. Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Software Asset Management (SAM) Licensing Consultant with strong functional expertise in software license entitlement management, license compliance, Effective License Position (ELP) calculations, licensing optimisation and audit support.

The candidate must have extensive hands-on experience interpreting complex software licensing rules, analysing software deployments and consumption, reconciling license entitlements, and identifying compliance risks and cost-optimisation opportunities across major software publishers.

Strong expertise in Microsoft server licensing is mandatory, particularly Windows Server, SQL Server, System Center and Exchange Server. Experience with Adobe, IBM and Oracle Database licensing is also required.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Software Licensing and Compliance

* Analyse software license entitlements, contractual terms, product usage, deployments and consumption to determine the Effective License Position (ELP).
* Interpret publisher licensing policies, product terms, licensing metrics, contract conditions and product use rights.
* Identify license compliance gaps, over-licensing, under-licensing and potential financial exposure.
* Perform license reconciliation, compliance calculations, risk assessments and optimisation analysis.
* Prepare licensing reports, compliance positions, audit evidence and management recommendations.
* Evaluate licensing implications arising from virtualisation, cloud migration, infrastructure changes and software upgrades.

B. Microsoft Server Licensing — Mandatory Core Expertise

Demonstrate strong functional licensing knowledge across:

* **Windows Server:**
  Standard and Datacenter editions, physical-core licensing, virtualisation rights, host-level licensing and Client Access Licenses (CALs).
* **Microsoft SQL Server:**
  Per-core and Server + CAL licensing, Standard and Enterprise editions, virtual-machine licensing, high availability and licensing implications of virtualisation.
* **System Center:**
  Management licensing, management servers and management licenses (MLs), applicable product editions and licensing dependencies.
* **Exchange Server:**
  Server licensing, Standard and Enterprise CALs, feature entitlements and applicable deployment requirements.
* Microsoft Enterprise Agreements (EA), Software Assurance, licensing entitlements, product use rights and relevant contract terms.

The candidate must be able to independently assess Microsoft licensing scenarios and explain the rationale behind compliance calculations.

C. Adobe Product Licensing

* Understand Adobe Creative Cloud, Acrobat and other applicable Adobe enterprise products.
* Analyse named-user, device-based and other applicable licensing arrangements.
* Reconcile assigned licenses, user entitlements, deployment data and usage information.
* Support Adobe license compliance reviews, entitlement validation and license optimisation.

D. IBM Software Licensing

* Interpret IBM software licensing metrics and entitlement terms, including Processor Value Unit (PVU), Virtual Processor Core (VPC), Resource Value Unit (RVU) and other applicable metrics.
* Understand IBM sub-capacity licensing, virtualisation environments and ILMT (IBM License Metric Tool) reporting requirements.
* Analyse IBM software deployments and entitlements to identify compliance exposure.
* Support IBM license audits, compliance assessments and evidence preparation.

E. Oracle Database Licensing

* Demonstrate knowledge of Oracle Database licensing, including Processor and Named User Plus (NUP) metrics.
* Analyse Oracle Database editions, options, management packs and associated licensing dependencies.
* Understand the impact of physical and virtual infrastructure, partitioning, clustering and deployment architecture on licensing.
* Interpret Oracle contractual terms, applicable licensing policies and entitlement documentation.
* Support Oracle license compliance assessments, audit preparation and risk mitigation.

Oracle ERP, E-Business Suite, Fusion Middleware and Java licensing experience will be an added advantage.

F. Software Audit and Publisher Engagement Support

* Support internal software compliance reviews and external publisher audit or licence verification exercises.
* Collect and validate deployment, entitlement, usage and contractual evidence.
* Prepare ELP statements, compliance workbooks, audit evidence packs and remediation plans.
* Analyse publisher claims and reconcile identified gaps against contractual entitlements and applicable licensing terms.
* Assist in developing remediation strategies, risk mitigation recommendations and licence optimisation opportunities.

G. SAM Tools and Data Analysis

* Hands-on experience with Flexera One / FlexNet Manager Suite (FNMS), Snow License Manager or equivalent SAM platforms.
* Understand software inventory, application recognition, license reconciliation, entitlement management and compliance calculations.
* Validate discovery and inventory data against licensing requirements and publisher rules.
* Analyse SAM tool outputs, identify data-quality gaps and translate technical findings into actionable licensing recommendations.

3. Mandatory Skills and Qualifications

* 4- 8 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 4 years in SAM, software licensing or license compliance.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Windows Server and SQL Server licensing.
* Practical experience with System Center and Exchange Server licensing.
* Experience in Adobe, IBM and Oracle Database license compliance and entitlement analysis.
* Demonstrated experience preparing or reviewing ELP calculations and software compliance reports.
* Experience supporting software audits, publisher compliance reviews or internal audit exercises.
* Knowledge of SAM governance, policies, processes and operating models.
* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise SAM tool, preferably Flexera FNMS or Snow License Manager.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Simulation Engineer – Plastics Processing
description:
**Position Overview**
At Ascend Performance Materials, we are seeking a simulation Engineer specializing in injection molding simulation to join our highly skilled team of industry professionals and support our continued growth in engineering plastics.
  
  
As a member of the Ascend Performance Materials team, the simulation Engineer will conduct injection molding process simulations using Autodesk Moldflow to support product development, material selection, and customer applications involving polyamide materials. This role will provide technical expertise in mold filling, packing, cooling, warpage prediction, fiber orientation, and manufacturability assessment. The position will work closely with customers, application engineers, material scientists, and commercial teams to optimize part and mold designs, troubleshoot molding issues, and accelerate successful product launches.
  
  
This is an in-person position based in Chennai, India, and reports to the Global Application Development Manager.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct injection molding simulations including fill, pack, cool, warp, fiber orientation, sink mark, weld line, air trap, and shrinkage analyses for thermoplastic components.
* Support existing core applications and strategic growth initiatives by leveraging Autodesk Moldflow simulation tools to predict and optimize the processing performance of Ascend's materials in customer applications.
* Collaborate with regional CAE and application development engineers to develop, review, and manage material characterization data, simulation models, technical analyses, and customer presentations.
* Evaluate part designs, gate locations, runner systems, cooling layouts, and processing conditions to improve manufacturability, part quality, and cycle time.
* Validate and correlate simulation results with molding trials, dimensional measurements, and customer production data to improve model accuracy and predictive capability.
* Plan, execute, and manage simulation activities to support project timelines and key customer development milestones.
* Conduct engineering analyses to support root cause investigations related to molding defects, dimensional instability, warpage, sink marks, short shots, weld lines, and other processing-related issues.
* Provide technical consultation to internal teams and external customers on injection molding best practices, mold design optimization, and process development.
* Support material selection activities by evaluating the molding behavior and processing robustness of Ascend materials in customer applications.
* Develop and implement innovative simulation methodologies, workflows, and best practices to support emerging applications, advanced manufacturing technologies, and new customer opportunities.
* Communicate technical findings and recommendations effectively through simulation reports, technical presentations, customer meetings, and training sessions.
* Support customer visits, mold trials, and troubleshooting activities when required.

**Required Experience**

* Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Polymer Engineering, Plastics Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline from an accredited university.
* 7 years of experience in injection molding simulation, plastics processing, or CAE engineering within the automotive, consumer goods, electrical/electronics, or general industrial sectors.
* Strong understanding of thermoplastic injection molding processes, mold design principles, and polymer processing behavior.
* Hands-on experience with Autodesk Moldflow Insight.
* Experience performing and interpreting filling, packing, cooling, warpage, fiber orientation, and shrinkage analyses.

title: R&D engineer - Refrigeration and HVAC
description:
**Job Title:**
Engineer - HVAC & Refrigeration (AWG R&D)

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Job Type:**
Full-Time

**Experience:**
1-3 Years

**CTC:**
4.5 LPA - 6 LPA

**Industry:**
Climate-Tech / WaterTech / HVAC & Refrigeration

**About the Company**

We are hiring for a climate-tech company developing innovative water-generation and

thermal technologies.

The company is working on products that combine refrigeration, thermal engineering and

multidisciplinary systems to address real-world water and sustainability challenges.

Work on the design, testing and optimization of refrigeration and HVAC systems for

Atmospheric Water Generation (AWG) products.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an HVAC & Refrigeration Engineer to join the R&D / Product Engineering

team.

The role involves hands-on work across refrigeration system design, testing, optimization

and troubleshooting. You will work on vapor-compression refrigeration systems and

contribute to improving system performance, energy efficiency, reliability and overall product

performance.

This role would suit someone who enjoys working with physical systems, prototypes and test

equipment and is comfortable moving between design, experimentation, analysis and

troubleshooting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Refrigeration System Design & Optimization**

● Design and optimize vapor-compression refrigeration systems.

● Perform refrigeration cycle analysis and system-level performance calculations.

● Select and size compressors, evaporators, condensers, expansion devices, fans and

related components.

● Optimize refrigerant charge, superheat, subcooling and operating parameters.

● Analyze cooling capacity, COP and overall system energy performance.

**Thermal & Condensation Engineering**

● Analyze heat transfer and condensation processes.

● Work on evaporator, airflow and heat-exchanger performance.

● Apply psychrometric and dew-point concepts to system performance.

● Identify opportunities to improve condensation and energy efficiency.

**Testing & Experimental Development**

● Design and conduct refrigeration and thermal performance tests.

● Develop test procedures and performance benchmarks.

● Collect and analyze temperature, pressure, humidity, airflow, electrical and

system-performance data.

● Prepare technical reports and recommend engineering improvements based on test

results.

**Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis**

● Diagnose refrigeration and thermal issues in prototypes and deployed systems.

● Troubleshoot compressor performance, refrigerant flow, expansion devices, frosting,

pressure and airflow-related issues.

● Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.

● Support technical resolution of field issues when required.

**Product Development**

● Support development and improvement of refrigeration-based products.

● Translate performance requirements into technical specifications.

● Support prototype development, testing and design iterations.

● Evaluate refrigeration components, heat exchangers, refrigerants and related

technologies.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

● Work with mechanical, electrical, controls and other engineering teams.

● Coordinate with manufacturing and service teams to ensure practical and reliable

designs.

● Support technical evaluation of refrigeration components and suppliers.

● Provide technical inputs during product testing and field deployments.

**Required Qualifications**

● B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering,

Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, HVAC, Energy Engineering or a related discipline.

● 1-3 years of relevant industry experience in HVAC, refrigeration, thermal systems,

heat pumps, cooling systems or product engineering.

● Strong understanding of:

○ Vapor-compression refrigeration cycles

○ Thermodynamics

○ Heat transfer

○ Psychrometrics

○ Fluid mechanics

○ Refrigeration system components

○ HVAC system design and troubleshooting

● Practical experience in refrigeration testing, commissioning or troubleshooting.

● Ability to analyze engineering data and identify performance improvement

opportunities.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:

● Compressor selection and performance analysis

● Evaporator and condenser design

● TXV / EEV selection and optimization

● Refrigerant charging and system commissioning

● Pressure-temperature analysis

● Superheat and subcooling measurement

● Psychrometric analysis

● Heat exchanger design

● Refrigeration system simulation

● MATLAB / Python / Excel for engineering analysis

● CoolPack / RefProp / Danfoss selection tools / DWSIM

● SolidWorks / AutoCAD or equivalent CAD tools

● Data acquisition and experimental testing

Experience with commonly used refrigerants would be an added advantage.

**What We're Looking For**

● Strong technical fundamentals with hands-on engineering capability.

● Ability to independently troubleshoot and solve technical problems.

● Comfortable working with machines, prototypes and test equipment.

● Data-driven approach to engineering decisions.

● Interest in energy efficiency and thermal performance.

● Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

● Willingness to work across design, testing and field troubleshooting when required.

**Why Join**

● Work on real-world climate and water technology.

● Hands-on exposure to refrigeration and thermal product development.

● Opportunity to work across multidisciplinary engineering functions.

● High ownership and exposure to product development in an early-stage environment.

● Opportunity to contribute to technology addressing sustainability and resource

challenges.

**Note:**
This is a hands-on engineering role. Candidates should be comfortable working from

the facility and participating in testing, troubleshooting and field activities when required.

Candidates are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in HVAC/refrigeration system

design, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, thermal analysis or product

development in their resumes.

* Proficiency in scripting languages- Python, JSON, Ruby, C#, PowerShell, YAML
* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)
* Define and describe Conjur/Hashicorp architecture, requirements, and workflow
* Integration of Secret Management solution with 3rd party solutions (LDAP/ SIEM)
* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation
* Hands-on experience with CyberArk Privileged Cloud Suite, including migration from on-prem (self-hosted) environments to Privilege Cloud (PCloud), with strong exposure to SIA, SCA, SWS and WPM capabilities.
* Proven experience in implementing and managing SCIM-based provisioning, Single Sign-On (SSO) integrations, and identity lifecycle management within Privilege Cloud.
* Experience in integrating CyberArk solutions with SIEM platforms using secure tunnel configurations to enable centralized logging, monitoring, and compliance reporting.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 3-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

**What We Look For**
Who has hands on experience in setting up the Identity and Access Management environment in standalone and cluster environment.
  
  
Who has hands-on Development experience on Application and Directory Integration, User Provisioning, Okta Workflows, triggers, Rules and customizing the tool as per the requirements.

title: Senior IT Infrastructure Lead
description:
Uniphore is the Business AI company. Our sovereign, composable and secure AI platform connects enterprise data, fine-tunes AI models and deploys agentic AI across the enterprise. We empower every worker to boost productivity and help businesses grow faster, operate smarter and reduce costs. Trusted by more than 2,000 businesses globally, and recognized on the Deloitte Fast 500, Uniphore delivers on the promise of AI as a transformative force for business.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Requirement**

* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network hardware, and enterprise security architecture.
* Must have very good working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 / Azure (Entra ID) platform end-to-end, including Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps and Defender for Endpoint; AWS knowledge is an added advantage.
* Good understanding of core networking concepts (VLANs, layer 2/3 routing, access lists, load balancing) and hands-on experience administering enterprise firewalls (rule management, VPN, NAT, segmentation).
* Ability to think through problems and design solutions across hybrid, cross-platform environments (Windows and macOS); ability to implement, administer, and troubleshoot end-to-end.
* Automate manual processes using AI tools wherever possible, to improve troubleshooting, documentation, and day-to-day infrastructure operations.

**Job Requirements**
**Identity & Hybrid Directory Services**

* Designing, planning, migrating, and implementing Active Directory in environments with 2,500+ users.
* Designing, implementing, and troubleshooting Directory Synchronization and Federation Services (Azure AD Connect / Cloud Sync, ADFS) for Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Managing Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) services including users, groups, device management, Enterprise Applications, App Registrations, and Conditional Access.
* Configuring SSO (SAML, OAuth2/OIDC) integrations and API/App Registrations, including service principals, API permission scopes, and certificate/secret-based authentication.
* DNS/DHCP and Group Policy design.
* Hands-on experience managing DNS records (A, CNAME, MX, TXT, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC) across internal and external DNS zones.
* Designing on-premises AD with Hybrid Azure AD Sync.
* Active Directory hands-on experience in multi-site / multi-domain / multi-forest environments.
* Deep knowledge of Active Directory and Entra ID, including Group Policy, Federation, and Single Sign-On.
* Strong experience with AD enterprise certificate services, rights management server, AD Federation Services, and identity manager.
* Experience with Active Directory consolidation/migration (Quest migration experience and ADMT a plus) and running AD health checks.

title: Cutover SaaS Admin
description:
Job Profile: Application Runbook Administrator (Cutover SaaS) Automated Runbook Technology for Enterprise Applications | Cutover.
  
  
IT Disaster Recovery (ITDR) Automation Software | Cutover
  
  
Automated Runbook Technology for Enterprise Applications | Cutover
  
  
This document defines the role, responsibilities, and qualifications for an Application Runbook Administrator supporting Client’s use of the Cutover SaaS product. It outlines key competencies, stakeholder interactions, and success measures to drive consistent, auditable, and high-quality runbook execution for releases and operational events.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Position Title: Application Runbook Administrator (Cutover SaaS)**
Role Summary: The Application Runbook Administrator is responsible for administering and operationalizing Client’s Cutover SaaS platform to plan, build, govern, and execute runbooks for application recovery, environment changes, and key operational events. This role ensures runbooks are accurate, standardized, auditable, and aligned to change management and IT resilience practices, enabling predictable cutovers and reduced operational risk.
  
  
Reporting/Alignment: Aligned to the IT Resilience Team (Disaster Recovery Team), partnering closely with application owners, infrastructure/Cloud teams, QA, InfoSec, and Service Management.
  
  
Primary Focus: Cutover runbook lifecycle management (build, maintain, execute, improve).
  
  
Core Value: Improve execution consistency, visibility, and auditability for resilience validation and critical events.
  
  
Scope: Enterprise applications, shared services, and cross-team dependencies where coordinated task execution is required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The Application Runbook Administrator owns day-to-day Cutover administration and enables delivery teams to produce high-quality runbooks that are ready for controlled execution.
  
  
Administer Cutover workspaces, runbook templates, user access/roles, and configuration in alignment with Client’s policies.
  
  
Build and maintain standardized runbook templates (e.g., DR test, migration events) including phase structure, task types, and required metadata.
  
  
Partner with application and platform teams to capture end-to-end cutover steps, dependencies, owners, prerequisites, validation checks, and rollback procedures.
  
  
Ensure runbooks meet governance standards: completeness, naming conventions, task clarity, time estimates, sequencing, and required approvals.
  
  
Coordinate cutover readiness reviews and dry runs; confirm execution owners, communications plan, and validation criteria are in place.
  
  
Lead or facilitate runbook execution in Cutover: launch events, manage task progression, monitor blockers, maintain real-time status, and ensure timely escalations.
  
  
Integrate Cutover usage with broader release/change processes (e.g., change records, release calendars, maintenance windows) and maintain traceability for audits.
  
  
Manage Cutover reporting and dashboards: runbook status, completion metrics, cycle time, missed steps, and post-event outcomes.
  
  
Maintain runbook documentation and knowledge articles; provide training and coaching for new teams adopting Cutover.
  
  
Drive continuous improvement via post-implementation reviews (PIRs), lessons learned, and template/process enhancements.
  
  

* Intake: Receive request for a new/updated runbook and confirm scope, timeline, and stakeholders.
* Build: Draft or update runbook in Cutover using approved templates and required controls.
* Review: Conduct readiness review with owners; ensure validations, communications, and rollback are defined.
* Execute: Facilitate the event; track progress, handle escalations, and provide leadership updates.
* Close: Capture results, evidence, and lessons learned; update templates and artifacts.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**
This role requires strong operational discipline, cross-functional coordination, and proficiency with runbook-driven execution in regulated environments.
  
  
Experience administering or power-using Cutover.
  
  
Hands-on experience with IT Resilience, Incident Management (ITIL), and production support practices.
  
  
Ability to translate technical procedures into clear, executable, step-by-step tasks with well-defined ownership and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills (coordinating cross-team tasks).
  
  
Knowledge of SDLC concepts, environment management, and deployment patterns (e.g., blue/green, rolling, canary) at a conceptual level.
  
  
Familiarity with incident/problem management and post-event review practices.
  
  
Strong attention to detail, documentation rigor, and an audit-ready mindset.
  
  
Comfort working in fast-paced schedules, including after-hours maintenance windows when needed.
  
  
**Skill Area**
**What Good Looks Like**
**Examples**
Runbook Quality
  
  
Tasks are unambiguous, sequenced, owned, and validated
  
  
Pre-checks, execution steps, validation, and rollback are all included
  
  
Execution Leadership
  
  
Keeps teams aligned and unblocks quickly
  
  
Real-time status updates; escalates risks early; manages dependencies
  
  
Governance
  
  
Traceability and evidence are captured consistently
  
  
Approvals recorded; artifacts linked; completion evidence retained
  
  
Communication
  
  
Clear and concise updates to technical and non-technical audiences
  
  
Leadership summaries; cutover bridge updates; stakeholder notifications

title: Sr IT Security Specialist
description:
**Overview**
The Sr. IT Security Specialist serves as a senior technical authority and key operational lead within the IT Security Team. Scaled for an experienced security practitioner (9–15 years of experience), this role bridges tactical security operations, advanced incident handling, and cross-functional security guidance.
  
  
While remaining hands-on and technical, the Sr. Specialist exercises broad independent judgment, takes ownership of enterprise risk mitigation, drives root-cause elimination, and guides junior and mid-level team members. The role works closely with Infrastructure, Network, OT, and Compliance teams to maintain resilient systems, optimize security controls, and strengthen the overall posture of the enterprise.
  
  
**Targeted Outcomes (12 Months)**

* Escalation & Operational Leadership: Act as the primary technical escalation point for junior and mid-level security staff, complex operational questions, and severe security events.
* Advanced Incident Management: Independently lead high-complexity security event investigations, forensic analysis, and end-to-end response coordination.
* Root-Cause Elimination: Drive deep-dive postmortems for recurring security issues and implement systemic long-term remediation actions.
* Process & Control Refinement: Lead initiatives to refine SIEM/EDR detection rules, security metrics, reporting frameworks, and incident response playbooks.
* Autonomous Project Delivery: Support major security engineering projects and infrastructure improvements with minimal supervision, strong decision-making, and high execution quality.

**Primary Focus**

* Advanced incident handling, forensic investigation, and escalation
* Mentorship, peer guidance, and technical leadership
* Root cause analysis, trend identification, and postmortem engineering
* Security monitoring, detection, and process optimization
* Cross-functional coordination across IT, Network, Cloud, and OT environments

**Key Responsibilities**
**Advanced Operations & Escalation**

* Provide expert guidance to junior and mid-level security resources, serving as the senior point of escalation within the IT Security Team.
* Perform advanced daily security telemetry analysis using modern SIEM, EDR, NDR, and threat intelligence tools, quickly isolating high-risk threats from background noise.
* Respond to, resolve, or escalate complex security incidents, including high-severity events escalated by the MDR provider.

**Incident Response & Forensic Analysis**

* Investigate enterprise security violations and lead thorough postmortem analyses to identify systemic vulnerabilities, threat trends, and remediation opportunities.
* Support updates and continuous testing for Incident Response (IR) and Disaster Recovery (DR) plans.
* Participate in a senior-tier on-call rotation for critical incident escalations.

**Vulnerability Management & Threat Mitigation**

* Research emerging cyber threats and zero-day vulnerabilities, translating threat intelligence into proactive defense measures.
* Review, prioritize, and execute remediation strategies for penetration test and vulnerability assessment findings.
* Recommend, schedule, or apply critical security fixes, patches, and defensive controls in response to active risks or breaches.

**Enterprise & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with the Infrastructure Team to secure and ensure the integrity of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Partner with the Network Team to maintain the security integrity of WAN, LAN, telephony systems, and Operational Technology (OT) networks.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders to align daily security operations with the enterprise-wide risk management framework.

**Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Produce executive-level monthly exception, metrics, and incident reporting to inform leadership on enterprise security posture.
* Support annual IT security audits, regulatory compliance inquiries, and customer security assessments.
* Monitor policy adherence across the enterprise and execute corrective action plans where non-conformities are identified.
* Manage incident and change request service levels (SLAs) according to IT service management guidelines.
* Develop, standardize, and maintain technical documentation for security platforms and operational procedures.

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 7 to 13 years of hands-on experience in IT security, security operations (SOC), threat management, or security engineering.
* Demonstrated track record of leading complex security investigations, root-cause analyses, and cross-functional remediation projects.
* Proven experience working across diverse environments, including on-premises infrastructure, cloud workloads, and network/OT environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Advanced industry certifications preferred (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, CEH, or CCSP).

**Key Skills & Capabilities**

* Technical Proficiency: Deep working knowledge of security operations, modern SIEM/EDR tools, threat hunting methodologies, network security protocols, and security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK).
* Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to collaborate with and influence infrastructure, network, and application teams without formal authority.
* Problem Solving & Agility: Strong analytical skills with the ability to remain calm, focused, and decisive in time-sensitive incident scenarios.
* Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a natural propensity for mentoring peer engineers and explaining complex risks to non-technical stakeholders.

**Work Environment**

* On-Call Availability: Requires participation in an on-call rotation to respond to high-severity security incidents.
* Travel: Occasional travel (5–10%) may be required for conferences, business audits, or site assessments.
* Autonomy: Demands high independent judgment while operating effectively within a collaborative enterprise team.

* Support incident response and investigation activities, including evidence collection, documentation, escalation, and lessons learned reviews.

* Good understanding of network security tools such as firewalls and NIDS

* Previous security work with PCI DSS compliant environment

title: Research Associate - Medical Devices & Imaging
description:
**About The Team / Practice Area**
The Medical Devices & Imaging cluster within TechVision tracks emerging and disruptive technologies transforming diagnosis, intervention, monitoring, rehabilitation, and care delivery. The team connects scientific and engineering advances with clinical needs, regulatory pathways, adoption dynamics, commercial potential, and growth opportunities across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our analysts engage with medical-device and imaging companies, healthcare providers, clinicians, researchers, universities, startups, investors, regulators, standards bodies, technology developers, and manufacturing partners. This ecosystem perspective helps the team evaluate technology maturity, clinical utility, competitive differentiation, implementation barriers, and routes to commercialization.
  
  
The cluster delivers syndicated research, technology scouting, opportunity assessments, benchmarking and prioritization studies, innovator and partner landscapes, growth opportunity analysis, executive briefings, workshops, and customized consulting engagements for medtech, diagnostics, imaging, digital health, life-science, and healthcare organizations.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Research Associate is a full-time entry-level position, ideal for a recent graduate or a candidate with 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in medical devices, biomedical engineering, medical imaging, diagnostics, digital health, healthcare research, life sciences, market intelligence, or a related field.
  
  
The associate will support the Medical Devices & Imaging cluster by conducting primary and secondary research, tracking technology and innovation signals, evaluating companies and ecosystems, and developing high-quality client deliverables. The role requires the ability to understand both the technical and business dimensions of healthcare innovation and translate complex evidence into clear implications, growth opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
  
  
Core Areas of Focus
  
  

* Advanced diagnostics and point-of-care testing
* Medical imaging, including X-ray, ultrasound, MRI, CT, optical and hybrid imaging
* AI-enabled diagnostics, image analysis, clinical decision support and workflow automation
* Connected medical devices, remote patient monitoring, wearables and digital biomarkers
* Surgical robotics, image-guided interventions, navigation and visualization technologies
* Minimally invasive devices, endoscopy and interventional technologies
* Implantable, bioelectronic, neuromodulation and drug-delivery devices
* Personalized, home-based, virtual and decentralized care technologies
* Rehabilitation, assistive, ophthalmic, hearing and vision-care technologies
* Smart materials, sensors, microfluidics, electronics and manufacturing enablers for medical devices

**Responsibilities**
Research and Analysis
  
  

* Monitor and analyze emerging technologies, clinical innovations, product developments, regulatory milestones, patents, scientific publications, funding activity, partnerships, acquisitions, and commercialization signals across medical devices and imaging.
* Conduct structured secondary research using peer-reviewed literature, clinical-trial registries, patent databases, company disclosures, regulatory databases, government and health-agency publications, conference materials, and credible industry sources.
* Support primary research through interviews with clinicians, researchers, device manufacturers, technology developers, startups, investors, healthcare providers, and other subject matter experts.
* Assess technology readiness, clinical utility, unmet need, differentiation, adoption potential, regulatory considerations, reimbursement context, scalability, and commercial relevance.
* Develop technology landscapes, value-chain maps, ecosystem assessments, company profiles, innovation benchmarks, and opportunity-prioritization frameworks.
* Identify emerging signals and technology convergence across medical devices, imaging, AI, sensors, microelectronics, materials, advanced manufacturing, and digital health.
* Evaluate innovations across the care continuum, including pre-hospital, hospital, post-acute, remote, and home-based care settings.
* Analyze the implications of emerging technologies for R&D strategy, product portfolios, partnerships, market entry, care pathways, and future growth.
* Maintain research trackers and evidence repositories with strong source traceability, data accuracy, and consistent taxonomy.

Content Development
  
  

* Produce high-quality research reports, technology assessments, executive summaries, presentations, dashboards, and client-ready deliverables.
* Translate scientific, engineering, clinical, regulatory, and commercial evidence into clear narratives, visuals, frameworks, and recommendations.
* Contribute to syndicated research and customized consulting projects covering technology scouting, benchmarking, prioritization, partner identification, innovation strategy, and growth opportunity analysis.
* Support cluster intelligence by converting research into client propositions, executive briefings, strategic workshops, and opportunity themes.
* Identify potential innovators, startups, research institutions, suppliers, technology partners, and best-practice companies relevant to client priorities.
* Contribute to thought leadership, webinars, client presentations, conference materials, and other external-facing content.

Stakeholder Engagement and Delivery
  
  

* Work closely with global research teams, sector specialists, account teams, and cross-cluster experts to build integrated perspectives.
* Manage key stakeholders by sector and practice area to ensure expectations are met or exceeded and timelines are followed.
* Support expert interviews, client discussions, research validation, workshops, and presentation of findings.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables and maintain high standards of technical accuracy, analytical rigor, consistency, and presentation quality.
* Work effectively with a global team to create a strong customer experience and contribute to the broader growth strategy of the business.

**Preferred Research And Technology Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; working knowledge of Power BI or other visualization tools is desirable.
* Familiarity with scientific-literature, patent, clinical-trial, regulatory, company, funding, and market-intelligence databases.
* Ability to interpret medical-device and imaging technology concepts, clinical workflows, technical specifications, performance evidence, and product-development pathways.
* Understanding of technology readiness levels, innovation scouting, technology benchmarking, opportunity prioritization, competitor analysis, and ecosystem mapping.
* Awareness of medical-device quality and regulatory concepts, including risk classification, clinical evidence, validation, and post-market considerations, is desirable.
* Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative evidence and communicate findings through clear frameworks, scorecards, charts, and visual storytelling.
* Ability to use AI-powered research and productivity tools responsibly to improve research efficiency, synthesis, and quality.

Required Competencies
  
  
Education
  
  
UG: B.E./B.Tech in Biomedical, Biotechnology, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Computer Science, Medical Electronics, or a related engineering discipline; or B.Sc./B.Pharm in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Medical Technology, Radiologic/Imaging Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related field.
  
  
PG preferred: M.E./M.Tech, M.Sc., M.Pharm, MBA, MPH, or an equivalent qualification in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Medical Technology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Healthcare Management, or a related discipline.
  
  
Professional and Personal Skills
  
  

* Excellent analytical, research, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to synthesize technical, clinical, regulatory, and commercial information from diverse sources and identify meaningful patterns.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop concise, evidence-based, and compelling business content.
* Curiosity about medical technology, clinical innovation, patient needs, healthcare delivery, and emerging business models.
* Ability to work with ambiguity and structure complex research questions into practical workplans and outputs.
* Self-motivated, independent, detail-oriented, responsible, and collaborative.
* Well organized, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable working to tight deadlines with remote supervision.
* Disciplined and committed to high-quality standards, source traceability, and data accuracy.
* Strategic thinker who understands how research and operational activities support client value and business growth.
* Adaptable and able to learn new technologies, clinical areas, research tools, and analytical approaches quickly.

What Will Make You Succeed at Frost & Sullivan?
  
  
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have a genuine interest in medical devices, diagnostics, imaging, digital health, and healthcare innovation.
* Can connect technical advances with clinical needs, adoption realities, and commercial opportunities.
* Enjoy investigating emerging technologies and identifying innovators before opportunities become obvious.
* Balance scientific and analytical rigor with practical business thinking.
* Communicate complex healthcare and technology insights clearly, visually, and persuasively.
* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and a growth mindset.
* Take ownership and consistently deliver accurate, polished, client-ready work.

**Benefits**

* Competitive base salary plus bonus opportunity.
* Attractive Medical and Accident insurance.
* Regional travel opportunities.
* A friendly open environment with a diverse and international operational focus.
* A definite career path with numerous growth opportunities.
* You will be part of a winning, global team that fosters teamwork and an Olympic spirit while enhancing your communication and people skills.
* Encouragement to develop your intellectual curiosity and will be provided the ability to collaborate across all levels of the company across the globe.
* Global awards & recognition opportunities & awards - President Club & Chairman Club Awards
* “Best in class" global team that strives for excellence.
* Matrix structure with high visibility to top leadership
* Growth Coaching University Certification.

**About Frost & Sullivan**
Frost & Sullivan, the Transformational Growth Journey Company, has spent more than 65 years partnering with clients to develop transformational growth strategies by focusing on innovation and growth opportunities driven by disruptive technologies, mega trends, emerging markets and new business models. Today, more than ever before, companies must innovate, not only to survive, but thrive in the future. Our Growth Pipeline Management (GPM) system supports clients by identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities and serves as the foundation for continuous growth. This is your opportunity to be part of a revolutionary global team that truly inspires positive global changes by innovating to zero. Learn more about Frost & Sullivan at www.frost.com

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

* Port-security
* Layer 3 (Foundational)
* Static routing

* Boot issues
* Image upgrade / downgrade support

* Reproducible steps
* Logs
* Network topology
* Customer impact summary\*\*

* Follow HPE support processes, compliance policies, and quality standards.

* Weekly enablement sessions
* Product update briefings

**Required Technical Skills (L1 Level)**
Networking Fundamentals
  
  

* TCP/IP, OSI Model
* Subnetting & IP addressing
* VLANs, Access vs Trunk ports
* STP fundamentals
* Basic routing concepts

**Switching Fundamentals**

* Aruba AOS-CX & AOS-S CLI (basic commands)
* Interface configuration
* VLAN creation & assignment
* PoE configuration basics
* Config save, restore, and image management

**Operating Systems & Tools**

* Basic Linux & Windows troubleshooting
* CLI access via SSH/Telnet/Console
* Log interpretation
* Case management tools (HPE ServiceNow, internal TAC tools)

**Soft Skills & Professional Competencies**

* Strong customer communication & empathy
* Ability to work in high-severity outage situations
* Analytical and structured troubleshooting mindset
* Attention to detail and documentation discipline
* Ability to work in rotational shifts
* Team-oriented with strong collaboration skills

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Networking, or related field
* 2 - 4+ years of experience in:
* o Network operations
* o NOC
* o TAC support
* o Field networking

* ACSA / ACSP
* CCNA / Network+

description:

The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.**
**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.

**(Associate)**

As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world-class technology infrastructure.

The On-site Technology Support Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing multiple technology support activities. This professional demonstrates ability to prioritize tasks, working with multiple software and hardware technologies, in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware).

title: Production Support Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
Citi's Securities Services division is seeking a Senior Production Support Analyst to join the Data & Client Platforms (DCP) Production Support team — a globally distributed, 24×6 function supporting business-critical and client-facing data and reporting platforms across Investor & Issuer Services.
  
  
This is a senior operational role that sits at the intersection of data platform operations, client service delivery, and technology transformation. The DCP PS team supports an expanding portfolio of platforms serving some of the world's largest institutional investors, across multiple geographies and business lines within Investor & Issuer Services.
  
  
The team is actively investing in engineering capability, automation, and AI-assisted operations — making this an opportunity for candidates who want to grow beyond traditional incident management into a forward-looking, engineering-oriented production support function.
  
  
**What You Will Be Working On**
The DCP platform underpins Citi's data distribution, client reporting, and operational data services across Securities Services. You will be supporting a portfolio of proprietary and industry-standard platforms spanning:
  
  

* Client data and reporting platforms — real-time and end-of-day data delivery, client reporting, and operational oversight tools
* Data lake and cloud-native platforms — next-generation cloud data infrastructure built on modern technologies including Snowflake, Apache Kafka, Couchbase, Amazon S3, and DataBricks
* Client-facing digital experience — platforms delivering data, reporting, and instructions to institutional clients via Citi's digital channels
* Entitlements and data access management — infrastructure governing client and user access to data services

The platform is undergoing significant transformation — including migration of applications to modernised digital platforms, consolidation of data services across business lines, and adoption of cloud-native data lake architectures. You will be directly involved in supporting this evolution.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Operations**

* Provide L2 production support across the DCP application portfolio — incident triage, investigation, escalation, and resolution — operating within a global follow-the-sun support model
* Perform start-of-day checks, continuous platform monitoring, and structured regional handovers to ensure seamless 24×6 coverage
* Manage and resolve user and client-reported incidents via ServiceNow, maintaining SLA adherence and clear communication throughout the incident lifecycle

**Client Service & Communication**

* Act as the internal operational point of contact for client-impacting incidents — providing timely, accurate, and professional communication to client-facing teams including Client Services, Technology Relationship Managers, and Operations
* Proactively identify and escalate data quality and service availability issues — contributing to a detect-first operating model that reduces client-reported incidents
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of a centralised service level inventory — ensuring Citi's commitments to institutional clients are tracked, governed, and met

**Platform Stability & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and drive resolution of recurring incident patterns through structured problem management — reducing manual toil and preventing reoccurrence
* Develop and maintain technical runbooks, support documentation, and operational procedures across the platform portfolio
* Contribute to automation and observability initiatives — using tools including Grafana, ITRS, and GCO — to reduce manual effort and improve platform monitoring coverage
* Participate in change management activities including release preparation, deployment support, post-implementation review, and production risk assessments

**Engineering & AI Enablement**

* Actively engage with and adopt AI-assisted tooling for incident troubleshooting, automated investigation, and resiliency gap detection — aligned to Citi's firm-wide AI-driven production management strategy
* Contribute to operational readiness for new platform migrations and onboarding — ensuring production support capability keeps pace with technology evolution
* Partner with development and platform engineering teams to influence upstream design decisions that improve production operability and resilience

**Transformation & Programme Delivery**

* Participate in continuous improvement workstream items spanning automation efficiency, monitoring uplift, resiliency, and application onboarding
* Support DCP's expansion as the central data services hub across Investor & Issuer Services
* Contribute to business continuity planning, contingency testing, and resiliency exercises across the platform portfolio

**Team & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as subject matter expert (SME) for one or more platforms — owning operational knowledge and serving as escalation point for junior team members
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with Development, Platform Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Audit, Infrastructure, and Vendor/Partner teams
* Contributing to the team's reputation as a value-adding, engineering-oriented function

**Experience**
**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 to 8 years in an application support, production management, or platform operations role — preferably within financial services or data-intensive environments
* Hands-on experience supporting data pipelines, reporting platforms, or client-facing financial applications
* Experience working within a global, follow-the-sun support model across multiple time zones
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management processes

**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of SQL and data querying — ability to investigate data quality issues across relational and cloud databases
* Experience with Snowflake, Couchbase, Amazon S3, or DataBricks is advantageous
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling such as Grafana or ITRS or GCO
* Experience with automation scripting (Python, Shell, or equivalent) — ability and willingness to build and maintain operational automation
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms for incident and problem management
* Understanding of cloud-native data architectures — data lakes, streaming pipelines, and event-driven architecture — is advantageous
* Interest in and exposure to AI-assisted operations tooling — agentic triage, automated incident investigation, or intelligent monitoring

**Behavioural & Professional**

* Strong analytical and investigative mindset — able to work through complex, ambiguous production issues methodically and under pressure
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders including client-facing teams and senior management
* Client-first orientation — understands the impact of production issues on institutional clients and takes ownership of communication and resolution
* Proactive and improvement-oriented — actively looks for ways to reduce toil, improve processes, and uplift team capability
* Collaborative — operates effectively in a geographically distributed team with shared accountability for platform health
* Comfortable with ambiguity and change — the DCP platform is in active transformation and the role requires adaptability as scope, technology, and operating model evolve

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline — or equivalent professional experience

**Why Join DCP Production Support at Citi**

* Strategic importance — DCP PS supports Citi's Securities Services data and client experience infrastructure, serving some of the world's largest institutional investors across a platform undergoing major transformation
* Engineering growth — the team is actively investing in automation, AI-assisted operations, and engineering capability — this is a role for candidates who want to grow beyond incident management into a technically sophisticated, forward-looking function
* Global reach — work within a globally distributed follow-the-sun team across EMEA, NAM, and Asia Pacific with genuine cross-regional collaboration and career mobility
* Transformation exposure — direct involvement in major platform programmes including cloud data lake modernisation, client platform migration, and multi-business-line data services consolidation
* AI-forward environment — early involvement in AI-assisted production management tooling aligned to Citi's firm-wide intelligent operations strategy
