**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Application Support (EAS) team is responsible for providing technical application support for ITP and ECS lines of business. Within EAS, the Associate Director Application Support Engineering / SRE Lead (Site Reliability Engineer Lead) is a senior technical role responsible for driving the overall reliability, scalability, and performance of critical systems by implementing standard methodologies, participating in incident response, automating processes, and collaborating with development teams to ensure system stability and uptime across the organization, often acting as a technical partner in promoting a strong SRE culture within the company; key responsibilities include designing monitoring systems, capacity planning, and actively identifying and mitigating potential issues before they impact users.
  
  
The SRE team works closely with development teams, infrastructure and network partners, security partners, Scrum Masters, and internal / external clients to improve observability, operational supportability, resiliency, and mean time to restore service through driving improvements to support capabilities.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Scrum Participation: Join all project collaborators planning and design sessions, sprint zero and stand-ups for all new delivery, to champion SRE requirements reflective of a strong observability and resiliency traits.
* System Reliability Architecture: Drive Design and help implement reliable, resilient, and scalable systems, considering redundancy, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery strategies. Make design recommendations that will allow the application to recover without cleanup activities or create a recovery runbook for application support team to follow for improved application recovery times.
* Monitoring and Alerting: Develop comprehensive monitoring systems to identify potential issues proactively, define actionable alerts, and establish SLIs (Service Level Indicators) and SLOs (Service Level Objectives).
* Incident Management: Lead incident response during critical system outages, facilitating timely problem diagnosis and resolution, conducting post-mortem analysis to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.
* Automation and Tooling: Develop and maintain automation scripts to streamline operational tasks, including self-healing, application deployments, scaling, and infrastructure management.
* Collaboration with Development Teams: Work closely with development teams to integrate SRE practices into the software development lifecycle, promoting code quality, reliability, and observability.
* Security Integration: Collaborate with security teams to ensure system resilience against cyber threats, implementing security best practices and supervising for vulnerabilities.
* Technical Expertise: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to cloud computing, distributed systems, and reliability engineering.
* Operational Readiness: Attend and present operational readiness with application support (EAS L2) at each project management meeting - raise any operational risks and concerns. Test SRE requirements in UAT environments to validate effectiveness and completeness of operational capabilities.
* Risk Management: Partner with IT Embedded Risk Managers to identify strategic solutions for risk incidents.
* Metrics and Reporting: Demonstrate operational improvements through defined KPIs.
* Capacity Planning: Proactively assess system capacity needs, plan for future growth, and implement scaling strategies to ensure optimal performance under high load.
* Performance Optimization: Analyze system performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and implement optimization strategies to improve system responsiveness and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 8 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in one or more programming languages like Python, Java, Go, etc. including the use of AI technology (Amazon Q, Kiro), for automation and development of monitoring and SRE compliance validation tools.
* System Administration: Expertise in Linux/Unix operating systems, network administration, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Mainframe experience is a plus.
* Monitoring and Observability: Deep understanding of monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace, ITSI, etc.) and experience in designing robust monitoring systems.
* Incident Management: Proven track record to participate in incident response teams under pressure, effectively solving complex issues.
* Experience in the financial services industry is good to have

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

IT Cyber Security (India)

None

**What You Will Do**
The Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) Lead is responsible for strengthening the security posture of the organization’s cloud environments across
**Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS)**
. This role leads the implementation, optimization, and operationalization of CSPM capabilities using
**Wiz and related cloud security technologies**
, translating cloud security findings into prioritized, measurable risk reduction.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead CSPM operations across Azure and AWS, including security posture, configuration, identity, vulnerability, and exposure management.
* Establish and maintain secure cloud configurations aligned to CIS, NIST, ISO 27001, and organizational security standards.
* Identify, prioritize, and drive remediation of cloud misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, excessive permissions, exposed services, and toxic-risk combinations.
* Partner with Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Application Security, Infrastructure, IAM, SOC, Vulnerability Management, and GRC teams to remediate security risks.
* Establish policies and automation to reduce manual remediation, improve response times, and eliminate recurring cloud security issues.
* Integrate Wiz findings with SIEM/SOC, vulnerability management, ticketing, and incident response processes.
* Support cloud security architecture reviews, threat modeling, incident response, data protection, and investigations involving AWS and Azure.
* Develop metrics and executive reporting demonstrating cloud risk, remediation trends, control effectiveness, and security posture improvement.
* Mentor engineers and analysts and establish repeatable cloud security engineering practices.

**What You Will Need**

* Microsoft Azure security and architecture
* AWS security and architecture
* Cloud vulnerability and exposure management
* Cloud logging and monitoring
* Security configuration and compliance
* Automation and remediation
* Cloud security architecture

* Cloud IAM and least privilege

title: Field Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

EVtron Tech is a startup focused on designing, manufacturing, and deploying electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions for logistics fleets, factories, and commercial facilities.

Our mission is to accelerate India’s transition to sustainable mobility through reliable EV charging hardware, smart charging software, and turnkey deployment solutions.

We manufacture our own EV chargers and develop an in-house Charging Management System (CMS) that enables operators to monitor and manage charging infrastructure through web and mobile platforms.

**Role Description**

We are looking for an
**EV Charger Installation & Field Service Engineer**
to join our growing team and support the installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance of EV charging infrastructure across customer locations.

This is a hands-on technical role suited for diploma holders and ITI candidates with an interest in electrical systems, troubleshooting, and emerging EV charging technology.

The role involves personally carrying out basic installation and troubleshooting activities, coordinating with electricians and electrical contractors, verifying installation quality, commissioning chargers, and resolving technical issues at customer sites. You will also work with our engineering team to diagnose charger-related issues and perform basic firmware flashing and configuration using a laptop.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in the field, willing to learn how EV charging systems operate, and capable of taking ownership of technical issues until they are resolved.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install and commission EV chargers at customer locations, including logistics fleets, factories, and commercial facilities.
* Coordinate with electricians and contractors to ensure safe, timely, and quality installation.
* Inspect sites for electrical readiness, including wiring, cable routing, earthing, protection devices, and charger mounting.
* Perform basic electrical installation, testing, and troubleshooting wherever required.
* Diagnose charger issues related to power supply, charging interruptions, connectivity, and configuration.
* Understand EV charging fundamentals and identify whether issues originate from the charger, electrical installation, vehicle, or Charging Management System (CMS).
* Use a laptop to perform basic firmware flashing, charger configuration, and software updates using company-provided tools.
* Verify charger connectivity with the CMS and assist with charging session testing and commissioning.
* Coordinate with customers and internal engineering teams to resolve technical issues, including remote troubleshooting with electricians.
* Support preventive maintenance, service visits, warranty assessments, and installation audits.
* Maintain site photographs, installation checklists, commissioning reports, and service records.
* Follow electrical safety procedures and ensure installations comply with company standards and applicable requirements.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline. ITI Electrician candidates with relevant experience may also apply.
* 0–2 years of experience in electrical installation, maintenance, field service, or commissioning. Freshers with strong practical aptitude are welcome.
* Basic understanding of single-phase and three-phase systems, wiring, earthing, MCBs, distribution boards, and electrical safety.
* Basic laptop and computer skills, with a willingness to learn firmware flashing, device configuration, and diagnostic tools.
* Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues methodically.
* Good communication and coordination skills to work with customers, electricians, contractors, and internal teams.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites and perform hands-on fieldwork as required.
* Experience in EV charging, solar installations, industrial electrical systems, electrical testing tools, or basic network troubleshooting is an added advantage. A valid two-wheeler driving licence is preferred.

**It's a Plus If You Have**

* Experience in EV charger installation, solar installations, industrial electrical systems, or automation projects.
* Experience coordinating electricians, electrical contractors, or installation teams.
* Familiarity with electrical testing tools such as multimeters, clamp meters, and insulation testers.
* Basic troubleshooting experience with electrical equipment.
* Basic knowledge of firmware flashing, device configuration, or diagnostic software.
* A valid two-wheeler driving licence.
* Startup experience or the ability to handle multiple responsibilities independently.
* A genuine interest in electric mobility and sustainable infrastructure.

**Why Join EVtron?**

* Be part of India's growing EV charging infrastructure ecosystem.
* Gain hands-on experience with EV charging hardware manufactured in-house.
* Learn about charger commissioning, troubleshooting, firmware, and charging management software.
* Work closely with the engineering team to solve real-world technical challenges.
* Take ownership of field deployments and grow into technical support, field service, or project execution roles.

**How to Apply?**

Interested candidates can send their resume to careers@evtron.in with the subject line:

📩
**Application for**
**EV Charger Installation & Field Service Engineer**
**– [Your Name]**

Applicants are encouraged to mention their experience in electrical installations, site supervision, industrial maintenance, EV charging, solar installations, commissioning activities, or any other relevant field experience.

Sloan Global offers end-to-end project management, design, and engineering services, including structural engineering, steel and concrete design, steel and rebar detailing, fabrication shop drawings, drafting, and MEP engineering. The company maintains a strong commitment to quality and is known for its energy, innovation, and high-performing teams that consistently deliver reliable results to clients.
  
**Role Description**
The Tekla Modeler (AISC) & Senior Detailer is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Chennai Area. In this position, the team member will create and manage 3D models in Tekla Structures following AISC standards, producing accurate shop and erection drawings for structural steel projects. The role involves reviewing design drawings and specifications, coordinating with engineers and project managers, and resolving detailing issues to ensure constructability and compliance with project requirements. The Tekla Modeler & Senior Detailer will check and verify model accuracy, perform clash detection, and support fabrication and installation teams with clear, timely documentation. Day-to-day work includes maintaining drawing logs, adhering to quality and safety standards, and participating in project meetings to support schedules and deliverables.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong proficiency in Tekla Structures modeling and detailing for structural steel, with practical experience applying AISC standards.
* Experience interpreting structural and architectural drawings, including steel and concrete design, steel and rebar detailing, and fabrication shop drawings.
* Ability to produce clear, accurate erection and shop drawings, perform clash detection, and coordinate details with engineering and project teams.
* Understanding of construction and fabrication workflows, including common connections, materials, tolerances, and industry detailing practices.
* Relevant technical education such as a diploma or degree in Civil/Structural Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced project environment.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with engineers, project managers, fabricators, and site teams.
* Familiarity with other detailing or CAD tools and basic knowledge of codes and standards beyond AISC is an advantage.

title: Payment Analyst
description:
Step into the role of Payment Analyst at Barclays, where you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the future. In this pivotal role you will manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives, and compliance with relevant regulators. You will take ownership of your work, ensuring it aligns with the relevant rules & regulations, and codes of conduct.
  
  
You will focus on for processing international payment transactions accurately and efficiently while ensuring compliance with global banking regulations, operational procedures, and service level agreements. The incumbent will manage SWIFT and payment messaging activities, support payment investigations, and contribute to process improvements in a fast-paced, shift-based environment within Barclays.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role such as:
  
  
  

* Process domestic and international payment transactions with speed, accuracy, and in accordance with approved procedures and regulatory requirements.
* Handle and validate SWIFT messages including MT103, MT202, MT199/299, MT192/292, as well as XML payment messages such as PACS.008 and PACS.009.
* Monitor and adhere to currency cut-off timings, service level agreements (SLAs), and quality control standards.
* Investigate and resolve payment-related queries using SWIFT, CHIPS, FED, and CAMT message formats (Camt056, Camt110, Camt111, etc.).
* Identify process improvement opportunities and actively contribute ideas to enhance operational efficiency and client experience.

**Desirable Skills Set**

* Strong knowledge of SWIFT messaging standards, payment processing, and correspondent banking operations.
* Detailed understanding of SWIFT fields/tags, CHIPS, FED payments, IBAN structures, and international payment regulations.
* Experience with ISO 20022 XML messages including PACS and CAMT formats.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
* Ability to work effectively in night shifts and manage high-volume transaction processing environments.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Chennai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support business areas with day-to-day processing, reviewing, reporting, trading and issue resolution.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Support various business areas with day-to-day initiatives including processing, reviewing, reporting, trading, and issue resolution.
* Collaboration with teams across the bank to align and integrate operational processes.
* Identification of areas for improvement and providing recommendations in operational processes.
* Development and implementation of operational procedures and controls to mitigate risks and maintain operational efficiency.
* Development of reports and presentations on operational performance and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments to implement best practice in banking operations.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through specialist advice and support
* Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard which will impact both the role itself and surrounding roles.
* Likely to have responsibility for specific processes within a team
* They may lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources. They supervise a team, allocate work requirements and coordinate team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they manage own workload, take responsibility for the implementation of systems and processes within own work area and participate on projects broader than direct team.
* Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of closely related teams.
* Check work of colleagues within team to meet internal and stakeholder requirements.
* Provide specialist advice and support pertaining to own work area.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how all teams in area contribute to the objectives of the broader sub-function, delivering impact on the work of collaborating teams.
* Continually develop awareness of the underlying principles and concepts on which the work within the area of responsibility is based, building upon administrative / operational expertise.
* Make judgements based on practise and previous experience.
* Assess the validity and applicability of previous or similar experiences and evaluate options under circumstances that are not covered by procedures.
* Communicate sensitive or difficult information to customers in areas related specifically to customer advice or day to day administrative requirements.
* Build relationships with stakeholders/ customers to identify and address their needs.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

You will join our established customer support team as a key point of contact for our customers, managing conversations across phone and chat and making sure every request is followed through to closure. At payrentz, we work on a customer-first principle, and we are looking for someone who places the customer above everything else.

title: Security Specialist
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Security Specialist, you will be responsible for monitoring, triaging, analysing, and responding to cybersecurity alerts and incidents within a 24x7 Security Operations Centre environment. You will work closely with SOC leadership, security engineers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to strengthen the organisation's cyber defence capabilities and ensure timely response to security threats.
  
  
This role provides the opportunity to develop deep technical expertise in threat detection, incident response, security monitoring, use case optimisation, and cybersecurity reporting while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the overall security posture of the organisation.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Triage security alerts generated by SIEM platforms within defined SLAs and determine validity, criticality, and ownership.
* Investigate confirmed security incidents and provide detailed analysis, recommendations, and remediation guidance to relevant stakeholders.
* Follow established SOPs and playbooks for alert triage, investigation, and incident management activities.
* Handle SOC-related requests and support activities in a timely and professional manner.
* Own and manage one or more log source types, ensuring log quality, relevance, and coverage for security monitoring.
* Document log event types and maintain log source documentation.
* Map security use cases to available log sources and recommend new detection opportunities.
* Generate scheduled security reports, provide investigation summaries, and communicate findings to stakeholders.
* Support SOC leadership in creating and maintaining SOPs, playbooks, and operational processes.
* Recommend improvements to existing detection use cases, workflows, and response procedures based on emerging threats and lessons learned.
* Produce detailed investigation reports and provide actionable recommendations to improve security posture.
* Support automation initiatives, strategic cybersecurity projects, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Stay updated on emerging threats, security technologies, and industry best practices.
* Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment.
* Strong understanding of Networking, TCP/IP, OSI Model, Windows and Linux Operating Systems.
* Knowledge of Web Applications, Databases, and common cyber attack techniques.
* Experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring processes.
* Strong analytical and incident investigation skills.
* Ability to communicate technical risks and findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with SOPs, security procedures, and incident management processes.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good.
* The embodiment of Cognizant's Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, and Own It.

  
  
**These will help you succeed**

* Cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, SC-200, CySA+, GCIH, Splunk Certified User, or equivalent.
* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or similar SIEM technologies.
* Experience with threat hunting, EDR/XDR, and security automation.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework and modern threat actor techniques.
* Experience creating SOPs, playbooks, and security reports.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to mentor team members and support knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Continuous learning mindset with a passion for cybersecurity research and innovation.

**Work model –**
Hybrid - Chennai
  
  
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position based in Chennai and will support 24x7 SOC operations through rotational shifts. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programmes.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Longevity Doctor & Health Partner
description:
**Company Description**
Prvnt is a private medical practice for families, focused on treatment, prevention, longevity, and performance through deep diagnostics, continuous monitoring, and evidence-based therapeutics. The practice manages a family’s health like a family office manages wealth: centrally, by a dedicated team, over many years, with each family member having an individual record and personalized program. Members receive a yearly programme across treatment, prevention, longevity, and performance, supported by advanced testing, genomics, nutrition, and full concierge care. Prvnt Intelligence, the practice’s own system, processes records and drafts so physicians can focus on decisions that require clinical judgment, with named doctors signing off on all programme changes. The practice admits a limited number of families, caps members per doctor, and works only with registered physicians and accredited laboratories to maintain a high standard of privacy, safety, and care.

**Role Description**

We develop cloud software that simplifies talent sourcing and acquisition across various channels, including staffing agencies, job boards, and freelance management systems. Our aim is to create intuitive software that enables customers to efficiently acquire top talent (contractors or full-time employees) through data-driven insights and transparent dashboards.
  
  
As part of Workday, we are committed to becoming the most customer-centric enterprise software company in the world. We prioritize enabling our customers to connect to the talent they need to excel, achieved by fostering an exceptional engineering team committed to code quality and innovative design.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be joining a team in Chennai responsible for maintaining and building our pay-related features. This is a hands-on-keyboard role where you will not only build features but also own the design, scalability, and resilience of critical services.
  
  
You will tackle complex challenges related to how contingent workers are onboarded, managed, and paid, working on key features like Jobs, Worker Provisioning, Contracts, and Integrations. You will be a key voice in our architectural decisions and will guide the team in building robust solutions using our stack: Python (backend), React (frontend), and AWS.
  
  
**About You**
This role is for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex software problems. The ideal candidate will join an established office of 15 VNDLY colleagues and will be at the forefront of building our engineering presence as part of Workday's larger investment in Chennai!
  
  
Beyond a desire for solving complex and writing high-quality, efficient code, this person must be an exceptional communicator, acting as a key technical connection between our established U.S. teams and the new Chennai office. The ability to work independently, while also working effectively within a large, distributed team, is essential.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years shown experience in software development, including experience in designing, building, and maintaining RESTful web services and working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Deep proficiency in Python and experience with at least one Python web framework (e.g., Django, Flask).
* Strong experience with JavaScript frameworks, specifically React.js.

**Other Qualifications**

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda).
* Knowledge of SaaS applications, multi-tenant architectures, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

title: Study Abroad Counsellor
description: Company Description VisionX Study Abroad is a student-first mentoring and counselling organization that helps learners achieve their goal of studying overseas. Founded by professionals with direct experience living, studying, and working abroad, the company offers end-to-end support for higher education in destinations such as the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and Europe. VisionX provides personalized mentorship, guidance on education loans, CV and SOP building, accommodation support, IELTS coaching, and visa counselling with a high success rate. The team also works closely with parents to clarify processes, career outcomes, and financial planning, maintaining full transparency and no hidden charges. VisionX operates from the United Kingdom and Vellore, and is expanding support through its on-site counselling presence in Chennai.Role Description The Study Abroad Counsellor is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai. This role involves providing one-on-one counselling to students on study abroad options, shortlisting countries, universities, and programs aligned with their academic background and career goals. The counsellor will guide students through application processes, documentation, CV and SOP preparation, and coordinate with internal teams for test preparation, visa filing, and loan assistance. title: Field Services Warranty Lead - IR South
description:

Field Service Warranty Site Manager is responsible for managing technical warranty operations and minor maintenance contracts at designated railway sites. With a focus on resolving field failures and ensuring
  
  
compliance with warranty terms, the role supports system reliability, customer satisfaction, and smooth execution of service obligations in coordination with depot teams and OEMs.

* Manage and execute technical warranty activities including fault diagnosis, component replacement, and coordination with engineering for root cause analysis.
* Oversee minor maintenance contracts ensuring timely service delivery, adherence to scope, and compliance with safety and quality standards.
* Maintain accurate documentation of warranty claims, service reports, and failure trends for analysis and reporting.
* Resolve escalated service issues and ensure customer satisfaction
* Support field validation and endurance trials of new components and retrofits.
* Ensure compliance with RDSO guidelines, Railway Board protocols, and internal service standards.
* Train and guide site technicians on warranty procedures, documentation, and technical updates.
* Ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Ensure adherence to Wabtec safety standards, promote a safety-first culture across all field teams.

* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics

**Experience**

* 5–10 years of experience in railway field services with strong exposure to warranty management and maintenance operations.
* Familiarity with ERP systems, service analytics, and failure reporting tools
* Sound understanding of warranty & maintenance schedules (IOH, POH) terminology of Railways and Metro Railways
* Ready to travel frequently
* Excellent communication skills with written and verbal proficiency in English and Hindi. Regional language will be an added advantage.

**Competence**

* Strong coordination, documentation, and communication skills
* Strong analytical skills, Flexible attitude to work in changing environment

**Additional Information**

If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational through proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems and restoring service to clients.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA) and focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity.
  
  
The Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2) may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyzes issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and log all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focused on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Coaches Service Desk and L1 teams for technical and behavioural skills.
* Establishes monitoring for client infrastructure.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.
* Additional skills proficiency such as (but not limited to) -

+ Pulse Secure SSL VPN / Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls / Cisco Nexus switches, ASR and ISR routers / Cisco ACS, ISE / Meraki switches and access points / Enterprise network architecture / Common routing protocols: BGP,OSPF, EIGRP / Network address translation / Configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting uplinks to ISPs for DIA, MPLS and P2P circuits / Familiarity with common network management and monitoring tools such as SecureCRT, Logic Monitor

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* CCNP or equivalent certification.
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).

**Required Experience:**

* Moderate level of relevant managed services experience.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**

* Ownership. You close the loop and don’t just pass tickets along

* Collaborate closely with Product Development, Frontline teams, Partners, and Operations teams for issue resolution and continuous service improvements.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related engineering field. Required Skills

* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure services, cloud architecture, and operational excellence.
* Proven experience working with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is highly preferred.
* Strong experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps pipelines using Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms.
* Good working knowledge of Java-based applications, JVM performance concepts, and production support.
* Solid hands-on experience with MS SQL Server, Azure SQL, and other Azure database services.
* Experience handling large datasets, operational reporting, and analytics.
* Exposure to IoT platforms, remote monitoring solutions, and telecom or device connectivity.
* Strong skills in automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global and virtual teams.
* Knowledge of integration technologies, REST APIs, and microservices architectures.
* Experience working in Agile, Lean, and DevOps-driven delivery teams.

What We Offer: KONE Internal
  
  

* Opportunity to work with a global technology leader shaping the future of digital cities.
* Hands-on exposure to large-scale, mission-critical, Azure-based and Kubernetes driven platforms.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment with a strong focus on continuous improvement and technical excellence.

title: Operations Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

OEC is in the middle of a multi-year journey to modernise its infrastructure and applications, transforming how we build, deploy, and operate software at global scale. The Operations Specialist (L2) is a core member of the Monitoring Team within the Enterprise Operations Team, responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of OEC’s observability stack, primarily powered by Datadog.

In this role you will own L2 alert triage, incident response, dashboard development, and service onboarding — contributing to the team’s tooling standards and best practices. You will also handle day-to-day server monitoring, infrastructure support, and service management tasks that keep OEC’s global platforms running reliably.

**Key Responsibilities & Duties (essential to the job)**

**Monitoring & alerting**

* Design, configure, and maintain Datadog monitors, composite alerts, and notification channels for production and non-production environments.
* Own the L2 alert triage process — investigate, diagnose, and resolve escalated alerts from L1, ensuring timely root cause identification.
* Tune alert thresholds and suppression rules to minimise noise and reduce false positive rates.
* Manage SLO (Service Level Objective) definitions, tracking, and reporting across assigned services.
* Participate in the on-call rotation for critical monitoring alerts and P1/P2 incident response.

**Dashboards & observability**

* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards covering infrastructure health, application performance, log analytics, and business KPIs.
* Configure and manage Datadog APM (Application Performance Monitoring), distributed tracing, and error tracking for key services.
* Implement and manage log ingestion pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based monitors.
* Develop and maintain Synthetic monitors (API and browser tests) for uptime and user experience validation.

**Service onboarding & integrations**

* Onboard new services and infrastructure components into the Datadog monitoring framework in collaboration with DevOps, Cloud, and Engineering teams.
* Configure and maintain Datadog integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Rackspace), Kubernetes, containerised workloads, and third-party tools.
* Support the migration of legacy monitoring tooling (SCOM, Dynatrace, Grafana, Prometheus, Pingdom, Apigee, Redgate, IDERA) into Datadog.

**Incident response & runbooks**

* Act as L2 escalation point during incidents — perform deep-dive investigations using metrics, logs, traces, and dashboards.
* Create, maintain, and improve runbooks for common alert scenarios, incident response procedures, and post-incident remediation steps.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews, documenting root cause findings and identifying monitoring gaps to prevent recurrence.
* Alerts system owners, stakeholders, and management of degraded system status and Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents; issues tickets for incident and problem escalation.

**AI & automation**

* Leverage Datadog AI capabilities including Watchdog, anomaly detection, outlier detection, and Bits AI to improve proactive issue detection.
* Implement forecast-based monitors for capacity management (CPU, memory, disk).
* Use AI-based alert correlation and deduplication features to reduce alert fatigue.

title: Lead, PKI & Cert Management
description:
**Job Summary**
Join Standard Chartered Bank's Data Security team as a Lead in PKI and Certificate Management, a pivotal role within our global Cyber Security framework. Data security underpins every facet of our operations, ensuring robust protection against evolving cyber threats and fostering secure growth across more than 70 countries. This role places you at the heart of our digital transformation journey, delivering best-in-class Public Key Infrastructure services that enable our business units to build, deploy, and operate secure applications with confidence. You will collaborate with diverse teams to strengthen the Bank's security posture and support our commitment to maintaining trust and resilience in a rapidly changing cyber landscape. If you are an expert with extensive PKI experience, passionate about driving security innovation and operational excellence, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on a global scale.
  
  
As the Lead for PKI and Certificate Management, you will contribute strategically and technically to safeguard critical information assets, working with a dynamic team dedicated to fostering a secure banking environment. Your expertise will underpin the assurance standards that empower our stakeholders worldwide, ensuring uninterrupted business continuity and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee and manage the Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services infrastructure, maintaining the highest levels of operational integrity for Root CA, Issuing CA, NDES/SCEP, OCSP, and CRL systems.
* Lead initiatives to enhance certificate lifecycle management, proactively identifying opportunities to upgrade toolsets and processes to support cloud, network, endpoint, and database environments.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with business, infrastructure, and security operations teams to architect solutions that enforce robust data protection and regulatory compliance.
* Provide expert technical guidance, advisory support, and incident response leadership to swiftly address and remediate security vulnerabilities within the PKI landscape.
* Design, review, and maintain certificate templates that meet current and anticipated business requirements while aligning with security best practices.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including architecture, policies, operational procedures, and configuration standards to ensure knowledge continuity and audit readiness.
* Conduct periodic PKI health assessments, monitor system performance and capacity, and validate disaster recovery processes to ensure resilient service availability.
* Analyze security incidents and conduct vulnerability assessments, applying risk-based approaches to inform security controls and tolerance decisions.
* Contribute actively to the governance framework, ensuring alignment with risk and audit requirements to uphold the integrity of the Bank’s cybersecurity infrastructure.
* Communicate effectively across all organisational levels, providing clear, concise updates and technical insights to both senior leadership and hands-on practitioners.

**Skills And Experience**
**Core Skills and Experience:**

* A minimum of eight years’ experience in data security with a focus on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate management, demonstrating hands-on expertise.
* Comprehensive knowledge of cryptographic key management principles and hardware security modules (HSM).
* Proven experience administering Microsoft PKI solutions at scale, including Root Certification Authorities, Subordinate CAs, OCSP responders, and certificate revocation infrastructure.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance standards such as PCI-DSS, alongside practical expertise in tokenization, data masking, and data dispersion techniques.

**Additional Technical Competencies**

* Programming skills in languages such as Java or Python to support automation, integration, and tooling development associated with certificate management.
* Ability to apply security assessment methodologies and perform vulnerability analyses related to encryption and PKI environments.

Demonstrated capacity to work within complex organisational structures and effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders is essential for success in this position.
  
  
**Motivations**
At Standard Chartered, we value individuals who approach their work with integrity and courage, embodying our principle to 'Do the right thing.' We encourage our team members to be resilient agents of change, thinking client-first and embracing continuous innovation. Motivated professionals who seek to uphold ethical standards while driving security excellence thrive in our environment. If you have a passion for contributing meaningfully to a global institution’s security posture and cherish collaborative, principled leadership, this role will offer a fulfilling platform to realise your ambitions.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Experience:**

* Proven experience managing Public Key Infrastructure and cyber security infrastructure components at an enterprise level.
* Relevant professional certifications including Microsoft PKI Specialist, CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), and CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) are highly desirable.

**Language Proficiency**

* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English are required to engage effectively with international teams and document critical security procedures.

Candidates with additional certifications or experience in risk management frameworks and cloud security technologies will be considered favourably.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**

we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

The position plays a key role in maintaining the quality, accuracy, and integrity of instrumentation engineering data, supporting Shell’s asset management, reliability, and digital transformation objectives. By managing SmartPlant Instrumentation (SPI) databases and associated engineering documentation, the role helps ensure that critical asset information is accessible, standardized, and aligned with business and operational requirements.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role combines instrumentation engineering knowledge with digital data management expertise. Responsibilities include administering and maintaining SPI databases, managing instrument specifications, loop diagrams, and wiring records, as well as ensuring data synchronization across systems such as GSAP, AVEVA AIM-A, SQL, and Digital Twin platforms. The position works closely with engineering, maintenance, and operations teams to support safe and reliable plant performance, making it well suited for candidates with a background in Instrumentation & Control Engineering, oil and gas operations, process industries, and engineering information management.

* Maintain SPI templates, tables, libraries, and Shell‑specific specification forms.
* Perform routine database cleanup, quality checks, and resolve discrepancies between SPI, SAP, AIM‑A, and Digital Twin.
* Manage SPI user accounts, roles, permissions, and access controls.
* Ensure robust QA/QC processes and support a “First Time Right” quality culture.

* Coordinate with EPCs and site teams for data reviews, updates, and technical clarifications.

* Review, validate, and incorporate SPI project deliverables from EPCs into the live database.
* Initiate and configure SPI databases for new capital and brownfield projects.
* Analyze technical documents, engineering data, and maintenance procedures to ensure SPI data accuracy.
* Support site teams with troubleshooting and SPI functionality training.
* Facilitate cross‑functional collaboration across Engineering, Operations, and Maintenance.

**Technical & Wiring Troubleshooting Support**

* Provide support for end‑to‑end loop verification, wiring diagnostics, and virtual troubleshooting for field engineers and EPCs.
* undefined

**Develop Power BI dashboards**

* Using SQL queries and build Power BI dashboards to extract, analyze, and visualize SPI‑related data for reporting and decision‑making.

**Review & Integration of Project Deliverables**

* Validate EPC submissions, integrate project and plant changes, and ensure document control alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

**Compliance, Safety & Documentation**

* Ensure adherence to Shell design standards, engineering practices, and HSSE requirements.
* Participate in Risk Assessments (RA) for instrumentation data changes.

We are looking for an experienced PCRF Deployment Engineer to handle deployment, installation, configuration, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of Policy and Charging Rules Function (PCRF) solutions in telecom core networks.

* Deploy, install, configure, and integrate PCRF nodes in telecom core network environments.

title: Technical Support/SKIL Instructor
description:
**About NCR Atleos**
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.
  
  
Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor
  
  
**Role Description**
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you are considered a subject matter expert in NCR Atleos ATM products and act as an advanced level remote support analyst and technical learning instructor. You are part of our support services and learning delivery teams, and your passion for providing exceptional customer service, technical guidance, and effective instruction contributes to our world-class high level of customer satisfaction and associate readiness.
  
  
Acting as second line support to NCR Atleos Field Service Technicians and as an instructor for assigned technical learning programs, you will communicate in an open, helpful, and engaging manner with your focus being finding the right solution for each Field Service Technician, learner, and customer. You connect with Field Service Technicians to address questions and resolve various problems, including uncommon or complex issues, knowing when and who to turn to for additional support. You also facilitate classroom, lab, virtual instructor-led, and online learning experiences that enhance technical capability and improve the overall effectiveness of the business unit/organization.
  
  
You will have a proactive approach and may handle problems before they start by identifying knowledge gaps, improving course content, creating knowledge articles, and feeding live field learning back into training materials and knowledge systems. No matter the situation, your formal training, technical expertise, available knowledge repositories, and adult learning techniques will allow you to provide Field Service Technicians and learners what they need when they need it. Additionally, you will always be on the lookout for preventative measures you can take, escalate issues appropriately, contribute to continuous improvement, and serve as an ambassador for the NCR Atleos brand.
  
  
Your goal is to keep our Field Service Technicians, learners, and customers completely assured and satisfied through your technical expertise, instructional capability, consistent communication, and commitment to quality support and effective learning delivery.
  
  
Position Summary & Key Areas of Responsibility
  
  
As a Technical Support Specialist / Learning Instructor, you will provide support to Field Service Engineers who will generally be onsite at a customer location and requiring technical assistance.
  
  
The support will include problem identification, analysis, diagnosis, and resolution.
  
  
You will utilize Knowledge Systems provided by NCR Atleos and other vendors as appropriate to identify solutions to known problems.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that solutions provided are successful, ensuring first time and long-term resolution of the problem.
  
  
If no known solution can be identified, you are responsible for escalation to other support groups where deeper level skilled personnel are available.
  
  
You retain ownership of escalated problems/issues through to resolution.
  
  
You are responsible for ensuring that NCR Atleos Management is informed if resolution to a problem will take longer than contractual requirements require.
  
  
You will provide input to the Knowledge Systems as and when required and create and publish knowledge articles when required.
  
  
You will coordinate with your peers, Management, Learning teams, and other support groups in providing part numbers, technical details, field learning, and product/process information to Field Service Technicians and learners.
  
  
You will act as a second line escalation point for junior colleagues and provide coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance where required.
  
  
You will facilitate course delivery using classroom, lab, VILT (virtual instructor-led training), online, and other approved methods of instruction.
  
  
You will execute course delivery according to the published training schedule.
  
  
You will maintain classroom facilities, training center, lab environment, training equipment, and learning materials necessary for the class.
  
  
You will work collaboratively with and around other team members in a Lab environment.
  
  
You will support course development by providing subject matter expertise for assigned products, technical procedures, and service processes.
  
  
You will perform course maintenance and identify required updates to course content using existing knowledge, field feedback, service trends, and analytical skills.
  
  
You will use a variety of delivery techniques, leveraging formal and informal delivery tools such as virtual classrooms, web conferencing, discussion forums, blogs, wikis, job aids, and short-form instructional videos where applicable.
  
  
You may serve as course owner for assigned instructor-led training courses.
  
  
You will develop or support performance support materials, including job aids, technical tips, procedural guides, and YouTube-style videos where applicable.
  
  
You will mentor new instructors and support knowledge transfer across technical support and learning teams.
  
  
You will manage day-to-day operations of the learning center where assigned, including keeping it clean, organized, and ready to support the best learning environment possible.
  
  
You will use continuous improvement processes and tools to improve Services Learning and Technical Support processes and increase the value-add provided to our customers.
  
  
You will deliver quality support and enhanced results meeting established KPI and Customer SLA requirements.
  
  
You will provide onsite and lab support for equipment as required.
  
  
You must be willing and able to work flexible schedules, which may include night and weekend shifts, and perform overtime work upon management request or business need.
  
  
You will perform travel as required, where applicable.
  
  
You must maintain a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.
  
  
You will comply with NCR Atleos policies which include but are not limited to:
  
  
The Company’s Shared Values and Code of Conduct.
  
  
Employee Health and Safety policy and standards.
  
  
Accurate timekeeping and records of hours worked.
  
  
Company Fleet policies and requirements, where applicable, which include but are not limited to NCR Atleos requirements for safe driving.
  
  
You will perform other corresponding duties and tasks in accordance with your qualifications, as directed by Employer.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
High School Diploma.
  
  
Prior work experience in a Customer Support or Technical Support role is required, with experience supporting customers in the Financial sector and/or Retail and Hospitality sector being a must where applicable.
  
  
3–5 years of experience working with, supporting, troubleshooting, or servicing technical equipment, heavy machinery, ATMs, retail technology, networking hardware, or similar technical environments; or an Associate Degree in a technical field or in education.
  
  
Experience servicing NCR Atleos supported equipment or equivalent technical platforms is required where applicable.
  
  
Must be authorized to work in the country where position is posted.
  
  
Must be a local candidate for in-country teams.
  
  
PC proficiency.
  
  
Proficiency with Windows-based applications/tools and MS Office products.
  
  
Good English communication skills and telephony etiquette; other languages may be required for certain teams.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Strong demonstrated public speaking, facilitation, or presentation skills.
  
  
Ability to listen and communicate effectively in a professional environment.
  
  
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Strong team player with the ability to work collaboratively in a matrix-managed organization.
  
  
Ability to explain technical concepts in clear and understandable terms to Field Service Technicians, learners, and other stakeholders.
  
  
Ability to work in an office environment either full time or on a hybrid work model where applicable.
  
  
Ability to work collaboratively in a lab environment and support onsite/lab-based technical learning and troubleshooting activities.
  
  
Willingness and ability to work flexible schedules, including shift hours, nights, weekends, and overtime as required by business need.
  
  
Must have the ability to carry and lift tool kits, training equipment, or parts of varying weights up to 50 lbs. where applicable.
  
  
Must be available to work in other training locations as needed, where applicable.
  
  
Must have a valid driver’s license where required for in-country teams or travel-related responsibilities.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor’s Degree in Education, IT, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  
  
Knowledge of Electrical Engineering.
  
  
Advanced understanding of Networking Technology.
  
  
Previous experience as a field-based Field Service Technician.
  
  
Previous experience in a Learning, Education, Technical Training, or Instructor role.
  
  
2–3 years teaching adult learners technical topics, including hands-on mechanical, hardware, electrical, or networking modules.
  
  
Knowledge of NCR Atleos products, services, tools, and processes.
  
  
Experience servicing ATMs, PCs, servers, networking hardware, or related customer service technology.
  
  
Experience with course ownership, course maintenance, instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, and learning center operations.
  
  
Proven ability to work independently, juggle multiple projects, and adapt to frequent change.
  
  
Ability to build rapport with internal and external customers.
  
  
Ability to self-manage while maintaining accountability for support quality, learning delivery, and operational readiness.
  
  
Ability to manage and maintain a training center or lab environment in a manner that is conducive to learning.
  
  
Proven ability to learn quickly and translate field experience into training materials, knowledge articles, and performance support content.
  
  
Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.
  
  
**EEO Statement**
NCR Atleos is an equal-opportunity employer. It is NCR Atleos policy to hire, train, promote, and pay associates based on their job-related qualifications, ability, and performance, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Atleos only accepts resumes from agencies on the NCR Atleos preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Atleos employees, or any NCR Atleos facility. NCR Atleos is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

description:

Are you an experienced engineering leader passionate about scaling mission-critical cloud infrastructure and pioneering AI and agentic automation? Trimble is seeking an exceptional Manager of Cloud Operations (COPS) to lead our Chennai Cloud Operations team. In this pivotal leadership role, you will oversee the daily management of Trimble Viewpoint's Global Cloud Services—supporting 22,000+ servers and 6,000+ customers in North America—while driving our strategic operational roadmap toward an AI-first future.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**About Trimble Viewpoint:**
Trimble Viewpoint provides market-leading construction management software solutions that connect the office, team, and field. Our cloud services deliver enterprise-grade performance, high reliability, and integrated data visibility to thousands of construction organizations worldwide.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this high-impact position, you will direct the global heartbeat of Trimble Viewpoint’s cloud estate. Operating from our Chennai office in an IST-driven collaborative model with our North American teams, you will champion agentic AI workflows, autonomous patch and incident pipelines, and FinOps cost-governance disciplines. You will have full executive support to cultivate an exceptional engineering culture, mentor top cloud talent, define technical standards with Information Security and Product Leadership, and lead the operational transition toward intelligent, self-healing cloud ecosystems.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Leadership & AI Vision: Develop and implement the technical roadmap for AI-enabled cloud operations, championing agentic automation with human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints across deployments, server lifecycle management, and daily workflows.
* Global Estate & 24/7 Service Oversight: Oversee 24/7 cloud operations across 22,000+ servers and 6,000+ enterprise customers, managing disaster recovery, capacity modeling, event management, incident resolution, and change governance.
* SLA & MTTR Optimization: Own customer-facing uptime and system reliability metrics, deploying AI-assisted root-cause analysis (RCA), predictive alerting, and automated remediation to systematically drive down Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).
* AI-SecOps & Audit Readiness: Champion AI-SecOps practices to integrate machine learning into threat detection, vulnerability remediation, and security incident response, ensuring full compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and ITIL standards.

* Team Leadership & Global Governance: Directly manage and mentor the Chennai Cloud Operations team, cultivating high AI fluency, structured career paths, and seamless cross-regional governance with North American counterparts.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Professional Leadership: 10+ years of overall IT and cloud infrastructure experience, with a proven track record in a direct people management and engineering leadership role.
* Service Management Frameworks: In-depth working knowledge and operational execution of ITIL disciplines (Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration, and Release Management).
* Escalation & Crisis Management: Proven ability to manage complex, high-priority operational escalations, maintain composed customer communications, and drive rapid incident containment.
* Customer Onboarding & Process Transition: Demonstrated experience facilitating customer onboarding and smooth enterprise transitions into cloud operations support.
* Global Cross-Functional Alignment: Track record of driving standard processes, operational rigor, and unified metrics across distributed, multi-region teams.

**Bonus Points For**

* Cloud & AI Certifications: Professional certifications in Microsoft Azure and/or recognized AI/ML platforms.
* Agentic Automation & Scripting: Practical exposure to building or supervising automated agentic workflows, autonomous remediation runbooks, or modern telemetry stacks.
* Compliance Expertise: Direct experience managing audits and operational security controls under SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 frameworks.

* Location: Chennai, India

* Level: M3
* Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

**How to Apply:**

**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**

title: SAP EWM Consultant
description:
**SAP EWM Consultant | SRM Tech | Chennai/Bangalore - Hybrid**

**About SRM Tech**

SRM Technologies is a global digital and engineering partner delivering capabilities across data and AI, enterprise platforms, embedded and platform engineering, supply chain, and design-to-manufacturing services.

We work across high-impact industries such as Mobility, Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Logistics, supporting enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe in building intelligent, future-ready ecosystems and driving transformation at scale.

As a Great Place to Work®-certified organization, we are committed to creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and thrive. We believe empowered individuals drive innovation, deliver value to customers, and play a meaningful role in shaping our collective success.

At SRM Tech, every contribution matters, and we are always looking for passionate individuals who are eager to shape their careers with us.

**Position**

SAP EWM Consultant

**Module**

SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

**Experience**

5-7 years (relevant SAP experience)

**Industry**

Pharmaceutical / Biotech - process manufacturing (GMP)

**Engagement**

Production support for 24x7 manufacturing operations

**Work schedule**

Rotational shifts / on-call; weekend and holiday support for critical incidents

**Location**

Chennai or Bangalore – Hybrid work

**About the Client**

Our client is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and manufacture of biosimilar medicines. SAP is their enterprise ERP platform, covering manufacturing, quality management, planning, production scheduling, warehouse management, finance and HR. Their GMP manufacturing plants operate 24x7, and the SAP landscape supporting them must be available and stable around the clock.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an SAP EWM consultant to support warehouse operations for a biopharmaceutical client whose plants and warehouses run 24x7. The consultant will keep inbound, outbound and production-supply processes running without disruption, resolve incidents fast, and ensure warehouse processes stay compliant with GMP requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide L1.5,L2/L3 support for SAP EWM, resolving incidents within SLA
* Support inbound, outbound, internal movements, physical inventory and returns processes
* Support production supply and staging for process orders, and receipt from production
* Troubleshoot warehouse tasks, warehouse orders, waves, storage types, putaway and picking strategies
* Support RF / mobile transactions and handheld device issues on the warehouse floor
* Support batch management, shelf-life (FEFO), quarantine, sampling and stock-type changes in line with QM decisions
* Resolve integration issues between SAP EWM and external systems (RFC queues, deliveries, IDocs) and with PP-PI and QM
* Perform root-cause analysis on recurring issues and deliver permanent fixes through change control
* Prepare functional specifications, test scripts and validation evidence for changes and enhancements

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5-7 years of SAP experience with hands-on EWM
* Process-industry experience (pharma, biotech, life sciences, chemicals, food or similar)
* Strong knowledge of EWM inbound/outbound processes, warehouse structure, process-oriented storage control and RF framework
* Good understanding of batch management, shelf life and stock types, and EWM integration with PP and QM
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting RFC / integration queues
* At least one production support engagement and preferably one full-cycle implementation

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* Pharma or biotech warehouse experience, including cold-chain and controlled-temperature storage
* Exposure to serialisation / track-and-trace integration
* Exposure to GMP / GxP and computer system validation
* Working knowledge of PP-PI, QM, MM; SAP WM to EWM migration experience

**Work Conditions**

* This is a 24x7 production support role for live manufacturing operations. The candidate will work in a rotational shift / on-call model as agreed with the client.
* Must be flexible to work on weekends and public holidays when a critical (P1/P2) incident affecting manufacturing needs to be resolved.
* Must follow ITIL-based incident, problem and change management, and the client's GxP change-control procedures.
* Must be able to work with global, multi-time-zone teams including business users, IT, QA/compliance and other SAP module consultants.

**Soft Skills**

* Clear written and spoken English; able to explain issues and fixes to shop-floor, QA and business users
* Calm, structured approach under pressure during production-down situations
* Strong root-cause analysis and documentation discipline (RCA, KEDB, SOPs, test evidence)
* Ownership mindset: follows an incident through to closure and permanent fix

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
* SAP certification in the relevant module is preferred
* Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites for short periods if required

*SRM Tech is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, without bias or discrimination, in line with applicable laws.*
