title: GRC Platform Delivery
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

1. Platform Administration and Operational Support

· Build a working knowledge of the GRC platform, including its modules, workflows, user permissions, and underlying data structures.

· Provide operational support for the platform across various global risk and compliance processes.

· Investigate user-reported issues, perform initial troubleshooting, and coordinate escalations to the relevant teams.

· Assist with user access management, role assignments, permission updates, periodic access reviews, and onboarding activities.

· Develop and maintain platform-related documentation, operating procedures, user manuals, and knowledge resources.

2. Business Requirements and Delivery Coordination

· Engage with business, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders to understand business needs and gather functional requirements.

· Translate business requirements into structured documentation, including user stories, process maps, functional specifications, and configuration requirements.

· Review existing workflows and business processes to identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and operational improvement.

· Monitor project deliverables, timelines, dependencies, action items, and implementation progress.

· Assist in coordinating delivery activities and ensuring requirements are clearly documented and aligned with stakeholder expectations.

3. Testing and Release Management Support

· Prepare and maintain test scenarios, test scripts, test cases, and expected outcomes for platform enhancements and changes.

· Conduct Quality Assurance (QA) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to verify that system functionality meets defined business requirements.

· Record test outcomes, identify defects, document observations, and track issues through resolution.

· Coordinate defect remediation, regression testing, retesting, and validation activities with relevant stakeholders.

· Support release preparation, deployment coordination, and post-implementation checks to confirm that changes have been delivered successfully.

4. Jira, Confluence, and Knowledge Management

· Create, update, and manage Jira tickets to track requirements, platform enhancements, defects, testing activities, and delivery progress.

· Maintain visibility into project tasks, dependencies, outstanding issues, decisions, and action items throughout the delivery lifecycle.

· Organize and update Confluence pages containing project documentation, meeting records, test evidence, release details, process flows, and user instructions.

· Ensure project and operational documentation is accurate, consistently maintained, and easily accessible to relevant stakeholders.

· Follow established documentation standards and support effective knowledge sharing across delivery teams.

5. Reporting, Data Analysis, and Quality Assurance

· Assist in preparing operational reports, performance dashboards, platform metrics, and management updates.

· Perform data quality checks, reconciliations, and validation activities to maintain the accuracy and consistency of platform information.

· Analyze platform usage, workflow efficiency, recurring support issues, and operational performance indicators to identify trends and improvement opportunities.

· Extract, organize, and analyze relevant data to support risk management, compliance reporting, and platform-related initiatives.

· Contribute to reporting improvements and the development of reliable, data-driven insights for stakeholders.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration and User Enablement

· Support demonstrations of platform features, business workflows, and newly introduced functionality for relevant stakeholders.

· Assist in delivering user training, system walkthroughs, knowledge-sharing sessions, and platform adoption initiatives.

· Coordinate with regional and global teams to gather feedback, clarify requirements, and facilitate the timely completion of delivery activities.

· Prepare user communications, release announcements, quick-reference materials, and instructional guides to support platform changes.

· Help resolve user queries by providing guidance on platform functionality, documented procedures, and established support channels.

title: Support Team Lead
description:
**Company Description**
Pulse Telesystems is a leading telecom solution provider in India, delivering personalized telecom services that support evolving business needs. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Chennai, the company has expanded into multiple major metropolitan cities, serving over 4,000 clients across diverse industries. Its offerings include Internet Leased Lines, VoIP Solutions, Cloud Telephony, Virtual Numbers, SIP Internet Calling, custom CRM integrations, and advanced spam monitoring and CNAM services. Pulse Telesystems is a trusted telecom partner for top enterprises such as Zoho, MGM Healthcare, Larsen & Toubro, CEAT, India Cements Ltd., and PVR Cinemas, helping them improve performance and reliability. Team members join a growing organization focused on innovation, service quality, and long-term client relationships.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive, disciplined and accountable Support Shift Lead to own day-to-day support operations during an assigned shift. The person will actively monitor tickets and incidents from logging through resolution, enforce response and resolution SLAs, coordinate the team, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. This role requires a hands-on leader who follows up relentlessly, escalates risks early, maintains accurate updates, and holds the team to agreed processes and commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.  Support Ticket & Incident Ownership

●      Monitor the support queue continuously and ensure every issue has a clear owner, priority, next action and target time.

●      Track tickets end-to-end—from acknowledgement and triage to troubleshooting, resolution, validation and closure.

●      Review ageing, overdue, stalled, reopened and high-priority tickets; drive action plans to prevent avoidable delays.

●      Enforce response, update and resolution SLAs; escalate potential breaches before they occur.

●      Coordinate major incidents, ensure timely technical escalation, and maintain an accurate incident timeline and handover notes.

2.  Team Leadership & Performance

●      Allocate and rebalance work based on severity, skills, workload and urgency; confirm ownership of every active issue.

●      Run shift kick-offs, periodic queue reviews and end-of-shift handovers.

●      Set clear expectations, monitor productivity and quality, and address missed commitments promptly and fairly.

●      Coach team members on troubleshooting, ticket hygiene, customer handling and escalation discipline.

●      Identify repeated performance gaps, document facts, and raise persistent issues to the Support Manager.

3.  Proactive Communication & Stakeholder Management

●      Provide timely, concise and factual updates to customers, internal teams, management and relevant stakeholders.

●      Communicate impact, current status, actions underway, blockers, ownership and the next update time—without waiting to be chased.

●      Alert stakeholders early when an issue risks breaching SLA or affecting business operations.

●      Coordinate with engineering, infrastructure, vendors and other teams until dependencies are resolved.

●      Ensure no critical issue goes silent and no shift ends without a documented handover of open risks.

4.  Process, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

●      Maintain accurate ticket records, incident notes, escalation details, workaround steps and resolution summaries.

●      Prepare shift reports covering ticket volumes, SLA performance, open/overdue incidents, major risks and follow-up owners.

●      Identify recurring incidents and recommend problem-management actions, knowledge-base updates and process improvements.

●      Follow support procedures, access controls, customer communication standards and incident-management policies.

●      Use ticketing and monitoring tools consistently; keep dashboards and operational trackers current.

Required Skills & Competencies

●      Strong ownership, urgency, discipline and follow-through; comfortable enforcing standards and holding people accountable.

●      Excellent written and verbal communication; able to provide clear updates to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

●      Sound incident triage, prioritisation, escalation and problem-solving skills.

●      Experience coordinating a support/helpdesk/service desk/NOC/application support team.

●      Strong organisation skills, attention to detail and confidence handling competing priorities.

●      Ability to remain calm, firm and professional during high-severity incidents or customer escalations.

●      Working knowledge of SLAs, ticket lifecycle, incident management, shift handovers and operational reporting.

Experience & Qualifications

●      Typically 3–6 years of experience in technical support, IT operations, service desk, application support or a related environment.

●      At least 1–2 years in a team-lead, shift-lead, senior support or incident-coordination capacity preferred.

●      Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Freshservice or similar.

●      Exposure to monitoring dashboards, SLA reports, escalation matrices and knowledge-base processes.

●      ITIL Foundation or equivalent incident/service-management training is an advantage.

Success Measures (KPIs)

●      SLA compliance for first response, stakeholder updates and resolution.

●      Reduction in overdue, ageing and unassigned tickets.

●      Quality and timeliness of incident communications and shift handovers.

●      Ticket documentation completeness and resolution quality.

●      Escalation timeliness, repeat-incident trends and customer/stakeholder feedback.

●      Team adherence to process, ownership and agreed action deadlines.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is firm but fair, highly visible in the support queue, and proactive by default. They do not wait for reminders, allow issues to drift, or accept vague status updates. They establish clear owners and deadlines, communicate risks early, verify that actions are completed, and maintain professional accountability without resorting to disrespectful or aggressive behaviour.

Application Note

* Applicants should highlight examples where they improved SLA performance, managed critical incidents, coordinated a support team, prevented escalations through proactive communication, or reduced ticket backlog.
* Please share the resume to hr@pulse.in/ samuel@pulse.in

* Managing, delivering, and governing financial controller related reporting and analytics requirements.
* Strategic direction and oversight of designing processes that will enhance Controls and outcomes.

* Operating Model Strategy

* Develop strong understanding of firm’s accounting and governance policies and ensure compliance of same.
* Establish clear guidelines that will drive decisions around close acceleration.
* Ensure Primary and Secondary financial statements are prepared in accordance with statutory and regulatory requirements for accountable captions in timely manner. Support Group Financial and Local Statutory reporting for LE & Group.
* Work with Tech CFO and project teams for effective controls around software intangibles.
* Oversee SL balance sheet substantiation process and remediate any risk and control issues.
* Secretarial function for the SL Board.
* Banking and funding management for SL and its branches.
* Manage key control forums at LE & Tech segment level with appropriate KRI & KPI reporting with aim to monitor open items and its implications covering risks and audit issues.
* Collaborate with the change & technology teams for upstream issue fixes to help resolve gaps.

**Qualifications:**

* Qualified Accountant with 20+ years’ work experience in leading & managing Finance controller function.
* Strong financial control experience of Cost, Investment Capitalization, Finance Risk & Governance.
* Have a sound knowledge on the right-shoring model (preferably with a financial services background).
* Ability to work well under pressure, strong problem-solving skills and some hands-on operational experience.
* Strategic mindset with strong experience in implementation of strategic changes as well as Knowledge of IFRS and standard accounting practices etc.
* Excellent business judgment, operational control management and risk assessment.
* Strong connect with business performance metrics and how it is enabled through good process discipline.
* Should have strong knowledge and understanding of data management, data quality and its linkage in driving business performance management.
* Good eye for detail and with a strong focus on controls and compliance to policies and procedures.
* Results orientation, exceptional energy, and ambition to drive systems, technology and process changes across geographies.
* Demonstrated experience of influencing decisions at senior leadership level. Strong stakeholder engagement skills and ability to work with cross cultural teams.
* Possesses skill to leverage interpersonal abilities to influence others and skilfully build credibility with stakeholders.
* Experience of working in a global organisation in a matrix environment.

title: ServiceNow SecOps SIR - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant**
**Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services**
help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.
  
  
**Work you will do**
As a
**Consultant / Senior Consultant**
, you would be expected to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.
* Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service.
* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.
* Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen.
* Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration.
* Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations.
* Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities.

**Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)**

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.
* Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions.
* Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling.
* Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities.
* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation.
* Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload.
* Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management.
* Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response.
* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

**Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)**
Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.

·      Support the finance team with routine accounting and administrative tasks.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

·      
**1+ year of experience**
in accounting or finance, preferably in a D2C, e-commerce or consumer products business.

·      Prior experience working in a
**D2C business is a must**
.

·      Familiarity with sales reconciliation, payment gateway settlements, refunds and marketplace transactions.

·      Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.

·      Basic understanding of GST, TDS and accounting documentation.

·      Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy and organisational skills.

·      Someone who takes ownership, follows up proactively and is comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

·      
**Ownership**
– Take responsibility for your work and contribute directly to our financial operations.

·      
**Learning**
– Build hands-on experience across D2C, e-commerce and consumer brand accounting.

·      
**Speed**
– We’re an early-stage team where good work makes a visible difference.

·      
**Access**

title: Network L3 Admin
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
We are seeking an NOC L2 Engineer with 6 years to manage and implement configuration changes on Palo Alto, Juniper SRX, and Fortinet firewalls using platforms like Panorama, Juniper Space/SD Cloud, and Forti Manager.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Configure and troubleshoot Cisco/Juniper switching, SD‑WAN, and L3 routing (BGP preferred).

* Deploy and maintain Cisco ACI constructs (EPGs, BDs, contracts) and Juniper SSR routing policies.
* Implement upgrades for Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, and Cisco platforms with validation and rollback planning.
* Execute Azure networking tasks: ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, VPN gateways, VNet peering, and custom routing.
* Configure remote access technologies including Palo Alto GlobalProtect, IPSec tunnels, and Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA).
* Use Python, Ansible, and Terraform for network automation, compliance, and repeatable workflows.
* Manage ServiceNow change lifecycle: creation, assessment, implementation, documentation, and coordination.

**Good To Have**

* Knowledge of Cisco ISE (802.1X, TACACS+, pxGrid, VPN auth).
* Understanding of EfficientIP (not mandatory).

**Preferred Certifications**

* Cisco: CCNP Enterprise / CCNP Security
* Juniper: JNCIE‑ENT / JNCIE‑SEC
* Palo Alto: PCNSA / PCNSE
* Fortinet: NSE 5 or NSE 7
* F5: CA, CTS‑LTM, or equivalent

**Skills Required**

* Proficiency in Palo Alto firewalls / Juniper SRX firewalls
* Proficiency in Juniper Mist wireless and wireless authentication
* Proficiency in Juniper / Cisco access layer switching
* Proficiency in SD-WAN
* Proficiency in L3 routing (BGP preferred)
* Proficiency in datacenter switching (ACI / VXLAN fabrics preferred)
* Proficiency in cloud networking (Azure / GCP preferred)
* Proficiency with load balancing (F5 preferred)

**Position Summary**

title: Piping Design Engineer
description:
**Job Description: Piping Designer (Water Treatment) – AutoCAD Plant 3D**

**Role Summary**

Develop 3D piping models and deliverables for municipal and industrial water and wastewater treatment plants (intake, clarification, filtration, RO/UF, disinfection, sludge handling, chemical dosing), using AutoCAD Plant 3D within a multidiscipline project team.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Build and maintain 3D plant models in AutoCAD Plant 3D, including piping, equipment, supports, and structural/civil interfaces.

- Develop and manage project specs, catalogs, and piping classes (carbon steel, SS 304/316, HDPE, PVC/CPVC, FRP, ductile iron, GRP).

- Produce P&ID-linked deliverables: piping GAs, plans/sections, isometrics, MTOs/BOMs, line lists, and equipment layouts.

- Maintain P&ID and 3D model consistency using Plant 3D's P&ID module, data validation, and tag/line number management.

- Route piping for pump stations, blowers, clarifiers, filter galleries, membrane skids, and chemical areas, accounting for gravity flow, NPSH/suction conditions, slopes, venting, and drainage.

- Design chemical piping (e.g., sodium hypochlorite, ferric chloride, caustic, acid, polymer) with proper materials, secondary containment, and double-wall considerations.

- Coordinate pipe supports, expansion, and stress-critical lines with the pipe stress engineer.

- Perform clash detection (Navisworks or Plant 3D clash tools) and resolve interferences with civil, structural, electrical, and mechanical teams.

- Ensure designs allow for operation, maintenance access, valve/instrument accessibility, and equipment removal.

- Generate and manage isometrics via Plant 3D Isometric/Ortho tools, including spool numbering for fabrication.

- Support site queries, as-built updates, and model revisions through project phases.

- Follow company CAD standards, QA/QC procedures, and document control.

**Required Qualifications**

- Diploma or ITI/degree in Mechanical/Piping Design or equivalent.

- 5+ years of piping design experience; at least 3 years in water/wastewater, desalination, or process industry.

- Strong proficiency in AutoCAD Plant 3D (spec editor, catalog builder, project setup, Iso configuration); working knowledge of AutoCAD and Navisworks.

- Solid understanding of piping codes and standards: ASME B31.3, B31.1 (as applicable), AWWA C-series, ASME B16.5/B16.47, ISO/EN flanges, AWWA M11 for steel pipe.

- Knowledge of valves (butterfly, gate, check, knife gate, diaphragm), pumps, strainers, flow meters, expansion joints, and flexible couplings used in water treatment.

- Ability to read P&IDs, process datasheets, and equipment vendor drawings.

**Preferred Skills**

- Experience with Autodesk ecosystem: Plant 3D, Navisworks, Autodesk Docs/BIM 360, Revit coordination (for building and structure interface).

- Experience in Plant 3D customization (spec, catalog, and iso style development).

- Familiarity with thermoplastic piping practices (PVC, HDPE butt/electrofusion, solvent weld) and FRP/GRP design.

- Knowledge of hydraulic profile basics and pipe sizing criteria (velocity limits, headloss).

- Exposure to RO/desalination pretreatment and post-treatment systems.

- Understanding of 3D model reviews (30/60/90%) and laser scan/point cloud integration for brownfield projects.

**Water-Treatment-Specific Design Considerations**

- Corrosion resistance and material compatibility with raw water, brine, chlorinated water, and chemicals.

- Buried pipe design: thrust blocks, restrained joints, cover depth, and trench details.

- Pipe-through-wall details (puddle flanges, wall sleeves, link seals) and concrete tank interfaces.

- Low-point drains, high-point air release/vacuum valves, and surge protection.

- Gallery and trench layouts, grating/handrail clearances, and safe access.

- Compliance with potable water standards (NSF/ANSI 61) where applicable.

**Deliverables Owned**

- 3D model and model review packages

- Piping layout drawings and sections

- Isometrics and spool drawings

- MTO/BOM and line lists

- Piping specs and support schedules (in coordination)

- As-built drawings

title: Structural Forensic & Diagnostic Engineer
company: Salt Design & Infra Services Pvt. Ltd.
description:
***Please note:***
*The advertised position is with RAMS Digital.*

**About RAMS Digital**

RAMS Digital, a product of INODE – RAMS Built Env Tech Pvt. Ltd., is transforming warehouse safety, efficiency, and compliance through Digital Twin technology, IoT-based monitoring, and advanced structural diagnostics.

By combining deep domain expertise in racking systems with cutting-edge technology, we help businesses understand what is physically happening inside their warehouses and make data-driven decisions.

🌐 Learn more: https://www.rams.digital

**What You’ll Do**

This is more than a conventional structural engineering role. You’ll investigate, analyse, and evaluate some of the tallest and most complex warehouse racking structures, combining on-ground audits, structural analysis, forensic investigations, and technology-driven engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Structural Audits Using Digital Twin Technology**

* Map warehouse racking systems, including structures up to 43 metres high, into a digital environment.
* Identify and classify beam deflections, bracing failures, corrosion, anchorage issues, and frame misalignments.
* Prepare digital inspection reports with risk assessments and repair recommendations.

**2. Structural Revalidation & Design Analysis**

* Perform structural calculations in accordance with applicable engineering codes and standards.
* Evaluate warehouse-specific loading conditions, material handling equipment (MHE) interactions, impact loads, and lateral drift.
* Analyse frame stability, load paths, buckling, and anchorage failures.

**3. Forensic Structural Investigations**

* Conduct post-incident investigations involving rack failures or structural collapses.
* Reconstruct incidents using site evidence, Digital Twin models, and back-analysis of loading conditions.
* Identify root causes, design deficiencies, and operational violations, and recommend corrective actions.

**4. Retrofit, Repair & Strengthening Design**

* Develop engineering solutions involving member replacement, additional bracing, anchorage redesign, and customised strengthening.
* Validate proposed solutions using the RAMS platform and simulate their performance before implementation.

**5. Technology-Driven Structural Diagnostics**

* Use Digital Twin technology for structural visualisation, inspection, and issue tracking.
* Explore AI-powered drone integration for detecting tilt, deflection, and component misalignment.
* Work with IoT-based monitoring systems for impact tracking, vibration analysis, and structural health indicators.

**What Makes This Role Unique?**

* Work at the intersection of structural engineering, forensic investigation, and advanced technology.
* Solve real-world engineering challenges across warehouses in India and international markets.
* Gain hands-on exposure to complex industrial structures and technology-enabled diagnostics.
* Explore career growth opportunities in technical leadership, product development, and specialised structural audit consulting.
* Work with leading brands and global warehouse operations.

**Role Overview**
The IT Operations Administrator is a senior-level role within the IT Operations Team. In addition to handling a full scope of end-user support responsibilities, the Administrator serves as a technical leader and mentor for junior analysts, owns the administration and continuous improvement of Chatham’s ITSM platform, and acts as a key liaison between front-line support and senior IT stakeholders. This role demands a high degree of technical proficiency, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine commitment to service excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-User Support & Service Delivery**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for inbound technical inquiries via phone, secure chat, walk-up, and email, ensuring every interaction reflects Chatham’s commitment to world-class service.
* Apply advanced conversational and diagnostic techniques to rapidly identify root causes, build end-user trust, and resolve issues at first contact whenever possible.

* Proactively identify patterns in inbound inquiries and share insights with management to drive systemic improvements to IT services, operations, and policies.

title: SAP SF Compensation and variable pay
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION- SAP Compensation, Variable Pay & Benefits Lead**
**NOTE- Immediate to 15 Days Notice Period Candidates will be considered.**
**Position Overview**
Oversee and execute the end-to-end Compensation, Variable Pay, and Employee Benefits architecture. Ensure competitive, compliant, and data-driven pay structures while driving operational accuracy, cost efficiency, and strong alignment with business performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Compensation Management
* Lead annual increment, merit, promotion, and market-adjustment cycles.
* Perform salary benchmarking and role evaluations using market data (e.g., Mercer, Aon).
* Manage salary bands, pay structures, and internal pay equity audits.
* Provide data-backed compensation proposals for new hires, promotions, and retention cases.
* Variable Pay & Incentives
* Design, administer, and govern short-term incentive, bonus, and sales pay plans.
* Execute monthly, quarterly, and annual variable pay calculations, audits, and payouts.
* Partner with Finance and Business Unit leaders to define, track, and validate target KPIs.
* Benefits Administration & Vendor Management
* Manage health insurance, leaves, wellness initiatives, and retirement benefits.
* Lead vendor management, SLA tracking, broker negotiations, and program renewals.
* Resolve escalated employee queries and ensure clear benefit policy communications.
* Governance & Statutory Compliance
* Maintain C&B policy compliance with statutory regulations (PF, Gratuity, ESIC, LWF, Minimum Wages).
* Maintain complete documentation and process controls for internal and external audit readiness.
* Standardize and automate Total Rewards workflows.
* Analytics, Modeling & Budgeting
* Build executive dashboards tracking C&B cost impacts, headcount metrics, and payout trends.
* Perform financial modeling and scenario planning to support strategic decision-making.
* Assist in annual budgeting and cost forecasting for pay, incentives, and benefits.
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Act as the C&B Subject Matter Expert (SME) for HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and Business Leaders.
* Drive communication and rollout plans for annual rewards, incentive cycles, and policy updates.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Execution: 100% timeliness and zero-error accuracy in increment and variable pay cycles.
* Compliance: 100% statutory compliance and clean audit reports.
* Competitiveness: Alignment of salary bands with target market percentiles.
* Cost Efficiency: Effective benefit program renewals within budget parameters.

**Requirements & ProfileExperience & Education**

* Experience: 7–12 years of core experience in Compensation & Benefits or Total Rewards in mid-to-large enterprise environments.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or Finance. MBA/PGDM preferred.

**Key Skills**

* Technical: Deep C&B domain expertise, Indian C&B statutory rules, Mercer/Aon benchmarking tools, advanced Excel modeling, and HRIS/payroll platforms.
* Competencies: Analytical problem-solving, high data accuracy and confidentiality, strong execution discipline, and clear stakeholder communication.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

title: Analyst - Consumer Support
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Communication Skills:
* Fluent English Proficiency: As the role supports U.S. consumers, fluency in English is essential. This includes clear verbal communication, proper pronunciation, and professional tone.
* Excellent Verbal and Written Communication: Ability to communicate clearly and effectively both over the phone and in writing. This is crucial for maintaining a positive customer experience and resolving issues.
* Active Listening: Good listening skills are important to understand the customer's concerns and guide them appropriately through non-technical solutions.
* Cultural Sensitivity: Understanding of U.S. communication styles, expectations, and cultural differences to ensure smooth and effective interactions.

**Customer Service Skills**

* Strong Customer Focus: Ability to empathize with customers, address their concerns, and deliver excellent customer experience, even if the issue cannot be fully resolved in the first interaction.
* Patience and Professionalism: Ability to remain calm and professional in all situations, especially when dealing with frustrated or upset consumers.
* Clear Problem Solving: Ability to provide basic support (e.g., assisting with product inquiries, warranty coverage, registration of products, locate documents) or direct the customer to the appropriate online resources.
* De-escalation Skills: Ability to manage challenging situations and de-escalate conflicts, ensuring that the consumer feels heard, and their concerns are addressed.
* Problem-Solving Abilities: A strong ability to analyze issues and provide clear and accurate solutions. Even though it’s a first-tier role, the ability to handle basic concerns and escalate when necessary is crucial.
* Call Handling Skills: Efficient in managing call flow, multitasking (e.g., using CRM tools while talking to customers), and maintaining professionalism in every interaction.
* Conflict Resolution: Ability to de-escalate situations with upset or frustrated consumers and provide satisfactory resolutions.

**Product And Company Knowledge**

* Basic HVAC Product Knowledge: Basic technical aptitude of mechanical products. Training will be provided, but having some familiarity with terms like air conditioning, thermostats, and filters can be beneficial.
* Company Policies and Procedures: Understanding the company’s policies, procedures, and product offerings so you can answer common questions (warranty coverage and exclusions) and provide accurate information to customers.

**Technical Skills (Non-Technical)**

* Salesforce Experience: Familiarity with Salesforce to log and track customer interactions .
* Basic Computer Skills: Strong experience in using software like Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc.) for handling administrative tasks and documenting customer issues or feedback.
* Multitasking: Ability to handle multiple tasks, such as managing customer inquiries while inputting data into Salesforce or updating case statuses.

**Time Management And Organization**

* Efficient Call Handling: Ability to manage call time effectively without compromising the quality of service. While some calls may require longer conversations, it's important to keep the interactions efficient and focused.
* Task Prioritization: Ability to prioritize multiple customer inquiries and resolve them in a timely manner, especially in a high-volume environment.

**Soft Skills**

* Empathy: Ability to understand the customer's feelings and needs, helping to build rapport and make the customer feel valued.
* Positive Attitude: Always maintain a positive and solution-oriented approach, even if you don’t have immediate answers or resolutions.
* Attention to Detail: Ensuring all customer information is captured accurately, following up on pending cases, and documenting interactions properly in Salesforce.

**Qualifications**

* Experience
* Previous Customer Service Experience: 5 plus years of experience in any customer-facing role, particularly in a contact center environment, is highly valued.
* Experience in a B2C (Business to Consumer) Setting: Familiarity with handling consumer inquiries, even if they’re not technical in nature, would be an asset.

**Shift Assignment**

* Ability to Work U.S. Hours: Supporting U.S. consumers, the role requires working in shifts that align with U.S. time zones, 8:00AM-6:00PM CST.

title: Lead Platform Engineer

description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. title: SecOps Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
We are seeking a Systems Engineer to own patch management, configuration automation, and vulnerability remediation across our Linux and Windows server and endpoint fleets. This role combines Puppet/Ansible-based automation for Linux OS patching and configuration enforcement with SCCM/Intune-based endpoint management and PowerShell-driven remediation on Windows, ensuring systems across both platforms stay compliant, secure, and up to date with minimal manual intervention.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities — Linux (Puppet/Ansible)**

* Manage end-to-end patch lifecycle (assessment, testing, staged rollout, validation) across RHEL servers.
* Develop, maintain, and version-control Puppet/Ansible modules and manifests for OS patching, software installation, and configuration enforcement.
* Design staged/canary patch rollout groups to minimize production risk.
* Automate software installation and configuration across environments to reduce manual provisioning.
* Troubleshoot patch failures, configuration drift, and Puppet/Ansible run errors across the fleet.
* Lead remediation of End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) operating systems and software — upgrading, re platforming, or migrating affected servers ahead of support cutoff dates.
* Execute EOL remediation plans in coordination with infrastructure and application owners, escalating and documenting formal risk acceptance only where remediation isn't feasible within the required timeline.

**Key Responsibilities — Windows (SCCM / Intune / PowerShell)**

* Manage and maintain endpoint security configurations using SCCM and Intune.
* Develop and implement PowerShell scripts to automate vulnerability remediation, security tasks, and processes.
* Create and manage imaging and task sequences in SCCM and Intune.
* Package and deploy patches on Windows servers and workstations based on a monthly schedule.
* Deploy collections in SCCM and push relevant missing patches to remediate vulnerabilities.
* Write PowerShell scripts to fix vulnerabilities based on testing on a few devices and implement them through Qualys or SCCM.

**Shared Responsibilities — Vulnerability Management & Compliance**

* Prioritize and remediate critical/high findings within SLA.
* Define and manage maintenance windows, rollback procedures, and exception/risk-acceptance workflows for unpatchable systems.
* Collaborate with security and application teams to align patch cadence with compliance requirements (CIS Benchmarks, STIG, PCI, etc.).
* Document processes, runbooks, and standard operating procedures for patch, configuration, and remediation management.

**Required Qualifications — Linux**

* Minimum 3+ years of Linux systems administration experience (RHEL).
* Hands-on experience with Puppet/Ansible (manifests, modules, Hiera, PuppetDB, r10k or similar control-repo workflow).
* Experience with package management (yum/dnf, apt).
* Hands-on experience remediating EOL/EOS operating systems and software — performing OS upgrades, migrations, or replat forming to bring systems back into supported status.

**Required Qualifications — Windows**

* Proven experience in vulnerability management and security operations.
* Strong knowledge of Qualys, SCCM, and Intune.
* Experience with imaging and task sequencing in SCCM and Intune.

**Required Qualifications — Shared**

* Scripting proficiency in Bash and/or Python, and proficiency in PowerShell scripting.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong communication and teamwork abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with patch orchestration tools (Red Hat Satellite, Spacewalk, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with vulnerability management/scanning tools (Qualys or similar).
* Understanding of CIS Benchmarks, STIG, or other security hardening standards.
* Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or higher; Puppet/Ansible Certified Professional.
* Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare) with formal exception/risk-acceptance processes.
* Experience running EOL remediation projects at scale (e.g., fleet-wide OS version upgrades, distro migrations) in coordination with cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Ansible or other configuration management tools as a secondary skill.
* Experience building compliance dashboards (Grafana, Splunk, or similar).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field — or equivalent practical experience.

title: ServiceNow SecOps SIR - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant**
**Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services**
help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.
  
  
**Work you will do**
As a
**Consultant / Senior Consultant**
, you would be expected to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.
* Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service.
* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.
* Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen.
* Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration.
* Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations.
* Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities.

**Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)**

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.
* Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions.
* Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling.
* Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities.
* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation.
* Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload.
* Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management.
* Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response.
* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

**Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)**
Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.
* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.
* Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion.

**Core Skills**
ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.
  
  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

title: Information Technology System Administrator
description:
**About Brite**

Brite Systems Inc. is a U.S.-based, AI-led digital transformation company and a Top 1% Salesforce Summit Partner. Since 2006, we have helped government and nonprofit organizations modernize their technology, improve operations, and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve.

Headquartered in Indianapolis with a Global Delivery Hub in Chennai, Brite brings together expertise across Salesforce, AWS, MuleSoft, AI, and our proprietary Enlite Accelerator to solve complex challenges and create meaningful impact.

At Brite, you’ll be part of a collaborative, people-first team where innovation, continuous learning, and meaningful work come together. We’re proud to be recognized among Indiana’s fastest growing companies, named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies, and recognized as a Great Place to Work in Indiana for seven years. Join Brite to build innovative technology, grow your career, and make a difference.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Administrator to provide first-level IT support to employees. The ideal candidate should possess strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and a service-oriented mindset to ensure timely resolution of technical issues while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

**End User Support**

* Provide first-level technical support for desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and application-related issues.
* Install, configure, and maintain Windows operating systems and standard business applications.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and OneDrive.



**User Administration**

* Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts.
* Manage password resets and access permissions.
* Configure email accounts, distribution groups, and shared mailboxes.

**Asset Management**

* Maintain the IT asset inventory, including laptops, desktops, monitors, and accessories.
* Track asset allocation, returns, warranty details, and lifecycle.
* Coordinate procurement and replacement of IT equipment.



**Ticket Management**

* Log, prioritize, and resolve support tickets within defined SLAs.
* Escalate unresolved issues to Level-2 or specialized support teams.
* Maintain proper documentation of incidents, resolutions, and root causes.



**Infrastructure Support**

* Assist in configuring and troubleshooting LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and internet connectivity.
* Support printers, scanners, meeting room equipment, and video conferencing systems.
* Assist with software deployment and patch management.



**Employee Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Prepare laptops and user accounts for new employees.
* Configure required software, licenses, and access rights.
* Recover company assets and revoke system access during employee exit.



**Documentation & Compliance**

* Maintain knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure compliance with IT security policies.
* Support periodic audits related to IT assets and access management.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related field.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Brite Systems is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Recruitment Fraud Alert! There has been an increase in fraud that targets job seekers. Scammers may present themselves to job seekers as Brite Systems employees or recruiters. Please be aware that Brite Systems does not request sensitive personal data from applicants via text/instant message or any unsecured method; does not promise any advance payment for work equipment set-up; and does not use recruitment or job-sourcing agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind. We encourage you to review and apply to our available job openings at Brite Systems website. For more information on avoiding and reporting scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission’s job scams website

**Summary**
The Linux Desktop Engineer will own the design, deployment, configuration, and structural maintenance of Celestica's high-performance Linux computing platform. This role directly supports the Hardware Platform Solutions (HPS) engineering group by managing a fleet of approximately 50 HP ZBook Mobile Workstations preinstalled with Ubuntu and optimized for advanced AI-based software development.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of enterprise endpoint compliance and agile engineering infrastructure , the successful candidate will use HCL BigFix as the primary Endpoint Management framework. Responsibilities include developing deployment packages for core endpoint security software , managing monthly patching cycles , and troubleshooting highly specialized developer toolchains to maximize engineering velocity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Fleet Configuration & Baseline Optimization: Own the baseline golden imaging, mass deployment, and configuration maintenance of the HP ZBook workstation fleet utilizing HCL BigFix.
* Silent Software Packaging: Architect and deploy automated, silent installation packages for all enterprise and custom engineering endpoint software via BigFix fixlets.
* Endpoint Security Management: Install and administer Celestica’s standard security applications, including CrowdStrike Falcon, ThreatLocker, and Zscaler ZPA.
* Developer Persona Customization: Configure application controls specifically for the engineering developer workspace. This involves deploying ThreatLocker in a persistent Learning Mode with dedicated sandbox path exceptions (such as ~/Workspace) to prevent process blocks during source compilation.
* Exclusion Path Auditing: Implement and maintain required anti-malware scan exclusions across engineering build paths (e.g., /home/\*/src/, make, gcc, cargo) to ensure frictionless local compilation.
* Patching & Vulnerability Remediation: Support and execute monthly operating system and application patching cycles. Ensure critical security patches are vetted and pushed to engineering systems within a mandatory 24-hour window when required.
* Privileged Access Governance: Administer scoped sudo access on developer workstations using secure alternative authentication models (such as SSH agent-based PAM) and manage compliance audits via session recording tools like tlog.
* Engineering Toolchain Support: Act as the primary technical interface for HPS Software Engineers, ensuring local access to build essentials, containerization software, and integrated development environments.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
  
  
**Preferred Technical Qualifications**

* Operating Systems: Expert-level administration of native Ubuntu Linux (specifically 22.04 LTS and 24.04 LTS Desktop environments).
* Endpoint Management: Deep technical expertise using HCL BigFix for software asset tracking, package packaging, enterprise scripting, and automated deployment.
* Endpoint Security: Direct experience administering patches and Fixlets for enterprise security suites: CrowdStrike Falcon, ThreatLocker (including allowlisting/ringfencing policy adjustments), and Zscaler ZPA.
* Developer Environments: Familiarity supporting low-level compilation workflows and toolchains: build essentials (GCC, Clang, CMake, Rust/cargo), Python 3.10+, Docker CE, MicroK8s/Kind, and VS Code.
* Scripting & Automation: Advanced proficiency in Bash or Python scripting to automate workstation configuration, environment provisioning, and repetitive IT administrative tasks.
* Workstation Hardware: Experience configuring high-density workstations (such as the HP ZBook Fury series), including managing system BIOS updates and optimizing dedicated NVIDIA hardware driver profiles.

**Core Competencies**

* Developer Velocity Orientation: Possesses an intense focus on minimizing developer friction, reducing environment downtime, and protecting the engineer's flow state.
* Matrix Collaboration: Exceptional diplomatic and relationship-building skills to successfully co-develop frameworks with Global Information Security and remote site infrastructure divisions.
* Advanced Technical Problem Solving: Proven ability to troubleshoot unique, non-standard software-hardware boundary failures that fall outside typical corporate enterprise IT ticketing scripts.

Physical Demands
  
  

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Information Systems, with a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience supporting specialized R&D or engineering IT environments.

title: Cloud AI Security - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
SeniorConsultant - Cloud AI Security
  
  
Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.
  
  
Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
  
  

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**
Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
  
  
**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
* Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer
* AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
We are looking for a proactive, organized, and communication-oriented individual to handle end-to-end student coordination, institutional communication, and operational support for international education activities.

The role involves acting as a bridge between students, universities, outreach partners, and the internal team to ensure smooth coordination, timely follow-ups, and successful execution of student processes and institutional engagements.

Key Responsibilities

Student Coordination & Support

- Handle end-to-end coordination for students interested in studying abroad- Maintain regular communication with active, potential, and pipeline students- Follow up consistently regarding documents, pending actions, application updates, and process completion- Ensure all information shared by the internal team is clearly communicated and implemented by students- Assist students with university/course shortlisting using internal portals and CRM systems- Provide timely support and updates throughout the admission process

Institutional & University Coordination

- Coordinate with Indian and foreign universities regarding meetings, seminars, collaborations, and partnership discussions- Fix appointments and follow up for potential MoU discussions and institutional collaborations- Support communication between university delegates and the Managing Director- Send professional emails, maintain contact records, and track communication updates- Follow up until meetings, sessions, or institutional activities are successfully confirmed

Event & Operational Support

- Coordinate seminars, webinars, study fairs, awareness sessions, and university events- Support operational activities including scheduling, logistics coordination, and event execution- Coordinate with speakers, university representatives, and institutional stakeholders- Assist in Campus to Corporate programs and other institutional engagement activities

Administrative & CRM Management

- Maintain student records, CRM updates, and process tracking- Stay updated on university programs, intakes, scholarships, and institutional information- Support internal coordination across operations, marketing, and student support teams

Preferred Skills

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills- Excellent follow-up and coordination abilities- Self-motivated with ownership mindset and initiative-taking ability- Good organizational and multitasking skills- Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment- Basic knowledge of CRM tools, Google Workspace, and email communication

Ideal Candidate

- Someone who enjoys coordination, communication, and relationship management- Interested in international education, institutional partnerships, and student engagement- Able to independently manage responsibilities and problem-solve proactively

Work Environment

* This role offers exposure to student support, university relations, business coordination, operations, and event management, providing strong practical learning and growth opportunities.
