title: SAP GRC Consultant – IT Audit & Access Controls
description:
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**Experience:**
4–6 years
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an SAP GRC professional with a strong IT Audit background to manage and strengthen the SAP Governance, Risk and Compliance framework. The role requires hands-on expertise in SAP GRC Access Control, Segregation of Duties (SoD) risk analysis and IT General Controls (ITGC). It ensures the SAP environment stays secure, compliant and aligned with internal control and regulatory requirements. The position reports to the Global Process Owner.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure and maintain SAP GRC Access Control, including access risk rulesets, mitigating controls and remediation workflows.
* Conduct periodic reviews of SAP user access, role assignments, privileged access and Firefighter (emergency access) to identify and remediate SoD conflicts.
* Monitor access controls across key business cycles, including Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash and User Access Management.
* Assess ITGC, application controls and infrastructure controls within SAP environments, benchmarking against frameworks such as NIST.
* Work with IT and business stakeholders to investigate audit findings, track remediation and improve control effectiveness.
* Support internal and external audit engagements across planning, fieldwork, reporting and issue follow-up for SAP systems.
* Evaluate third-party assurance reports (ISAE 3402 / SOC) for outsourced IT functions.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments and support IT security reviews with the security team.
* Train key users, internal auditors and auditees on GRC processes, tools and controls.
* Maintain and enhance audit issue tracking systems and workflows.

**Qualifications (All Mandatory)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting or a related field.
* 4–6 years of experience in IT Audit (internal and/or external), with a strong focus on SAP Access Controls and GRC.
* Hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control, including access risk analysis, mitigating control assignment and SoD rulesets.
* Working knowledge of SAP modules (MM, FI, PP, QM, PM, SD) and how they relate to access risk.
* Solid understanding of ITGC, application controls and vulnerability management.
* Experience with Identity & Access Management tools such as CyberArk, and with privileged access reviews.
* Familiarity with audit and analytics tools such as ACL and TeamMate.
* CISA certification is required. ITIL Foundation is a plus.
* Exposure to vulnerability assessment tools such as Nmap or Nessus is an advantage.
* Proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, Word, Visio and PowerPoint.

**Candidate Profile**

* An IT Audit professional with Big 4 or large-scale internal audit experience.
* Has delivered GRC or access-control training to end users and auditors.
* A strong communicator who can turn technical findings into clear business recommendations.
* Fluent in English.

title: Generic - TechnologySpecialist
description:
**Job Summary**
This role as a technology specialist focuses on designing developing and optimizing enterprise grade applications using Java and Hibernate in a hybrid work model. The specialist will analyze complex business requirements create robust solutions and enhance existing platforms to improve performance scalability and reliability while aligning with organizational standards and supporting sustainable innovation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust server side components using Java and Hibernate to deliver reliable business functionality that supports scalable enterprise solutions
* Optimize application performance by fine tuning Hibernate mappings and queries to ensure efficient data access and responsive user experiences across critical business workflows
* Collaborate with cross functional product and engineering teams to translate technical and non technical requirements into well structured Java application designs that align with organizational standards
* Develop and maintain clean modular and testable code in Java ensuring adherence to coding guidelines and best practices to support long term maintainability of core platforms
* Configure and manage Hibernate persistence layers including entity relationships transaction handling and caching strategies to improve data integrity and reduce latency in production systems
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex defects in Java and Hibernate based applications by performing detailed root cause analysis and implementing sustainable fixes that prevent recurrence
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions to provide constructive feedback share best practices in Java and Hibernate development and uplift overall team proficiency
* Create and maintain technical documentation for application architecture data models and integration points to enable clear knowledge sharing and smoother onboarding of future team members
* Coordinate with quality assurance teams to define test scenarios automate key flows and validate Java and Hibernate components so that releases meet reliability and compliance expectations
* Support deployment activities in a hybrid work model by collaborating with operations teams to ensure stable rollout of Java services and structured monitoring of application health
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging Java frameworks and Hibernate enhancements and recommending pragmatic adoption paths that align with organizational goals
* Guide peers on effective use of Hibernate features such as criteria based queries and batch operations to improve efficiency in handling large data sets across business applications
* Engage with business stakeholders to understand evolving functional needs and propose Java based solutions that enhance customer experiences and deliver measurable value to society through improved digital services

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate professional experience between six and nine years in designing and developing Java applications with significant exposure to complex enterprise environments
* Apply deep knowledge of Hibernate including mapping strategies caching mechanisms and transaction management to create stable and efficient persistence layers for business critical systems
* Use strong skills in object oriented programming and core Java concepts such as collections concurrency and exception handling to build resilient software components
* Bring practical experience with relational databases and structured query design to support Hibernate integration and ensure accurate reliable data operations within applications
* Show familiarity with hybrid work models by effectively collaborating using digital tools coordinating with distributed teams and maintaining consistent productivity across remote and office settings
* Exhibit proficiency with modern development practices including version control unit testing and continuous integration to sustain software quality and predictable delivery cycles
* Possess strong analytical abilities to evaluate complex technical issues articulate solution options and recommend approaches that balance performance scalability and maintainability for enterprise systems
* Display clear communication skills to explain technical concepts to diverse stakeholders gather actionable feedback and ensure alignment between technology solutions and organizational objectives
* Present experience working in day shift environments supporting business stakeholders during standard hours and aligning development activities with key operational timelines
* Demonstrate awareness of secure coding practices in Java and responsible data handling with Hibernate to protect sensitive information and support trustworthy digital services for customers
* Maintain adaptability to learn new frameworks tools and architectural approaches in the Java ecosystem and apply them judiciously to enhance platform capabilities over time
* Show commitment to collaborative problem solving by working closely with peers testers and operations specialists to resolve incidents quickly and sustain high availability of applications

description:

**Location:**
Chennai, India |

Full-time |
**Function:**
Quality Assurance & Test Engineering |
**Reports To:**
Head – Quality Engineering

**RAMCO CONGLOMERATE**

Ramco Systems is part of the
**$1 billion+ diversified Ramco Group**
, a legacy enterprise with deep roots in industries such as cement, textiles, engineering, software, energy, and biotech. With over 75 years of heritage and innovation, the Ramco Group is a global powerhouse that blends traditional business values with modern technologies.

**Ramco Systems**
is the Group’s technology arm, delivering
**next-gen enterprise software**
across
**Global Payroll**
,
**HR**
,
**Aviation MRO**
,
**ERP**
, and
**Logistics**
. Headquartered in Chennai, India, Ramco serves over 1,000 customers across 35+ countries and is recognized for its
**AI/ML-based**
,
**bot-enabled**
, and
**cloud-native**
solutions.

Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high-growth enterprises alike.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications—
**Ramco is the place to be.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Testing AI & Agentic Software (core focus)**

* Own test strategy for copilots, assistants, LLM workflows, RAG pipelines, and multi-step agents across Ramco products.
* Build evaluation-driven quality:
  **golden datasets, eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge with human calibration**
  , and pass thresholds agreed with Product before release.
* Run regression for models and prompts — version pinning, drift detection, re-baselining on model upgrades, and A/B release comparison.
* Test RAG quality (retrieval precision and recall, groundedness, citation correctness, hallucination rate) and agents (tool selection, trajectories, memory, retries, loops, handoffs, MCP and tool contracts).
* Validate blast radius of autonomous action — permission scoping, approval gates, human-in-the-loop, idempotency, and rollback.
* Lead AI red teaming (prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, PII and tenant leakage) and AI non-functional quality (latency, token cost, concurrency, fallback).
* Extend quality into production through tracing, online evals, and drift monitoring, feeding failures back into regression.
* Ensure responsible-AI readiness — bias, explainability, and audit evidence against EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001.

**AI-Led Testing Transformation**

* Define the AI-in-QA strategy across test design, automation, test data, triage, RCA, and release readiness — including where AI is deliberately not used.
* Personally build testing accelerators with
  **Claude Code**
  or comparable agentic tools, and establish agent engineering practices (prompts, context files, skills, sub-agents, MCP integrations to ALM and CI, shared workflow repositories).
* Drive AI-assisted test design with mandatory human review, NL-to-script automation (Playwright, Selenium), self-healing locators, risk-based test selection, synthetic and masked test data, and AI defect intelligence.
* Govern AI-generated artefacts — review gates, traceability, IP hygiene, secure data handling, and human ownership of every released test asset.
* Measure AI impact (adoption, cycle time, coverage, escaped defects, cost per release), retire what shows no value, and reskill 40–50 engineers in prompt, context, and agent engineering.

**Quality Strategy & Organisational Leadership**

* Set the quality vision and multi-year roadmap with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Support, and Delivery.
* Run Quality Maturity Assessments with the Quality CoE and ensure QMS adherence.
* Balance Dev and QA capacity, and re-baseline QA sizing as AI gains land.
* Own the operating budget, including AI tooling and token spend, with ROI tracking.

**Test Engineering, Automation & Non-Functional Quality**

* Manage strategies across functional automation, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing.
* Drive testability and observability, including the instrumentation AI features need to be evaluable.
* Build simulation environments with mocked model endpoints for deterministic CI.
* Run proofs of concept comparing AI testing platforms against internal builds, and plan end-to-end testing across products and partners.

**Delivery, Metrics & People Leadership**

* Track productivity, defect leakage, automation coverage, AI adoption and, for AI features, eval pass rates and hallucination trends.
* Report licensing, financials, delivery, and quality to executives, and resolve production issues with global stakeholders.
* Lead managers, leads, and engineers across performance, automation, accessibility, security, and AI quality.
* Define career paths for AI quality and test tooling engineers, and build a culture of experimentation and psychological safety.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* AI features released against defensible, pre-agreed evidence rather than subjective confidence.
* Non-deterministic behaviour caught in evals before it reaches a customer workflow.
* AI used in QA where it demonstrably earns its place, and retired where it does not.
* Escaped defects trending down across products while release cadence goes up.
* A test organisation whose engineers can build their own tooling with coding agents.
* Responsible-AI evidence available when a customer, auditor, or regulator asks for it.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head of Quality Engineering and reviewed on the cadence noted.*

* **AI release confidence**
  — eval pass rates against agreed thresholds, hallucination rate, and groundedness and citation correctness on RAG features at release.
  *(Per release)*
* **AI safety and blast-radius assurance**
  — red-team findings (prompt injection, jailbreak, data leakage) closed before release, and permission scoping, approval gates, and rollback validated for autonomous actions.
  *(Per release)*
* **AI-in-QA impact**
  — adoption of AI testing accelerators, cycle-time reduction, coverage gain, and cost per release against baseline.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Escaped defects and production quality**
  — defect leakage to production across products, and production issues resolved within agreed timelines.
  *(Monthly)*
* **Automation and non-functional coverage**
  — functional automation, API, performance, accessibility, and security test coverage against plan.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Quality maturity and governance**
  — Quality Maturity Assessment outcomes, QMS adherence, and responsible-AI evidence maintained and audit-ready.
  *(Half-yearly)*
* **Capability and budget stewardship**
  — engineers reskilled in prompt, context, and agent engineering against plan; QA sizing re-baselined; and operating budget including AI tooling and token spend managed to plan with ROI tracked.
  *(Half-yearly)*

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
* 18+ years in test engineering, including 10+ years as a QA manager on complex products.
* 5+ years leading 50+ engineers including managers, in a matrixed global MNC, with a proven shift from QA to test engineering to AI-augmented testing.

**AI & Agentic Testing — essential**

* Hands-on tools built with
  **Claude Code**
  or equivalent, with concrete examples of users and savings; agent engineering across context files, skills, sub-agents, and MCP.
* Production experience testing LLM and agentic software — copilots, RAG, multi-step workflows — not lab-only.
* Eval frameworks for non-deterministic systems: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge with human calibration, and defensible release criteria; RAG quality measurement.
* AI safety testing — prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool data leakage, and agent permission scoping.
* Tooling: LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, DeepEval, Ragas, promptfoo, and agent-run tracing; judgement on AI economics and when deterministic tests are the better answer.

**Core Test Engineering**

* Functional and non-functional testing, Agile and Scrum, SQL validation, and quality standards and metrics for strategic programmes.
* Automation and performance tooling: Playwright, Selenium, Cucumber, Postman, JMeter, LoadRunner; REST, SOAP, GraphQL, and event-driven APIs.
* Languages and DevOps: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java or C#; Git, Jenkins, containers, Terraform or Ansible; LLM APIs and orchestration patterns.
* ALM: Jira/Xray, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, with APIs for agent-driven integration.
* ISTQB Advanced Test Manager certification.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* AI quality gates embedded in CI/CD.
* Exposure to EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001.
* Human-in-the-loop models for agents operating on enterprise data.
* AI enablement contributions — training, guilds, hackathons.
* AI certification such as CT-AI; PMP or PRINCE2 an advantage.

**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS**

* Lead quality for AI assistants, copilots, and autonomous agents embedded in enterprise workflows used across 35+ countries.
* A genuine dual mandate — testing AI, and rebuilding testing itself around AI.
* Budget and authority to build tooling rather than only buy it.
* Be part of a fast-evolving, innovation-led enterprise software company.

title: Community & Content Associate (SaaS)
description:
**About The Role**
You’ll build and run Entropik’s community for researchers across Asia-Pacific and North America. That means growing it across platforms, keeping it active and helpful, and making it a channel we can bring into our other campaigns. Along the way, you’ll learn how outreach, content and marketing fit together, work with sales on customer marketing, and become a face of our video content.
  
  
Freshers are welcome :) We care more about energy, curiosity, and ownership than years of experience. Gen Z or not doesn’t matter; we want someone who’d rather try something and fail than sit in a meeting talking about it.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
***Build the community***

* Build a community of researchers across platforms such as Slack and LinkedIn, so we can bring them into the other campaigns we run.
* Bring in new members who can contribute, and welcome each one.
* Make sure no question goes unanswered for more than a working day, on any platform.
* Post a question, a thought, or a thought-leadership post every week.
* Send a weekly digest of the best threads, and flag the ones worth using in other campaigns.

***Run live sessions and videos***

* Help run monthly study-design clinics, AMAs, podcasts and webinars, from booking guests to the run-of-show.
* Handle the camera, lights, and sound, appear on camera when needed, and cut recordings into short clips.
* Get internal teams to record product demos and feature-release videos. Once you know the platform well, you can become the face of that series yourself.

***Work with sales***

* Help bring our customer marketing channel to life with the sales team. This is already underway.

***Create and track***

* Turn the best questions and threads into posts, Quora answers, and short videos.
* Log the numbers every Friday: members joined, weekly activity, questions answered, and threads started by members.

**Your First 30 Days**
You’ll join while the community is being built, so you’ll see it go from an empty Slack workspace to its first live session.
  
  

* Week 1: Shadow the marketing team and our in-house content writer. Learn the audience and the platform, and help set up channels, rules, and the welcome flow.
* Week 2: Help send personal invitations to founding members and soft-launch the community.
* Week 3: Help run the first study-design clinic and send the first weekly digest.
* Week 4: Help produce the first AMA and run a short member survey.
* Week 5: Join the 30-day review and help decide what changes next.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* You love talking to people, online and in person, and you’d rather help them than sell to them.
* You’re comfortable on camera, or keen to get comfortable fast.
* You can handle basic camera, lighting, and editing, or you’re willing to learn in your first month.
* You write clearly and quickly, and you know how to use AI tools well. We see AI as an investment when it’s used well.

**Nice to have:**
You’ve run a college club, a Discord or WhatsApp group, a YouTube channel, a podcast or an event. Interest in research, UX, or B2B SaaS is a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**How To Get Ahead Of The Line**
Send a 60-second video intro to marketing@entropik.io. Tell us about a community you’ve been part of, or one you’d love to build. If you’ve made anything, like a reel, a post, or a group you run, add a link.

Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

As a Vendor Consultant and part of Selling Partner Engagement and Growth (SPEG), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon Vendors.
  
  
SPEG team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. * Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
* Can manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

title: Oracle Database Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Company / Team**
Join a technology-driven infrastructure and application operations team responsible for managing enterprise Oracle environments. The team focuses on delivering secure, scalable, highly available and reliable database, application and middleware services across on-premises and cloud platforms.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with cross-functional infrastructure, database, middleware and application teams to ensure operational excellence, business continuity and continuous service improvement.
  
  
The candidate should also possess scripting and automation capabilities, exposure to cloud infrastructure, particularly Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and the ability to support complex production environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oracle Applications & Database Administration: Administer, maintain, patch, upgrade, clone and refresh Oracle Applications 11i/R12 and Oracle Database environments, including database upgrades to 19c and support for multi-node application architectures.
* Fusion Middleware & WebLogic Administration: Install, configure, manage, patch and troubleshoot Oracle WebLogic Server, SOA, OBIEE and Fusion Middleware environments, including standalone and clustered deployments, JDBC Data Sources, JMS configurations, SSL and application deployments using WLST and administration utilities.
* High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Maintain highly available Oracle environments across multiple data centers using Oracle RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases, clustering, load balancing, switchover/failover procedures and disaster recovery synchronization mechanisms.
* Infrastructure & Production Support: Coordinate infrastructure, database, middleware and application changes; manage planned downtime; resolve critical production incidents; and ensure service restoration within defined SLAs in 24×7 environments.
* Performance Optimization & Capacity Management: Monitor system health, analyze performance bottlenecks, perform capacity assessments and implement proactive improvements to enhance application availability, scalability and reliability.
* Automation & Operational Excellence: Develop and maintain Python and shell scripts to automate administrative activities, streamline deployments, minimize manual interventions, reduce recurring incidents and standardize operational processes.
* Cloud Infrastructure & Migration: Provision, administer and support Oracle environments on cloud platforms, particularly OCI, and contribute to on-premises-to-cloud migration, infrastructure modernization and operational integration initiatives.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Troubleshooting: Work closely with infrastructure, database, application and customer teams to diagnose complex technical issues, implement preventive measures, maintain operational documentation and support mission-critical business services.

**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications & Skills**
**Mandatory**

* Minimum 5–6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Oracle Applications DBA, Database Administration and/or Fusion Middleware administration.
* BE/B.Tech, MCA or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong expertise in at least one domain—Oracle Apps DBA or Oracle Fusion Middleware/WebLogic—with good working knowledge of the other.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Applications 11i/R12, including cloning, patching, refreshes, upgrades and multi-node environments.
* Strong knowledge of Oracle WebLogic Server and Fusion Middleware installation, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, patching and clustered architecture.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration, Oracle Database 19c, RAC, Active Data Guard, standby databases and high-availability/disaster-recovery concepts.
* Experience managing WebLogic components such as JDBC, Data Sources, JMS, SSL and application deployments (WAR/EAR/EJB).
* Understanding of multi-node application infrastructure, load balancing, networking and application-tier configurations.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and Python or shell scripting for operational automation.
* Experience supporting production systems, troubleshooting complex incidents, coordinating infrastructure changes and managing SLA-driven operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to independently manage production-critical environments and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and proactive service-management mindset.
* Willingness to work in rotational 24×7 shifts, including weekends when required.

**Good-to-Have**

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) administration, provisioning and migration experience.
* OCI certification.
* Experience with other cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SOA, OBIEE, Identity Management and Oracle Access Manager (OAM)
* Experience with advanced WebLogic configurations, including Distributed JMS, Foreign JMS Providers, Message Bridges and WLST automation.
* Exposure to Docker containers and orchestration technologies.
* Experience implementing cross-data-center disaster recovery solutions, including synchronization using RSYNC.
* Experience driving operational improvements through proactive monitoring, automation and performance tuning.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have at least 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Apps DBA and/or Fusion Middleware administration, with strong expertise in one domain and practical working knowledge of the other?
* Have I independently administered Oracle Applications 11i/R12 environments or Oracle WebLogic/Fusion Middleware platforms, including installations, configurations, patching, cloning, upgrades or troubleshooting in production?
* Can I troubleshoot Oracle Database, RAC/Data Guard, WebLogic clustering, load balancing, JDBC/JMS, SSL or multi-node application issues to maintain high availability and meet production SLAs?
* Have I used Linux/Unix administration skills and Python or shell scripting to automate operational tasks, reduce manual effort and resolve recurring infrastructure or application issues?
* Am I comfortable independently supporting mission-critical environments, coordinating with customers and technical teams, and working rotational 24×7 shifts including weekends?

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. title: Advanced Associate, Observability Engineering
description:
**Function: Observability Engineering / SRE / Cloud Engineering**

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We are looking for an
**Observability Engineer**
to join our Observability Engineering team and help build, standardize, and operate a modern enterprise observability platform across cloud and application environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on engineering experience with
**New Relic, Grafana, and modern observability technologies**
, combined with solid foundations in
**cloud engineering, automation, DevOps, and SRE practices**
.

  
  

This role goes beyond dashboard creation and monitoring operations. You will be responsible for
**engineering scalable observability solutions**
, defining telemetry standards, building reusable monitoring capabilities, improving application and infrastructure visibility, and enabling engineering teams to adopt observability as part of their software delivery lifecycle.

  
  

You will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Operations teams to build a consistent and scalable observability experience across the organization.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  
  

**1. Observability Engineering**

  

  
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade observability solutions across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and services.
  
  
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, service health views, and operational telemetry.
  
  
* Develop standardized observability patterns for
  **metrics, logs, traces, events, and application performance monitoring**
  .
  
  
* Implement observability solutions using
  **New Relic, Grafana, and other industry-standard tools**
  .
  
  
* Develop reusable dashboards, alerts, instrumentation patterns, and observability components.
  
  
* Establish observability standards and best practices across engineering teams.
  
  
* Continuously improve signal quality by reducing alert noise, false positives, and non-actionable alerts.
  

  

**2. New Relic Engineering**

  

  
* Hands-on engineering experience with
  **New Relic APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, Browser Monitoring, Synthetic Monitoring, Logs, Distributed Tracing, NRQL, Alerts, Workloads and Dashboards**
  .
  
  
* Design and implement New Relic monitoring and alerting strategies for enterprise applications.
  
  
* Develop complex
  **NRQL queries**
  , alert conditions, dashboards, and operational views.
  
  
* Configure and optimize New Relic agents and integrations.
  
  
* Implement application and infrastructure instrumentation.
  
  
* Develop reusable New Relic configurations and automation using APIs/IaC where appropriate.
  
  
* Participate in New Relic platform governance, licensing optimization, and standardization.
  
  
* Evaluate and implement emerging New Relic capabilities to improve engineering productivity and reliability.
  

  

**3. Grafana & Visualization**

  

  
* Build and maintain operational dashboards using
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Integrate Grafana with multiple telemetry and data sources.
  
  
* Design effective dashboards for application health, infrastructure, SRE, NOC, and executive operational visibility.
  
  
* Develop visualization standards and reusable dashboard templates.
  
  
* Understand the difference between
  **visualization, monitoring, alerting, and observability**
  , and apply each appropriately.
  

  

**4. OpenTelemetry & Modern Observability**

  

  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  and modern telemetry architectures.
  
  
* Implement and manage telemetry collection for metrics, logs, and traces.
  
  
* Understand distributed tracing and service dependency mapping.
  
  
* Work with telemetry pipelines, collectors, agents, exporters, and integrations.
  
  
* Experience with technologies such as
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar observability platforms**
  is desirable.
  
  
* Evaluate new observability technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, cost, reliability, and engineering value.
  

  

**5. Cloud Engineering**

  
  

Strong cloud engineering fundamentals are expected, including experience with one or more major cloud platforms:

  

  
* **AWS**
  
  
* **Microsoft Azure**
  
  
* **Google Cloud Platform**
  

  

Experience should include:

  

  
* Compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, and cloud-native services.
  
  
* Cloud monitoring and logging.
  
  
* IAM and security fundamentals.
  
  
* Infrastructure automation.
  
  
* Cloud-native architecture and operational best practices.
  
  
* Troubleshooting distributed cloud environments.
  

  

**6. Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

  

  
* Automate repetitive observability and operational activities.
  
  
* Develop scripts and tools using
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages**
  .
  
  
* Use
  **Terraform / OpenTofu**
  or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies.
  
  
* Build reusable automation for dashboards, alerts, instrumentation, integrations, and configuration management.
  
  
* Integrate observability capabilities into CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

**7. DevOps & CI/CD**

  

  
* Experience with modern CI/CD practices and tools.
  
  
* Hands-on experience with
  **GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms**
  .
  
  
* Integrate observability and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
  
  
* Implement deployment markers and release health monitoring.
  
  
* Enable automated validation of application and infrastructure health following deployments.
  

  

**8. SRE & Reliability Engineering**

  

  
* Apply SRE principles to improve system reliability and operational maturity.
  
  
* Define and monitor
  **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets**
  .
  
  
* Participate in incident investigation and root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Develop proactive monitoring and reliability solutions.
  
  
* Identify reliability gaps and engineer solutions to eliminate recurring incidents.
  
  
* Support capacity, performance, availability, and resilience engineering.
  

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

  
  

**Must Have**

  

  
* **3+ years of experience**
  in Observability, SRE, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **New Relic**
  .
  
  
* Strong hands-on experience with
  **Grafana**
  .
  
  
* Experience building production-grade dashboards, monitoring and alerting solutions.
  
  
* Strong understanding of
  **APM, infrastructure monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and distributed systems**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **NRQL**
  and New Relic alerting.
  
  
* Experience with
  **OpenTelemetry**
  is highly desirable.
  
  
* Strong cloud engineering experience in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP**
  .
  
  
* Strong scripting/programming experience in
  **Python, Bash, Go, or similar**
  .
  
  
* Experience with
  **Terraform/OpenTofu**
  or another Infrastructure-as-Code technology.
  
  
* Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
  
  
* Understanding of SRE principles, SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability engineering.
  
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  

  

**Good to Have**

  

  
* New Relic certifications or equivalent hands-on expertise.
  
  
* Grafana/Prometheus experience.
  
  
* OpenTelemetry implementation experience.
  
  
* Kubernetes and container observability.
  
  
* Experience with
  **Prometheus, Loki, Elastic, Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, AppDynamics**
  or similar platforms.
  
  
* Experience designing enterprise observability architectures.
  
  
* Experience with observability platform migrations or consolidation.
  
  
* Experience with observability cost optimization and licensing governance.
  
  
* Experience developing observability-as-code.
  
  
* Experience integrating observability with
  **ServiceNow, Jira, PagerDuty, Opsgenie**
  , or similar ITSM/incident platforms.
  
  
* Experience with AI-assisted observability, AIOps, anomaly detection, or automated incident investigation.
  

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  
  

In this role, you will be successful when you can:

  

  
* **Engineer rather than simply operate monitoring.**
  
  
* Build scalable observability solutions that can be reused across hundreds of applications.
  
  
* Turn raw telemetry into meaningful engineering and operational insights.
  
  
* Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality.
  
  
* Standardize New Relic and Grafana adoption across engineering teams.
  
  
* Automate observability configuration and reduce manual operational work.
  
  
* Improve application reliability through better telemetry and proactive detection.
  
  
* Enable engineering teams to own more of their operational health.
  
  
* Help establish
  **Observability as a Platform/Capability**
  , rather than simply another monitoring tool.
  

  

**Behavioral & Leadership Skills**

  

  
* Strong ownership and accountability.
  
  
* Ability to work across engineering, application, infrastructure, and operations teams.
  
  
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  
  
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, enterprise engineering environment.
  
  
* Passion for automation, engineering excellence, reliability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
* Ability to challenge existing approaches and introduce better engineering practices.

title: Execution systems-Snr Eng
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role for an execution systems senior engineer focuses on designing implementing and optimizing industrial data solutions using AVEVA PI Historian to support manufacturing and supply chain operations enabling high availability of plant information improved decision making and sustainable efficiency gains across global sites while collaborating with cross functional teams in a day shift environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust AVEVA PI Historians that reliably capture real time plant data to support critical production and supply chain decision making across global manufacturing operations.
* Configure and maintain data collection interfaces and tags within AVEVA PI systems to ensure accurate high quality and timely acquisition of operational information from diverse industrial control assets.
* Develop and optimize PI Asset Framework models that clearly represent manufacturing assets process hierarchies and supply chain entities to enable meaningful analytics and standardized reporting.
* Create and maintain event frames and calculations in AVEVA PI environments to transform raw operational data into actionable performance indicators and insight for business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with operations manufacturing engineering and planning teams to understand data needs and translate them into scalable historian solutions aligned to enterprise standards.
* Implement and support data integration between AVEVA PI platforms and upstream or downstream systems such as MES ERP quality and planning tools to enable end to end process visibility.
* Define and enforce historian governance practices including naming conventions data retention strategies and security controls to ensure consistency and compliance across all installations.
* Troubleshoot complex AVEVA PI incidents and performance issues by conducting systematic root cause analysis and implementing durable corrective actions that minimize downtime.
* Develop comprehensive technical documentation covering system architecture configuration procedures operational runbooks and support guidelines to enable sustainable operations.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to enable advanced use cases such as production optimization demand planning and predictive quality based on PI data sets.
* Guide and mentor peers and junior team members on best practices for historian configuration data modeling and industrial connectivity to uplift overall team capability.
* Engage with business stakeholders in manufacturing and supply chain to prioritize enhancement backlogs and deliver incremental value through well planned historian improvements.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to ensure that AVEVA PI deployments follow corporate security baselines while maintaining high availability and performance.
* Drive continuous improvement of monitoring and alerting for PI systems so that potential capacity stability or data quality issues are proactively identified and resolved.
* Participate in hybrid work model ceremonies and cross site collaborations ensuring effective communication and smooth delivery while primarily operating in a day shift schedule.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive hands on experience in designing configuring and administering AVEVA PI Historian environments for complex industrial operations.
* Exhibit strong knowledge of PI components such as PI Server PI Asset Framework PI Vision and data interfaces with the ability to tailor solutions to varied plant contexts.
* Apply solid understanding of manufacturing processes and production workflows to design historian structures that accurately reflect real world operations and constraints.
* Utilize experience in supply chain or logistics domains to align data models and metrics with inventory fulfillment and planning objectives when applicable.
* Employ strong skills in industrial connectivity and automation concepts including OPC field devices and control systems to ensure reliable data collection into AVEVA PI.
* Demonstrate proficiency in scripting or query based configuration for calculations and analytics within PI environments to support advanced reporting and insight generation.

title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance
description:
**Job Title: Platform Engineer – Enterprise Golden Paths & Automated Governance**
**GCL: D3**
**Introduction To Role**
Do you want to build the clear routes that ensure secure delivery becomes the standard across a global enterprise? Can you turn sophisticated security and compliance controls into simple, reusable developer experiences that teams love to adopt?
  
  
In this role, you will develop the outspoken pipelines, infrastructure modules, and automation that power efficient, secure software delivery at scale. Your work will reduce friction for engineering teams, embed security-by-design from the start, and accelerate the delivery of technology that underpins life-changing science for patients worldwide.
  
  
You will partner closely with engineering, security, architecture, and operations to shape enterprise-grade platform capabilities—hands-on and end-to-end. Expect to start by shipping high-impact, reusable assets and evolve into guiding standards and adoption across hundreds of engineers, always balancing deep technical difficulty with practical, outcome-focused delivery.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Golden Paths & Shared GitHub Actions: Design, build, and version enterprise-grade shared GitHub Actions (Composite Actions and Reusable Workflows) and standardized delivery templates to create secure, automated "Golden Paths" across product teams.
* Reusable Infrastructure-as-Code: Build and maintain secure, modular Terraform modules and IaC assets, versioned and documented for broad reuse and easy consumption.
* Embedded DevSecOps Controls: Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM generation, and supply chain protections into default delivery workflows, shifting security left through automation and policy-as-code guardrails.
* Secure CI/CD Patterns: Create scalable, resilient CI/CD patterns aligned to enterprise standards, applying least privilege and reducing configuration risk to strengthen operational reliability.
* Automation and Internal Tooling: Develop automation services and developer tooling in Python or Golang that enable self-service onboarding, secure defaults, and consistent quality checks.
* Multi-Environment Architecture: Chip in to solutions spanning cloud, serverless, containerized, compute, and hybrid environments, producing reference architectures, diagrams, and implementation guidance that accelerate adoption.
* Testing and Quality Engineering: Define and execute testing strategies for infrastructure code and automation (unit, integration, and environment validation) to ensure repeatable, high-quality delivery.
* Adoption and Continuous Improvement: Partner with product and platform consumers to drive adoption, capture feedback, and iterate on patterns and assets to enhance developer experience and business value.
* AI-Enabled Engineering: Apply AI tools and techniques where appropriate to improve development speed, quality, secure design, and innovation, sharing learning and elevating team practices.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Significant 6+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or a related technical engineering discipline.
* GitHub Actions Platform Development: Hands-on experience authoring, testing, and maintaining centralized, reusable GitHub Actions (Composite Actions, Reusable Workflows) across an enterprise organization.
* Pipeline Versioning & Security: Understanding of Semantic Versioning for GitHub Actions (@v1, @v2), supply chain pinning, and securing pipeline-to-AWS authentication using OpenID Connect (OIDC)
* Strong experience with AWS, including services related to compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.
* Advanced expertise in Terraform and reusable infrastructure-as-code design.
* Strong scripting or software engineering capability in Python or Golang.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles and controls, including SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOM, and software supply chain security.
* Experience designing and implementing secure CI/CD pipelines within enterprise environments.
* Solid grasp of security-by-design, the least privilege, and secure architecture principles.
* Experience building scalable, reusable, modular platform solutions rather than one-off implementations.
* Ability to create clear and effective user documentation and architecture artefacts.
* Collaboration skills and ability to work optimally across engineering, security, and architecture teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, security, infrastructure, or DevOps/DevSecOps would be advantageous.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration technologies.
* Exposure to hybrid or on-premises environments.
* Familiarity with Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of modern application stacks such as Java, .NET, or React.
* Experience applying AI tools to development, testing, secure design, or engineering productivity improvement.
* Experience with infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest.

**Process Overview\***
Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitors, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents
  
  
**Job Description\***
We are seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to join the Cyber Security Operations team. This role will be responsible for understanding the enterprise DLP strategy, policy enforcement, threat detection, investigation, and response activities across on-premises, cloud, and endpoint environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in DLP technologies, information protection, insider risk management, cloud security, and detection engineering. In addition, the candidate should have hands-on experience leveraging AI/ML-driven security analytics, automation, and orchestration capabilities to improve detection accuracy, reduce operational overhead, and strengthen the bank's overall data protection posture.
  
  
As a senior member of the team, you will provide technical leadership, guide junior analysts, drive strategic security initiatives, enhance monitoring capabilities, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure protection of sensitive data across the enterprise
  
  
**Responsibilities\***
Data Loss Prevention & Information Protection
  
  

* Serve as the primary SME for enterprise DLP technologies, policies, controls, and monitoring capabilities.
* Design, implement, tune, and maintain DLP controls across endpoint, network, email, web, SaaS applications, and cloud environments.
* Lead investigations involving data exfiltration, insider threats, unauthorized disclosures, and policy violations.
* Develop and optimize detection use cases for sensitive data protection, insider risk monitoring, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Partner with business, technology, and risk teams to identify data protection risks and implement appropriate controls.
* Security Monitoring, Detection & Response
* Operate within the end-to-end detection and response lifecycle (Detect → Investigate → Respond → Improve).
* Conduct advanced investigations utilizing SIEM, EDR/XDR, DLP, Cloud Security, Identity Security, and Threat Intelligence platforms.
* Analyze logs, events, and telemetry from multiple security sources to determine attack scope, root cause, business impact, and remediation requirements.
* Lead security incident response activities involving DLP violations, cloud security incidents, insider threats, and data exposure events.
* Develop and continuously improve detection content aligned with MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
* Cloud Security (AWS & Azure)
* Design and monitor DLP and data protection controls across multi-cloud environments including AWS and Microsoft Azure.
* Support implementation and management of cloud-native security solutions, including:

+ AWS GuardDuty
+ AWS Macie
+ AWS Security Hub
+ AWS CloudTrail
+ Microsoft Defender for Cloud
+ Microsoft Purview Information Protection & DLP
+ Microsoft Sentinel
+ Azure Monitor and Azure Security Center

* Investigate cloud-based threats involving sensitive data exposure, excessive permissions, misconfigurations, and unauthorized access.
* Develop cloud security monitoring and detection use cases to enhance visibility and protection across cloud workloads and SaaS platforms.

AI/ML-Driven DLP & Security Analytics
  
  

* Leverage Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning capabilities to improve DLP effectiveness, classification accuracy, insider risk detection, and threat identification.
* Develop and implement behavioral analytics and anomaly detection models for identifying malicious or accidental data leakage.
* Utilize Generative AI and advanced analytics capabilities to enhance incident triage, threat enrichment, investigation workflows, and response effectiveness.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate AI/ML solutions into DLP monitoring, detection, and response processes.
* Measure and drive improvements in detection quality, false-positive reduction, and operational efficiency through AI-driven capabilities.

* Exposure to cross-functional projects spanning IT, security, and business operations.
* Competitive compensation and professional development support

title: Longevity physician and researcher
description:
**Company Description**
Prvnt is a private, invitation-only medical practice for families, focused on treatment, prevention, longevity, and performance through deep diagnostics, continuous monitoring, and evidence-based therapeutics. The practice manages a family’s health like a family office manages wealth, bringing parents, operating generations, and children under one coordinated, long-term medical program, while maintaining strict privacy within and around the family. Each member receives an individualized annual program across treatment, prevention, longevity, and performance, built on comprehensive review of existing records and targeted testing with rigorous clinical ranges. A multidisciplinary panel in therapeutics, diagnostics, genomics, and nutrition supports each physician, while Health Partners coordinate all logistics, from home blood draws to specialist referrals. Prvnt limits the number of families and members per doctor to preserve depth of care and uses its own intelligence system so clinicians can focus on decisions where human judgment matters.

**Role Description**
The Longevity Physician and Researcher will provide longitudinal, evidence-based care to family members, designing and supervising individualized protocols across treatment, prevention, longevity, and performance. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing comprehensive medical records, ordering and interpreting advanced diagnostic and genomic tests, setting personalized biomarker targets, and adjusting programs based on follow-up measurements. The role involves integrating clinical care with ongoing research in longevity medicine, critically appraising emerging literature, contributing to internal protocols and publications, and collaborating with the therapeutics, diagnostics, genomics, and nutrition panel. The physician will work closely with Health Partners to ensure seamless coordination of home-based procedures, specialist consultations, and international care logistics, maintaining the highest standards of privacy and safety. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, requiring regular in-person interactions with team members and, when applicable, patients.

**Qualifications**

* Advanced clinical training, such as MD/MBBS with residency in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Endocrinology, Geriatrics, or a closely related specialty; board certification or eligibility preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise or strong interest in longevity medicine, preventive care, metabolic health, and performance optimization, including managing chronic disease risk and age-related conditions.
* Proficiency in evidence-based practice: ability to interpret clinical trials, guidelines, and translational research, and to integrate emerging longevity science into safe, graded therapeutic decisions.
* Experience with advanced diagnostics and data-driven care, including laboratory panels, imaging, genomics, and continuous monitoring technologies, and comfort with setting and tracking individualized biomarker ranges.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills for working within a multidisciplinary team (therapeutics, diagnostics, genomics, nutrition) and coordinating care across multiple specialists and settings.
* Commitment to high standards of privacy, medical ethics,

description:

Main location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad
  
  
Position ID: J0926-1800
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 06 years of relevant experience
  
  
**Job Summary**
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.
* Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.
* Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.
* Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.
* Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.
* Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering
* Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.
* Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.
* Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.
* Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.
* Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering
* Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).
* Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.
* Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.
* Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.
* Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration
* Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.
* Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.
* Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.
* Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture
* Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).
* Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.
* Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.
* Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).
* Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning
* Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.
* Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.
* Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.
* Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.
* Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture
* Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.
* Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.
* Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.
* Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.
* Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship
* Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).
* Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.
* Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.
* Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.

Key skills :
  
  
Backup strategies, disaster
  
  
Recovery plans
  
  
Performance tuning,
  
  
Capacity/resource planning
  
  
Data Restoration
  
  
System Upgrades
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.
* Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).

**Required Technical Skills**

* Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.
* OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.
* Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.
* High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.
* Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.
* Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.
* Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.
* Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.
* Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* IBM Certified System Administrator / Solution Architect – IBM i.
* Certified High Availability Professional (e.g., Precisely Certified MIMIX Professional).
* Direct experience architecting IBM i within Hybrid Cloud environments (e.g., IBM Power Virtual Server / PowerVS on IBM Cloud).
* Deep experience in Ansible automation for IBM i system administration.
* ITIL Intermediate or Expert Certification.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Masterful Diagnostic Mindset: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, multi tiered infrastructure failures spanning OS, hypervisor, SAN, network, and application code.
* Decisive Crisis Leadership: Ability to take total technical command during critical production outages and execute high risk recovery actions under executive visibility.
* Strategic Infrastructure Vision: Capacity to balance immediate operational reliability with multi year modernization and platform automation goals.
* Technical Mentorship & Advocacy: Passion for uplifting team capabilities, mentoring L2 engineers, and evangelizing modern IBM i administrative patterns.e zones.boration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

Your future duties and responsibilities

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

description:

SimpliReply is a done-for-you WhatsApp follow-up system for businesses that run ads. We reply to every lead in 5 seconds, qualify them, and follow up for 14 days until they book.

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.
  
  
As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.
  
  
As a Systems Support Specialist at ICON, you will contribute to our client services function, working collaboratively to deliver high-quality outcomes across our clinical programmers.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
You will take responsibility for scientific operations deliverables, applying your skills to ensure quality and efficiency in Veeva Vault.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* User Support: Provide technical assistance and support to end-users, offering prompt solutions to hardware and software issues while maintaining a positive customer service experience.
* Troubleshooting: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues by researching and utilizing appropriate resources, tools, and processes.
* Documentation: Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date system documentation, ensuring that all processes are well-documented for optimal IT functionality.
* System Monitoring: Regularly monitor systems to detect and resolve operational problems, aiming to prevent service disruptions.
* Training: Assist in training end-users on various IT systems and applications to enhance their proficiency.
* Recommendations: Collaborate with the IT team to identify areas for improvement, propose recommendations for system enhancements, and support system upgrades and deployments.

**Your Profile**
You will bring relevant scientific operations experience, along with the following qualifications and skills.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience in IT support, troubleshooting, and system maintenance in Veeva Vault.
* Strong knowledge of hardware and software components, network configuration, and IT security best practices.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical information effectively.
* Detail-oriented and committed to providing top-Ntch customer service.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+) are a plus.

**What ICON Can Offer You**
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
  
  
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
  
  
**Our Benefits Examples Include**

* Various annual leave entitlements
* A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
* Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
* Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
* Life assurance
* Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.
  
  
At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Cyber Operate - Pentesting - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a Consultant– AI/ML/DevSecOps / Application Security with strong hands-on delivery experience in SAST, SCA, and DAST to embed security across the software development lifecycle. This role focuses on implementing and operating application security tooling in CI/CD pipelines, executing application security assessments (including API security), triaging and prioritizing findings, enabling remediation, and driving secure-by-design engineering practices across cloud-native and enterprise applications. SAST, SCA, and DAST remain foundational AppSec capabilities, and the role is positioned accordingly with an emphasis on measurable delivery outcomes (tool onboarding, pipeline coverage, risk reduction, and remediation closure).
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Integrate, configure, and optimize static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and dynamic application security testing (DAST) tools in continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, including quality gates and exception workflows.
* Perform security assessments across application code, open-source dependencies, REST and GraphQL application programming interfaces (APIs), cloud-native workloads, containers, and Kubernetes environments to identify vulnerabilities, exposed secrets, configuration gaps, and software supply-chain risks.
* Triage scan results, validate findings, prioritize vulnerabilities based on exploitability and business impact, and provide remediation guidance, compensating controls, and verification steps.
* Facilitate threat modeling and security design reviews; translate risks into secure design requirements, test cases, acceptance criteria, and engineering backlog items.
* Implement DevSecOps controls, including infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, container image scanning, policy-as-code, software bills of materials, and build and release integrity controls.
* Design and build artificial intelligence agents and agentic workflows for application security automation; assess AI/ML and generative AI application risks; and deliver client reports, dashboards, trend analysis, and implementation roadmaps.

**The team**
Deloitte's Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes:
  
  

* Managing Identity Lifecycle
* Security Operations
* Threat Intelligence
* Application Security
* Business Transformation
* Continuous Compliance

**Location: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata**
**Shift Timings: Rotational**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another technical discipline.
* 3-6 years of hands-on application security or DevSecOps experience, including operation of SAST, SCA, and DAST capabilities in CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with at least one application security tool: Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, Mend/WhiteSource, or Black Duck.
* Experience integrating security controls into Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, including pipeline templates, quality gates, and exception workflows; experience using Python or Bash for application security automation.
* Experience performing REST or GraphQL API security testing, including authentication and authorization testing, input validation, rate limiting, broken object-level authorization, and broken function-level authorization; experience with vulnerability triage and remediation validation.
* Experience conducting threat modeling and security architecture reviews for modern applications, microservices, or APIs.
* Experience designing and building AI agents or agentic workflows for security or engineering use cases, including tool or function calling, multi-step orchestration, logging, guardrails, and human validation.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience applying the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard to define or validate application security requirements.
* Experience implementing container or Kubernetes security, infrastructure-as-code scanning, secrets detection, or policy-as-code controls.
* Experience implementing software or AI/ML supply-chain controls, including software bills of materials, model bills of materials, artifact signing or verification, dependency pinning, build provenance, model registries, or data and model lineage.
