title: Senior Infrastructure Platform Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a hands-on Infrastructure Engineer to focus primarily on capacity and demand planning across data centers and public cloud. You will combine practical infrastructure experience with analytical thinking and strong internal customer relationships to translate future demand into clear capacity models, options, and timely decisions. This is a hands-on planning role grounded in how production infrastructure actually performs.
  
  
You will proactively engage engineering, application, product, and business teams, and help drive capacity and cost discussions with our existing FinOps engineers. Leadership owns approved forecasts, procurement and investment recommendations and decisions, and team backlog priorities. You provide the evidence, facilitate the planning cadence, and surface issues early.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build trusted relationships and proactive demand intake with internal customers, connecting delivery plans, workload changes, and business growth to infrastructure needs.
* Develop headroom, runway, growth, and scenario models for data center and public cloud capacity, documenting assumptions, uncertainty, dependencies, and changes in demand.
* Validate sizing against production evidence, peak demand, failover conditions, and performance requirements, rather than treating average utilization as sufficient.
* Account for hardware lifecycle and procurement lead times, cloud quotas, regional availability, and provisioning constraints when developing timing and capacity options.
* Run a leadership-sponsored planning cadence, maintain clear analytical inputs, and escalate approved threshold crossings for review. Thresholds trigger discussion, not automatic purchases.
* Help drive FinOps discussions with existing FinOps engineers: facilitate consumption, demand, capacity, and cost conversations; support consumption and spend forecast scenarios; and follow up with agreed action owners without controlling their backlogs.
* Partner on rightsizing, reclamation, total cost of ownership, workload placement, and commitment analysis. Validate potential savings against resilience and performance needs; FinOps specialists retain ownership of their practice and program.

**Requirements**

* Five or more years of practical infrastructure engineering or operations experience, with the technical depth and independent judgment expected of a senior engineer. We welcome candidates whose experience has been built in infrastructure operations.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams in a global environment. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with the US Eastern business day is required.

**Technical Requirements**

* Practical understanding of virtualization, compute, operating systems, storage capacity and performance (IOPS, latency, and throughput), networks, and resilience. Experience with platforms such as VMware or Nutanix and Windows or Linux is relevant; specific vendors are not required.
* Ability to interpret observability and time-series data, assess public cloud capacity constraints, and build demand forecasts using Excel, SQL, Python, or equivalent data analysis tools.

**Working Experience With**

* Sizing production workloads and validating capacity assumptions against real telemetry, workload behavior, service objectives, and operational constraints.
* Translating cross-team demand into planning inputs and collaborating with globally distributed teams to resolve gaps, dependencies, and competing assumptions.

**Must-Have Capabilities**

* Personal, practical infrastructure depth: explain how resources, bottlenecks, failure modes, and workload behavior affect usable capacity.
* Translate customer demand into defensible forecasts and scenarios, clearly separating evidence, assumptions, uncertainty, and risks.
* Facilitate constructive stakeholder conversations, challenge weak assumptions respectfully, and apply sound technical judgment to capacity and cost trade-offs.
* Collaborate effectively with FinOps engineers and service owners, making cost-aware options understandable without compromising performance or resilience.

**What This Role Is NOT**

* A general infrastructure delivery or ticket-queue role measured primarily by throughput, or a position intended to backfill on-call coverage. Operational experience informs the work; capacity and demand planning remain the primary focus.
* Ownership of approved forecasts, spend approval, procurement or investment recommendations and decisions, architecture, team backlog priorities, or the FinOps program. You develop analytical inputs and options in partnership with the accountable owners.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior specialist FinOps experience or certification, and experience supporting cloud cost optimization or commitment analysis. These are preferred, not required.
* Automation that improves telemetry collection, model inputs, or repeatable analysis. Terraform, Ansible, Git, CI/CD, and Kubernetes experience can be useful, but none is mandatory.

**How You'll Be Successful / Bottom Line**
You combine hands-on infrastructure knowledge with analytical judgment and strong working relationships to help our teams plan ahead. You work with internal customers and engineers to translate business demand into clear capacity requirements across data center and cloud environments, validate assumptions, and surface constraints early.
  
  
You help drive FinOps discussions in partnership with our FinOps engineers, connecting capacity needs, resource utilization, and cost tradeoffs without compromising performance or resilience. Your success is measured by the quality of your planning inputs, stakeholder engagement, and timely analysis that supports leadership's forecast, investment, and procurement decisions. Capacity planning is your primary focus; automation supports that work rather than defining the role.

description: The P&M Mechanical Engineer owns end-to-end mechanical engineering for the project's plant & machinery fleet, principally Tower Cranes, Batching Plants, Concrete Pumps, Boom Placers (Static/Mobile), Passenger-cum-Material Hoists and Telehandlers — the major P&M asset categories deployed on project, along with the wider spread of earthmoving, material-handling and site-support equipment, and additionally owns the mechanical/piping scope of Site Enabling Services — temporary water supply, plumbing and drainage infrastructure. The role spans the full equipment lifecycle — pre-mobilization technical evaluation, installation, commissioning, operation support, maintenance, overhaul and eventual demobilization/redeployment — with accountability for maximizing equipment uptime, safety and cost efficiency across the project. Key Responsibilities Conduct pre-mobilization technical evaluation and site-suitability assessment of equipment — foundation/ground bearing capacity, approach and clearances — before deployment. Plan and supervise equipment mobilization, positioning, erection and commissioning sequences as per OEM guidelines, GA drawings and approved method statements. Interpret and apply load charts, structural drawings and rigging plans to plan safe lifting operations. Plan and execute mast climbing/telescoping sequences for tower cranes and mast-based equipment in coordination with structural and safety teams. Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and structural faults across the equipment fleet. Design and drive preventive and predictive maintenance regimes — including condition-based monitoring such as vibration or oil analysis where applicable — to reduce unplanned downtime. Plan and execute major overhauls, critical component change-outs (engines, gearboxes, wire ropes, hydraulic cylinders) and end-of-life refurbishment decisions. Monitor fuel and consumable consumption across the fleet and drive efficiency and cost-control initiatives. Plan equipment demobilization, redeployment across clusters and disposal of surplus or obsolete assets. Lead root-cause analysis for repeat equipment failures and implement corrective and preventive actions. Sound understanding of engine, transmission, hydraulic and pneumatic system design and operating principles. Working knowledge of the structural and mechanical design aspects of cranes, hoists and mast-climbing equipment — stability, ballast and tie-in requirements. Familiarity with statutory and regulatory frameworks governing lifting equipment — competent-person certification, periodic testing and factory/labour regulations. Knowledge of preventive/predictive maintenance methodologies and condition-monitoring techniques. Commercial acumen for equipment cost evaluation, contract negotiation and lifecycle cost analysis. Understanding of water supply network design principles, pump hydraulics and piping standards. Analytical and root-cause problem-solving ability for recurring technical failures. Ability to read and apply engineering drawings, GA drawings and OEM technical manuals.

description:
**JD: Planning & Operations Control Engineer**

**Company:**

Sanah Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. — Architeca Design Build Firm

**Location:**

Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Department:**

Project Operations

**Reports to:**

Operations Head

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

**About Architeca**

Architeca Design Build Firm is a residential design-and-build company focused on delivering quality homes through integrated design, construction and project management. We are strengthening our project operations systems to ensure predictable project delivery, effective cost control and consistent execution across our growing portfolio.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a technically competent and highly organised Planning & Operations Control Engineer to establish and maintain project planning and monitoring systems across our residential construction projects.

This role combines construction scheduling, progress monitoring, cross-functional coordination and management reporting. The person will ensure that every project has a clear master schedule, that upcoming work is planned in advance, that delays are identified early and that agreed actions are followed through to closure.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Operations Head, Project Leads, Site Engineers, QS/Cost Control and Procurement teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Initiation and Planning**

* Coordinate the handover of newly signed projects from the Sales and Design team to Operations.
* Ensure project scope, contractual milestones, drawings status, client commitments and other essential inputs are documented.
* Prepare and maintain the master project schedule in coordination with the relevant technical and execution teams.
* Establish activity sequencing, durations, dependencies, milestones and target completion dates.
* Coordinate with QS/Cost Control to ensure the project budget, BOQ and BOM are established and approved.
* Identify long-lead materials, critical activities and major execution constraints during the planning stage.

**2. Schedule Monitoring and Project Controls**

* Monitor actual progress against the approved master schedule.
* Track planned versus actual progress, milestone achievement and forecast completion dates.
* Identify schedule deviations, critical-path delays and potential completion risks.
* Obtain progress updates from Project Leads and validate them against site-level information.
* Analyse the reasons for slippage and coordinate the preparation of recovery schedules.
* Maintain a consolidated project portfolio dashboard highlighting project health and critical exceptions.

**3. Look-Ahead Planning and Readiness Coordination**

* Coordinate preparation and weekly updating of the six-week look-ahead schedule.
* Ensure upcoming activities are reviewed for drawing approvals, material availability, manpower, equipment, client decisions and other constraints.
* Coordinate with Project Leads, Procurement and QS/Cost Control to ensure upcoming work is adequately planned and made ready.
* Track material request and procurement milestones against the required site delivery dates.
* Flag unresolved constraints before they affect site execution.

**4. Weekly Operations Review**

* Prepare the weekly project review dashboard before the scheduled review meeting.
* Coordinate with the relevant departments to obtain accurate and timely project updates.
* Highlight delayed activities, cost risks, unresolved constraints and decisions requiring management intervention.
* Record meeting decisions, responsible owners, target dates and corrective actions.
* Track action closure and escalate overdue commitments to the Operations Head.
* Maintain a consistent weekly project management rhythm across all active projects.

**5. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as the central coordination point for project planning information and operational follow-through.
* Facilitate communication between Project Leads, Site Engineers, Procurement, QS/Cost Control and Design teams.
* Follow up on interdepartmental dependencies and ensure unresolved issues reach the appropriate decision-maker.
* Maintain clear records of project milestones, constraints, risks, decisions and commitments in the ERP or designated project tracking system.
* Support the Operations Head in identifying recurring operational bottlenecks and improving project control processes.

**6. Process Development and Reporting**

* Develop standard formats for master schedules, look-ahead plans, progress updates, constraint registers and project dashboards.
* Improve the accuracy, timeliness and consistency of project information.
* Establish clear reporting and escalation procedures for project delays and unresolved dependencies.
* Support implementation of project planning and control SOPs across the organisation.
* Recommend improvements to ERP-based planning, monitoring and reporting workflows.

**Authority and Role Boundaries**

The role is responsible for planning, monitoring, coordination and reporting. It does not replace the accountability of functional owners.

* The Planning & Operations Control Engineer owns the integrity of the schedules, monitoring data, reporting and action-tracking process.
* Project Leads remain accountable for site execution and delivery commitments.
* QS/Cost Control remains accountable for cost estimation, budgets and cost-control inputs.
* Procurement remains accountable for purchasing and vendor coordination.
* The Operations Head retains overall accountability for project delivery, management decisions, priorities and escalation resolution.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering or Construction Management.
* Additional qualifications in project planning or project management are an advantage.

**Experience**

* Approximately 4–8 years of relevant experience in construction planning, project controls or project coordination.
* Experience in residential building construction or other building projects is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience preparing construction schedules, monitoring progress and coordinating multiple departments.
* Experience managing several concurrent projects is desirable.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of construction sequences, activity dependencies, critical paths and project milestones.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and project scheduling tools such as MS Project or Primavera P6.
* Familiarity with BOQ, BOM, procurement lead times, construction budgets and project reporting.
* Experience using ERP or construction project management software.
* Ability to interpret construction drawings and communicate effectively with technical teams.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong planning, organisation and follow-up discipline.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Confidence in coordinating with multiple departments and following up with senior team members.
* Analytical thinking and proactive identification of risks.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to work independently, maintain deadlines and escalate issues appropriately.
* A process-oriented mindset with a strong focus on measurable outcomes.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated against measurable indicators, including:

1. Percentage of active projects with approved master schedules and baseline completion dates.
2. Timeliness and accuracy of weekly schedule updates.
3. Timely preparation of the six-week look-ahead schedule.
4. Early identification and escalation of critical schedule deviations.
5. Accuracy of project progress and forecast completion reporting.
6. Timely preparation of weekly operations review dashboards and action trackers.
7. Percentage of assigned coordination actions closed by their agreed deadlines.
8. Timeliness of identifying material and other readiness constraints.
9. Completeness and reliability of project records in the ERP or designated tracking system.

Project completion performance will be a shared outcome with the Operations Head and Project Leads, rather than the sole responsibility of this position.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should:

* Establish a consolidated register of all active projects.
* Ensure each project has a documented schedule baseline or a clearly defined plan to establish one.
* Implement a consistent weekly progress-update and six-week look-ahead process.
* Introduce a reliable portfolio dashboard and action-tracking system.
* Establish clear visibility of delayed projects, upcoming constraints and overdue decisions.
* Enable the Operations Head to review project health and take timely action without personally chasing every department for routine updates.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may submit their updated CV highlighting relevant construction planning experience, scheduling tools used, the number and types of projects handled, and examples of project monitoring or coordination systems implemented.

title: Senior Design Engineer

The individual will collaborate with a team of architects, engineers, modelers and detailers to transform design concepts into detailed structural plans, specifications, and formal calculation packages. They will utilize computer-aided design (CAD) software and other industry-standard tools to develop accurate and efficient structural designs. Attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and a strong understanding of structural engineering principles will be crucial in this role.

The role will primarily focus on developing expertise in a variety of approaches and tasks involved in structural design through the completion of general and system-wide design tasks in close coordination with their Project Managers. The individual will expand on knowledge of a variety of material types, design approaches, project phases, and project scales, while actively participating in their project teams.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Assist in the production of drawings, specifications, and calculations during a project’s design phase life cycle from conceptual design to completion of construction documents under close supervision and coordination with the Project Manager or Senior Design Engineer. Responsibility will include tasks that are general and system-wide in nature.
* Assist in the completion of various construction administration tasks, such as reviewing shop drawings and submittals, responding to RFIs, and making site visits, under close supervision and coordination with the Project Manager.
* Assist in the development of structural designs and analytical models for various building types and materials.
* Review and revise designs based on feedback from senior design engineers and project stakeholders.
* Perform calculations and analyses to ensure structural integrity and compliance with building codes and regulations. Working knowledge of common codes.
* Working knowledge of CAD software, including Tekla Structures, and other tools to create 2D drawings and 3D models.
* Collaborate with team members, including engineers, modelers and detailers, to meet project deadlines and deliver high-quality design solutions within budget.
* Participate in internal project design meetings to gain practical knowledge and understanding of project requirements.
* Stay updated with industry trends, code updates, and advancements in structural design techniques and technologies by actively participating in professional development activities to enhance skills and knowledge in structural engineering and project management.
* Help identify opportunities for process improvement, cost optimization, and efficiency enhancement within the company.

**Required Skills and Abilities**

* Working knowledge of structural engineering principles, codes, and standards.
* Familiarity with structural design and analysis, and materials. General understanding of construction practices.
* The ability to identify and analyze problems, propose solutions, and make informed decisions; which includes critical thinking skills and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues that arise during the design and construction process.
* The ability to ask questions openly after spending a reasonable amount of time working through the task at hand.
* Competent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration and communication internally within the project team.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage project tasks in a fast-paced environment to meet deadlines.

* The ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with diverse stakeholders, which includes active listening, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

* Proficiency in relevant software and tools used in structural engineering and project management, such as computer-aided design (CAD) software.
* A desire to stay updated with industry trends, new technologies, and regulatory changes.

**Education and Experience**

* Must have a bachelors degree in civil engineering.

title: Tekla - Sr. Checker
description:
**Company Description**
Visai Engineering Private Limited is a growing, engineering and technology-driven company specializing in structural design, BIM solutions, and Tekla-based detailing services for the construction and infrastructure sectors. The organization focuses on delivering accurate, efficient, and innovative solutions through advanced engineering practices and digital transformation. Its multidisciplinary team combines structural engineering expertise with modern software tools, including Tekla Structures, CAD drafting, and BIM workflows. With a strong emphasis on precision, collaboration, and client satisfaction, Visai Engineering aims to be a trusted partner for clients in India and overseas. The company is committed to engineering the future by integrating innovation, technology, and expertise to create sustainable, scalable solutions.
  
**Role Description**
The Tekla – Sr. Checker is responsible for reviewing and verifying Tekla Structures models and drawings to ensure accuracy, constructability, and compliance with project standards and codes. **Qualifications**

* Sound knowledge of structural engineering concepts and steel fabrication/erection practices, with the ability to interpret design drawings and specifications.
* Experience with BIM workflows, model coordination, and data management within Tekla and related tools.
* Proficiency in CAD drafting and reading engineering drawings, with attention to dimensional accuracy and detailing standards.
* Demonstrated ability to perform systematic quality checks, apply project standards, and ensure code and client compliance.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with engineers, detailers, and project managers in a team environment.
* Relevant experience as a Checker or Sr. Checker in steel detailing projects; prior experience in industrial, commercial, or infrastructure projects is an advantage.
* Diploma or degree in Civil/Structural Engineering or a related discipline; Tekla certification or formal training is a plus.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines, maintain organized documentation, and adapt to evolving project requirements and technologies.

This is a handson engineering role rather than a support role Expect to spend most of your time in code in reconciliation and in conversation with the business users who rely on the reports and datasets being migrated The work is well suited to someone who has lived inside a large SAS codebase and now wants to carry that knowledge into a cloud data platform
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Analyse and document the existing SAS estate Base SAS programs macros PROC SQL DATA steps scheduled jobs and stored processes and produce the code inventory complexity rating and dependency map that drive the migration wave plan
  
  
Convert SAS logic into equivalent Snowflake stored procedures and ELT pipelines preserving business rules joins aggregations formats and edgecase handling rather than reimplementing from assumption
  
  
Own data reconciliation between the SAS output and the Snowflake output build rowcount controltotal and recordlevel comparison scripts investigate breaks and sign off each migrated object against agreed tolerance
  
  
Reengineer SAS data access layers that read from files RDBMS sources and SAS datasets so they land in Snowflake through the programmes chosen ingestion pattern
  
  
Work with the architecture team on target data models translating SASera structures into curated Snowflake schemas that suit setbased processing
  
  
Tune migrated workloads for cost and performance warehouse sizing clustering pruning and query rewrites so that converted jobs meet or beat their existing batch windows
  
  
Engage report owners and business analysts to confirm interpretation of legacy logic retire redundant code instead of migrating it and support user acceptance testing through to cutover
  
  
Maintain migration artefacts mapping documents conversion standards test evidence and runbooks and mentor junior engineers on reading SAS code safely
  
  
MustHave Skills
  
  
Strong handson Base SAS SAS Macro PROC SQL and DATA step development including formats informats arrays hash objects and bygroup processing
  
  
Proven ability to read and reverseengineer undocumented longlived SAS programs and explain what they do in business terms
  
  
Advanced SQL with practical exposure to Snowflake virtual warehouses stages streams tasks time travel cloning and micropartition behaviour
  
  
Experience on at least one completed legacytocloud data migration with responsibility for validation and reconciliation not only code conversion
  
  
Working knowledge of Python or a comparable scripting language for conversion accelerators automated comparison and repetitive refactoring
  
  
Comfortable with version control structured testing and defect tracking in a deliverymanaged environment

title: Process & Requirements Analyst - VP
description:
Join us as a “
**Process & Requirements Analyst-VP**
” and help us deliver a simpler, better and more balanced experience for our colleagues and leaders across the world.
  
  
As the Process & Requirements Analyst, you will play a critical role in transforming the bank through disciplined business analysis, requirements management and process design across complex change initiatives. You will independently facilitate stakeholder discussions, capture and translate complex business needs into clear documentation, map current-state journeys and shape practical future-state designs. You will identify pain points, dependencies and testing scenarios, and translate business requirements into functional requirements for technology delivery teams. Working confidently with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams, you will simplify ambiguity, challenge assumptions and maintain end-to-end traceability from business need through design, configuration, validation and testing. You will also partner with Change and Training leads to ensure launch collateral connects the new solution to the agreed requirements and intended benefits.
  
  
To be successful as a “Process & Requirements Analyst-VP”, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Critical Reasoning, Curiosity & Attention to Detail: Must have strong analytical skills, be specific, tenacious, curious and quick to learn, with a focus on crystallizing requirements and problem statements. Should be proactive, ask the right questions, probe for clarity, and move at pace. You can look across requirements, connecting the dots across a broad set of requirements, to support creation of a coherent design solution.
* Business Analysis and Requirements Management: Independently facilitates complex stakeholder discussions, captures and analyses business needs, and translates them into clear, prioritised and traceable business and functional requirements.
* Process Mapping and Improvement: Creates clear current-state and future-state process maps, identifies pain points, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and uses tools such as Blueworks, Visio or comparable process mapping applications.
* Ability to work in dynamic, fast paced, agile environment. You are a really fast learner, understanding different information quickly, assimilating new information and being able to represent that clearly and coherently, in a manner that others, not involved, can understand.
* You are solutions oriented, credible with colleagues, People Leaders and senior leaders able to work across centres of excellence, colleague support, HR tech and the journey experience team, creating one coherent, aligned set of requirements and designs.
* Technology Change and Governance: Uses Jira to manage requirements, traceability, governance and version control across design, build and testing activities, and works effectively with technology delivery teams.
* Testing and User Acceptance: Defines realistic positive and negative test scenarios from requirements and process analysis, understands key dependencies and supports thorough user acceptance testing.
* Strategic Requirements Leadership: Translates strategic objectives into clear business outcomes, capability needs and prioritised requirements, ensuring alignment across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
* Senior Stakeholder Management and Influencing: Builds trusted relationships with senior leaders, constructively challenges assumptions, facilitates evidence-based decisions and secures alignment where priorities or perspectives differ.
* Portfolio Prioritisation and Dependency Management: Assesses value, urgency, risk and delivery complexity to support prioritisation, while identifying and managing cross-functional dependencies, constraints and impacts.
* Risk, Controls and Design Governance: Embeds risk and control considerations into requirements and solution design, establishes clear decision records and traceability, and ensures appropriate governance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Benefits and Outcome Focus: Defines measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, links requirements to intended benefits and uses evidence to confirm that delivered solutions address the original business need.

**Additional Skills**

* Business English and Multinational Experience: Highly experienced in writing detailed specifications in business English and working with global stakeholders; experience supporting United Kingdom-based teams is highly desirable. Experience in Human Resources, Workday or process transformation environments is also desirable.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Lead Through Ambiguity: Provides structure and direction in complex or uncertain situations, makes sound decisions with incomplete information and maintains momentum while key issues are resolved.
* Cross-functional Leadership: Leads virtual and cross-functional teams through discovery, design and validation activities, clarifying accountabilities and creating an environment in which challenge and collaboration are encouraged.
* Decision Facilitation and Conflict Resolution: Surfaces trade-offs, resolves competing priorities and facilitates timely decisions, escalating material risks or unresolved issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Coaching and Capability Building: Coaches analysts and delivery colleagues, sets quality standards, provides constructive feedback and shares practical methods that strengthen requirements and process analysis capability.
* Executive Communication: Communicates complex information in a concise and compelling way, tailoring messages for senior audiences and presenting clear insights, impacts, recommendations and decisions required.
* Accountability for Delivery Quality: Sets expectations for quality, pace and governance, monitors progress and intervenes early to address gaps, ensuring requirements remain coherent, testable and aligned to agreed outcomes.

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree

You may be assessed on critical reasoning, business analysis, requirements management, process mapping, stakeholder engagement, change and transformation, risk and controls, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology skills. Assessment may include a process-flow exercise or case-study discussion focused on gathering requirements, structuring delivery activities, managing stakeholders and supporting project execution.
  
  
This role will primarily be based in Chennai, India, with Pune accepted as a secondary location.
  
  
Core hours for this role are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST, with flexibility required for key afternoon meetings. There is a policy to attend the office 3 days in a week on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of every week.
  
  
  

* Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Implementation Consultant Professional II
description:

title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
description:
**Senior Manufacturing & Production Quality Lead – LifeBand**

**Location:**
India – predominantly on-site in Chennai

**Engagement:**
Contract, Full Time

**Reporting to:**
Equivital UK Product & Operations Leadership

**Product:**
Equivital LifeBand – first high-volume production run of 2,000 units

**Role purpose**

Equivital is seeking experienced electronics manufacturing professional to provide hands-on leadership and oversight of the first high-volume production run of approximately 2,000 LifeBand devices at our manufacturing partner in India.

This is a critical production-launch role. The successful candidate will act as Equivital's senior on-site manufacturing representative and will be responsible for ensuring that the production process is properly controlled, technically robust and capable of delivering a consistently high-quality product at the required yield.

The individual will work closely with the manufacturing company in Chennai and quality teams, Equivital's UK engineering and product teams, and other technical stakeholders.

The role requires someone who is comfortable working directly on the factory floor, identifying problems, challenging poor processes, implementing corrective actions and communicating clearly with both factory personnel and senior technical teams in the UK.

**Key objectives**

The successful candidate will be accountable for:

* Excellent build quality across the 2,000-unit production run.
* High first-pass yield and minimal rework/scrap.
* Successful integration of the new ATE into the production process.
* Implementation and control of the new final DFT testing process.
* Robust control and verification of the LifeBand welding process.
* Ensuring welded assemblies meet the required mechanical and electrical specifications, particularly those affecting pogo-pin performance.
* Accurate material, component and finished-goods traceability.
* Improved stock control and production material management at Manufacturing plant.
* Rapid identification, containment and resolution of production issues.
* Accurate production reporting to the UK team.
* Establishment of a repeatable production process that Manufacturing company can continue to operate after the launch phase.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Production launch and daily manufacturing oversight**

* Be Equivital's principal technical and operational representative on-site during the production run.
* Work closely with Manufacturing company production, engineering and quality personnel.
* Review and approve production readiness before volume manufacturing begins.
* Establish clear daily production targets and monitor actual performance.
* Monitor production flow from incoming components through assembly, welding, programming, testing, final inspection and packing.
* Identify bottlenecks, recurring defects and process weaknesses.
* Challenge processes that are not producing the required quality or yield.
* Have authority to recommend or initiate a production stop where there is a significant quality or product-risk issue.

**2. ATE implementation**

The successful candidate will:

* Work with Equivital engineering and manufacturing company to embed the ATE into the production process.
* Ensure operators understand the correct test procedure.
* Verify that the ATE is correctly configured and being used consistently.
* Establish appropriate test records and traceability.
* Monitor ATE failure rates and identified abnormal trends.
* Distinguish genuine product failures from test-equipment/operator/process failures.
* Ensure failed units are correctly quarantined and investigated.
* Ensure that production does not bypass required ATE testing.
* Work with engineering to refine the ATE process where necessary.

**3. Final DFT implementation**

Final Design-for-Test / DFT testing is a new element of the LifeBand production process.

The role will be responsible for:

* Implementing the final DFT test process on the production line.
* Ensuring appropriate test fixtures, equipment and procedures are available.
* Training and supervising operators.
* Ensuring 100% of required devices receive the defined final testing.
* Ensuring test results are recorded and traceable to individual units.
* Monitoring DFT failure modes and trends.
* Working with Equivital engineering to investigate recurring failures.
* Preventing units from progressing to final packing without completing the required tests.

**4. Welding process control**

A particularly important responsibility will be oversight of the LifeBand welding process.

The successful candidate must have practical experience of manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies and understand the failure modes associated with welding/joining processes.

They will:

* Establish and document the required welding process parameters.
* Verify that the welding equipment is correctly set up and maintained.
* Ensure operators are trained and following the approved process.
* Establish appropriate first-off and periodic inspection requirements.
* Monitor weld quality throughout production.
* Identify potential weld defects before they become downstream failures.
* Ensure appropriate mechanical/electrical verification of the weld.
* Investigate weld-related failures and implement corrective actions.
* Pay particular attention to the impact of the welding process on the alignment, positioning and reliability of the LifeBand pogo-pin interface.
* Ensure the finished assembly meets the required mechanical tolerances and electrical performance requirements.

Experience with welding or joining of small electronic assemblies, plastics, metals, flexes, contacts or similar precision components would be highly desirable.

**5. Quality and yield management**

Establish and maintain a clear production-quality dashboard covering, at minimum:

* First-pass yield (FPY)
* Overall yield
* Scrap
* Rework
* ATE failures
* DFT failures
* Welding defects
* Pogo-pin/contact failures
* Functional test failures
* Component/assembly defects
* Repeat failure modes
* Units quarantined
* Units released
* Production throughput

The successful candidate will identify trends rather than simply report numbers.

Where yield deteriorates, they will determine the likely root cause and drive corrective action.

**6. Factory process discipline and stock control**

Manufacturing company currently requires improved production discipline and material control.

The role will therefore include:

* Verification of component availability before production starts.
* Physical verification of critical stock where required.
* Improving accuracy between recorded and actual stock.
* Ensuring components are correctly identified and traceable.
* Preventing uncontrolled substitution of components.
* Ensuring rejected/failed components are segregated.
* Establishing appropriate quarantine and disposition processes.
* Identifying shortages before they stop production.
* Ensuring finished and semi-finished units can be reconciled against production records.

**7. Non-conformance and root-cause analysis**

The individual will lead or coordinate investigation of manufacturing defects.

They should be comfortable using appropriate techniques including:

* CAPA
* Non-Conformance
* Process capability analysis where appropriate

The objective is not simply to repair defective units but to prevent recurrence.

**8. Communication with the UK team**

Provide a concise daily/weekly production report to Equivital UK covering:

**Production**

* Units planned, completed, passed, failed, yield, Rework/scrap

**Quality**

* Top defects, ATE failures, DFT failures, Welding defects, Contact/pogo-pin issues, Open NCRs

**Operations**

* Stock/component issues
* Production constraints
* Staffing/process issues
* Risks to schedule

**Actions**

* Corrective actions completed
* Actions in progress
* Decisions required from the UK team

Significant quality issues should be escalated immediately rather than waiting for the weekly report.

**Authority**

The individual must have sufficient authority to:

* Stop or pause production where a significant quality issue is identified.
* Quarantine suspect product.
* Require re-testing or additional inspection.
* Challenge production processes that do not meet the agreed specification.
* Escalate unresolved issues directly to Equivital UK leadership.

The role is not intended to be a passive inspection position.

**Required experience**

**Essential**

* Significant experience in electronics manufacturing.
* Experience managing or overseeing production of electronic devices/products.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality systems.
* Hands-on experience with production testing and test equipment.
* Experience implementing or managing ATE or automated production testing.
* Experience with DFT/functional testing.
* Experience with precision manufacturing processes involving small components.
* Practical experience with welding, joining or equivalent manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies.
* Strong understanding of process control, yield and defect analysis.
* Strong communication skills in English.
* Ability to work directly with factory operators, engineers and management.
* Comfortable working on the factory floor rather than purely in an office environment.

**Highly desirable**

* Experience with wearables, medical devices, IoT devices, consumer electronics, industrial electronics or similar products.
* Experience with high-volume electronics manufacturing.
* Experience with SMT/PCBA and final assembly.
* Experience with pogo pins, spring contacts, connectors or similar electrical interfaces.
* Experience establishing production test fixtures and traceability systems.
* Experience working with international companies or overseas engineering teams within regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience with ISO 9001, ISO 13485 or similar quality systems.
* Engineering degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing or a related discipline.

**Personal characteristics**

The successful candidate will be:

* Technically credible.
* Hands-on and practical.
* Highly organised.
* Detail-oriented without losing sight of production objectives.
* Comfortable challenging poor processes.
* Calm under production pressure.
* Commercially aware.
* Strong enough to represent Equivital's interests with the manufacturing partner.
* Excellent at communicating technical issues simply and clearly to UK-based colleagues.

title: Lead Analyst - Learning & Development
description:
**Company Profile**
We support key functions with a strong focus on innovation, collaboration, and digital excellence, we thrive in driving business growth and elevating customer experiences across global markets.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Capability Diagnosis & Learning Strategy
* Partner with BU HRs and leaders to identify capability gaps across technical, behavioral and leadership dimensions.

title: Senior SAP Consultant
description:
SAP BTP Developer (CAP + Fiori/UI5 + Integration Suite)

Location: Remote / Hybrid

Type: Full-time / Contract

Experience: 8+ years

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on SAP BTP Developer to design and build cloud-native applications, custom Fiori apps, and integrations on the SAP Business Technology Platform. This is a development role — you will be writing code (CAP services, UI5 apps, integration flows) day to day, not administering systems or deploying standard apps. The candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP and should or may have expertise in these modules. You will work alongside functional consultants and architects to turn business requirements into clean, scalable extensions that sit outside the S/4HANA core.

What You'll Do

Build enterprise applications on SAP BTP using the SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) model (Java)

Develop custom SAP Fiori / UI5 applications — views, controllers, OData models, custom controls

Design and expose OData (v2/v4) services and consume SAP and third-party APIs

Build and maintain integration flows in SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI) — iFlows, mappings, adapters, API Management

Integrate applications with SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA Cloud (HDI containers, CDS views)

Implement authentication and security on BTP (XSUAA, IAS, destinations, Cloud Connector, roles and scopes)

Participate in code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and production support

Write technical specifications and maintain documentation

Must-Have

8+ years building applications on SAP BTP with hands-on SAP experience

Hands-on SAP CAP development — building services with CDS entities in Java

Hands-on SAP Fiori / UI5 development — custom apps you have coded

OData service development and consumption

SAP Integration Suite / CPI — building integration flows

Integration with SAP S/4HANA via OData / APIs

Working knowledge of BTP security — XSUAA, IAS, destinations, Cloud Connector

Proficiency in Java

Comfortable with SAP Business Application Studio and Git-based workflows

Nice-to-Have

SAP HANA Cloud / HDI containers, CDS modeling

Event-driven architecture — Event Mesh / Advanced Event Mesh, CQRS, outbox pattern

SAP Build (Apps / Process Automation / Work Zone)

SAP Joule / Business AI — building Skills/Agents (strong differentiator)

ABAP RAP / CDS (for S/4HANA core extensions)

CI/CD pipelines and DevOps for BTP

SAP certification in BTP, CAP, or Fiori

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-BS-HC
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)**
**At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.**
**We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments.**
**But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.**
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation.**
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move.**
**The team**
Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
  
  
Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
  
  
**Work you will do**
Deloitte’s ‘Healthcare Strategy’ team helps companies (providers, payers, pharmacies, etc.) address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
  
  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop the appropriate business models, operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies

**Required Experience And Skills**
**Strategy-specific experience:**
**Enterprise and Growth Strategy – Health Care**

* Experience working for / with corporate strategy teams of leading companies in the US Provider and/or US Payor/Health Plan/PBM industries, OR Consulting experience serving Healthcare clients
* Hands-on exposure of one or more of the following: Payer, Provider, Market access, Enrolment, Distribution, Network, Claims service, Population health management, Value based care in a consulting / advisory role
* Interest and knowledge about the current trends in Healthcare space, especially pertaining to the US market
* Understanding of the Medicare, Medicaid and Commercial payer businesses
* Exposure to working in non-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders is a plus
* Ability to generate leading market insights from market data
* Certifications in healthcare domain (AHM 250/500, HIPAA etc.) are a plus

**Core Consulting Skills**

* Ability to develop understanding of new topics quickly; conduct targeted research and derive insights relevant for client
* Clear and concise communication – ability to articulate thoughts well, ask relevant questions – be able to participate in team discussions (both internally and with clients)
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members, conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
* Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization

**Qualifications Required:**

* MBA or other Master’s degree from a premier (Tier-1) school in India or abroad
* 3 - 7 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA), with focus on Healthcare sector

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

**Position Summary**
CBTS is seeking four Network Engineers to join our Network Engineering team, specializing in LAN, and SD-WAN technologies. In this role, you will design, deploy, and support enterprise wired and wireless network solutions and next-generation SD-WAN architectures for CBTS clients. You will work across Core Network, OSP Planning and Engineering, VoIP Engineering, and operations teams to plan, configure, and implement IP network solutions. This position has a direct impact on client perception of the quality and value of CBTS data and internet products, as well as on operational and financial outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Network Design and Deployment****

* Design, deploy, and support LAN and SD-WAN solutions for enterprise clients, including underlay/overlay design, orchestration, policy configuration, and ongoing optimization
* Engineer and configure Cisco-based LAN environments, deployments for distributed branch and remote site architectures
* Lead all aspects of technical deployment projects including implementation planning, methods of procedure (MOPs), and execution of work
* Implement network designs that consistently deliver performance, reliability, and scalability within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

****Operations and Support****

* Provide Tier 3 escalation support for LAN and SD-WAN environments in a 24x7 production network environment via on-call rotation
* Monitor network performance and communicate capacity needs to Network Planning to support growth and capacity plans
* Troubleshoot complex network issues using tools such as traceroute, dig, tcpdump, packet analysis, and wireless diagnostic tools
* Configure and maintain hardware and software firewalls, VLANs, routing protocols, and related security controls

****Client and Cross-functional Collaboration****

* Represent Network Engineering on cross-functional product and project teams for the development, launch, and administration of managed network services
* Act as technical lead on complex networking projects as required by the business
* Engineer customer orders within the scope of the role based on accepted processes and established timeframes (OLAs)
* Create detailed network diagrams in Visio and maintain accurate technical documentation

**Qualifications**
****Required****

* 6 to 7 years of hands-on network engineering experience, or 2 years of experience as a CBTS Engineer II
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience engineering and administering enterprise IP networks
* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, and troubleshooting SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN/Viptela, Meraki, VeloCloud, or Fortinet)
* Demonstrated experience with Cisco LAN and WLAN technologies, including architecture for branch and remote site deployments
* In-depth knowledge of TCP/IP and dynamic routing protocols including EIGRP, OSPF, and BGP
* Experience with VLAN design, ATM, Frame Relay, optical carriers, and heterogeneous networking environments
* Familiarity with ITIL service management frameworks and their application to network operations and incident management
* Experience configuring and maintaining routers, bridges, switches, and related network hardware
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

**Preferred**

* Cisco CCNP or CCIE certification strongly recommended; CWNA or equivalent wireless certification a plus
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher
* Expert knowledge of TCP/IP enhancements including multicast, QoS techniques, and bandwidth/path reservation
* Working knowledge of DS3, T1, OC3, ISDN, Frame Relay, SONET, ATM, DSL, and related link specifications
* Previous sales engineering, network design, or team leadership experience
* Experience with Telco provisioning processes
* Project management experience or exposure

****EDUCATION****
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on job experience.

* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills

* Manage the performance management for the direct reports, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example

* Knowledge of the function and use of REST APIs
* Working knowledge of common and industry standard cloud-native/cloud-friendly authentication mechanisms (OAuth, OpenID, etc)

* Ability to conduct workshops to understand existing service models, analyse DevOps procedures and security requirements, and identify required secret management functions and relevant use cases
* Supports and oversees the planning, maintenance and change management for risk system strategies, process changes, system parameter changes, production schedules, and operational tasks.
* Works with stakeholders to resolve issues and provide solutions that ensure service delivery and effectiveness.
* Ability to provide PAM best practices recommendations to the client
* Supports the development and maintenance of system and process documentation / process controls / knowledge assets required for the operation

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Privileged Management Solutions like CyberArk, Thycotic, Hashicorp
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 5-7 years’ Work Experience
* CyberArk CDE or relevant product certification

**Certifications:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Hashicorp Vault/ CyberArk Conjur

title: Market Development Specialist
description:
🇺🇸 US Market Development & Field Sales Executive

Chennai, India + USA | 6 Months India / 6 Months USA

We are looking for highly articulate, commercially driven and research-oriented sales professionals to join our US healthcare business development team.

This is a unique opportunity for professionals who want to build a long-term career in US B2B sales and business development.

The role will be divided approximately equally between India and the USA:

6 months in India: Research, prospect identification, account intelligence, pre-sales and pipeline development.

6 months in the USA: In-person meetings, relationship building, field sales, conferences and business development.

🇮🇳 Your role in India – Pre-Sales & Pipeline Development

You will be responsible for doing the detailed groundwork before an opportunity reaches the US sales team.

You will:

* Research target US healthcare organizations
* Understand the company's business model, size, locations, services and estimated revenue
* Research the organization's current business challenges and potential areas of opportunity
* Identify the right decision-makers and influencers
* Research executives and their backgrounds
* Identify verified contact information
* Build detailed account/prospect profiles
* Identify potential buying signals and business opportunities
* Conduct LinkedIn, email and telephone outreach
* Qualify prospects
* Develop relationships with prospects before the sales team engages
* Schedule qualified meetings
* Maintain detailed CRM information
* Prepare account intelligence and briefing notes for the US sales team
* Continuously build a qualified pipeline

The objective is not simply to generate leads.

The objective is to deliver well-researched, qualified business opportunities to the US sales team.

🇺🇸 Your role in the USA – Field Sales & Business Development

During your US assignment, you will transition into a client-facing role.

You will:

* Meet prospects and decision-makers in person
* Visit healthcare organizations
* Conduct business development meetings
* Attend conferences and industry events
* Build executive relationships
* Follow up on opportunities developed during your India phase
* Identify new business opportunities
* Participate in discovery meetings
* Support presentations and proposals
* Work closely with the US sales leadership
* Develop opportunities through the sales cycle
* Represent Scintillate professionally in the US market

🎯 Strict Qualification Criteria

We are looking for a very specific profile. Please apply only if you meet most of the following requirements.

* Education
  Postgraduate degree is mandatory
* MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Sales, Business Development, International Business, Healthcare Management or a related discipline preferred
* Candidates with strong academic backgrounds and relevant postgraduate specialization will be preferred
* Experience
  3–7 years of relevant experience
* Prior experience in US-focused pre-sales, business development, inside sales, lead generation or market research is mandatory
* Experience selling into the US market is strongly preferred
* Experience dealing with US healthcare organizations, healthcare services, RCM, DMEPOS, medical billing, healthcare IT, BPO or SaaS will be a significant advantage
* Candidates must have experience independently researching US prospects and identifying decision-makers
* Experience using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase or similar sales intelligence/prospecting platforms preferred
* Hands-on experience working with a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Nutshell or similar

🗣️ Communication — Critical Requirement

Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.

The candidate must be:

* Extremely articulate and confident in spoken English
* Comfortable speaking with US C-level executives, VPs, Directors and business owners
* Able to conduct a professional discovery conversation
* Able to ask intelligent business questions
* Able to understand and respond to different US accents
* Able to communicate clearly without excessive reliance on scripts
* Strong in business writing, including emails and LinkedIn communication
* Comfortable presenting information to senior executives
* Able to communicate professionally in person as well as virtually

Candidates with weak spoken English or limited experience communicating with US business executives will not be considered.

🔎 Research & Analytical Skills

This is equally important.

The candidate should be able to take a company name and independently answer:

Who are they?

What do they do?

How large are they?

What is their approximate revenue?

Where do they operate?

Who makes the decision?

What problems might they have?

Why would they potentially need our services?

Who else should we speak with?

You should enjoy researching companies and people, not just making calls.

* ✈️ Mobility & Travel
  Must be willing and able to spend approximately 6 months each year in the USA
* Must be comfortable with frequent domestic travel within the US
* Must be comfortable conducting face-to-face meetings with senior executives
* Must be willing to attend conferences, trade shows and networking events
* Appropriate US travel/work authorization will be required for the activities undertaken during the US assignment

⭐ The person we are looking for

We are not looking for a conventional telesales executive.

We are looking for someone who combines:

Researcher + Pre-Sales Professional + Business Development Executive + Relationship Builder + Field Salesperson

Someone who can spend Monday morning researching a 500-employee healthcare company, understand its business, identify its CFO/COO/VP Revenue Cycle, build an intelligent outreach strategy — and six months later sit across the table from that executive in the United States and have a meaningful business conversation.

If you are highly articulate, commercially curious, comfortable with senior executives and genuinely interested in the US market, this could be an excellent opportunity to build a long-term international sales career.

📍 Base: Chennai, India

🇺🇸 US Assignment: Approximately 6 months annually

💼 Experience: 3–7 years

🎓 Postgraduate qualification: Mandatory

🇺🇸 US pre-sales/business development experience: Mandatory

🏥 US Healthcare experience: Strongly preferred

**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**
At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.
  
  
What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.
  
  
In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.
  
  
**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.
* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.
* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.
* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**
At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.
  
  
If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Position Description:**
Under general direction, the Engineering Systems Analyst drives strategies to improve engineering processes and ensure systems and tools are efficient and optimized. The individual will provide functional and technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements while directly supporting engineering initiatives from the business. They will assist in designing the structure of our engineering systems and carry out programs to ensure the proper architecture is implemented. Provide hands-on experience in software development and be able to manage complex programs. They will also assist in designing, building, and updating database structures and SQL queries. You will then deploy engineering solutions assuring its implementation, effectiveness, adaptability, responsiveness, quality, governance, and the continuous improvement. This role is responsible for providing technical assistance to other engineers. This role also frequently provides guidance to engineering staff, using extensive experience to manage the prioritization, development and completion of technology projects.
  
  
**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**

* Maintain and administer PDM and CAD systems, databases, and infrastructure. Optimize systems for efficiency and security.
* Partner with users to understand PDM, CAD, and drafting concerns, troubleshoot issues, and propose process improvements to increase user efficiency and experience.
* Troubleshoot PDM and CAD issues with the end user base. Perform root cause analysis to develop, test, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Develop and deliver training for PDM and CAD products. Establish and communicate PDM and CAD best practices. Standardize PDM and CAD environments across all workstations.
* Work with IT to develop and support communication protocols between PDM and other data systems as required.
* Manage licenses for PDM and CAD software and add-ons.
* Evaluate, maintain, and develop new tools to support the end user base.
* Evaluate operating systems and upgrades to manage impact on CAD servers and workstations
* Attends and participates, as an ‘ambassador’ for testing, in project meetings regarding solution of the requirements, design, and test plan review.
* Maintain a working knowledge of advancing technologies. Identify applicable solutions and implement with existing networks when appropriate.
* Identify creative ways to reduce cost by streamlining processes and systems (i.e. modification of responsibilities, consolidation or tasks, elimination of non-value added processes and re-engineering processes and systems).
* Drive continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management leveraging PowerBI and other similar tools.
* Participate in blueprinting and mapping sessions with customers for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations.
* Analyze requirements and contribute to the design of CAD/PDM solutions to complex requirements
* Design and execute implementations for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations
* Mentor and collaborate with services team members on design, documentation, and implementations
* SQL queries and analysis
* Participate in large project support, system/application implementations and upgrades.
* Assist with the long term migration to standard engineering tools.
* Designing and maintaining custom applications.
* Collaborate with DBAs and Infrastructure teams.

**Job Specifications:**

* Extensive knowledge and experience in Engineering PDM and CAD applications including SolidWorks and Autodesk products
* Broad understanding of the engineering new product development process and how CAD and PDM/PLM play a role within that process.
* Excellent team player.
* Strong logic, problem solving ability, takes initiative.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, IT, or related technical field required
* Typically has 4+ years’ engineering or IT experience
* BlueStar PLM experience preferred

**Supervisory/Responsibility:**

* Indicate if individual contributor w/no direct reports or if supervise direct reports & level of reports (individual contributors, supervisors, managers, etc.)

**Work Environment:**
Works in an office environment but may occasionally be exposed to manufacturing conditions to include noise, fumes, Odors, gases, dust, and hazards such as moving mechanical and electrical machinery. Required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided to mitigate or eliminate these hazards and all employees will be trained on appropriate use of PPE.
  
  
**Position Type:**
This is a regular, full-time position with the understanding that a regular workweek will require extended days and hours as needed to meet business needs.

No travel is expected for this position

OFFICE
