Performing the role frequently uses close vision, speech, hearing, and dexterity to operate office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.

title: CAM Engineer
description:
JD: CNC Machinist and CAM Programmer (5-Axis)

21 Oct 2026

We are hiring a person for our 5-axis CNC machine, from CAM programming to finished part to upkeep. Strong 3-axis CAM experience is the main requirement; we will train you on 5-axis work.

**Company:**
 Floaid Medtech Pvt. Ltd., IIT Madras Research Park, Chennai 
**Employment type:**
 Full-time  
**Experience:**
[3-6] years, flexible for the right candidate

About Floaid

Floaid Medtech is a Chennai-based cardiac medical device company building heart-lung machines and percutaneous ventricular assist devices. We are setting up in-house precision machining for prototypes and low-volume production parts.

Role Summary

You will convert 3D models and drawings into toolpaths, set up and run the machine, inspect the parts, and keep the machine in good condition. You are the single point of ownership for the 5-axis CNC machine

Key Responsibilities

**CAM and programming**

* Create toolpaths from CAD models and drawings for 3-axis, 3+2 (indexed) and, as you grow, simultaneous 5-axis machining.
* Select cutting tools, speeds, feeds and work-holding strategies suited to each material.
* Simulate and verify toolpaths for collisions, gouges and travel limits, then post-process for the machine's controller.
* Optimise cycle times and tool life, and keep a library of proven programs, tool lists and setup sheets.

**Machine operation**

* Plan setups, fixtures and work-holding, and set work offsets and tool lengths.
* Run first-article and production batches, and make in-process adjustments for tolerance and surface finish.
* Prove out new programs safely: dry runs, single-block, and reduced feed on the first cut.

**Quality and inspection**

* Inspect parts with calipers, micrometers, height gauges and surface roughness testers.
* Read drawings with GD&T and tight tolerances, and flag manufacturability issues to the design team early.
* Maintain traceability of material, program version and inspection records, as required by our ISO 13485 quality system.

**Maintenance and housekeeping**

* Carry out daily, weekly and monthly maintenance: lubrication, coolant concentration and level, filters, chip clearing, spindle and axis checks.
* Maintain a maintenance log, and coordinate with the vendor for service and breakdowns.
* Manage tooling and consumables inventory, and keep the machining area clean and safe.

**Collaboration**

* Work with the design and development team on design for manufacturability.
* Support rapid prototyping requests with realistic lead times.

Must-Have Requirements

* **Hands-on CAM programming experience on 3-axis CNC machines (mandatory).**
* Proficiency in at least one CAM package (for example Fusion 360, Mastercam, SolidCAM, hyperMILL, NX CAM, Esprit or similar).
* Ability to read engineering drawings and GD&T.
* Working knowledge of G-code and M-code, work offsets, tool compensation and post-processors.
* Experience with precision inspection tools.
* Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production or Manufacturing, or an ITI/NTTF/CITD qualification with relevant experience.

Good to Have

* Exposure to 4-axis, 5-axis or 3+2 machining.
* Experience machining stainless steel (316L), titanium, aluminium or engineering plastics such as PEEK and Delrin.
* Experience with micro-machining or small, thin-walled, high-finish parts.
* Experience with Siemens, Fanuc or other controllers used on 5-axis machines.
* Familiarity with medical device, aerospace or other regulated manufacturing.
* Experience with fixture design and probing cycles.

What We Offer

* Ownership of a new 5-axis machine and a chance to build our machining capability from the start.
* Training and upskilling on 5-axis programming.
* Work on life-saving cardiac devices in a startup environment at IIT Madras Research Park.

title: Engineer -Design Engineering
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop refrigeration systems, components, and assemblies for HVAC&R products.
* Perform refrigeration cycle calculations, load analysis, and system performance evaluations.
* Select and size compressors, heat exchangers, expansion devices, refrigerants, and other system components.
* Create and modify 3D models, engineering drawings, and BOMs using CAD tools.
* Conduct design validation through simulations, testing, and prototype evaluations.
* Analyze system performance, energy efficiency, reliability, and compliance with applicable standards.
* Collaborate with global engineering teams, manufacturing, sourcing, and quality functions during product development.
* Support product design reviews, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards such as ASHRAE, AHRI, UL, ISO, and environmental regulations.
* Participate in new product development, value engineering, and cost reduction projects.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, Thermal Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in refrigeration system design, HVAC, or thermal product development.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Refrigeration Cycles
+ Thermodynamics
+ Heat Transfer
+ Fluid Mechanics
+ Psychrometrics

* Experience in refrigeration component selection and system optimization.
* Knowledge of refrigerants, compressors, evaporators, condensers, and expansion devices.
* Ability to perform engineering calculations and design documentation.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* CAD Tools: Creo, SolidWorks, CATIA, NX, or AutoCAD.
* Simulation Tools: Coil Designer, HTRI, ANSYS, MATLAB, or similar engineering tools.
* Knowledge of DOE, DFMEA, GD&T, and Design Validation processes.
* Experience working on HVAC, Commercial Refrigeration, Heat Pumps, Rooftop Units, Chillers, or Industrial Cooling Products.
* Understanding of energy efficiency standards and sustainability initiatives.

**Desired Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work in a global cross-functional environment.
* Continuous improvement mindset and customer-focused approach.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

**Qualifications**
Requires a high school diploma or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Requires at least 2 years related experience.
  
  
Strong oral and written communications skills. Knowledge of CAD software techniques and tools. Knowledge of design tools, and principles involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.

title: Lead Qualification Representative
description:
Location: Remote
  
  
Schedule: Full-time, EST Business Hours Required
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$40,000–C$50,000 annually, based on performance and qualifications
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Langford Staffing is recruiting experienced outbound calling professionals to qualify consumers and connect eligible individuals with licensed representatives through live transfers.
  
  
This is a performance-focused position for someone who can communicate confidently, think quickly, handle objections and remain professional during continuous high-volume calling.
  
  
You will not provide licensed advice or complete customer enrolments. Your responsibility is to qualify consumers, obtain their permission and complete an accurate live transfer.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Contact consumer leads using an outbound dialer.
* Follow campaign scripts, introductions and compliance requirements.
* Ask focused questions to determine whether consumers meet campaign requirements.
* Explain the reason for the call clearly and professionally.
* Handle hesitation, objections, rejection and difficult conversations.
* Obtain permission and complete warm live transfers.
* Remain on the call until the receiving representative accepts the handoff.
* Record accurate notes, dispositions, outcomes and follow-up requirements.
* Handle unsuccessful transfers and callbacks according to campaign procedures.
* Apply feedback from call reviews, coaching and performance reporting.
* Learn and work across different consumer-service campaigns.

**Required Experience**

* Three or more years of recent high-volume outbound calling experience.
* Experience qualifying leads and completing warm or live transfers.
* A history of achieving measurable call, qualification or transfer targets.
* Experience using Convoso, Five9, NICE CXone, Genesys Cloud CX, CallTools, Readymode or a comparable dialer.
* Strong understanding of call dispositions, callbacks, holds, consultation calls and live transfers.
* Experience maintainingaccurate CRM records while speaking with consumers.
* Strong listening, communication and objection-handling skills.
* Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with rejection or abusive callers.
* Ability to type at least 35 net words per minute with strong accuracy.
* Verifiable employment history and professional references.
* Availability to work the assigned full-time campaign schedule.

Experience in insurance, health-benefit programs, telecommunications, financial services, consumer services or another regulated calling environment is an asset.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.
  
  
Selected candidates may also be asked to complete a typing test, equipment check, reference check, call role-play and live skills interview.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Performance Will Be Measured Through**

* Accepted and properly qualified live transfers
* Consistent progress toward campaign production targets
* Call quality and compliance
* Accurate CRM notes and dispositions
* Productive dialer activity
* Attendance and schedule reliability
* Professional objection handling
* Improvement following coaching and call reviews

Representatives may be expected to produce approximately five accepted qualified transfers per dialing hour, depending on the campaign.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person is confident, resilient, organized and comfortable speaking with a high volume of consumers every day.
  
  
You should be able to recover quickly from rejection, follow a structured process and sound natural rather than scripted. You must maintain quality while working toward demanding performance targets and remain professional when consumers become impatient, suspicious or disrespectful.
  
  
Remote Technology Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* A dual-monitor setup
* Reliable internet with a speed of at least 100 Mbps
* A backup internet connection or power solution
* A wired, noise-cancelling USB headset
* A webcam
* A quiet, private and professional workspace

contribute to improving system performance, energy efficiency, reliability and overall product

performance.

This role would suit someone who enjoys working with physical systems, prototypes and test

equipment and is comfortable moving between design, experimentation, analysis and

troubleshooting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Refrigeration System Design & Optimization**

● Design and optimize vapor-compression refrigeration systems.

● Perform refrigeration cycle analysis and system-level performance calculations.

● Select and size compressors, evaporators, condensers, expansion devices, fans and

related components.

● Optimize refrigerant charge, superheat, subcooling and operating parameters.

● Analyze cooling capacity, COP and overall system energy performance.

**Thermal & Condensation Engineering**

● Analyze heat transfer and condensation processes.

● Work on evaporator, airflow and heat-exchanger performance.

● Apply psychrometric and dew-point concepts to system performance.

● Identify opportunities to improve condensation and energy efficiency.

**Testing & Experimental Development**

● Design and conduct refrigeration and thermal performance tests.

● Develop test procedures and performance benchmarks.

● Collect and analyze temperature, pressure, humidity, airflow, electrical and

system-performance data.

● Prepare technical reports and recommend engineering improvements based on test

results.

**Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis**

● Diagnose refrigeration and thermal issues in prototypes and deployed systems.

● Troubleshoot compressor performance, refrigerant flow, expansion devices, frosting,

pressure and airflow-related issues.

● Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.

● Support technical resolution of field issues when required.

**Product Development**

● Support development and improvement of refrigeration-based products.

● Translate performance requirements into technical specifications.

● Support prototype development, testing and design iterations.

● Evaluate refrigeration components, heat exchangers, refrigerants and related

technologies.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

● Work with mechanical, electrical, controls and other engineering teams.

● Coordinate with manufacturing and service teams to ensure practical and reliable

designs.

● Support technical evaluation of refrigeration components and suppliers.

● Provide technical inputs during product testing and field deployments.

**Required Qualifications**

● B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Engineering,

Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, HVAC, Energy Engineering or a related discipline.

● 1-3 years of relevant industry experience in HVAC, refrigeration, thermal systems,

heat pumps, cooling systems or product engineering.

● Strong understanding of:

○ Vapor-compression refrigeration cycles

○ Thermodynamics

○ Heat transfer

○ Psychrometrics

○ Fluid mechanics

○ Refrigeration system components

○ HVAC system design and troubleshooting

● Practical experience in refrigeration testing, commissioning or troubleshooting.

● Ability to analyze engineering data and identify performance improvement

opportunities.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:

● Compressor selection and performance analysis

● Evaporator and condenser design

● TXV / EEV selection and optimization

● Refrigerant charging and system commissioning

● Pressure-temperature analysis

● Superheat and subcooling measurement

● Psychrometric analysis

● Heat exchanger design

● Refrigeration system simulation

● MATLAB / Python / Excel for engineering analysis

● CoolPack / RefProp / Danfoss selection tools / DWSIM

● SolidWorks / AutoCAD or equivalent CAD tools

● Data acquisition and experimental testing

Experience with commonly used refrigerants would be an added advantage.

**What We're Looking For**

● Strong technical fundamentals with hands-on engineering capability.

● Ability to independently troubleshoot and solve technical problems.

● Comfortable working with machines, prototypes and test equipment.

● Data-driven approach to engineering decisions.

● Interest in energy efficiency and thermal performance.

● Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.

● Willingness to work across design, testing and field troubleshooting when required.

**Why Join**

● Work on real-world climate and water technology.

● Hands-on exposure to refrigeration and thermal product development.

● Opportunity to work across multidisciplinary engineering functions.

● High ownership and exposure to product development in an early-stage environment.

● Opportunity to contribute to technology addressing sustainability and resource

challenges.

**Note:**
This is a hands-on engineering role. Candidates should be comfortable working from

the facility and participating in testing, troubleshooting and field activities when required.

Candidates are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in HVAC/refrigeration system

design, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, thermal analysis or product

development in their resumes.

title: Lead Qualification Representative
description:
Appointment Setting, Call Centre, Customer Aquisition, Customer Service, Inside Sales, Outbound Sales, Sales
  
  
Lead Qualification Representative
  
  
**Location:**
Remote
  
  
**Schedule:**
Full-time, EST Business Hours Required
  
  
**Compensation:**
C$40,000–C$50,000 annually, based on experience, qualifications, and performance
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring an experienced Lead Qualification Representative to speak with property owners about rental-guarantee insurance options.
  
  
Rental-guarantee insurance may help protect property owners when a tenant defaults on their rent. Your role will be to contact property owners, explain the purpose of the call, confirm basic qualification information, identify interest, and connect appropriate property owners with a sales representative through a live transfer.
  
  
This is a high-volume outbound-calling position—not a traditional customer-service role. You will work from an automatic dialer and will be expected to handle objections, keep appropriate prospects engaged, and consistently meet qualified-transfer targets.
  
  
You will not provide detailed insurance advice, determine eligibility, guarantee approval, or complete enrolments. Sales representatives will review the property owner’s circumstances and explain the available coverage.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Make continuous outbound calls using an automatic dialer
* Speak with property owners about rental-guarantee insurance options
* Deliver clear and professional call openings
* Confirm required property-owner and qualification information
* Identify whether the prospect is interested in learning more
* Explain the purpose and potential value of the service clearly
* Handle questions, objections, suspicion, and rejection professionally
* Obtain permission before initiating a transfer
* Complete warm live transfers to sales representatives
* Remain on the line until the receiving representative accepts the call
* Record accurate notes, outcomes, and dispositions in the CRM
* Schedule callbacks and follow up on unsuccessful transfers when required
* Respect opt-out and do-not-call requests
* Follow approved scripts, qualification rules, and compliance requirements
* Participate in coaching, call reviews, and performance reporting
* Meet call-quality and accepted-transfer targets

**What You’ll Need**

* Three or more recent years of high-volume outbound-calling experience
* Experience with lead qualification and live transfers
* Experience working against measurable hourly or daily performance targets
* Experience using an automatic dialer
* Experience using a CRM while actively calling
* Strong spoken and written English
* Clear listening, communication, and objection-handling skills
* Confidence speaking with busy, suspicious, or frustrated prospects
* The ability to remain calm and professional during difficult calls
* Accurate call-disposition and documentation habits
* The resilience to remain productive during continuous calling
* The ability to follow scripts and compliance requirements without sounding unnatural
* Full-time availability during the assigned campaign schedule
* Verifiable employment history and professional references

Experience with Convoso, Five9, NICE CXone, Genesys Cloud CX, CallTools, Readymode, or a comparable dialer is preferred.
  
  
Experience in insurance, real estate, property management, mortgages, financial services, telecommunications, lead generation, telemarketing, consumer services, or another regulated call-centre environment is an asset.
  
  
Direct property-management or insurance experience is preferred but not mandatory. Strong candidates from other high-volume outbound campaigns will be considered.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your résumé.
  
  
If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.
  
  
Selected candidates may also be required to complete a typing test, equipment check, employment-reference verification, call role-play, and live skills interview.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Performance Will Be Measured Through**

* Accepted qualified transfers
* Accuracy of lead qualification
* Call quality and professionalism
* Compliance with campaign requirements
* Accurate CRM notes and dispositions
* Dialer activity
* Attendance and schedule reliability
* Objection-handling ability
* Responsiveness to coaching
* Consistent performance during high-volume calling

The position may require approximately five accepted qualified transfers per dialing hour, depending on campaign conditions and lead quality.
  
  
Who Will Succeed
  
  
The right person is confident, resilient, organized, and comfortable spending most of the workday on consecutive outbound calls.
  
  
You should be able to recover quickly from rejection, communicate naturally within a structured call process, and move interested property owners toward a live conversation with a sales representative.
  
  
You must also understand that strong performance never requires misleading a prospect, promising coverage, ignoring qualification requirements, or continuing after an explicit opt-out request.
  
  
Remote-Work Requirements
  
  
**You Must Have**

* A private and professional workspace
* Dual monitors
* A computer with at least 16 GB of RAM
* Reliable internet speed of at least 100 Mbps
* Backup internet connectivity or power
* A wired noise-cancelling headset
* A webcam
* A current operating system with appropriate security updates

**This is a design, review and advisory role.**
You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a continuous vulnerability assessment programme, using outputs from the client's vulnerability management platform released through the UK service boundary.
* Prioritise vulnerabilities using threat-informed criteria (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, NCSC advisories and vendor PSIRTs) and produce monthly remediation recommendations.
* Issue critical patch advisories, typically within 24 hours, based on client guidance and credible threat intelligence, to enable expedited remediation by UK-based personnel and client suppliers.
* Produce a monthly report on vendor patch and firmware releases across the server, end-user, mobile, network and security estate.
* Produce OS patch and device firmware compliance reports.
* Consolidate patch and upgrade status reporting for firewalls, intrusion prevention, email gateway, secure web gateway and application control platforms.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) compliance against the 48-hour target, working with the Security Engineer | Network.
* Maintain the vulnerability exception and risk acceptance register and present items for decision through service governance.
* Prepare and co-facilitate the monthly vulnerability and patch review with the UK Head of Service, client teams and third-party suppliers.
* Carry out targeted vulnerability analysis in support of incidents and investigations when directed.
* Apply safe practice for operational technology (OT) assets, where scanning and patching are constrained.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vulnerability management vendor certification, e.g. Rapid7, Tenable or Qualys (at least one required).
* CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, GIAC GEVA, or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

**Essential Skills**

* Vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and interpretation of their outputs.
* Patch management processes and tooling (e.g. Intune/MECM, Ivanti, Tanium, BigFix).
* Threat-informed prioritisation using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and vendor advisories.
* Coordinating remediation across internal teams and third-party suppliers.
* Strong reporting and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
* Clear, concise written advisories for technical and non-technical audiences.

**Desired Skills**

* OT vulnerability management and safe scanning practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Experience supporting NIS or CAF-aligned assurance reporting.

**Experience**

* 8-12 years in IT security or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing vulnerability and patch management programmes.
* Experience running risk exception and acceptance processes through governance.

**What Do I Need Before I Apply**

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening (equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard) and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

**Benefits**

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits [India HR to confirm the benefits package].
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”
  
  
If you are an experienced vulnerability management professional who can turn vulnerability data into clear, prioritised action, we encourage you to apply today.

Build repeatable operating practices for change management, on-call readiness, escalation, and continual service improvement.

**Cloud platform and financial stewardship**

Guide the architecture and operating model for OCI or an equivalent major provider such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Oversee Kubernetes and virtualized environments, microservices foundations, cloud networking, databases, provisioning, and platform lifecycle.

Expand infrastructure as code and policy as code to make environments consistent, reviewable, and controlled.

Ensure backups and disaster recovery are routinely tested against agreed recovery objectives; improve resilience based on exercise results.

Introduce sound cloud financial management through cost allocation, forecasting, capacity choices, rightsizing, and accountable spend.

**Security engineering and threat response**

Own identity and privileged-access practices, secrets handling, and least-privilege design across cloud and engineering environments.

Ensure application and API authorization testing addresses tenant boundaries, isolation, and access-control failures in multi-tenant services.

Operate a risk-based vulnerability program that assigns owners, sets remediation targets, verifies fixes, and escalates overdue exposure.

Maintain cloud security posture management, continuous monitoring, security incident response, and disciplined penetration-test follow-through.

**Secure delivery, assurance, and AI operations**

Work with software engineering to embed automated checks in CI/CD: SAST, DAST, SCA, secret detection, container scanning, and IaC scanning.

Agree practical remediation SLAs and risk exceptions with engineering teams, keeping controls effective and delivery workflows usable.

Maintain operating evidence for ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, and SOC 2; lead customer security assessments and responses.

Apply automation and AIOps to detection, triage, response, and toil reduction. For AI agents, establish identity controls, authorized tool access, isolated execution, complete audit trails, and human approvals for sensitive actions.

**Experience and leadership profile**

At least 20 years of technology experience, with a track record of senior ownership in cloud platforms, production operations, reliability engineering, DevSecOps, or security engineering.

Executive leadership across multiple functions, including managing managers, setting direction, building leadership capability, and delivering outcomes through sizeable teams.

Accountability for business-critical production services; product SaaS or other cloud-native, multi-tenant environments are especially relevant.

Practical depth in a major cloud provider, Kubernetes, microservices, networking, databases, observability, IaC, and recovery planning.

Credible record of leading significant production incidents and converting lessons into lasting changes to architecture, process, or operational readiness.

Applied security engineering experience spanning IAM/PAM, secrets, application and API authorization, vulnerability remediation, cloud posture, monitoring, and response.

Experience introducing automated CI/CD security checks and achieving sustained remediation without relying on manual review as the main control.

Experience leading ISO 27001-family and SOC 2 assurance, including evidence quality and customer-facing security reviews.

Ability to communicate technical risks, trade-offs, service performance, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.

**Additional strengths**

Production experience with OCI; equivalent leadership depth with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud is applicable.

Background in enterprise SaaS or a regulated, security-conscious technology environment.

Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or audit credentials, such as cloud architecture/security certifications, CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.

Demonstrated use of AIOps or AI agents in operational settings with clear boundaries, oversight, and auditability.

title: Lead Consultant - SAP S/4HANA – IT Product Expert – Asset Maintenance
description:
**Role Title:**
Lead Consultant - SAP S/4HANA – IT Product Expert – Asset Maintenance
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, enhanced financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are aiming to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
The Product expert owns end-to-end solution design within the Production to Despatch Door IT Design Team. The role defines, maintains and improves AstraZeneca’s global template in line with fit-to-standard principles and SAP standard.
  
  
As the central design authority, the role aligns business processes, SAP design, master data, integrations, reporting and compliance into a scalable, deployable global Asset Maintenance template.
  
  
Working with Process Leads, site SMEs, Architecture, Data, Integration, Testing, Deployment and SI/SAP partners, the Product Expert ensures integration with Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Procurement, Inventory/Warehouse Management, EHS and Reporting.
  
  
The role ensures the global solution is documented, governed, validated and tested to programme and AstraZeneca compliance standards. It leads design decisions through governance, handles risks and assesses local requirements without compromising the global template.
  
  
During deployment, the role supports localisation, data migration, cutover, business readiness and hypercare, helping sites adopt the standard design while meeting GxP, validation, data integrity and change control requirements.
  
  
The role also shapes a future-ready global maintenance template by applying expertise in digital and mobile maintenance, connected worker solutions, predictive maintenance, analytics, IoT and AI.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and lead the SAP S/4HANA Asset Maintenance solution design, ensuring it underpins the global standard process and integrates effectively across the wider ERP landscape
* Act as the IT design authority for Asset Maintenance, translating business capability requirements into fit-to-standard SAP design decisions, configuration principles and deployable solution outcomes and taking these through the relevant governance forums
* Partner with Enterprise Process Leads, business SMEs and site representatives to align maintenance planning, scheduling, execution, reliability and calibration-related processes with SAP standard functionality
* Ensure Asset Maintenance integration requirements are defined, governed and delivered across adjacent capabilities including Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Procurement, Inventory/Warehouse Management, EHS, Master Data and Reporting
* Support and govern the definition, migration and quality of Asset Maintenance master data, including functional locations, equipment, BOMs, task lists, maintenance plans, measuring points and related data objects
* Be responsible for the documentation of the Asset Maintenance solution design, including design decisions, process flows, data requirements, WRICEF needs, test scope, validation evidence and deployment standards
* Champion the Asset Maintenance design through appropriate programme, architecture, data, process and business governance forums, ensuring decisions are clearly recorded and traceable
* Ensure the solution is documented, tested and validated in accordance with AstraZeneca compliance standards, including GxP, data integrity and change control expectations for regulated manufacturing environments
* Work with Architecture and Integration teams to ensure the Asset Maintenance solution and related integrations align with AstraZeneca’s strategic technology architecture and application roadmap
* Assess localisation, legal, regulatory and site-specific requirements during deployment, balancing legitimate local needs with the integrity of the global standard template
* Support deployment teams through build, test, data migration, cutover, business readiness, launch and hypercare, ensuring Asset Maintenance issues are triaged and resolved effectively
* Develop and lead detailed delivery plans for Asset Maintenance activities, aligned with wider programme milestones, dependency plans, BTG projects and BAU service transition needs
* Track delivery progress, handle risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, and provide clear status reporting into the Enterprise domain and wider programme governance
* Proactively evaluate latest SAP, industry and digital maintenance capabilities, including mobile maintenance, predictive maintenance, analytics, IoT and AI, and assess their relevance to AstraZeneca’s Asset Maintenance roadmap
* Represent IT as the Asset Maintenance SME and product leader in relevant programme, business process, data, architecture and external partner forums

**Essential For The Role**

* Solid understanding of Asset Maintenance, Engineering, Reliability and Maintenance Operations, including corrective, preventive, predictive and calibration-related maintenance in regulated manufacturing
* Recognised SAP S/4HANA Asset Management / Enterprise Asset Management SME, with solid understanding of technical objects, maintenance notifications and orders, task lists, maintenance plans, work scheduling, permits and maintenance execution
* Demonstrable record of owning or shaping sophisticated SAP solution designs in a large ERP transformation, balancing fit-to-standard principles with valid local regulatory and operational requirements
* Solid understanding of S/4HANA integration between Asset Maintenance and Finance, Procurement, Inventory/Warehouse Management, Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Master Data and Reporting
* Experience defining and governing global process, data and solution templates, including testable design documentation, decisions, WRICEF requirements, configuration rationale and deployment standards
* Strong Business and IT partner management and communication skills, with demonstrable ability to influence Enterprise Process Leads, site SMEs, and architecture, data, integration, testing and deployment teams
* Solid understanding of GxP, validation, data integrity and change control for maintenance processes and ERP systems in pharmaceutical manufacturing
* Evidence of building high-performing matrix teams and collaborating effectively with internal colleagues, external SI partners and SAP product specialists
* Good team player who collaborates across the programme and explains technical solution choices in clear business terms
* Agile, open attitude and comfortable with ambiguity, challenging priorities and programme pace
* Demonstrable ability to deliver IT change across locations and/or functions and translate technical information into business language

**Personal**

* Self-driven and able to prioritise effectively to achieve project goals.
* Strong business operations, communication, customer and partner engagement, and internal stakeholder management skills
* Confidently challenges the status quo and brings together different perspectives to drive solutions
* Able to handle large work efforts and meet ambitious deadlines
* Demonstrates personal credibility and positive energy
* Thinks creatively and thrives in ambiguous, high-pressure situations
* Innovative, agile, strategic and forward-thinking

**Functional/Technical Skills**

* Knowledge of the relevant SAP application roadmap and ability to translate it into AZ’s strategic view
* Demonstrated knowledge of SAP S/4HANA configuration requirements for the capability area
* Good presentation skills and ability to explain complex concepts to multi-functional audiences
* Knowledge of standard project tools, including JIRA, Smartsheets and Solman
* Comfortable working through technical details to solve problems quickly and handle urgent issues

**Desirable for the role**

* Certification in SAP S/4HANA Asset Management related SAP lines of business, or willingness to complete such certification
* Worked in a hybrid environment with a mix of internal and external resources across multiple geographical locations and time zones
* Experience of S/4HANA implementations for sophisticated global organisations from design through build, test, data migration, cutover, deployment and hypercare
* Knowledge or experience of maintenance, digital work management, connected worker solutions, condition-based monitoring, predictive maintenance, IoT, analytics or AI-enabled maintenance capabilities
* Experience integrating SAP Asset Management with external maintenance, calibration, MES, historian, reliability, document management, spare parts or plant automation systems
* Experience with maintenance master data governance, asset hierarchy design, equipment criticality, BOMs, functional locations, measuring points, task lists and maintenance strategy standardisation
* Knowledge of SAP Fiori user experience, embedded analytics and role-based maintenance apps for planners, supervisors, technicians and reliability teams
* Experience of regulated pharmaceutical, biologics, medical device or similarly controlled manufacturing environments

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca?**
At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.
  
  
**So, what’s next?**

title: Associate Technical Lead, DevSecOps
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
▪ 4–5 years of experience in DevSecOps, Application Security, Security Engineering, or related roles, with at least 2+ years in a lead or senior technical role.
  
  
▪ Proven experience leading and mentoring security or DevOps engineering teams.
  
  
▪ Expert-level hands-on experience with Checkmarx One (SAST) or equivalent enterprise SAST platforms.
  
  
▪ Deep experience with DAST tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or commercial alternatives.
  
  
▪ Extensive experience architecting and integrating security tools into Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions at enterprise scale.
  
  
▪ Strong expertise in container security, Kubernetes security, and API security.
  
  
▪ Hands-on experience designing and implementing secrets management solutions (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault).
  
  
▪ Expert understanding of Secure SDLC, OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, and enterprise vulnerability management practices.
  
  
▪ Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native security controls.
  
  
▪ Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, or Ansible.
  
  
▪ Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and service mesh technologies.
  
  
▪ Proficiency with observability and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk).
  
  
▪ Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell.
  
  
▪ Experience driving security initiatives in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
  
  
▪ Experience with threat modeling and secure architecture reviews.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
▪ Master’s degree with 4–5 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor’s degree with 6–8 years of experience.
  
  
▪ Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GWAPT, GWEB, or cloud security specialty certifications (AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer).
  
  
▪ Cloud or DevOps certifications (CKS, CKA, AWS DevOps Professional, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert).
  
  
▪ Experience with container and API security platforms (Aqua, Prisma Cloud, Sysdig, Snyk).
  
  
▪ Experience with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, Chronicle) and security orchestration (SOAR).
  
  
▪ Experience with zero trust architecture and identity-based security models.
  
  
▪ Background in penetration testing or red team activities.
  
  
▪ Experience presenting to and influencing executive leadership on security strategy and risk.
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
▪ Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence and drive change across teams and organizational boundaries.
  
  
▪ Excellent strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  
  
▪ Outstanding communication skills with the ability to articulate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
▪ Proven ability to mentor and develop talent.
  
  
▪ Collaborative mindset with experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
  
  
▪ Ownership mentality with a focus on quality, security, and continuous improvement.
  
  
▪ Ability to balance security requirements with business objectives and delivery timelines.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
Solution Engineer
  
  
What We Need
  
  
Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
**Reports to:**
Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
  
  
**About Corpay Cross-Border**
Corpay Cross-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
  
  
As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross-border.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  
  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company-issued equipment
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Overview
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
  
  
The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
  
  
You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
  
  
The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
Client Implementation & Solutioning
  
  

* Support end-to-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post-go-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.

Technical Analysis & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.

Global Team & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.

Special Projects, Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support special and ad-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs, file-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.

Benefits & Perks
  
  

* Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Medical & Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* Wellness & Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for self and family.
* Tech & Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commute & Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.

title: Apps Support Intmd Analyst
description:
**Citi Overview**
Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.
  
  
A critical enabler of Citi’s mission to enable growth and economic progress is technology. Our teams are creating innovations used across the globe – we’re changing the way people bank and how the world does business.
  
  
**Why Citi? Join a Global Bank that believes in its talent.**
Due to significant and continued investment, Citi’s technology team is growing. We’re looking for talented, driven individuals to help build the future of global banking. At Citi, you’ll have the chance to build the career you want, with the scale, inclusive culture and technology to support you.
  
  
You’ll be joining a diverse team of professionals across the world in an environment focused on growth and progress. This is the opportunity to take your career to the next level through the power of Citi’s unmatched globality and vast expertise.
  
  
**About the Team: SMBF Production Management**
Our Production Management team provides critical business and technical support to the Security Markets, Banking and Functions (SMBF); working collaboratively to ensure that our platforms and services operate for our clients, whenever they need them. We act as highly skilled and valued partners to our businesses.
  
  
Working as part of our Production Management team, you will help deliver a world class client service and experience, by applying engineering, innovation, learning and risk management across our systems and user environments. We interact with a diverse range of people each day, collaborating to solve problems as well as to anticipate and remove them before they occur.
  
  
Citi’s distinct global network of people, data and relationships creates a mindset that allows us to identify opportunities, manage risks and connect dots for our clients in ways that others cannot. Our people really do make all the difference in our success. We’re a forward-thinking team. We’re looking for ambitious, capable professionals who thrive on collaboration and want to improve how things are done. In return, we offer rewarding work in a supportive environment, clear opportunities for progression and exciting company benefits.
  
  
**Role And Position Overview**
Working as an
**Apps Sup Intermediate Analyst**
**,**
you will play an integral role in running and maintaining the production environment for reconciliation applications so that the our Operations and Risk & Control users can confidently service their clients. You will be a member of a highly efficient team which is focused on building a robust Production Support platform through utilizing the latest technologies and SRE disciplines.
  
  
The role sits within the Data Engineering Production Management team, Which aims to be the best for our clients by creating a Service-Centric organization focused on digitizing SMBF’s products/services, driving out manual work and delivering world-class Client experience and enabling growth via scalability. If you can demonstrate an appetite to learn technical concepts, have strong problem-solving skills and an ability to build excellent working relationships then we want to hear from you!
  
  
You will be working closely with colleagues in APAC, EMEA and NAM to ensure perfect 24/7 support of our franchise critical applications. In addition, you will also partner with Level 1 Support teams, Application Technology Development teams, Infrastructure teams and the Business Product owners.

title: Controls Tech EIM Database Lead / Database Engineering Lead
description:
**Position Overview**
Citi is seeking an experienced, high-caliber Database Technical Lead (C13 / VP) to lead the design, modernization, administration, and resiliency engineering of enterprise database platforms. As a C13 Database Lead, you will be responsible for defining technical strategies, driving cloud and database-as-a-service (DBaaS) transformations, ensuring strict data governance and security compliance, and leading senior technical engineers across critical multi-region banking systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Requirements**

* Enterprise Database Architecture & Technical Strategy Architect, design, and deliver end-to-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis). Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments. Drive the technical roadmap aligned with Citi's enterprise reference architectures, zero-trust infrastructure, and microservices ecosystem.
* Modernization, DBaaS & Cloud Enablement Lead migration initiatives from legacy on-premises databases to modern cloud and containerized platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, OpenShift, internal private cloud DBaaS/PaaS). Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling. Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re-platform and refactor applications for cloud-native persistence layers.
* High Availability, Replication & Scalability Engineering Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets & Sharded Clusters). Establish cross-region and multi-data-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
* Advanced Performance Engineering, Tuning & Diagnostics Spearhead deep-dive performance troubleshooting, query optimization, indexing reviews, execution plan analysis, and database profiling across production systems. Establish automated monitoring, telemetry, and observability frameworks (using Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, AppDynamics, and APM tools) to proactively detect anomalies, locking/blocking, and resource bottlenecks. Direct proactive capacity planning, I/O footprint optimization, and memory management across compute and storage tiers.
* Security, Vulnerability Management & Access Control Enforce end-to-end database security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, tokenization, TLS encryption in-transit, and privileged access controls. Drive automated security patching, configuration baseline compliance (CIS Benchmarks), and rapid remediation of vulnerabilities (CVEs), ensuring zero non-compliant instances across the fleet. Integrate identity and credential workflows with enterprise secrets management tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk) and role-based access control (RBAC).
* Database DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & CI/CD Champion Database DevOps practices by integrating schema migrations and database deployments into automated CI/CD pipelines (via Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub). Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) playbooks and configuration scripts using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Bash automation. Eliminate manual operational touchpoints through self-service database provisioning and automated routine maintenance.
* Continuity of Business (COB) & Disaster Recovery (DR) Own the disaster recovery framework for core database estates, designing and executing regular formal COB/DR failover drills. Define and maintain backup and restore strategies (RMAN, storage snapshots, point-in-time recovery) to safeguard data integrity against hardware failures, corruption, and site-level disasters. Ensure comprehensive auditability and validation of backup retention policies aligned with financial regulatory standards.
* Governance, Risk, Audit & Regulatory Compliance Serve as the primary database technical authority during internal and external audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk assessments. Ensure full compliance with Citi's Information Security policies, data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws), and financial record retention mandates. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational readiness checklists.
* Technical Leadership, Mentorship & Vendor Engagement Provide strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to senior engineers, database administrators, and offshore support teams. Collaborate closely with application squads, enterprise architects, site reliability engineers (SREs), and product owners to translate complex business requirements into robust database architectures. Liaise with major database software vendors (Oracle, EnterpriseDB, MongoDB, AWS) on product escalations, feature enhancements, and roadmaps.
* Required Qualifications, Experience & Certifications Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in database engineering/administration, with at least 3+ years in a lead or architect capacity within a large-scale, enterprise financial services environment. Core Technical Competencies: In-depth expertise in Oracle (19c/21c, RAC, Data Guard) and/or PostgreSQL (v12+, Patroni, Connection Pooling). Strong working proficiency with NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Redis) and DBaaS architectures. Demonstrated hands-on scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform. Solid understanding of Linux kernel OS tuning, storage architectures (SAN/NAS/NVMe), and networking protocols. Certifications (Preferred): Certified Oracle Database Administrator / Specialist AWS Certified Database – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect Professional PostgreSQL / EDB Certified Professional MongoDB Certified DBA Associate / Professional Key Leadership & Soft Skills Proven track record of managing high-impact technical incidents and driving root cause analysis (RCA) to conclusion. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. Strong ownership mindset, problem-solving agility, and passion for continuous technology modernization.

title: Senior PMM (IC3)
description:
**About Everstage Inc.**
Everstage is the leading sales compensation and SPM platform. We automate commissions, quota and capacity planning, territory design, and real-time payout visibility for sales teams globally.
  
  
We're heading into the most exciting chapter of our story so far, a global brand refresh is about to go live, the leadership team is showing up more publicly and gaining followers and we want our social channels to feel less like a corporate handle and more like a creator brand.
  
  
That's where you come in.
  
  
**About The Role**
Everstage is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market for major launches across our revenue platform: Everstage Incentives, Everstage Planning, and Everstage CPQ. You will own product storytelling and differentiation for your product areas, run projects end to end, and be accountable for launch impact. You will work directly with senior leaders in Product, Sales, and Customer Success, and help shape how customers experience and advocate for Everstage.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own GTM strategy for major product launches, from positioning and messaging through sales enablement, launch campaigns, and post-launch measurement.
* Lead product storytelling and differentiation, including how we position our AI capabilities against how buyers run incentives, quoting, and planning today.
* Develop market segmentation and narrative for key buyer personas: RevOps leaders, Sales Ops, Finance, and sales reps.
* Synthesize customer insights, competitive analysis, and market trends into sharper positioning, and bring those insights into roadmap conversations with Product leadership.
* Lead multi-format content campaigns across web, email, social, events, and sales enablement.
* Build sales tools that win deals: pitch decks, demo narratives, battle cards, and objection handling for competitive situations.
* Build and grow Everstage's customer marketing program: launch and manage a customer reference program, turn customer wins into case studies and video testimonials with measurable outcomes, grow our presence on peer review sites, recruit customers to speak at webinars and events, and set up structured feedback channels, such as customer interviews and advisory board sessions, that feed messaging and roadmap decisions.
* Influence cross-functional peers and leadership on launch priorities, timing, and success metrics.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3 to 5 years of product marketing experience in enterprise or technical B2B SaaS.
* Experience in Sales Performance Management (SPM), Incentive Compensation Management (ICM), or Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ). You know how RevOps, Sales Ops, and Finance teams buy and use these tools.
* Exceptional writing skills. You can take a complex concept and turn it into a clear, simple copy a busy RevOps leader understands in one read.
* Experience marketing AI products or AI-powered features, and a working knowledge of how buyers evaluate AI in enterprise software.
* A track record of owning major launches end to end, with results you can point to. You know how to bring Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing together around one plan and keep them aligned through launch day and beyond.
* Deep technical acumen. You can learn a complex product quickly and explain it in plain language tied to a business outcome.
* Comfort working with senior stakeholders and managing projects autonomously.
* Experience building and growing a customer marketing program is preferred. Ideally you have launched a reference program, shipped case studies and video testimonials, or run a customer advisory board, and you can show how that work helped Sales win deals.

description:

**Location: Egmore, Chennai**

**﻿Kindly do not proceed with the application for this job, if you are uncomfortable with the requirements.**

**About Digenie**

Digenie is a creative digital marketing agency producing high-quality visual content for brands across lifestyle, F&B, alcohol & beverages, tourism, government, and emerging startups. We focus on strong ideas, culturally relevant storytelling, and visually impactful content designed for social media.

We are looking for an Assistant Photographer / Editor who is hands-on, creative, and detail-oriented — someone who can support shoots, contribute ideas, and handle end-to-end editing for social platforms.

**Role Overview**

The Photographer / Editor will work closely with the content and social media teams to plan, shoot, and edit photos and videos for multiple brands. This role requires a balance of technical shooting skills, creative thinking, storytelling, and social media awareness.

You will assist in product shoots, testimonial videos, meme-based reels, behind-the-scenes content, and short-form videos, while also contributing to ideation and execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Photography & Videography**

* Assist in shooting product photoshoots, lifestyle images, testimonials, and brand visuals.
* Capture vertical video content including reels, shorts, meme-based videos, BTS, and social-first formats.
* Handle basic camera setup, framing, composition, and shot execution.
* Support on-location and in-studio shoots as required.

**Storyboarding & Pre-Production**

* Collaborate with the content and social media teams to plan shoots and content formats.
* Help with storyboarding, shot lists, and reel structures for testimonials, memes, and campaigns.
* Participate in discussions to align visuals with content calendars and campaign goals.

**Lighting & Shoot Setup**

* Set up and manage basic lighting (continuous lights, softboxes, reflectors, practical lights).
* Understand lighting needs for products, faces, food, and indoor environments.
* Ensure consistent lighting quality across shoots.

**Creative Research & Ideation**

* Research trending reels, meme formats, transitions, and visual styles.
* Bring new ideas, references, and inspirations for shoots and edits.
* Stay updated with Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and emerging visual trends.

**Editing & Post-Production**

* Edit photos (colour correction, retouching, cropping, optimisation & design for posters/carousels).
* Edit reels, shorts, and videos with transitions, sound effects, subtitles, and motion elements/animations.
* Format and optimise content for Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other platforms.
* Maintain organised storage of raw footage and final assets.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in photography, videography, or video editing.
* Good understanding of camera basics, framing, composition, and lighting.
* Proficiency in tools like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects (basic), Lightroom, Photoshop, or similar.
* Familiarity with social media content formats and platform requirements.
* Ability to work collaboratively with content, design, and social media teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience shooting products, testimonials, or short-form social content.
* Basic knowledge of motion graphics or text animation.
* Understanding of meme culture and internet trends.
* Ability to assist in creative planning beyond execution.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Hands-on, eager-to-learn, and proactive.
* Strong visual sense and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment.
* Someone who can both execute instructions and contribute ideas.

**Why Join Digenie**

* Exposure to diverse brands and content formats.
* Opportunity to grow into a Photographer / Videographer / Video Editor role.
* Creative freedom to experiment with trends and formats.
* Collaborative team with a strong focus on ideas and execution.
