title: Lead Advanced Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Chargebee**

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

**About the Team**

You’ll join the Advanced Solutions Engineering team, an L2 support group connecting customer-facing operations directly with our Engineering and Product teams. We focus on triaging and solving mission-critical customer issues to keep our systems running smoothly. We value sharp diagnostic skills, asynchronous collaboration, and driving solutions from issue detection to final resolution.

**About the role (Job Summary)**

As a Lead Advanced Solutions Engineer, you will act as a senior technical leader, team guide, and pivotal bridge connecting Customer facing teams, Core Engineering, and Product Management. Stepping up from execution, you independently define and drive issue resolution strategies, ensuring efficient troubleshooting and escalations across multi-component systems. You will take complete technical and troubleshooting ownership as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) across all sub-modules within the ASE module.

In this role, you will lead and mentor Advanced Solutions Engineers (ASEs) and Senior ASEs, lead complex multi-phase investigations, write targeted code patches, and champion AI-powered diagnostic workflows. You own the reliability of supported modules/services, architect internal troubleshooting tools, and partner directly with Engineering leaders to eradicate systemic friction, implement scalable fixes, and elevate overall platform supportability.

**What you’ll do (role and responsibilities)**

* **Lead, mentor, and elevate**
  Advanced Solutions Engineers by fostering a culture of debugging excellence, establishing diagnostic playbooks, and driving team-wide adoption of AI-powered troubleshooting tools.
* **Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME)**
  across all ASE sub-modules, taking full ownership of platform reliability, observability, and service maintenance.
* **Perform deep-code debugging**
  across complex microservices and integration layers to uncover non-obvious logic flaws, concurrency bugs, and performance bottlenecks.
* **Write targeted code patches**
  and develop scalable workarounds to quickly resolve high-impact customer issues, ensuring all fixes meet platform security and maintainability standards.
* **Drive incident response strategies**
  during critical platform outages, leading rapid cross-component triage to protect customer trust and maintain operational readiness across 24/7 rotational shifts.
* **Champion AI innovation**
  by integrating LLM-driven log analysis, automated stack trace summarization, and AI coding assistants to continuously reduce MTTR.
* **Collaborate directly with Engineering and Product leaders**
  to translate recurring incident patterns into long-term product fixes, eliminating platform friction and improving supportability.

**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)**

* **6+ years supporting complex enterprise applications or SaaS products**
  in an L2/L3 technical support capacity.
* **Strong fluency in Java/J2EE**
  with proven experience reading, navigating, patching, and profiling large, production-grade enterprise codebases.
* **Hands-on experience with AI-powered diagnostic tools**
  (e.g., GitHub Copilot, LLM prompt engineering, AI log analyzers, and automated code inspection tools).
* **Deep technical expertise in web technologies**
  , including RESTful APIs, webhooks, JSON/XML payloads, and modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue).
* **Extensive experience with enterprise observability tools**
  (such as Datadog, Splunk, ELK Stack, or New Relic) for log analysis and performance profiling.
* **Excellent oral and written communication skills**
  to effectively explain complex technical concepts to both cross-functional engineering teams and leadership.

**Nice to have (preferred)**

* 3+ years of direct experience as a Software Development Engineer (SDE) or Sustaining Engineer building or maintaining multi-tenant cloud software.
* Track record of designing internal tools, AI diagnostics, or engineering automation that significantly improved troubleshooting efficiency, reduced support overhead, or eliminated recurring ticket categories.

**Benefits we offer**

At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include:

* Health & Wellness: Robust coverage and access to programs to support your physical and mental well-being.
* Financial Security: Initiatives to help you build long-term financial stability.
* Work-Life Balance: Flexible options and resources to help you thrive both professionally and personally.

*Chargebee is an equal opportunity employer. At Chargebee, we believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences is not a “good-to-have” but a “must-have” as it strengthens us as a company and as individuals. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.*

*We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, national origin, ancestry, caste, citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

title: Network Architect
description:
We are seeking a Network Architect, responsible for designing and governing secure, scalable, highly available enterprise network solutions across LAN, WAN, WLAN, data center, cloud, and SD-WAN environments. The role will define network architecture and standards, provide technical leadership for implementations and migrations, perform capacity and performance planning, ensure security and resiliency, and act as the senior escalation point for complex network issues. Strong expertise in routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, SD-WAN, cloud networking, network security, and high-availability architecture is required.

**6 Months On Contract Role**

Design enterprise LAN, WAN, WLAN, data center, and cloud connectivity solutions.

Develop high-level and low-level network architecture and maintain network diagrams and technical documentation.

Translate business and application requirements into scalable network designs.

Define network architecture standards, design principles, technology roadmaps, and best practices.

Architect and support SD-WAN, VPN, routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing, DNS/DHCP, and secure remote connectivity solutions.

Design network solutions for high availability, redundancy, disaster recovery, performance, and scalability.

Perform network capacity planning, performance analysis, and optimization.

Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to incorporate appropriate security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access controls.

Evaluate new network technologies and recommend improvements or modernization opportunities.

Provide architectural guidance to Network Engineers and implementation teams.

Lead technical reviews and support major network migrations, upgrades, and transformation initiatives.

Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex network issues and perform root-cause analysis.

Work with technology vendors and service providers on solution design, technical evaluation, and implementation.

Ensure network solutions comply with organizational architecture, security, and operational standards.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLAN, STP, MPLS, VPN, QoS, DNS and DHCP
* Enterprise routing and switching
* LAN/WAN/WLAN architecture
* Firewall and network security architecture
* SD-WAN and modern enterprise networking
* Cloud networking across Azure/AWS or equivalent cloud platforms
* Hybrid-cloud and data-center connectivity
* Network monitoring and performance management
* High availability and disaster recovery design
* Network troubleshooting and root-cause analysis
* Network documentation and architecture diagrams
* Exposure to network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code is desirable

**Key Competencies**

* Enterprise architecture and solution-design capability
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Technical leadership and decision-making
* Stakeholder and vendor management
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Ability to explain complex network designs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong documentation and presentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple technical priorities in enterprise environments

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in enterprise networking, progressing into network solution design and architecture.
* Experience designing networks across data centers, enterprise sites, cloud environments, and remote connectivity.
* CCNP/CCIE, Juniper, cloud networking, or equivalent certifications are desirable. Industry role descriptions commonly identify advanced Cisco, Juniper, and cloud networking certifications as relevant to Network Architect positions.

title: Client Relations Associate
description:

FreeElective Network Pvt. Ltd., based in Chennai, introduced and operates Jodi365.com, a premium, personalized matchmaking service for elite singles.
  
  
We understand that elite singles may be at different stages of their lives and careers, with different time frames for getting married. We work closely with discerning clients, worldwide, and help them find the right partner at a pace that's right for them.
  
  
Our reach is global and we have earned much goodwill since 2009, by bringing people together. Just as important: We have a validated business model, are profitable, and are growing briskly.

The ideal Client Relations Associate will have excellent communication and people skills and be experienced in customer service or hospitality. * Energized by the opportunities and challenges of working at a small and growing company

title: Senior DFT Engineer
description:
**Role:**
Senior DFT Engineer

**Function:**
Design for Test (DFT) / Semiconductor Engineering

**Location:**
Bangalore / Malaysia / Japan / Chennai

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Semiconductors, Information Technology & Services

**About Company**

A Bangalore-based technology consulting firm specialising in Semiconductor ASIC Design Services and Embedded Software Development. Founded by industry veterans with over 100 years of combined semiconductor experience.

The company guides projects from initial specifications all the way to first-pass silicon success. It operates across six verticals: Design & Verification, Physical Design & SignOff, DFT, FPGA Design, Analog & Analog Layout, and Embedded Software.

A close-knit team of 67, with deep multi-foundry capabilities and advanced node expertise from 180nm to 3nm.

**Position Overview**

This role sits at the heart of the company's DFT vertical, responsible for defining and implementing test architectures that ensure high fault coverage across complex SoC and ASIC designs. The engineer will own the full DFT flow — from scan insertion and ATPG pattern development through GLS debug and post-silicon bring-up support — working across design, verification, and physical design teams to accelerate client time-to-market.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Define and implement DFT architecture for SoC/ASIC designs, including scan insertion and scan chain stitching
* Develop and validate ATPG patterns for stuck-at, transition, bridge, and path delay fault models
* Implement and verify MBIST and memory repair solutions
* Perform DFT rule checks (DRC) and drive resolution of violations
* Support JTAG/boundary scan (IEEE 1149.1) implementation and verification
* Run and debug Gate Level Simulations (GLS) for DFT pattern validation
* Analyse and improve test coverage, pattern count, and test time; support post-silicon bring-up and failure analysis
* Create and maintain DFT documentation, methodology guides, and best-practice flows

**Must Have Criteria**

* 7+ years of hands-on DFT experience on SoC/ASIC designs
* Proven experience with scan insertion, scan chain stitching, and ATPG pattern generation (stuck-at, transition, bridge, path delay)
* Experience implementing and verifying MBIST and memory repair solutions
* Proficiency in DFT rule checks (DRC) and violation debug
* Experience with JTAG/boundary scan and IEEE 1149.1 implementation
* Hands-on experience running and debugging Gate Level Simulations (GLS) for DFT patterns
* Exposure to advanced process nodes and industry-standard EDA tools for DFT

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with post-silicon bring-up and silicon failure analysis
* Familiarity with multi-foundry design environments
* Exposure to advanced nodes (7nm and below)
* Experience authoring DFT methodology documentation and best-practice flows

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on complex SoC/ASIC projects spanning 180nm to 3nm process nodes
* Close collaboration with industry veterans carrying 100+ years of combined semiconductor expertise
* Skill development through diverse, client-driven semiconductor engagements
* Stable, engineering-first culture in a focused 67-person firm

We are looking for a System Integrator with hands-on experience in network infrastructure implementation, integration, and troubleshooting. * Experience with Fortinet FortiGate or SonicWALL firewalls.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte’s Cyber Incident Response team as a Manager and help organizations respond to complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. In this role, you will lead incident response activities, advise client stakeholders during high-impact events, and help drive forensic analysis, threat hunting, and recovery efforts. This position requires strong technical judgment, responsiveness during active incidents, and the ability to lead teams in fast-paced environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager on the Cyber Incident Response team, you will be responsible for leading incident response engagements and supporting clients through complex cyber investigations and recovery efforts.
  
  

* Lead incident response engagements involving malware, ransomware, data breach, and insider threat investigations across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments

* Oversee threat hunting, log analysis, malware analysis, and investigative activities across security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, and network security platforms

* Document incident timelines, indicators of compromise, attack methodologies, findings, remediation actions, and post-incident reviews for client delivery

**The team**
Deloitte’s Cyber Incident Response team helps organizations investigate, contain, and recover from complex cyber incidents across enterprise, cloud, and hybrid environments. The team supports clients through forensic analysis, threat hunting, incident management, and recovery planning during high-impact events. Professionals in this practice work across industries to strengthen incident response readiness, improve detection and response capabilities, and reduce the impact of future attacks.

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai

Based on client / project needs
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 9+ years of experience in cybersecurity, including 2+ years of experience in incident response

title: Design Manager – Mechanical (Water & Wastewater Infrastructure)
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Mechanical Infrastructure, you will lead the multidisciplinary mechanical design delivery for complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects, including pump stations, water treatment plants (WTPs), wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs), desalination systems, and associated mechanical/process systems.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, quality assurance, constructability, risk management, and programme certainty across all stages of project delivery—from concept through detailed and construction design.
  
  
Working closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional Leadership, you will plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of mechanical design packages, while mentoring and developing engineers across global teams.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Lead and manage mechanical design for water/wastewater pump stations, treatment plants, and associated mechanical/process systems.
* Develop project-specific mechanical design strategies ensuring multidisciplinary integration, alignment with project requirements, and risk mitigation.
* Oversee preparation and coordination of mechanical deliverables

+ Equipment sizing & selection
+ Mechanical design calculations
+ Pumping system calculations & hydraulic checks
+ P&IDs, equipment layouts, plant general arrangements
+ Mechanical data sheets and specifications

* Review and validate vendor documents, datasheets, and shop drawings; ensure integration with overall design.
* Lead mechanical engineering inputs for Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) and EPC delivery models constructability, staging, installation methodology, O&M requirements.
* Support and lead HAZOP/HAZID, value engineering, risk workshops, failure mode assessments, and operability/maintainability reviews.
* Manage and own key design management documents

+ Project Responsibility Matrix
+ Basis of Design
+ Overall Design Programme
+ Schedule of Deliverables
+ Design Risk Register
+ Design Change Register

* Coordinate with process, civil, electrical, ICA, BIM, structural, and architectural teams for holistic design delivery.
* Engage with clients through workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical clarifications.
* Ensure design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, project specifications, and HSE requirements.
* Support the preparation of technical proposals, LOE estimates, design execution plans, and project scheduling.
* Mentor, coach, and provide performance feedback to engineers to strengthen organisational capability.
* Collaborate with global delivery centres to ensure consistent design practices and effective resource utilisation.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* PipeFlo, AFT Fathom/Impulse, WaterGEMS (for hydraulics interface), vendor pump selection software
* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6, MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Plant 3D, OpenPlant Modeler, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds strong, collaborative relationships across multidisciplinary teams.
* Confident, approachable leader with strong client‑facing presence.
* Demonstrates leadership through coordination, clarity, and proactive communication.
* Encourages teams to develop integrated, constructible, and high‑quality mechanical design solutions.
* Organised, disciplined, and able to resolve complex mechanical issues in a timely manner.
* Champions a strong culture of safety, quality, and innovation.
* Flexible, dependable, and capable of performing in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Work Experience**

* 15+ years of experience in mechanical engineering design and design management within water/wastewater infrastructure projects.

* Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams delivering mechanical design for

+ Water/wastewater pump stations
+ WTPs/WWTPs and associated process units
+ Chemical dosing systems
+ Sludge handling systems
+ High‑lift/low‑lift pumping systems
+ Treatment mechanical equipment (screens, clarifiers, blowers, compressors, valves, etc.)

* Strong understanding of pumping systems NPSH, system curves, pump selection, surge analysis interface, pipework design, and hydraulic analysis.
* Demonstrated capability in Design for Design‑Build constructability reviews, contractor interface, installation sequencing, technical risk mitigation.
* Experience coordinating mechanical design within a BIM‑enabled environment.
* Strong ability to interpret P&IDs, hydraulic profiles, process input documents, engineering drawings, and specifications.
* Experience with vendor coordination, MTO/BoQ preparation, equipment procurement support, and technical bid evaluations.
* Experience with change management, design risk management, and impacts assessment.
* Ability to support bids, proposals, LOE estimates, and multidisciplinary design execution plans.
* Experience with alternate delivery models (DB, EPC, CMAR, PPP) is an asset.
* Strong interest in digital delivery, automation, and continuous improvement of mechanical workflows.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field is advantageous
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Mechanical Engineer (CEng) is advantageous

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large, complex water/wastewater facilities and pumping systems.
* Exposure to brownfield upgrades, shutdown/staging, and commissioning planning.
* Knowledge of sustainability principles and low‑carbon mechanical design approaches.
* Experience working with international codes, standards, and global delivery frameworks.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Senior Linux & UNIX Systems Administrator
description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Information Technology (IT) group at KLA is involved in every aspect of the global business. IT’s mission is to enable business growth and productivity by connecting people, process, and technology. It focuses not only on enhancing the technology that enables our business to thrive but also on how employees use and are empowered by technology. This integrated approach to customer service, creativity and technological excellence enables employee productivity, business analytics, and process excellence.
  
  
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Linux & UNIX Administration**

* Administer, maintain, and support large-scale Linux and UNIX environments including:

+ Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
+ Oracle Linux
+ Solaris 10/11
+ Ubuntu and other enterprise Linux distributions

* Perform OS installation, upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and capacity planning.
* Develop automation using shell scripting, Ansible, Python, and other infrastructure automation tools.

**ERP & Mission-Critical Application Support**

* Provide infrastructure support for:

+ SAP S/4HANA
+ SAP ECC
+ Oracle ERP and associated applications
+ SAP application and database landscapes

* Coordinate with application, database, storage, network, and security teams to ensure high availability and optimal performance.

**High Availability & Clustering**

* Design, implement, manage, and troubleshoot:

+ Veritas Cluster Server (VCS)
+ Linux High Availability Clusters
+ Solaris Clustering environments
+ SAP High Availability architectures

* Ensure business-critical applications meet availability and recovery objectives.

**Kubernetes & Container Platforms**

* Deploy and administer:

+ Kubernetes clusters
+ Container platforms (Docker, Podman)
+ Container orchestration and lifecycle management

* Support modernization initiatives involving cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure solutions.

**Virtualization & Cloud Infrastructure**

* Manage VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization platforms.
* Design and support virtualized enterprise workloads.
* Optimize infrastructure utilization and resource allocation.
* Support hybrid cloud integration and cloud migration initiatives.

**Storage & Data Protection**

* Administer enterprise storage environments including:

+ SAN storage
+ NAS storage
+ NFS/CIFS environments
+ Enterprise backup solutions

* Work with storage teams on provisioning, performance optimization, replication, and capacity management.

**Disaster Recovery & Replication**

* Design and maintain enterprise DR strategies supporting critical workloads.
* Implement and manage:

+ Storage replication technologies
+ VMware SRM
+ Database replication
+ DR automation and orchestration

* Conduct DR testing and recovery validation exercises.
* Ensure compliance with RTO and RPO requirements.

**Security & Infrastructure Compliance**

* Secure Linux and UNIX environments following industry best practices.
* Conduct security assessments, vulnerability reviews, and compliance audits.
* Identify infrastructure security gaps and drive remediation activities.
* Implement hardening standards, CIS benchmarks, and security controls.
* Collaborate with Cyber Security teams on risk mitigation and compliance initiatives.

**Vulnerability Management & Patching**

* Own enterprise Linux/UNIX patching programs.
* Coordinate vulnerability scanning and remediation activities.
* Ensure timely resolution of critical and high-risk findings.
* Maintain patch compliance and security reporting metrics.

**Infrastructure Solution Design**

* Lead architecture and infrastructure design initiatives.
* Develop scalable, resilient, and secure solutions supporting enterprise workloads.
* Create technical designs, implementation plans, and operational documentation.
* Participate in technology evaluation, proof-of-concepts, and platform selection.

**Hardware & Data Center Infrastructure**

* Manage enterprise server hardware platforms including:

+ Dell PowerEdge
+ HPE ProLiant
+ Cisco UCS
+ Oracle SPARC
+ Lead hardware lifecycle management, upgrades, firmware updates, and refresh programs.

* Coordinate with vendors for troubleshooting and support escalations.

**Technical Skills**

* Linux Administration (RHEL, Oracle Linux, Ubuntu)
* Solaris 10/11 Administration
* SAP S/4HANA Infrastructure
* Oracle Enterprise Platforms
* Veritas Cluster Server (VCS)
* Linux High Availability Clustering
* VMware / Nutanix / Hyper-V
* Kubernetes and Docker
* NAS and SAN Storage
* NFS, CIFS, Multipathing
* Disaster Recovery and Replication Technologies
* Vulnerability Management Tools
* Infrastructure Automation (Ansible, Python, Shell Scripting)
* Monitoring and Observability Platforms
* Enterprise Backup and Recovery Solutions

**Preferred Certifications**

* Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)
* Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA)
* Oracle Linux Certification
* Solaris Administration Certification
* VMware VCP
* Kubernetes CKA/CKAD

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* Master's degree preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of Linux/UNIX Administration experience in large global enterprise environments.
* 5+ years supporting SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, Oracle ERP, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Proven experience supporting global 24x7 production environments.

To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.
  
  
Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.
  
  
You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.
  
  
Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. You will report and escalate incidents when necessary and strive for efficient, comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. With each interaction, you will aim to provide a positive client experience, placing their needs at the forefront of all you do.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Entry-level experience with troubleshooting and support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage within a medium to large ICT organization.
* Basic knowledge of management agents, redundancy concepts, and ITIL processes.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day-to-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools.
* Skill in planning activities and projects in advance and adapting to changing circumstances.
* A client-centric approach, understanding their requirements and ensuring a positive experience throughout their journey.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening techniques and refraining from interrupting.
* A positive outlook at work, even in pressurized environments.
* Willingness to work hard and put in longer hours when necessary.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT or Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.

title: SecOps Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
We are seeking a Secops Engineer with minimum 3 years to maximum 5 years – Vulnerability, Patch, and Application Packaging Management
  
  
**Role Summary**
Responsible for overseeing end-to-end vulnerability management, patch lifecycle, and application packaging for servers and workstations. The role ensures timely remediation of vulnerabilities through effective patching, packaging, and deployment strategies across enterprise assets, integrating automation, compliance, and tool optimization (Qualys, SCCM, Intune, AdminStudio, ORCA).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Packaging & Deployment:**

* Develop, customize, and validate MSI/MST/MSIX packages using AdminStudio, InstallShield, and ORCA.
* Convert legacy EXE installers into silent MSI/IntuneWin formats for streamlined deployment.
* Perform application discovery, dependency mapping, and compatibility testing for Windows 10/11 environments.
* Coordinate testing and deployment of packaged apps through SCCM and Intune.
* Manage version control, documentation, and change requests for packaged applications.
* Automate repetitive packaging and deployment tasks using PowerShell scripting.
* Collaborate with the Cybersecurity team to validate that packaged applications meet security compliance and vulnerability-free baselines.

**Vulnerability & Patch Management**

* Lead enterprise Vulnerability Management Program using Qualys VMDR — ensuring timely detection, prioritization, and remediation.
* Manage monthly patch cycles for Windows servers (via SCCM) and workstations (via Intune).
* Validate and test Microsoft and third-party patches before deployment to production environments.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, endpoint, and security teams to ensure critical vulnerabilities are remediated within SLA.
* Perform zero-day vulnerability handling (e.g., WannaCry-type events) with accelerated patch validation and rollout.

**Operational Excellence**

* Drive automation for vulnerability-to-patch correlation workflows using Python and PowerShell.
* Integrate patch and packaging workflows with vulnerability intelligence (Qualys → SCCM/Intune mapping).

**Tools & Technologies**

* Application Packaging: AdminStudio, ORCA, InstallShield, MSIX Packaging Tool
* Scripting: PowerShell
* Patch Management: SCCM, Intune, WSUS
* Vulnerability Management: Qualys VMDR, Rapid7 InsightVM

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Tier 2 — Technical Support Engineer**

**Job Description**

**Additional CSR Qualifications / Requirements / Waivers**

**Tier 2 — Technical Support Engineer:**

* Proficient in Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols)
* Proficient in VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, SIP traces)
* Strong communication skills and a customer-first attitude
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously
* Ability to:
* Independently develop solutions to complex technical, process, and systems problems
* Thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
* Perform advanced root cause analysis and drive issues to resolution
* CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification preferred

**Job Description**

**Why this role matters**
To customers, Tier 2 Technical Support Engineers are the escalation backbone of our support organization. When Tier 1 specialists encounter issues beyond initial troubleshooting, our Tier 2 engineers’ step in to own the resolution. We go deeper — into SIP traces, network captures, platform configurations, and engineering-level diagnostics — to deliver the answers our customers and teammates need. The Technical Support Engineer is a mid-level, high-impact position requiring strong technical aptitude and independent problem-solving.

IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU, CONTINUE READING BELOW…….

**What you will do**

* Serve as the primary escalation point for Tier 1 Technical Support Specialists, receiving and owning complex cases that require advanced technical investigation.
* Perform in-depth troubleshooting on call quality, call completion, SIP registration, call flow builds, features, and network-related issues across the platform.
* Analyze SIP traces, packet captures (PCAPs), and platform logs to diagnose and resolve voice and network issues.
* Independently resolve complex issues and collaborate with Tier 3 engineers, Voice Engineering, and Advanced Operations Support (AOS) on issues requiring escalated technical expertise.
* Manage and drive cases to resolution, ensuring timely updates to customers and adherence to SLA commitments.
* Follow up with customers and Tier 1 agents to confirm resolution and ensure a high level of satisfaction.
* Document customer issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions thoroughly within the ticketing system.
* Identify trends, recurring issues, and systemic problems; escalate patterns to management and Tier 3 for root cause analysis.
* Contribute to the development of internal knowledge base articles (IKBs) and training materials for Tier 1 upskilling.
* Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours and weekend support coverage.
* Mentor and coach Tier 1 team members on advanced troubleshooting methodologies and platform knowledge.

**What you will bring**

* Proficient knowledge of Networking (Layer 2 & 3 topology, networking hardware, cabling, WAPs, routing protocols such as OSPF/BGP).
* Strong working knowledge of VoIP technologies (QoS, SIP Flow, Codec Negotiations, RTP, DTMF, PCAP analysis).
* Experience troubleshooting within an IP/VoIP environment, including SIP registration, call routing, and call quality diagnostics.
* Familiarity with the Broad Works/BroadSoft hosted voice platform.
* Strong communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to manage difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to:
* Manage multiple complex escalations simultaneously while maintaining quality and accuracy.
* Work independently and collaboratively across teams.
* Mentor junior team members and share knowledge proactively.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment with tight SLA requirements.

**What is required for application?**

**Required**

* 2+ years of experience in technical support or network engineering role.
* CCNA, Network+, or equivalent networking certification, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Hands-on experience with SIP, TCP/IP, VoIP, and LAN/WAN troubleshooting.

**Preferred**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a technical field.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco and other networking equipment.
* Experience reading and interpreting SIP traces and PCAP files.
* Prior experience supporting enterprise-level customers in a tiered support model.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Technical Support Specialist**

**Job Title- Frontline agent**

The primary work activity for the Technical Support Representatives (“TSRs”) includes, but is not limited to:

a) Logging initial report or inquiry detail from Customer

b)Initial issue triage and information gathering

c) Completing MACD (move, add, change and delete) tasks

d)Isolation testing to identify the root cause of the trouble

e) Initiating trouble resolution process management

(i.e. resolution or escalation of support issues submitted to)

f) Inbox monitoring (“Triage”) per mutually agreed upon processes

Will deliver these services inclusive of ticketing systems, troubleshooting tools, and monitoring applications. Services consist of two main work categories: (a) administrative support tasks and (b) “break/fix” support tasks. Services falling into either of these categories may be escalated to Level 3 team on an as needed basis per established and approved processes.

**Scope of Services**

**Platform Administration**

• Call flow modifications

• Number assignment

• Device assignment/configurations

• User configuration

• Group service configurations

• Password resets

• Call routing / Schedule adjustments

• Music on Hold /Announcement assignment

• Incoming/Outgoing call restrictions

• Feature configurations

• Other functionality changes as required

**Service Support**

• Device setting adjustments

• IP address whitelisting

• Devicere build/reset

• Service Testing

• Endpoint troubleshooting

• SOHO (Small Office/Home Office) network recommendations

• Call quality data gathering

**Application Support**

• FaxMail

• Voicemail portal

• Webex

• SMTT(visual voicemail)

• Counterpath/Softphone

• MobileLink

• Call center

• Receptionist

• CTI (Call Recording)

**Service Disruption Support**

• Appending tickets to master

• Offering routing adjustments

• Customer call backs

• Collect trending data

• Direct callers to trust site

**Account Administration**

• Authorize contact add/remove

• Gather data on billing inquiries

• Collect Letter of Agency (LOA) information for porting of Customer telephone

numbers

• Provide contact pathway for cancellations

**General Service Questions and User Assistance**

• Enterprise Portal Walkthrough

• Device/Service functionality assistance

• CSA/SMB contact information

• Ticket triage and escalation

• Ticket status updates

• Review and strategize Billing related inquiries

• Resolve Billing issues

**Job Profile
: Technical Support Agent**

**Why this role matters**

Technical Support Agents work directly with customers to diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair end user system access, device issues, and first level troubleshooting steps in a call center environment. The Technical Support Agent works to gather all details of the request to eliminate follow up engagement for added information. We are part of the team ensuring that customers get the functionality and reliability they expect and demand. The Technical Support Agent provides Customer Care support to a broad range of clients and/or multiple product areas.

***IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU, CONTINUE READING BELOW…….***

**What you will do**

* Communicating clearly, consistently, and professionally with customers and teammates via phone and email
* Meet metric goals in a high volume inbound/outbound call center environment
* Document customer issues, troubleshooting status updates, and resolution summaries.
* Process Move Add Change Delete requests and other billable changes
* Setup call flow as desired by customer and ensure documentation within Case
* Raise awareness to leadership of large-scale impairments as inbound customer engagement may dictate.
* Follow up with customers to ensure ongoing high levels of satisfaction and meeting SLOs.
* Follow processes as outlined in IKBs
* Follow all guidelines and procedures as outlined in the Call Center environment
* Understand complex call flows for customers
* Handle a variety of issues dealing with various platforms, operating systems, applications, inbound / outbound calling, caller ID, calling features, etc.

**What you will bring**

* Basic experience with SIP, TCP/IP and similar multimedia technologies and protocols.
* Basic knowledge and experience with network troubleshooting including LAN/WAN, Routers, Switches, TCP/IP.
* Basic understanding of the telecommunications service provider and SaaS industry sectors.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills
* Work effectively in a team environment, as well as independently. Be accountable to deliverables and timelines.
* Learn quickly in a dynamic environment
* Excellent communication skills, including writing, speaking, and listening.
* Strong analytical, problem solving and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to:
* Multitask, work under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
* Quickly respond to customer inquiries, requests and issues.
* Communicate technical, process, and business information in language easily understood by diverse audiences.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, diagnose and resolve technical issues related to the suite.
* Demonstrate ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities in a dynamic troubleshooting environment.

**Preferred but not required for application**

* 1-3 years of experience troubleshooting within an IP environment, including VoIP
* Prior experience (1+ years) in progressive skill development technical support roles.

title: Technical Support Analyst (NAM Shift)
description:
**About Kinaxis**
Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high-trust and high-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® CertifiedTM. Our state-of-the-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
  
  
****Location****
Chennai, India
  
  
**About The Team**
The Customer Support team focuses on the post-sales support to Kinaxis’ customers, serving as their initial point of contact to resolve their technical challenges and gaps. The team strives for outstanding customer satisfaction through interactions, timeliness and quality of resolution for which each member of the team plays an integral part in achieving this success.
  
  
The Technical Support Analyst will provide responsive technical support to our customers, on a global basis in a 24/7 environment, with a focus on resolving customer issues and ensuring their ongoing success with Maestro.
  
  
This role to be based out of our Chennai GCC, supporting North American customers on a night Shift schedule (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Standard Time). This is a hybrid, office-based role and represents a critical pillar of Kinaxis’ strategy to extend 24x7 global support coverage across NAM and EMEA time zones from India.
  
  
****What you will do****

* Investigate, research and resolve issues in a timely fashion while maintaining communication with customers on status, roadblocks and timelines.
* Respond to customers’ queries by determining nature and likely causes of issues, recommend corrective actions or guide customers through resolution.
* Follow up with customers ensuring recommendations and steps taken continue to fit customer expectations, recommend further action where necessary.
* Assume role of Triage, as scheduled, to review newly acquired cases ensuring all key documentation / information is included, assigning cases to appropriate agents based on team matrix and updating case statuses as required.
* Determine potential root causes for reported customer issues, going beyond the presented issue to identify true issues, challenges and recommend appropriate solutions to mitigate future impacts
* Respond to monitoring alerts from customer environments
* Perform daily application administration functions for on-demand hosted customers and on premise remote-administration customers
* Handle all assigned cases within specified SLA response times
* Create knowledge base articles related to a particular affinity
* Liaise and coordinate with other departments to respond to and resolve urgent, critical and/or complex issues and inquires
* Participate in on-call duty rotation and after hours environment maintenance

****What we are looking for****

* Minimum 2 years of experience in a technical support role, supporting external customers on a software solution, ideally in a SaaS environment
* At least 1 year of experience supporting Kinaxis Maestro, with relevant Kinaxis RapidResponse / Maestro certifications
* Experience in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) support, with a focus on supply chain applications, is ideal
* Knowledge of relevant case tracking applications
* Solid working knowledge of Windows environments, ERP business software, and experience with web-based applications
* Strong research skills
* Working knowledge of relational databases and query writing is considered an asset
* Experience in manufacturing, production planning, inventory management, or demand management in a support or planning role is a strong asset
* Successful candidate must be able to fulfill all security and confidentiality thresholds for this position (SOC2, CGRP, etc.)

**#Associate**
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P&G, Lockheed-Martin, and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
  
  
Kinaxis strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply to our welcoming community. We strive to make our website and application process accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com . This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

title: Meta ads
description:
**Company Description**
The Wave Visual is a creative marketing agency focused on helping brands grow through visually compelling and performance-driven digital campaigns. Based in Chennai, the team combines strategic thinking, data-driven experimentation, and strong design sensibilities to deliver measurable results for clients across industries. The agency specializes in social media advertising and content that connects with audiences and drives conversion. Team members are encouraged to bring fresh ideas, collaborate across disciplines, and continuously improve their craft in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time Meta Ads Specialist role with a hybrid work arrangement, based in Chennai, with some work-from-home flexibility. The role involves planning, creating, and managing Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad campaigns to achieve client performance goals such as lead generation, sales, and brand awareness. Day-to-day tasks include audience research, campaign setup, budget allocation, and continuous optimization of targeting, creatives, and bidding strategies. The specialist will monitor performance metrics, prepare reports, and translate data into actionable recommendations. Collaboration with designers, copywriters, and account managers to develop ad creatives and landing page strategies is also a core part of the role.

**Qualifications**

* Experience managing Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad campaigns, including campaign setup, audience targeting, and budget optimization.
* Strong skills in performance analysis using Ads Manager and other analytics tools, with the ability to interpret data and improve ROAS and conversion rates.
* Knowledge of digital marketing fundamentals, including funnels, attribution, remarketing, and A/B testing.
* Ability to collaborate on creative strategy, providing input on ad copy, visual assets, and landing page alignment.
* Solid organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup from Chennai, with reliable internet connectivity for remote work.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory; relevant experience in paid social advertising is highly valued.
* Prior experience in an agency environment and familiarity with other paid channels (e.g., Google Ads) is an advantage.

title: Co-Founder
description:
**Company Description**
Monkey Mind Media is a boutique media and digital creative studio powered by a close-knit team of five storytellers, designers, and digital strategists. The company focuses on crafting compelling content and campaigns that help distinctive brands stand out in a crowded digital environment. With capabilities in video production, content creation, digital marketing, and brand strategy, Monkey Mind Media delivers work that combines creativity with measurable impact. The team values experimentation, diverse perspectives, and collaborative problem-solving as core drivers of its culture. Applicants will join an agile environment that is focused on building resonant narratives and visually engaging media for a range of clients.

The Co-Founder will play a hands-on leadership role in shaping the strategic direction, operations, and growth of Monkey Mind Media. This full-time position is on-site in the Greater Chennai Area and involves working closely with the existing team to refine the company vision, develop new service offerings, and build long-term client relationships. title: AI Content Marketer
description: About CultureMonkeyCultureMonkey is building HR tech for companies that take people seriously.We help organisations listen to their people better through employee engagement surveys, lifecycle surveys, pulse surveys, action planning, and people analytics. But the real thing we are building is not just software...We are helping companies build workplaces where people feel heard, understood, and valued.We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company working with mid-market and enterprise customers across geographies. Over a million employees in 150+ countries trust us with something important: the honest voice of how they feel at work.And the way people find us is changing fast. They do not just Google us anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. That shift is exactly where this role comes in.About the RoleWe are looking for an AI Content Marketer who can make CultureMonkey the answer... on Google, and inside every AI engine people now ask first.This role sits right between content, SEO, product, and distribution.You will write content that HR leaders actually finish. You will make sure it ranks, gets cited, and keeps earning attention long after you hit publish.This is not a "write a blog and move on" role.This is a role about being remembered.You will own how a fast-growing brand gets found, read, and trusted in a search world that AI is rewriting in real time.What You Will DoWrite content people actually finish. Blogs, case studies, and playbooks that are clear, human, and genuinely useful.Write for the answer, not just the algorithm. Content built to rank on Google and get cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.Use AI as a real part of your workflow, for research, drafting, and scaling, then edit hard so every piece stays accurate, original, and human.Run keyword and prompt research in Ahrefs and Search Console to publish content that ranks and holds its place.Refresh and re-optimize existing content so top pages keep their rankings as search intent and SERPs shift. Content decay is where organic traffic quietly leaks.Build domain authority through internal linking and structured outreach: guest posts, backlinks, and partnerships.Distribute with intent across newsletters, LinkedIn, Reddit, and product communities. Right message, right channel, right timing.Partner across teams on landing pages, sales and marketing emails, and ad copy, all research-backed.Track what matters, from CTR and organic traffic to keyword rankings and visibility in AI answers, and let the data shape the next draft.Most importantly... do not just write content that fills a calendar. Write the content that people, and AI, actually trust.What We Are Looking For1 to 2 years in content marketing, content writing, SEO, or a similar role where your writing had to perform, not just publish.Someone who writes clearly because they think clearly. Practical, useful, no filler.Someone who treats SEO and AI search as strategy, not jargon.Someone who uses AI fluently but never blindly. You can tell a sharp draft from generic filler, and you fix the difference.Comfort with data. Rankings, CTR, and traffic should tell you what to write next, not intimidate you.Strong follow-through. You track open items, hit publish dates, and keep multiple pieces moving without being chased.A curious, proactive streak. You would rather test an idea than wait for permission.Someone who takes feedback without ego and turns it into sharper work.Bonus points if you have played with keyword tools, AI writing tools, or have a portfolio you are proud to show.You Will Love This Role IfYou like writing that actually gets read, not just filed away.You enjoy turning a messy topic into a clean, useful piece.You get a quiet thrill from watching a page climb the rankings.You want to crack how to get cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity, not just Google.You like data pointing you to your next move.You want your work to have visible impact quickly.You enjoy working with people who move fast, care deeply, and still know how to have fun.Why Join CultureMonkeyYou will work on content that genuinely matters to the people reading it.You will help companies listen to their employees better, not just push another dashboard.You will join a content practice that is still being shaped, so your ideas on process, tooling, and how we win AI search will actually matter.You will work directly with a fast-moving team that values sharp thinking, ownership, and honesty over hierarchy.You will be part of a team that believes people grow when they are trusted, heard, and given room to contribute.We practice what we build for customers: people-first experiences, high ownership, empathy, flexible work, learning, fun, and a real sense of belonging.Things move fast here. Decisions happen in days, not quarters. Good ideas travel quickly. And when you do good work, you will see its impact almost immediately.The Kind of Person We Are Hoping To MeetSomeone who is curious about how AI is changing search, and wants to be early to it.Someone who can turn a blank page into something people actually want to read.Someone who cares about the reader on the other side of the screen, not just the keyword.Someone who wants to build a content engine, not just hit publish.Someone who believes great content is not about volume, it is about being the answer people trust.If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

NOC Analyst

* Experience monitoring Windows and Linux server environments.
* Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as: SolarWinds/PRTG/Logic Monitor

* Understanding of cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, ConnectWise, or Jira.
* Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment

title: Design Manager - Water/Wastewater Treatment
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution.
* Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems.
* Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs.
* Provide leadership in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) models—ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations.
* Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.
* Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables.
* Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‑consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated.
* Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments.
* Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* GIS ArcGIS Pro / QGIS
* Treatment Modelling (exposure advantageous) RO/ion balance tools, process simulators
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
* Strong client‑facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident.
* Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement.
* Drives integrated, high‑quality design solutions across disciplines.
* Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly.
* Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

**Work Experience**

* 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‑Build environment.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities.
* Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents.
* Strong experience in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation.
* Experience leading design delivery in BIM‑enabled environments.
* Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‑driven workflows, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills.
* Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management.
* Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation.
* Ability to develop Level‑of‑Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans.
* Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing.
* Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design–Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination).
* Exposure to complex staging, commissioning planning, or brownfield facility expansions.
* Experience or understanding of PFAS treatment technologies (e.g., GAC, IX, RO) is an added advantage.
* Awareness of sustainability, circularity, and low‑carbon treatment solutions.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Principal Robotics Engineer
description:
**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates United States solar, battery storage and EV projects by providing turnkey development as a service including 100% internal systems engineering. The company deploys a leading team that spun out of the largest solar power producer in the world. This team operates within a sophisticated suite of software to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

**Location of Position:**

Chennai

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

As a Drone and Robotics Engineer at CIR, you will develop and deploy automated solutions for inspecting and monitoring solar assets. You'll work with cross-functional teams to define use cases, integrate sensors and flight control systems (ROS/PX4/ArduPilot), and ensure safe, regulation-compliant drone operations. Your role includes analyzing imagery using AI/ML, maintaining robotic systems, and driving innovation through continuous testing and technology upgrades.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Define automation use cases and requirements:**
  Work with the automation and solar O&M teams to understand inspection and monitoring needs, translate them into robotics/drone system requirements and propose technical solutions.
* **Integrate hardware and software:**
  Develop flight control software and integrate GPS, LiDAR, thermal cameras and other sensors. Use ROS/PX4/ArduPilot frameworks to ensure reliable navigation and data capture.
* **Plan and execute inspections:**
  Plan flight paths and robotic missions for thermal imaging and visual inspections of panels, trackers and other infrastructure while complying with DGCA/UAS 2.0 regulations. Conduct preflight checks and ensure operational safety.
* **Process and analyze data:**
  High-Fidelity 3D Photogrammetry, Precision Point Cloud Generation, and Geometric Feature Extraction to process high-resolution and thermal imagery for hotspot detection, shading analysis and fault identification. Present results to stakeholders and integrate findings into maintenance workflows.
* **Testing and quality assurance:**
  Conduct laboratory and field tests to verify performance, identify mechanical/software issues and optimize system reliability before deployment.
* **Maintenance & troubleshooting:**
  Perform regular diagnostics, firmware updates and repairs on drones and robots. Establish maintenance schedules and keep detailed logs.
* **Compliance & documentation:**
  Ensure systems meet DGCA/FAA regulations and obtain necessary certifications. Produce documentation, standard operating procedures and training material for end-users.
* **Innovation & research:**
  Stay current with advancements in robotics, UAVs and AI; evaluate new sensors and technologies; and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and prototypes.
* **Collaboration and training:**
  Collaborate with software developers, GIS analysts and solar engineers; provide training to field technicians on robotic and drone operation; and communicate technical information clearly to nontechnical team members.

**Education Requirements**

Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

**Software Proficiency:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar.
* 5+ years’ experience designing, building and testing drones or robots—preferably for infrastructure inspection .
* Experience in extracting geometric features from point clouds, such as roof pitch, façade dimensions, and calculating structural thickness from derived models."
* Expert-level proficiency in Photogrammetry and Point Cloud Processing: Deep, hands-on experience with commercial (e.g., Pix4D, Agisoft Metashape) or open-source photogrammetry software and libraries.
* Knowledge of AI/ML techniques for image and thermal data analysis.
* Proficiency in ROS/PX4/ArduPilot and sensor integration (RGB, GPS, IMUs, LiDAR)
* Understanding of UAS regulations and safety protocols (DGCA regulations in India, FAA Part 107 elsewhere).
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving; excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal skills while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Conditions**

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.
