title: C&P Hardware Design Engineer - HVDC Service
description:
**The Opportunity**
As a C&P Hardware Design Engineer for HVDC Service at Hitachi, Ltd., you will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of control and protection hardware systems for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission projects. This role involves ensuring the reliability, performance, and safety of critical electrical infrastructure.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Design, develop, and test control and protection hardware components and systems for HVDC converters, including PCBs, power supplies, I/O modules, and communication interfaces.
* Prepare detailed technical specifications, block diagrams, schematics, BOMs, and design documentation in accordance with industry standards and internal procedures.
* Conduct hardware simulations, analyses, and verification tests to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with project requirements.
* Collaborate with software engineers, system engineers, and project managers to integrate hardware and software components into a complete HVDC control system.
* Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and commissioning activities for HVDC projects.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware-related issues during design, testing, and operational phases.
* Participate in design reviews and provide technical expertise to improve existing designs and develop innovative solutions.
* Stay updated with the latest industry trends, technologies, and standards in HVDC control and protection.
* Ensure adherence to safety regulations and quality management systems throughout the design and development lifecycle.

**Your Background**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
* You should have 7 to 12 years of experience in hardware design and development, specifically with control and protection systems for power electronics or HVDC applications.
* Strong understanding of analog and digital circuit design principles, microcontrollers, FPGAs, and communication protocols (e.g., Ethernet, Modbus, IEC 61850).
* Proficiency with PCB design tools (e.g., Altium Designer, OrCAD, PADS) and simulation software (e.g., SPICE, MATLAB/Simulink).
* Experience with testing and debugging hardware, including the use of oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other test equipment.
* Knowledge of power system protection principles and relevant international standards (e.g., IEC, IEEE).
* Ability to read and interpret complex technical drawings and specifications.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

**Resource Person - Urban Initiatives (Chennai)**

**Eligibility Criteria:**

1. Must have 5-8 years of experience working in a civil society organization in a programme role at the ward/zone/field level.

2. Prior experience in using MIS systems.

3. Familiarity with basic budgeting and reading of utilization reports is desirable (this is not a grant-management or finance-expert role).

4. Language proficiency - Tamil and English mandatory.

5. Owns a two-wheeler and is willing to travel extensively within the city every day.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

The Resource Person is responsible for ensuring that the planned programme interventions are implemented well on the ground in the allotted geography. The Resource Person partners with field staff and coordinators to oversee the implementation of interventions, ensuring alignment with programme design and desired outcomes.

Although the primary responsibilities remain same, the Resource Person must continuously adapt to new programme components added from time to time.

The current interventions include welfare rights and entitlement facilitation, elderly care, running creches, community-based rehabilitation for persons with disability, work with specific communities and addressing drinking water and sanitation needs. These are largely implemented in the settlements, with some needs addressed at the city level as well.

**Programme Implementation & Ground Engagement**

* Understand clearly how each planned intervention is to be carried out and make sure it is implemented on the ground as designed.
* Spend good quality time in the field with the partner field staff and coordinators across the allotted geography, staying close to the programme on the ground.
* Understand the concepts behind each intervention and the vulnerabilities being addressed and work out practical ways to achieve the intended objectives.

title: Manager Programs – Chennai
description:
**Manager Programs – Chennai**

**About the role**

The Foundation works in Chennai with families living in the settlements of the city. The work is carried out through implementing partner organisations and through grant making. The current interventions include welfare rights and entitlement facilitation, elderly care, running creches, community-based rehabilitation for persons with disability, work with specific communities, and addressing drinking water and sanitation needs. These are largely implemented in the settlements, with some needs addressed at the city level as well. New components will be added from time to time as the city-level programme grows.

The Manager Programs is responsible for grant making and grant management for the Chennai programme, for managing the partnerships with the implementing organisations, and for supporting the partners and the Foundation’s field team to achieve the programme outcomes. The role also holds the programme’s correspondence, documentation and reporting.

**Responsibilities**

**Grant making and grant management**

* Assess organisations and proposals in the thematic areas of the Chennai programme and make grants in line with the Foundation’s processes.
* Manage the assigned grants: proposals and budgets, payment disbursement, utilisation and progress reports, renewals and closures.
* Review programme quality and implementation against the grant commitments, and take up gaps with the partner.

**Partnership management**

* Hold the relationship with the implementing partner organisations: regular reviews with partner leadership and programme managers, resolving issues, and keeping the partners aligned to the programme design.
* Build relationships with civil society organisations, government departments, and other stakeholders in the city to further the Foundation’s understanding of the local context and to open up collaborations.

**Programme implementation**

* Lead or support the city-level initiatives implemented with partners, so that the programme outcomes are met.
* Guide and review the work of the Foundation’s Resource Persons who are placed with the partner teams on the ground, and help them address gaps in implementation.
* Strengthen ground-level operations: partner systems and processes, team building, capacity building, and changes to programme design where needed.
* Identify unaddressed issues of the community or gaps in implementation and do the needful to address them, including feedback to partners, and layering and deepening of efforts.

**Correspondence, documentation and reporting**

* Handle the programme’s correspondence with partners, with the Foundation’s internal functions (grant operations, finance, HR, legal) and with external stakeholders.
* Prepare programme documents: proposals, concept notes, review notes, guidelines, minutes and records.
* Use the programme MIS for reviews and reporting, and support its adoption across partner teams.
* Update internal leadership on a quarterly basis on progress in the programme, challenges and ground-level changes.

**What we are looking for**

Candidates who have

* A minimum of 10–15 years of experience in the sector, including experience of managing programmes implemented through partner organisations; grant management experience is desirable.
* A good understanding and experience of working on urban-specific issues and vulnerabilities, preferably in Chennai or a similar urban context.
* Substantial knowledge of organisational and project management, and the ability to read budgets, utilisation reports and programme data.
* Good writing and correspondence skills; fluency in Tamil and English is required.
* A high level of self-motivation, initiative and creativity, and the ability to work with minimal supervision and solve problems independently or collaboratively as needed.
* A willingness to travel extensively within the city, and occasionally outside.

* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.
* Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems.

**Education**

* Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

* IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL)
* Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, Virtualization, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications

****Experience & Qualifications****

* 5+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and managing enterprise infrastructure environments in a complex, global environment.
* Strong experience with Dell servers, storage systems including NAS / SAN, Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V and file services.

title: Chief Cloud Infrastructure & Security Officer
description:
Job Description

**Senior Director / Vice President, Cloud Operations & Security Engineering**

**Location:**
Chennai DLF

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
20+ years

**Role Summary**

Talentgigs is seeking an experienced technology leader to own and advance Production Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevSecOps, and Security Engineering.

This leader will bring deep technical judgment and a strong record of leading cloud-native production environments. They will build a capable, accountable organization that protects and operates critical services through reliable engineering, proactive security, automation, continuous monitoring, and disciplined incident management.

The role extends beyond traditional infrastructure management and information security management system (ISMS) compliance. The successful candidate will embed security and reliability in engineering and operational practices, reduce risk before it becomes an incident, and use automation and AI-driven operations to improve service health and response.

**Key Responsibilities**

Production Operations and Reliability

* Own the reliability, availability, performance, and operational readiness of production services.
* Establish clear service ownership, operational accountability, escalation paths, and on-call practices.
* Lead incident response, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on corrective actions.
* Define and improve service-level objectives, service-level indicators, error budgets, and operational health measures.
* Strengthen change, release, capacity, resilience, backup, and disaster-recovery practices.
* Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil through engineering-led improvements.

**Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering**

* Set the direction for secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-aware cloud infrastructure.
* Lead the design and operation of cloud-native platforms, environments, networks, identity controls, and shared services.
* Promote infrastructure as code, standard platform patterns, self-service capabilities, and repeatable environment provisioning.
* Ensure platform design supports availability, recovery, observability, performance, and secure delivery.
* Guide capacity planning, cloud cost visibility, and optimization without compromising reliability or security.

**SRE and Operational Excellence**

* Build and mature SRE practices that make reliability measurable and part of day-to-day engineering.
* Develop observability across services using actionable metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and service health views.
* Improve deployment safety through progressive delivery, automated checks, rollback readiness, and resilient release practices.
* Use incident trends, operational data, and post-incident reviews to guide prioritized improvements.
* Create a culture of learning and accountability in which incidents lead to durable fixes.

**DevSecOps and Security Engineering**

* Embed security into software delivery, infrastructure management, and operational workflows.
* Lead practical security engineering across identity and access, secrets, configuration, network controls, workload protection, and data safeguards.
* Build automated security checks into build, test, deployment, and infrastructure pipelines.
* Establish continuous monitoring and threat detection with clear triage, escalation, and response ownership.
* Drive vulnerability prevention and remediation through asset visibility, risk-based prioritization, patching, secure configuration, and dependency controls.
* Strengthen cloud security posture and address risks across applications, platforms, identities, and operational processes.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to resolve security issues early and sustainably.
* Ensure audits and ISMS obligations are supported by effective technical controls and evidence, while keeping operational security and risk reduction at the center.

**Automation and AI-Driven Operations**

* Set an automation strategy that reduces manual work, improves consistency, and speeds up safe delivery and recovery.
* Apply AI and advanced analytics to suitable operational use cases, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident triage, capacity forecasting, and knowledge retrieval.
* Establish appropriate safeguards, human oversight, validation, and access controls for AI-supported operational workflows.
* Measure automation outcomes through reduced toil, faster response, fewer repeat incidents, and improved service health.

**Organization and Leadership**

* Build, develop, and retain strong teams across production operations, cloud infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, and security engineering.
* Define organizational structure, role clarity, decision rights, service ownership, and measurable accountability.
* Develop senior technical leaders and create growth paths for engineering and operations talent.
* Work closely with product, application engineering, architecture, risk, and business leaders to align technology priorities with business outcomes.
* Communicate operational risk, service health, security posture, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Lead through technical credibility, sound judgment, collaboration, and consistent follow-through.

Required Technical Qualifications

* 20+ years of progressive experience in technology, infrastructure, production operations, cloud engineering, reliability, or security, including substantial leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership in cloud-native production environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, networking, identity, compute, storage, and platform operations.
* Experience designing and operating containerized and orchestrated workloads, such as Kubernetes or comparable platforms.
* Practical knowledge of infrastructure as code, configuration management, CI/CD, source control, and deployment automation.
* Deep working understanding of SRE principles, observability, service-level objectives, incident management, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Experience implementing security controls in cloud and software delivery environments, including identity management, secrets, vulnerability management, secure configuration, and threat detection.
* Experience establishing continuous monitoring, alerting, incident response, and security operations practices.
* Ability to assess architecture and operational risk, make trade-offs, and guide teams through complex technical decisions.
* Familiarity with cloud cost management and capacity planning in production environments.

**Required Leadership Qualifications**

* Experience leading multiple technical functions and managing managers or senior technical leaders.
* Track record of building technically strong teams with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to stay close to technical decisions while setting direction and enabling teams to execute.
* Proven leadership in major incidents, security events, operational change, or complex service transformations.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and investment priorities to executive and non-technical audiences.
* A practical, engineering-led approach to governance, risk management, and compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust and work across organizational boundaries.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience leading operations and security in a high-scale, high-availability, or business-critical environment.
* Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure and operational models into cloud-native platforms and practices.
* Familiarity with zero-trust principles, security architecture, threat modeling, and secure software supply chains.
* Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, game days, and recovery exercises.
* Experience using AI or machine learning to improve operational monitoring, incident workflows, or engineering productivity.
* Familiarity with security and service-management frameworks or standards relevant to the organization.
* Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or leadership certifications.

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be assessed through sustained improvements in:

* Production service availability, reliability, performance, and recovery readiness.
* Incident frequency, severity, time to detect, time to restore, and recurrence rates.
* Adoption and quality of service-level objectives, observability, and service ownership.
* Vulnerability exposure, remediation timelines, secure configuration, and cloud security posture.
* Security monitoring coverage, alert quality, response readiness, and closure of corrective actions.
* Automation coverage, reduction in manual toil, and safe deployment frequency.
* Resilience, backup, disaster-recovery, and continuity test outcomes.
* Cloud cost visibility and efficiency while meeting reliability and security requirements.
* Team capability, role clarity, leadership depth, and accountability across the functions.
* The ability of engineering teams to adopt secure and reliable practices as part of normal delivery.

****Job Description****
The IT Application Support Analyst role is responsible for the end-to-end investigation and resolution of ERP incidents requiring deeper functional or technical expertise, including root-cause analysis, integration troubleshooting, solution validation, documentation, and effective escalation to Level 3 when required.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability****
**Incident investigation and resolution**

* Analyze ERP incidents escalated from Level 1.
* Identify root causes and provide functional or technical solutions/workarounds.
* Reproduce issues and distinguish between configuration, master data, integration, application, and infrastructure problems.

**Functional support**

* Provide expertise across assigned ERP modules and business processes.
* Troubleshoot transactional errors and incorrect system behavior.
* Assist users with complex process or application-related questions.

**Integration troubleshooting**

* Investigate failures between the ERP and connected applications.
* Analyze interfaces, error messages, batch jobs, queues, and data flows.
* Coordinate resolution with other application/support teams when the problem crosses system boundaries.

**Escalation to Level 3**

* Determine when an issue requires development, product expertise, infrastructure changes, or vendor intervention.
* Provide Level 3 with a complete analysis, including reproduction steps, logs, examples, expected versus actual results, and business impact.
* Validate the solution after Level 3 implementation.

**Problem management and root-cause analysis**

* Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems.
* Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis.
* Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions.

**Change and release support**

* Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates.
* Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate.
* Support deployments and post-deployment verification.

**Monitoring and operational support**

* Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces.
* Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available.
* Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels.

**Ticket and SLA management**

* Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them.
* Prioritize according to severity and business impact.
* Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users.

**Knowledge management**

* Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues.
* Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently.
* Share knowledge with other ERP support team members.

**Business and IT coordination**

* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams.
* Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists.
* Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders.

****CRITICAL CAPABILITIES****

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* ERP Functional Expertise
* Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012).
* Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules.
* Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues.

**Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis**

* Systematic investigation of complex incidents.
* Identify symptom vs. root cause.
* Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history.
* Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable.

**Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding**

* Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications.
* Trace transactions across systems.
* Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it.
* Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems.

**Incident Ownership & Prioritization**

* Take ownership from escalation through resolution.
* Assess business impact, urgency, and priority.
* Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams.
* Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders.

**Technical Analysis**

* Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages.
* Basic understanding of databases and data structures.
* Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate.
* Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams.

****Requirements****

* EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related)
* EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred.
* 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset.

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.
* Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

**Requirements**
**What you’ll Do:**
**Team-building**
- inside the team and across teams - you’ll be proposing new ideas and helping implement them
**Thinking**
- coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work.
**Documenting**
- describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated.
**Optimizing**
- working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster.
**Defining**
- writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules.
**Coding**
- you’ll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and Groovy
**Securing**

* working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
* working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

**Observing**
- adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itself
**Alerting**
- getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening again
**DevOps / DevSecOps**
- We’re not “DevOps” engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company.
**What you will work on**
-
  
  

* IaaS - GCP, AWS
* AI tooling and automation - Claude Code, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, Software Factories
* Platform tools - Kubernetes, terraform, helm, docker
* Language tools - Golang
* Engineering tools - Jenkins, Backstage
* Operations tools - PagerDuty, DataDog

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
* 8+ years working in a DevOps style environment - building automations, writing software, solving problems
* 2+ years working in AWS (preferred) or GCP
* 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)
* Experience of working asynchronously in a distributed team.
* Experience of contributing to your team’s technical strategy
* Strong self organization skills and communication skills

You have experience in:
  
  

* programming in various languages and domains
* Development with agentic AI and administration of tools
* the "modern Ops stack" (e.g. monitoring, alerting, cloud-based provisioning, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Linux systems administration
* cloud-based operations (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
* cluster orchestration and management tools (e.g. k8s / ECS / Terraform / etc)
* continuous integration / continuous delivery tools (Jenkins / Tekton etc)
* modern software engineering practices: code reviews, unit / acceptance testing, source control, etc.
* You have experience using work tools like GSuite, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
* Experience of managing and responding to production incidents

title: Senior Engineer - Security Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Zscaler & Network Security Engineer responsible for administering, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuously improving secure internet access, endpoint connectivity, remote access, and security controls. The role will work closely with security operations, network teams, and senior security stakeholders to maintain a strong security posture while ensuring reliable user connectivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and maintain Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) policies, including:
* SSL inspection
* Application control
* Sandbox policies
* URL filtering
* CASB controls
* Malware exceptions, blocks, and security policies
* Manage and troubleshoot Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) deployments, including installation, connectivity, authentication, policy enforcement, and endpoint-related issues.
* Manage PAC file changes through a controlled, tested, peer-reviewed, and approved deployment process.
* Monitor security alerts and operational dashboards, investigate issues, and resolve day-to-day security incidents within defined SLAs.
* Raise, document, implement, and drive changes through formal Change Control processes, particularly where changes deviate from the approved security baseline.
* Manage and troubleshoot VPN/remote-access solutions, such as Palo Alto GlobalProtect, addressing connectivity, authentication, performance, and user-access issues.
* Use asset inventory and vulnerability-management tools, such as Qualys or similar platforms, to support troubleshooting, asset identification, security investigations, and vulnerability-management activities.
* Review and assess policy, URL, application, and whitelisting requests, escalating higher-risk requests to senior security stakeholders for appropriate risk assessment and approval.
* Apply least-privilege access principles across different user populations, including employees, contractors, privileged users, and executives.
* Support security audits and compliance reviews by collecting, validating, and providing appropriate control evidence and supporting documentation.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Hands-on experience administering Zscaler ZIA and Zscaler Client Connector.
* Strong understanding of web security concepts, including SSL inspection, URL filtering, application control, CASB, sandboxing, and malware protection.
* Experience troubleshooting ZCC, PAC files, proxy connectivity, and endpoint access issues.
* Experience with VPN technologies, preferably Palo Alto GlobalProtect.
* Familiarity with security incident management, alert monitoring, and SLA-driven operations.
* Understanding of Change Management and Change Control processes.
* Experience using Qualys or similar vulnerability/asset-management platforms.
* Strong understanding of least privilege, secure baselines, access control, and security governance.
* Ability to assess security risks and appropriately escalate exceptions or higher-risk requests.
* Strong documentation skills, including writing SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working in an enterprise Security Operations or Network Security environment.
* Palo Alto Networks security technology experience.
* Familiarity with vulnerability-management and security-compliance frameworks.
* Experience supporting internal and external security audits.
* Relevant certifications such as Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Security+, or equivalent.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Security-focused mindset
* Attention to detail and risk awareness
* Effective incident and change management
* Clear written and verbal communication
* Ability to work within defined SLAs and operational processes
* Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills

description:
**Associate Senior Solutions Architect**

**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).

* Own and manage corporate IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, identity and access services, office networks, Wi-Fi, VPN, collaboration platforms, and related technologies.

* Develop and maintain standards for end-user computing, hardware, software, asset lifecycle management, and IT infrastructure.
* Partner with Information Security to ensure secure endpoint management, identity and access controls, patching, vulnerability remediation, and compliance with corporate security policies.
* Drive automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvements to enhance employee experience and operational efficiency.
* Manage IT budgets, procurement, hardware and software vendors, contracts, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Develop and lead a high-performing IT team, including geographically distributed resources and third-party service providers.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

As a leading contributor, this position will perform services design requirement analysis, development of product-specific architectures, lab testing and evaluation, prototype demonstration, and technical documentation across Network Engineering. You will drive best practice development by providing consistent design methodology and modelling for asset management, provisioning standards, fault management analysis, utilization and performance monitoring, and security requirements. In conjunction with design development, this role will interact with SES upstream and downstream teams to define detailed Statement of Work (SOW) documentation. We are looking for a strategic expert that is familiar with the integration of existing and emerging technology trends and can provide advanced technical leadership for continued growth. In collaboration with other senior SME’s, this position will mentor junior team members and assist in the creation of a training environment for the Deployment and Operations teams. In addition, you will provide level 4 services support to the Operations team.

* Provide guidance on all existing and proposed architecture to ensure that the design supports strong performance and that proper monitoring/analytic tools are in place.
* Provide level 4 operational support to the level 1 and 2 NOCs for trouble ticket escalations
* Support the rest of the platform engineering team with hub hardware deployments and assist operations with service activations.
* Ensure that all designs apply consistent methodology with best practices, in order to deliver stable and secure networks.
* Perform engineering calculation related to design that requires the application of standard engineering principles, theories, concepts and techniques.
* Provide SME (Subject Matter Expert) support for service feasibility.
* Create detailed scope requirements for the Statement of Work (SOW) process, ensuring that final documentation is clear and accurate to ensure the greatest work efficiency.
* Collaborate with Project Managers to ensure the success of the design detailed in the SOW, including communication regarding technical scope, schedule, budget, and resource needs.
* Work closely with Finance, Engineering, and other applicable departments to ensure the profitability of all designs.
* Practice and enforce compliance with current operating standards, to best assess effectiveness and process alignment.
* Provide proactive leadership to mentor and coach all team members.
* Enhance training materials and deliver ongoing training to Operations team members.

COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Ability to demonstrate technical leadership focusing on system integrity throughout the system lifecycle
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills, both written, and oral
* Ability to work and deliver within a fast-paced working environment
* Ability to set priorities and work under deadlines
* Good teamwork spirit by working cohesively with the team towards a common goal

**Qualifications & Experience**

* A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar discipline with at least five years of network and/or systems experience (or an equivalent amount of education and work experience).

* Must have Experience in L3 and L4 NOC support

* Must have knowledge of switching technologies including but not limited to; IGMP, 802.XX, Gigabit Ethernet, 10G Ethernet, Vlan/Trunking (802.1q And ISL), Etherchannel, Spanning Tree (STP), EVPN and VXLAN.

Reporting directly to the IT Manager, he will manage, secure, and optimize our enterprise Unix and Windows server environments, core infrastructure, and high-availability ISP communication networks while leading a close-knit team of 5 IT professionals. While reporting to the IT Manager for overall operations and project delivery, he will provide critical functional support to the Information Security Officer (ISO) for ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001) implementation and audits. As an operational leader, he will govern daily service delivery using ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and track asset lifecycles via robust IT Asset Management (ITAM) practices. He will leverage centralized toolsets like OpenText/Micro Focus Network Operations Management (NOM) alongside 2S/5S methodologies to drive systemic reliability, IT cost reduction, and process automation, while proactively developing team skills and conducting structured training.

**About the Role**

Job Summary Reporting directly to the IT Manager, he will manage, secure, and optimize our enterprise Unix and Windows server environments, core infrastructure, and high-availability ISP communication networks while leading a close-knit team of 5 IT professionals. While reporting to the IT Manager for overall operations and project delivery, he will provide critical functional support to the Information Security Officer (ISO) for ISMS (ISO/IEC 27001) implementation and audits. As an operational leader, he will govern daily service delivery using ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and track asset lifecycles via robust IT Asset Management (ITAM) practices. He will leverage centralized toolsets like OpenText/Micro Focus Network Operations Management (NOM) alongside 2S/5S methodologies to drive systemic reliability, IT cost reduction, and process automation, while proactively developing team skills and conducting structured training.

**Responsibilities**

* **Key Responsibilities**
* **1. Operations & Escalation (Reporting to the IT Manager)**
* Keep the IT Manager fully informed of hybrid network health, multi-platform server uptime, security posture, and project milestones through regular structured reporting.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for critical infrastructure incidents, executing rapid remediation and conducting root-cause analyses for the IT Manager's review.
* Align departmental workflows, OS patch schedules, and project timelines with the broader strategic objectives set by the IT Manager.
* **2. Team Leadership & Skill Development**
* Manage, mentor, and direct the 5-person IT infrastructure and technical support team to ensure high operational uptime and prompt service delivery.
* Conduct regular skills gap analyses within the team and design targeted training programs to uplift capabilities in network engineering, hybrid system administration, and security best practices.
* Establish clear Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), conduct performance evaluations, and foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment.
* **3. ITIL/ITSM Operational Governance**
* Establish and mature daily IT service operations based on ITSM / ITIL best practices (Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management).
* Ensure the 5-person team meets or exceeds defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and operational support targets.
* Lead Change Advisory Board (CAB) requests for all infrastructure, network overhauls, and security patches to minimize production disruptions.
* **4. ITAM (IT Asset Management) & Cost Optimization**
* Own the lifecycle management of all hardware, software, and network assets (ITAM), ensuring accurate tracking from procurement to decommissioning.
* Maintain a comprehensive and accurate Configuration Management Database (CMDB) to feed technical state changes directly into operational pipelines.
* Analyze hybrid IT processes and configurations to identify opportunities for cost optimization and waste reduction (re-allocating unused licenses, rightsizing virtual environments, and retiring legacy assets).
* **5. Network Operations Management (NOM) & ISP Networks**
* Administer enterprise multi-vendor routing, switching, and firewall topologies utilizing NOM (Network Operations Management) software suites.
* Leverage NOM to integrate multi-vendor fault detection, performance monitoring, configuration backups, and compliance policy mapping under a centralized dashboard.
* Design, configure, and maintain high-speed ISP communication networks, managing WAN links, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), traffic shaping, and telecom circuit troubleshooting.
* **6. Unix, Windows & Hybrid Systems Administration**
* Administer, configure, and troubleshoot Unix/Linux server environments (e.g., Red Hat, Ubuntu, CentOS, or AIX) handling critical enterprise workloads and network services.
* Build, deploy, and maintain physical and virtual Windows servers (VMware ESXi or Hyper-V), including Active Directory (AD), GPOs, DNS, and DHCP.
* Oversee automated cross-OS patch management, script-based system tracking, and unified data backup / disaster recovery (DR) protocols.
* **7. Digitalisation Support & Process Automation**
* Identify opportunities to digitize, modernize, and automate legacy manual business processes across departments.
* Leverage automation tools and scripting languages (PowerShell for Windows, Bash/Shell scripting for Unix, Power Automate) to streamline routine IT operations and cross-departmental workflows.
* **8. Workplace Organization (2S / 5S for IT Infra)**
* Apply and sustain 2S (Sort, Set in Order) and the broader 5S framework to physical spaces (server rooms, data centers, cable layouts) and digital workspaces (Active Directory structures, Unix file hierarchies, file shares, and decommissioned assets).
* **9. Security Administration & ISMS Support (Functional Alignment with ISO)**
* Configure next-generation firewalls (NGFW), intrusion detection systems (IDS/IPS), and VPNs across the hybrid network.
* Assist the Information Security Officer (ISO) in collecting technical compliance evidence across Windows Event logs, Unix Syslogs, NOM configuration history, and IT

title: Linux Principal Engineer II - ICON

Strong experience with OpenShift and Kubernetes, including cluster management and container orchestration.

title: Infrastructure Engineer (Compute)
description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
  
  
We’re looking for an Infrastructure Engineer (Compute) to design and build core systems that manage containerised and virtualised workloads running on bare-metal and hybrid environments. This role is ideal for engineers who love working close to the kernel, building tools that abstract hardware complexity, and optimising infrastructure for scale and speed.
  
  
Up for the challenge? Let’s get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Designing and maintaining compute layer, focusing Kubernetes on bare metal
* Developing infrastructure-agnostic tooling and APIs to manage hybrid cloud environments at scale
* Ensuring infrastructure reliability through proactive detection/remediation of hardware failures and auto-healing
* Managing hardware lifecycle, from procurement and installation to decommissioning and upgrades
* Collaborating closely with network, security, and DevOps teams to ensure seamless integration between physical infrastructure and public cloud
* Documenting infrastructure processes, configurations, and best practices

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages
* 3+ years of experience managing physical hardware
* Experience with Kubernetes on bare metal and open-source storage solutions (Ceph, MinIO)
* Experience automating infrastructure tasks using Infrastructure-as-Code tools
* Deep knowledge of data center operations, including power distribution, cooling, and rack management
* Familiarity with server hardware and storage systems (Dell, HP, Supermicro)
* Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to hardware failures and performance bottlenecks
* Expertise in one or more object-oriented programming languages (Go, Java, Python)
* An academic background in STEM

**Nice to have**

* Professional certifications (e.g., CCNP, CKA, Google Cloud, Red Hat)
* Experience working in regulated environments (financial services)
* Familiarity with security best practices and compliance frameworks (PCI DSS, SOC2, GDPR)

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

**Job Description for Senior JIRA & Confluence Administrator**

We are seeking an experienced Senior JIRA & Confluence Administrator with 7-10 years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing Atlassian environments across enterprise scale organizations. This role will lead the administration, customization, integration, and governance of JIRA & Confluence to support Agile delivery, ITSM processes, and enterprise collaboration

You will work closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, operations, project management, security, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment between Atlassian tools and organizational goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the entire Atlassian stack including JIRA Software, JIRA Service Management, and Confluence (Cloud Server, or Data Center)
* Lead design and implementation of complex JIRA workflows, permission schemes, customer fields, and automation rules tailored for Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and ITIL processes.
* Design and administer Confluence spaces, templates, access structures, macros, and content strategies to support knowledge management and team collaboration
* Work closely with product owners, delivery managers, and support teams to gather requirements and translate into effective Atlassian solutions
* Drive platform governance, including user access control, audit compliance, plugin evaluations, and license management.
* Lead or contribute to migration initiatives, such as JIRA server to cloud or third-party tool consolidations
* Develop custom integrations using REST APIs. Webhooks and middleware platforms.
* Mentor and guide junior administrators and support users through training, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain system uptime, schedule upgrades/patches, and ensure data integrity and backup policies are followed.
* Act as an SME for JIRA & Confluence best practices, enterprise scaling, and strategic enhancements.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 7-10 years of hands-on experience with Atlassian JIRA and Confluence administration in enterprise environments
* Deep expertise in JIRA configuration, including complex workflow creation, automation, and JQL.
* Strong command of Confluence Space and template design, user management, and governance
* Proven experience working in Agile/DevOps/ITSM frameworks
* Experience with ScriptRunner, Automation for JIRA, Insight, and other Marketplace apps.
* Strong understanding of Atlassian Cloud vs Server/Data Center architectures and migration considerations
* Proficient with REST API Integration, scripting (Groovy, Python, Shell) and log analysis.
* Knowledge of SSO, LDAP/Active Directory integrations, user provisioning, and permission models
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Atlassian Certifications (ACP-610/120/1000) is a plus
* Experience managing large-scale environments with 1000+ users
* Exposure to Atlassian Access, Crowd, and Bitbucket/Bamboo
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline, security compliance and audit controls
* Experience leading tool governance forums or CoE.

title: Advanced Associate, Cloud Services Engineer
description:
**Advanced Associate, Cloud Service Engineer**

  
  

**Location:**
Chennai, India (Hybrid)

  
  

**Team:**
Atlassian Administration & Engineering

  
  

**Experience:**
2+ years in Atlassian administration or a related platform engineering role

  
  

**About the Role**

  
  

We’re looking for an Atlassian engineer with a few years of experience to join our Atlassian Administration & Engineering team. You’ll work with a team of seven engineers who support a global Atlassian Cloud platform used by about 10,000–12,000 people around the world, across Jira, Confluence, Jira Product Discovery (JPD), and Jira Service Management (JSM).

  
  

We recently finished a large migration to Atlassian Cloud, and we’re still bringing separate product instances together into one environment. The migration moved fast and left technical debt behind, so we’re now focused on cleanup: removing legacy customizations and making the platform match Atlassian Cloud best practices. You’ll own parts of that work yourself. That means spotting problems, proposing fixes, and building automation that keeps the platform clean and scalable.

  
  

**What You’ll Do**

  

  
* **Platform administration:**
  Take ownership of administration across Jira, Confluence, JPD, and JSM, including permissions, schemes, workflows, custom fields, and space and project configuration.
  
  
* **User lifecycle automation:**
  Design and maintain automated onboarding and offboarding, group management, and license management, working with identity providers and SCIM provisioning.
  
  
* **Space and project lifecycle:**
  Build repeatable, automated processes to create, standardize, and archive projects and spaces at scale.
  
  
* **Reduce legacy customizations:**
  Audit the environment for redundant custom fields, workflows, schemes, and app dependencies. Then propose and carry out plans to remove or consolidate them, using automation wherever possible.
  
  
* **Automation engineering:**
  Build and maintain Atlassian Automation rules for routine and bulk administrative work. Where built-in features fall short, design robust API-driven automation.
  
  
* **Engineering practices:**
  Treat platform automation as production code. Changes are peer-reviewed, tested, and released through a pipeline, not run ad hoc.
  
  
* **AI-assisted engineering:**
  Make AI part of your everyday workflow, from drafting scripts and analyzing configurations to writing documentation, so you deliver more without lowering the quality bar.
  
  
* **Service metrics and observability:**
  Capture service metrics through the Atlassian APIs, store them outside the platform, and build dashboards that show how the service is used and how it’s performing.
  
  
* **Solution evaluation:**
  Weigh built-in Atlassian features against custom or external solutions, and explain clearly why the chosen option is the best fit.
  
  
* **Continuous improvement:**
  Challenge processes that are overly complex, costly, or full of manual toil, and propose simpler, automated alternatives.
  
  
* **Best practices and governance:**
  Help define standards, naming conventions, and configuration guidelines for each product, and document them.
  
  
* **Instance consolidation:**
  Contribute to ongoing migration and consolidation work, including planning, data validation, and post-migration cleanup.
  
  
* **Escalations and mentoring:**
  Resolve complex platform issues, and share knowledge with less experienced teammates and stakeholders.
  

  

**What We’re Looking For**

  
  

**Required:**

  

  
* 2+ years of hands-on administration of Jira and/or Confluence, preferably in Atlassian Cloud
  
  
* Working experience with Atlassian Automation, including building and troubleshooting rules
  
  
* Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or a similar language, and experience building automation against REST APIs (including JSON, authentication, pagination, and rate limits)
  
  
* Hands-on experience with Git and version-controlled code or configuration, plus a working understanding of CI/CD practices: build, test, release, versioning, and branching strategies
  
  
* Daily, effective use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude, with the judgment to validate, refine, or reject what they produce
  
  
* A solid understanding of Jira configuration: schemes, workflows, screens, fields, and permissions
  
  
* Experience managing users and groups at scale in Atlassian Admin
  
  
* The ability to analyze an existing configuration, recommend simplifications, and explain the trade-offs clearly
  
  
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with stakeholders around the world
  
  
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  

  

**Nice to have:**

  

  
* Atlassian certifications (ACP-120, ACP-620, or Cloud Organization Admin)
  
  
* Experience with AWS services (such as Timestream, Lambda, or S3) and with dashboards in Grafana or similar tools
  
  
* Experience administering JSM (request types, queues, SLAs, portals) or JPD
  
  
* Experience with identity integration such as Okta, Azure AD/Entra ID, SAML SSO, or SCIM
  
  
* Migration experience with JCMA/CCMA or instance merges
  
  
* Experience with ScriptRunner or other marketplace apps, and with assessing app usage
  

  

**What You’ll Gain**

  

  
* Ownership of meaningful parts of a large, enterprise-scale Atlassian Cloud platform
  
  
* Real influence over how a global platform is standardized and modernized
  
  
* A clear growth path to Specialist and Advanced Specialist roles on the Atlassian Platform Engineering team
  
  
* Support for Atlassian certifications and ongoing learning

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
**Role: Mechanical Design Engineer**

We are looking for a passionate and hands-on Mechanical Design Engineer to join our R&D team. This role offers an opportunity to work on the development of innovative mechanical systems and precision engineering products, taking designs from initial concepts through prototyping, testing, and refinement.

The ideal candidate enjoys both designing in CAD and working hands-on with physical components. The role involves developing and iterating design concepts, fabricating prototypes using our in-house 3D printing facility or external manufacturing vendors, and performing practical workshop activities such as drilling, rework, fitting, and assembly. We are looking for someone who can translate design ideas into functional prototypes, identify practical engineering challenges, and improve designs through hands-on experimentation.

**What you'll do:**

* Translate functional requirements into practical, manufacturable mechanical designs.
* Develop and iterate design concepts using CAD tools, incorporating feedback from prototype evaluation and testing.
* Fabricate prototypes using in-house 3D printing facilities and coordinate with external vendors for components requiring other manufacturing processes.
* Perform hands-on prototyping activities, including drilling, tapping, cutting, fitting, rework, and mechanical assembly.
* Troubleshoot mechanical and assembly issues and implement design improvements based on practical observations.
* Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to integrate mechanical components with electrical, optical, and other subsystems.
* Prepare engineering drawings, GD&T, bills of materials (BOMs), and manufacturing documentation.
* Support prototype testing, design verification, and continuous improvement of mechanical assemblies.

**What we are looking for:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field. Recent graduates and early-career engineers are encouraged to apply.
* Strong fundamentals in mechanical design, engineering drawing, materials, and manufacturing processes.
* Proficiency in at least one CAD platform, such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Creo, CATIA, or NX.
* **A strong hands-on approach to engineering**

  , with the willingness and ability to personally fabricate, modify, rework, and assemble prototypes.
* Practical understanding of manufacturing processes, including 3D printing, machining, drilling, tapping, and fastening methods.
* Ability to identify design and manufacturing issues during prototyping and translate them into improved CAD designs.
* A practical problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in an R&D environment.
* Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external manufacturing vendors.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with FDM, SLA, or other 3D printing technologies.
* Experience developing precision mechanical components, enclosures, fixtures, or electromechanical assemblies.
* Familiarity with GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, and DFM/DFA principles.
* Exposure to structural or thermal simulation tools such as ANSYS, COMSOL, or Abaqus.
* Experience working on research prototypes, robotics, medical devices, or multidisciplinary engineering projects.

**Why join us:**

* Work on technically challenging engineering problems in a research and development environment.
* Gain exposure to multidisciplinary projects involving mechanical design, prototyping, and system integration.
* Take ownership of the complete development cycle, from concept development and CAD design to fabrication, assembly, testing, and refinement.
* Work with modern prototyping facilities and external manufacturing partners to turn design concepts into functional products.

**What matters most:**

 We are looking for someone who enjoys building things as much as designing them. The ideal candidate should be comfortable moving between CAD and the workshop, personally carrying out prototype modifications and assembly, and iterating on designs until they work as intended. Immediate joiners are encouraged to apply as well.
