title: Product Test Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior product test consultant specializing in Facets claims and benefit configuration for healthcare payer and provider solutions in a hybrid work model. Apply deep hands on experience to validate complex configurations optimize claims processing accuracy and ensure system reliability and compliance. Collaborate closely with cross functional teams to deliver robust high quality Facets implementations that improve member and provider experiences while supporting enterprise scale o
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive comprehensive test strategy planning for Facets modules focused on claims adjudication and benefit configuration to ensure end to end coverage across core healthcare payer and provider use cases.
* Design detailed test scenarios and data sets for Facets claims processing including complex benefit rules and provider contract variations to validate accurate outcomes in high volume production environments.
* Execute functional and integration testing on Facets claims workflows to verify proper configuration of benefits accumulators pricing logic and provider networks while minimizing defects reaching production.
* Analyze Facets configuration tables and rule sets to identify potential gaps or conflicts in benefit designs and claims edits and propose corrective changes that improve operational efficiency.
* Collaborate with business analysts configuration teams and operations stakeholders to translate payer and provider business requirements into testable Facets scenarios that reflect real world claim patterns.
* Perform root cause analysis on defects identified in Facets claims and benefit configuration and document findings in clear test artifacts that enable targeted remediation and future prevention.
* Validate interoperability between Facets and downstream systems such as financial reporting data warehouses and provider portals to ensure claims and benefit data integrity across the ecosystem.
* Apply healthcare payer and provider domain expertise to evaluate the impact of new benefit designs regulatory mandates and product changes on Facets test coverage and regression suites.
* Create and maintain reusable test assets including regression packs test data libraries and execution checklists tailored to Facets claims and benefits modules to support continuous delivery.
* Coordinate test execution in a hybrid work environment ensuring effective communication of progress risks and dependencies across onsite and remote stakeholders during day shift operations.
* Provide mentoring and guidance to peers and junior testers on Facets configuration concepts claims adjudication flows and best practices for healthcare product testing while promoting quality ownership.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by assessing test process performance proposing optimization opportunities and supporting adoption of automation where feasible in Facets testing.
* Document clear and concise test results and business impact summaries highlighting improvements in claim accuracy benefit interpretation and provider satisfaction driven by high quality configuration validation.

**Qualifications**

* Leverage extensive experience of nine to twelve years in product testing with a strong focus on healthcare payer and provider domains to interpret complex requirements and design robust Facets test approaches.
* Apply expert proficiency in Facets claims functionality to validate claim adjudication business rules pricing logic and edits ensuring alignment with contractual and regulatory expectations.
* Utilize advanced knowledge of Facets benefit configuration including benefit plans accumulators and eligibility constructs to verify that configured products support diverse member coverage scenarios.
* Demonstrate hands on experience across broader Facets platform capabilities such as membership billing and provider data to ensure holistic validation of integrated health plan operations.
* Use deep domain knowledge in provider networks reimbursement models and contract structures to assess how Facets configurations impact provider claim outcomes and operational workflows.
* Employ strong understanding of payer business processes including enrollment benefits administration and claims lifecycle management to design tests that reflect real health plan operations.
* Apply familiarity with hybrid work practices and day shift collaboration models to maintain effective stakeholder engagement clear communication and consistent delivery of test commitments.

\* Review and verify test and commissioning reports for electrical systems (e.g., switchgear, transformers, protection relays, cables, motors, earthing, LV/MV/HV installations).

\* Recommend corrective actions, retesting requirements and next steps, and follow up until issues are closed.

\* Join client meetings, handover sessions and site visits to support commissioning sign-off and answer technical queries.

\* Work with test engineers and technicians to ensure reports are accurate, complete and consistent before release.

\* Prepare summary reports, technical clarifications and response letters to client comments.

\* Support quality, safety and compliance requirements, and contribute to improving report formats and procedures.

\* Mentor junior engineers on report review and client communication.

**Required Qualifications**

title: Infrastructure Senior Tech Analyst -Assistant Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
Infrastructure Technology Lead Analyst (Red Hat Linux, GRID Infrastructure L3 Support Engineer)
  
  
The Infrastructure Technology Lead Analyst is an intermediate-level technical role responsible for providing Level 3 support, engineering, remediation, and operational excellence across the Unified Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) estate consisting of more than 100,000+ servers. The role requires deep expertise in Linux administration, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, security hardening, automation, and configuration management. The overall objective is to leverage advanced infrastructure technology knowledge, operational policies, and engineering best practices to maintain platform stability, security, compliance, and service availability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 3 technical support for complex Red Hat Enterprise Linux, GRID infrastructure server incidents, escalations, and critical production outages across a large-scale enterprise environment.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of high-impact operating system, kernel, performance, storage, networking, and server infrastructure issues to restore services within agreed SLAs.
* Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) following service restoration and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Design and implement server security hardening standards in accordance with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Manage vulnerability remediation activities, security patching, operating system lifecycle management, and compliance controls across the Red Hat server estate.
* Administer and troubleshoot infrastructure agents including monitoring, security, backup, automation, compliance, and endpoint management agents deployed across Linux servers.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize Ansible playbooks for server provisioning, configuration management, patching, security remediation, and operational automation.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks and develop engineering solutions to improve platform stability, efficiency, and operational resilience.
* Review infrastructure requirements, define operating system standards, and update operational processes, procedures, and technical documentation as required.
* Conduct proactive system health reviews, capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational risk assessments.
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic guidance to team members and operational support teams.
* Collaborate with security, application, middleware, storage, network, and infrastructure teams to resolve cross-functional technical challenges.
* Support operating system upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity initiatives.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory requirements, corporate governance standards, and security frameworks.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Red Hat Enterprise Linux platforms and associated technologies when engaging with senior stakeholders, engineering teams, and project groups.
* Operate independently with minimal supervision while demonstrating strong ownership, sound judgment, and decision-making capabilities.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations; adhering to policy; applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices; and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration, GRID infrastructure and troubleshooting.
* Advanced knowledge of Linux kernel, system performance tuning, networking, storage, LVM, multipathing, clustering, and filesystem management.
* Experience in enterprise server security hardening, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with Ansible automation and playbook development.
* Experience with Chef configuration management and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Knowledge of monitoring, backup, security, and compliance agents deployed in enterprise Linux environments.
* Experience supporting mission-critical production environments at large scale.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, incident management, and root cause analysis skills.
* Familiarity with virtualization, cloud technologies, and DevOps practices is advantageous.

**Education:**

* 6-8 years of experience in relevant technologies.
* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

title: TechOps Engineer
description: Role Summary:We are seeking a Technical Operations Engineer to support the Staples Promotional Products application portfolio. The engineer will not own release governance, release scheduling, release communications, or DevOps management responsibilities; those responsibilities remain with the DevOps Manager.Duties & monitoring, and environment tasks that can be automated through scripts, workflow tooling, dashboards, checklists, or standard operating procedures.• Develop working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS workflows, GitHub repositories, deployment pipelines, and release automation processes to provide backup coverage and operational continuity when primary DevOps resources are unavailable.• related field.• Hands-on experience supporting application health, operational monitoring, incident investigation, technical triage, and production or lower-environment troubleshooting.• Experience with monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, and production troubleshooting using New Relic or similar observability tools.• Ability to review alerts, failed jobs, integrations, error trends, and operational signals to identify issues and summarize follow-up actions.• Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts, release automation, deployment validation, source control management, and software delivery lifecycle practices.• Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS, GitHub, or similar software delivery and deployment platforms.• Ability to investigate application issues by analyzing logs, traces, metrics, failed jobs, application behavior, database indicators, and service dependencies.• Scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Shell, SQL, YAML, Power Automate, or similar technologies.• Experience creating technical documentation, operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, investigation summaries, dashboard documentation, deployment validation notes, health-check procedures, and support handoff notes.• Problem-solving skills with the ability to address monitoring, application support, deployment validation, environment, operational readiness, and recurring issue patterns.• Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical findings to cross-functional stakeholders.• Ability to work independently, manage technical tasks across time zones, produce clear handoff documentation, and collaborate with GCC and CST-based teams.Preferred Qualifications• Experience with New Relic dashboard creation, alert tuning, service health reporting, recurring error trend analysis, post-deployment health checks, or production-readiness reporting.• Experience supporting release validation, deployment monitoring, post-deployment verification, pipeline monitoring, or production readiness activities.• Experience with Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS, GitHub, Windows/IIS application hosting, SQL troubleshooting, enterprise application support, or similar operational environments.• Experience building or improving a daily operations review model, system health scorecard, operational checklist, or proactive monitoring process.• Exposure to DevSecOps or security operations support including certificate monitoring, vulnerability remediation tracking, dependency review, configuration risk tracking, or security scan follow-up.• Experience supporting business-facing applications, incident evidence collection, application reproduction support, or collaboration with QA/manual testing description:

At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
  
  
**The Role**

* Design, configure, implement, test, and support enterprise routing, switching, software-defined networking, and network security solutions
* Participate in customer discovery sessions and technical workshops to document requirements, dependencies, constraints, and success criteria
* Develop and maintain technical designs, implementation procedures, migration plans, test plans, rollback procedures, and as-built documentation
* Build and support resilient networks across campus, data center, lab, branch, cloud-connected, and hybrid environments
* Configure and troubleshoot routing protocols, VLANs, network segmentation, redundancy, high availability, quality of service, and common network services
* Implement and support software-defined networking and network virtualization solutions under established architecture and design standards
* Configure and support network security controls, including firewalls, secure remote access, segmentation, access policies, and secure connectivity between environments
* Perform advanced troubleshooting, collect and analyze diagnostic information, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with internal teams and vendors
* Plan and execute approved lifecycle activities, including software upgrades, firmware upgrades, hardware refreshes, configuration updates, and post-change validation

* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through technical guidance, peer reviews, troubleshooting support, lab exercises, and knowledge-sharing sessions

**Technology/Area Of Specialization**

* Strong knowledge of enterprise routing and switching, including dynamic routing protocols, Layer 2 and Layer 3 design, redundancy, segmentation, quality of service, and network services
* Working knowledge of software-defined networking, policy-based networking, network virtualization, automation, and centralized management platforms
* Practical knowledge of network security technologies, including firewalls, VPNs, secure access, segmentation, access control, policy enforcement, and security monitoring integrations
* Familiarity with network automation, APIs, configuration management, telemetry, monitoring, and operational analytics

description: Job DescriptionThe Technical Consultant - ERP is responsible for the analysis, design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of the company’s on-premise SAP HR/Payroll environment. Configure, test, implement, and support SAP HR/Payroll changes within a formal System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management methodology. Implement, maintain, support, and troubleshoot the Rsite Tax Engine , including coordination with Rimini Street and the application, testing, and validation of tax updates and releases. Manage the impact of Rsite Tax Engine updates on SAP Payroll, including payroll configuration, tax calculations, testing, regression testing, and production implementation. Partner with Rimini Street and other vendors to investigate and resolve tax engine, payroll, and integration-related issues. Support payroll tax compliance activities by ensuring applicable federal, state, and local tax updates are appropriately tested and implemented in the Rsite Tax Engine/SAP Payroll environment. Understand and manage integration touchpoints between SAP HR/Payroll, Rsite Tax Engine, SuccessFactors, Kronos Workforce Management, and other downstream or upstream applications. Implement and support SaaS solutions and their integrations with SAP HR/Payroll. Manage, prioritize, and complete support requests for a large and complex organization. Estimate and plan work effort for projects, enhancements, upgrades, tax updates, and production support activities. Independently perform technical, configuration, testing, documentation, and process-related activities. Develop and maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration documentation, test scripts, and support procedures. Work collaboratively across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendor teams with a focus on overall business success. Effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced, and constantly changing environment. Strong technical and functional knowledge of SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6. Strong experience with SAP Payroll including experience with Personnel Administration, , Benefits configuration, and Financial Postings. title: Senior IT Internal Controls Analyst
description:
The Senior IT Internal Controls Analyst serves as Information Technology’s primary liaison and coordination point for internal audit, external audit, Finance, controller, risk, compliance, cybersecurity, application owners, infrastructure teams, and third-party service providers. The role supports the design, documentation, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement of IT controls that enable reliable financial reporting and effective technology governance, with particular emphasis on Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) systems and business-process support.

This position coordinates audit requests and evidence, evaluates IT general controls and automated/application controls, supports remediation of deficiencies, and embeds control requirements into key system implementations and significant changes. The analyst provides control-focused oversight across the systems development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, security, data conversion, interfaces, testing, segregation of duties, deployment, and post-implementation stabilization. Experience with ServiceNow and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (FinOps) and Project Operations (Proj Ops) is preferred.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary IT liaison for Internal Audit, External Audit, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and other stakeholders on IT controls and audit-related activities.
* Coordinate audit planning, walkthroughs, evidence collection, testing requests, and responses to support internal and external audits.
* Support the organization's SOX compliance program across financially relevant systems, applications, and business processes.
* Evaluate and monitor IT General Controls (ITGCs), including user access management, segregation of duties, change management, incident management, and backup/recovery controls.
* Support the design, documentation, testing, and monitoring of automated controls, application controls, and key financial reporting controls.
* Facilitate risk assessments, control reviews, deficiency management, and remediation activities to improve control effectiveness.
* Maintain risk and control documentation, including process narratives, flowcharts, control matrices, and audit-support documentation.
* Provide controls and governance support for system implementations, ERP projects, upgrades, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives throughout the SDLC lifecycle.
* Review project deliverables, security roles, data migration activities, testing results, and deployment readiness from a controls and compliance perspective.
* Develop audit readiness, remediation, and control-performance reporting for management and leadership teams.
* Partner with ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Finance, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Application teams to support technology governance and compliance requirements.
* Identify opportunities to automate controls, standardize processes, improve audit readiness, and strengthen the overall control environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with ServiceNow ITSM, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), Audit Management, or related modules.
* Experience supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (FinOps) and Project Operations (Proj Ops).
* Knowledge of Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis, ERP security design, workflow controls, and financial system governance.
* Experience supporting enterprise ERP transformations, cloud-based platforms, and global technology implementations.
* Familiarity with third-party assurance reporting, SOC reports, complementary user entity controls (CUECs), and vendor risk management.
* Experience working within large, global, regulated, engineering, professional services, or multi-provider environments.
* Knowledge of business process controls related to finance, accounting, project management, and reporting processes.

title: SMM Strategist
description:
**BigBoost AI Private Limited | Chennai | Work From Office**

About BigBoost AI

BigBoost AI is a fast-paced performance marketing agency and AI product-building company working with brands across India, the US, the UK and the Middle East. We bring together strategy, creativity, content and performance to build meaningful business outcomes for our clients.

As we expand our social media capabilities, we are looking for an experienced social media professional who can take ownership of client accounts, drive high-quality execution and contribute to building a stronger, collaborative team.

Work Details

* **Location:**
  Chennai
* **Work Model:**
  Work From Office
* **Working Days:**
  Monday to Friday
* **Working Hours:**
  10:30 AM to 7:30 PM IST
* **Experience:**
  5+ years in Social Media industry
* **Employment Type:**
  Full-time

The Opportunity

This role is designed for a seasoned social media professional who enjoys working beyond conventional job boundaries. You will be actively involved in strategy, content planning, client communication, execution, shoots, events and cross-functional collaboration while helping the team maintain quality, speed and accountability.

The role follows an
**80% individual contribution and 20% team development and coordination**
approach. You will remain closely involved in the actual work while taking ownership of delegation, team coordination, delivery standards and client expectations.

This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in an agency environment where initiative, adaptability and ownership matter more than routine processes.

Key Responsibilities

**Social Media Strategy & Execution**

* Own end-to-end social media planning and execution for Indian D2C brands, covering content calendars, campaign concepts, platform-specific strategies and audience engagement.
* Translate brand objectives into compelling content ideas, creative briefs, reels, stories, static posts and campaign-led initiatives.
* Work hands-on with content creation, copywriting, ideation, publishing coordination and performance reviews.
* Maintain high standards of creative quality, brand consistency and delivery timelines across multiple client accounts.

**Client Communication & Account Ownership**

* Serve as a dependable point of contact for day-to-day social media coordination, client discussions, feedback and approvals.
* Present content ideas confidently, communicate recommendations clearly and manage expectations in high-pressure situations.
* Handle feedback constructively, resolve execution bottlenecks and ensure timely follow-through on client commitments.
* Build strong client relationships through proactive communication, clarity and accountability.

**Team Coordination & Delivery Management**

* Coordinate with social media executives, designers, video editors, performance marketers and other internal stakeholders to deliver integrated campaigns.
* Delegate tasks based on team capacity, skill sets and priorities while maintaining visibility over progress and deadlines.
* Support team development through constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, workflow improvements and quality checks.
* Identify delivery risks early, prioritise competing requirements and maintain execution standards during high-volume periods.
* Collaborate with the existing social media leadership and wider team to strengthen the function as the agency grows.

**On-Camera Content, Shoots & Field Engagement**

* Be comfortable appearing on camera for client reels, brand content, interviews and other relevant social media formats.
* Travel to client locations for shoots, content production and campaign execution.
* Accompany the team to events, exhibitions and brand activations when required, coordinating activities and communicating confidently with visitors, clients and stakeholders.
* Adapt to changing shoot schedules, live-event requirements and time-sensitive deliverables with a practical, solution-oriented mindset.

What We Are Looking For

* Approximately 4–5 years of hands-on social media experience, preferably within a digital marketing or creative agency.
* Strong experience managing social media for Indian D2C brands, with a clear understanding of brand positioning, consumer behaviour and content-led growth.
* Demonstrated capability in handling multiple client accounts, fast-moving deliverables and demanding timelines.
* Excellent client communication, presentation, coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience guiding team members, delegating responsibilities and maintaining accountability without losing touch with execution.
* Strong creative judgement, content ideation, copywriting and social media planning capabilities.
* Confidence in front of the camera and willingness to travel for client shoots, events and exhibitions.
* The ability to prioritise effectively, manage pressure and make sound decisions in a dynamic agency environment.
* A collaborative mindset with the flexibility to work across teams, take initiative and contribute wherever business priorities require.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

This opportunity is best suited to professionals who:

* Prefer ownership and problem-solving over narrowly defined responsibilities.
* Enjoy a hands-on role while contributing to team development and delivery coordination.
* Are comfortable balancing client expectations, creative execution and internal team priorities.
* Value collaboration, pace and continuous learning over repetitive, highly structured routines.
* Are willing to step beyond their usual responsibilities when shoots, events, exhibitions or critical campaign deadlines demand it.

**Please note:**
This is a senior individual-contributor-oriented role with team coordination responsibilities. It is not a purely supervisory position. Candidates seeking exclusively managerial responsibilities, a routine-only work environment or a role without hands-on execution may find this opportunity unsuitable.

How to Apply

Interested and eligible candidates may share their updated resume at
**shashank@bigboost.agency**
.

Please apply only if your experience aligns with agency-led social media execution, Indian D2C brand management, strong client communication and hands-on ownership.

At BigBoost AI, we value professionals who combine strategic thinking with execution, bring people together and take responsibility for delivering meaningful outcomes.

* Enable and support consistent web and digital optimization practices across the organization through training, documentation, website reviews, and ongoing collaboration with marketing, web, engineering, and content teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or a related discipline
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in technical SEO, supporting complex or large-scale websites, including 8+ years of experience planning and executing successful SEO initiatives

* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with the ability to review, troubleshoot, and recommend on-page and technical improvements
* Strong proficiency with SEO and analytics tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Raven Tools, Screaming Frog, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Mouseflow, and similar platforms; hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, and relevant certifications is a strong advantage
* Experience working with enterprise CMS platforms (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager) in large, multi-site environments
* Experience with Python or scripting and automation to support SEO audits, web crawling, and large-scale technical analysis is a plus
* Familiarity with AEO and GEO, including structured content and schema for AI-driven search experiences is preferred
* Demonstrated interest in emerging search technologies, AI-driven discovery, and evolving search algorithms
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and consistently deliver projects on time, while translating technical insights into clear, actionable recommendations

**Travel Time**
No Travel

accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

title: Director Media (Cross Channel)
description:
**About WPP Media**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
**About WPP Media**
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It's what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media's shared core values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

**Role Summary and Impact**
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, the Director – Cross Channel will lead and evolve a global media execution function, working across the United States, Europe and Asia. The role combines cross-channel media expertise, operational leadership, client partnership and people development to deliver scalable, consistent and high-quality outcomes across markets.
  
  
The Director will own the operational strategy, governance, delivery standards, reporting, capacity planning and continuous-improvement agenda across multiple PODs and workstreams. The role will translate business and marketing priorities into practical activation frameworks, guide teams through ambiguity, and build a future-ready, AI-enabled delivery organisation. We are looking for a Director – Cross Channel who will:
  
  
Cross-Channel Operations and Delivery Excellence
  
  

* Lead end-to-end operations across at least two core digital media disciplines, such as Search, Social, Programmatic or Ad Operations, while maintaining a working understanding of complementary channels.
* Build and govern common delivery standards across teams, PODs and markets, covering campaign setup, quality assurance, tracking, reporting, documentation and operational controls.
* Drive measurable improvements in quality, timeliness, productivity and delivery outcomes through clear performance measures, root-cause analysis and disciplined follow-through.
* Scale and continuously improve processes, integrating workflows across media functions to enable consistent and connected cross-channel delivery.
* Champion automation, advanced measurement and AI/ML-enabled ways of working to improve efficiency, insight and scalability.
* Maintain awareness of evolving industry developments, including identity solutions, real-time analytics and server-side tagging, and translate relevant developments into the media operations roadmap.

Client, Market and Stakeholder Leadership
  
  

* Build trusted relationships with Nexus-Hub regional teams, market leaders, internal senior stakeholders and external clients.
* Confidently lead senior and CEO-level conversations, simplifying complex operational issues and translating business goals into scalable frameworks and activation plans.
* Act as a strategic partner rather than only a delivery lead, thinking beyond the immediate problem and focusing stakeholders on sustainable solutions and outcomes.
* Influence across strategy, analytics, engineering and activation teams, including situations where direct authority is limited.
* Own cross-market escalations, exercise sound stakeholder judgement and make informed decisions in ambiguous situations or where information is incomplete.
* Communicate clearly and credibly across organisational levels, both verbally and in writing.

People and Leadership
  
  

* Lead a high-performing, globally distributed organisation, with experience managing teams of approximately 30–50 people and 4–8 direct reports.
* Create clarity of direction and accountability across multiple PODs or workstreams, balancing delivery priorities, team capacity and stakeholder expectations.
* Coach and mentor leaders and team members, provide timely and actionable feedback, and build a strong succession and leadership pipeline.
* Drive training, professional growth and platform capability while reinforcing best practices, operational consistency and quality at scale.
* Foster resilience, collaboration and openness to feedback, and visibly translate feedback into action.

Planning, Risk and Commercial Discipline
  
  

* Lead or support scoping, capacity planning, staffing and resource management across markets and workstreams.
* Proactively identify delivery, capability and stakeholder risks; establish mitigations early and maintain ownership through resolution.
* Manage vendor relationships and evaluate relevant martech and adtech solutions to support platform compliance and operational innovation.
* Work independently, take ownership of outcomes and make timely decisions while balancing client needs, team sustainability and operational priorities.

**Skills and Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant digital media and operations experience, with no exceptions; 12–15 years of professional experience is preferred for this Director-level scope.
* Deep expertise in at least two digital media channels among Search, Social, Programmatic and Ad Operations, with working knowledge of complementary channels.
* Hands-on experience with relevant platforms and tools, which may include Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, The Trade Desk, DV360, SA360, CM360/DCM, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads, LinkedIn, AppsFlyer and tagging or analytics tools.
* Proven experience leading sizeable, multi-location media activation or operations teams and delivering centralised support to local or regional teams.
* Experience working with global and geographically distributed teams; exposure to multiple PODs or workstreams is strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to manage complex client relationships, cross-functional collaboration and senior stakeholder expectations.
* Strong track record of maintaining quality standards, driving operational improvement and delivering performance at scale.
* Good understanding of scoping, capacity planning, staffing requirements and resource trade-offs.
* AI-enabled mindset, with prior experience or meaningful exposure to applying AI in work highly desirable.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in any field.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

Leadership and Behavioural Traits
  
  

* Solution-oriented and strategic: looks beyond the immediate problem and focuses on scalable, sustainable solutions.
* Mature stakeholder manager: navigates complex internal and external relationships, including senior and CEO-level conversations, with confidence and judgement.
* Delivery standard-setter: creates consistency across teams and markets and holds the organisation accountable for measurable quality and delivery outcomes.
* Decisive under ambiguity: makes sound, informed choices when information is incomplete and maintains ownership of the outcome.
* Proactive risk leader: anticipates challenges, surfaces issues early and mobilises the right action before delivery is affected.
* Continuous-improvement champion: scales processes, embraces automation and raises operational maturity over time.
* Coach and talent builder: develops people, strengthens leadership capability and creates an environment in which feedback leads to action.
* Resilient and collaborative: remains constructive under pressure, works across boundaries and responds openly to feedback.
* Influential and independent: shapes outcomes without relying on hierarchy and works autonomously while staying connected to enterprise priorities.

**Life at WPP Media & Benefits**
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we're just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Content Production Specialist
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
  
  
**The Role**
Presidio is seeking a detail-oriented and productive
**Content Production Specialist**
to build, style, and maintain content pages and experiences within our Showpad enablement platform. This is a hands-on production role: the primary, day-to-day activity is the accurate and efficient creation of Showpad pages — laying out graphics, formatting copy, uploading and tagging assets, and assembling clean, on-brand, easy-to-navigate experiences for our sales and technical teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate is fast, reliable, and has a good eye for visual layout. Deep sales enablement strategy experience is not required — Showpad is learnable within a few days, and success in this role is measured by output quality, consistency, and speed. We are looking for someone personable, organized, and quick to get up to speed, who takes pride in producing polished pages at volume.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Page Creation & Layout (Primary Activity): Build and style Showpad pages — arranging graphics, images, text, and links into clean, consistent, on-brand layouts. This is the core, high-volume function of the role.
* Content Entry & Assembly: Upload, place, and organize content assets (PDFs, decks, videos, images) into pages and experiences accurately and at pace, including frequent copy-paste and formatting work.
* Graphics & Visual Formatting: Place, crop, resize, and align graphics and thumbnails; apply basic image edits so pages look professional and adhere to Presidio brand standards.
* Tagging & Organization: Apply the established tagging/metadata taxonomy so content is categorized correctly and easy to find; keep folder structures and page navigation tidy and logical.
* Navigation & Experience Structure: Assemble and update page navigation, sections, and experiences so sellers and technical staff can move through content quickly and intuitively.
* Quality & Consistency: Proofread and QA pages before publishing — checking links, formatting, spelling, image quality, and brand consistency — to ensure a polished end result.
* Content Maintenance: Keep pages current: swap outdated assets, fix broken links, archive retired material, and action update requests promptly.
* Turnaround & Volume: Manage a steady queue of production requests, prioritize effectively, and deliver a high volume of pages on schedule.
* Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with enablement, marketing, and content owners to understand requests, ask clarifying questions, and confirm final output meets expectations.

**Required Skills And Professional Experience**

* Demonstrable production efficiency: Proven ability to produce digital pages, layouts, or content at volume with speed and accuracy. A portfolio or work samples showing Showpad pages (or comparable web/CMS/DAM/slide layouts) is strongly valued.
* Strong visual and layout sense: A good eye for spacing, alignment, image placement, and clean, professional-looking pages.

description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**

As a

within the

You will drive communication strategies that align with business priorities, enhance employee engagement, support executive thought leadership and service line PR efforts, and strengthen Cognizant's culture and brand presence.
  
  
You will collaborate with business leaders, HR, and cross-functional teams to develop impactful communications that connect employees with business goals while fostering engagement and organizational visibility.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly communication strategies aligned to business priorities and measure their effectiveness.

* Identify and amplify impactful stories, including employee achievements, innovation, client success stories, and leadership perspectives.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in journalism, Creative Writing, English Language, Communications, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in Corporate Communications, Internal Communications, or related communication functions.
* Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, presentation, and storytelling skills.
* Demonstrated experience developing communication strategies and delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Proven ability to partner with senior leaders and provide strategic communications counsel within a global, matrixed organization.
* Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, collaboration, project management, and organizational skills.
* Experience communicating effectively with geographically dispersed employee populations.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage multiple priorities, and independently drive initiatives from concept through execution.

**These Will Help You Succeed**

* Experience supporting executive thought leadership and leadership visibility initiatives.
* Proficiency with digital communication and social media platforms, including LinkedIn and employee engagement channels.
* Experience identifying, curating, and promoting impactful business and culture stories.
* Strong analytical mindset with a data-driven approach to communications.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.
* HTML knowledge and experience with digital communications tools.

**Work Model**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a
**hybrid position located in Chennai**
, requiring employees to work from a Cognizant office
**3 to 4 days per week**
. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
**Work Authorization**
Must be legally authorized to work in the country without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting perspectives to this role.

* Involved in the design, operation, and maintenance of enterprise servers, including specialty mainframe systems like IBM/LPARS, high performance super computing systems, and general-purpose hybrid and cloud systems, for optimal end-user business operations.
* Research, design, implement and maintain complex infrastructure solutions for internal customer needs such as specialty software, data warehouses, identity access management, event frameworks, containerization and on demand scaling, etc.

* Monitor and review resources like CPU, memory, storage, and network traffic to ensure effective utilization aligned with expected parameters and to safeguard against runaway costs. Resolve bottlenecks and plan for future capacity needs based on resource usage trends. Advise enterprise architecture teams on usage trends to incorporate into future blueprints.

* Bachelor's Degree

* Private Cloud & Container Architecture: o Deep expertise in Kubernetes/OpenShift internals, including Operators (OLM), MachineConfig, Multus CNI, Trident, CePH and OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF). o Experience utilizing OpenShift Virtualization to run diverse workloads.

title: Technical Account Engineer
description:
We are seeking a customer-focused Technical Account Engineer to serve as the bridge between our enterprise customers, products, and internal engineering teams. In this role, you will provide technical expertise, proactive onboarding, and high-touch support across the customer lifecycle. You will troubleshoot complex cloud environments, advocate for customer needs, write documentation, and automate routine operational tasks.

  

Because this role involves direct customer interaction across channels (tickets, chat, phone, video) and daily alignment with US engineering teams, strong written and spoken English communication skills are essential.

  

Location: Remote, India

  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

  
* Customer Support & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical inquiries, infrastructure failures, and performance bottlenecks across client cloud systems via tickets, chats, calls, and video sessions.
  
* Onboarding & Pre-Sales Assistance: Assist with new customer onboarding, initial platform provisioning, customization requests, pre-sales technical configurations, and end-user enablement.
  
* Automation & Scripting: Write and maintain Bash and Ansible scripts to automate operational processes and deploy software updates.
  
* Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create clear internal and external technical documentation, runbooks, and process guides using Markdown, Git, GitHub/Wiki, or Google Docs.
  
* Monitoring & Outage Ownership: Monitor customer-facing platforms, configure alerting tools, and maintain end-to-end ownership during outages or critical incidents until fully resolved.
  
* Product Advocacy: Partner closely with internal Engineering teams to surface customer feedback, bug reports, and feature requests to continuously improve product performance.
  

  
  
Required Qualifications & Skills
  

  
* Experience: 3+ years of experience in customer-facing technical support, system administration, networking, or cloud operations.
  
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills with experience creating customer-facing technical documentation.
  
* Linux Systems Administration: Advanced Linux administration skills, including experience managing clustered Linux environments and executing live root-level updates.
  
* Cloud & Containers: Hands-on experience or working knowledge of cloud platforms (OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Docker, or virtualization).
  
* Scripting & Automation: Intermediate experience with Ansible and Python scripting, alongside shell tools (Bash).
  
* Networking & Tools: Understanding of core networking concepts and tools (DNS, Load Balancers, VPNs, iptables, HAProxy, OpenVSwitch) and version control via Git.
  
* Hardware Management: Experience accessing and managing remote servers via IPMI/BMC interfaces.
  

  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  

  
* Experience using Terraform or Heat for infrastructure configuration management.
  
* Direct experience supporting public or private cloud hosting components (VMs, Databases, Network Storage).

JOB DETAILS

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Software Engineer – Warehouse Management, you will contribute to the design, development, enhancement, and migration of warehouse management functionalities from SAP WM to SAP EWM. You will work closely with architects, functional analysts, and cross-functional technical teams to convert business requirements into scalable, maintainable software solutions that support complex warehouse operations. Education & Certifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field

· SAP EWM or SAP WM certification preferred

· Agile / Scrum certification is a plus

Required Experience

· Minimum 3 years of experience in SAP WM with hands-on development exposure

· Strong understanding of WM objects, warehouse processes, and migration considerations

· Experience working in SAP S/4HANA environments and integrating with modules such as MM, SD, and TM

Essential Skills

· Proficiency in ABAP development (Reports, Enhancements, BADIs, User Exits, OO-ABAP)

· Hands-on experience with EWM development objects including queues, RF screens, warehouse tasks, and warehouse orders

· Strong analytical skills for troubleshooting integration, queue failures, and warehouse execution issues

· Experience working with SAP BTP, Fiori/UI5 is an advantage

· Ability to write clean, maintainable, performance-optimized code

Desired Skills

· Experience supporting cutover activities for WM to EWM migration

· Understanding of decentral EWM and embedded EWM architectures

· Exposure to automated warehousing, scanners, mobility solutions, and RF frameworks

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Development & Execution

· Develop, enhance, and maintain SAP WM and EWM custom objects supporting migration and steady-state operations

· Build and validate interfaces between EWM and related systems (ERP, transportation, scanning devices, middleware)

· Perform code retrofitting, technical redesign, and remediation for WM → EWM migration

· Conduct detailed technical analysis for gaps and design required customizations

Migration Support

· Support data conversion and migration activities (warehouse master data, stock, open tasks)

· Collaborate with functional and QA teams for integration, regression, and performance testing

· Analyze queue failures (SMQ1/SMQ2), dumps (ST22), logs (SM21), and support defect resolution

· Assist in cutover planning, mock runs, and go-live hypercare

Technical Excellence & Collaboration

· Ensure adherence to coding standards, performance guidelines, and security requirements

· Participate in design and code reviews to uphold development quality

· Work closely with Solution Architects and business teams to translate technical needs into executable solutions

· Prepare and maintain technical specifications, test scripts, and deployment documentation

WHAT WE OFFER

· Opportunity to be part of a large-scale SAP modernization initiative transforming legacy WM to EWM

· Work with global teams across supply chain and technology

· Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

· Strong career development pathways within a high-performance engineering organization

· Exposure to advanced warehouse technologies, automation interfaces, and S/4HANA-based innovation

title: IT Security Manager - IAM Architect / Lead
description:
Wolters Kluwer Global Business Services (GBS) is designed to provide services to the business units in the areas of technology, sourcing, procurement, legal, finance, and human resources. These global centers promote team collaboration using best practices around a specific focus area to drive results and enhance operational efficiencies. There is a constant endeavor to benchmark against best\-in\-class industry standards to improve the quality of deliverables, increase cost savings, enhance productivity and reduce time to market for products and applications.
   

  

 We have an amazing opportunity for a IAM lead architect, IT Security available within our Global Business Services division. This position has been created due to growth. IAM lead Architect, IT Security will be Accountable and Responsible for defining the identity fabric — the standards, reference architectures, and integration patterns and working closely with project teams as well as internal / external groups to protect and enhance the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of Wolters Kluwer assets.
   

  

 This position location is Pune or Chennai, India .
   

  

 As IAM lead Architect, IT Security, you will be accountable for defining IAM architectures, standards, road maps for all our IAM programs to secure access to personal and confidential information at Wolters Kluwer. In this role, you will be required to demonstrate proficiency in identity and access concepts as they pertain to every area of security management. Your role will also include interfacing with all other areas of the security organization and responding to 3rd party audits and internal audits, and interfacing with internal business unit IT representatives on global information security initiatives and compliance tasks and projects.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Define and own the enterprise identity architecture strategy, reference architectures, and engineering standards aligned to business and regulatory requirements across US and EU jurisdictions.
* Produce and maintain the IAM RACI — resolving ownership boundaries between Access Management, IGA, Privileged IAM, Access Management, and NHI pillars.
* Establish and govern the IAM Architecture Review Board (ARB), ensuring architectural sign\-off on all material identity, access, and authentication changes.
* Own the identity fabric design — the authoritative directory model, hybrid sync strategy, group and role taxonomy, and attribute schema across AD and Entra ID.
* Define integration standards for all IAM tool\-to\-tool connections: SailPoint to AD, CyberArk to Entra PIM, CIEM to SIEM, and emerging NHI tooling.


 Zero Trust and Cloud IAM Architecture
   

  

* Architect and enforce Zero Trust identity controls across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), including least\-privilege, just\-in\-time access, and continuous access evaluation.
* Define cloud IAM governance standards: Entra ID tenant architecture, AWS IAM permission boundaries, Azure RBAC design, and GCP IAM policy structure.
* Drive the architectural strategy for CIEM integration — ensuring cloud entitlement visibility, toxic combination detection, and least\-privilege remediation at scale.
* Own the identity component of the organization’s Zero Trust roadmap, including micro\-segmentation, device trust, and identity\-aware network policy.


 NHI and AI Identity Architecture
   

  

* Define the Non\-Human Identity (NHI) governance architecture — covering service accounts, managed identities, service principals, pipeline identities, and AI agent identities.
* Design the secrets management architecture integrating CyberArk Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, and CI/CD OIDC federation for keyless pipeline authentication.
* Architect the AI agent identity model — defining how AI agents authenticate, what permissions they hold, how their actions are audited, and how their lifecycle is governed.
* Produce architectural guidance for MCP server identity controls and LLM API key governance for emerging AI tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, custom agents).


 Regulatory and Compliance Architecture
   

  

* Ensure identity architecture satisfies GDPR, NIS2, DORA, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27001 requirements across all operating regions.
* Translate evolving regulatory requirements (EU AI Act, Cyber Resilience Act, SEC cybersecurity rules) into actionable identity architecture changes.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Data Protection Officers to embed Privacy\-by\-Design and data minimization at the identity architecture layer.
* Maintain the IAM architecture risk register — classifying, prioritizing, and driving remediation of architectural debt and control gaps.


 Cross\-Pillar Governance
   

  

* Serve as the primary architectural authority for the IAM program — covering Access Management and Controls and Audit operationally where dedicated leads are not yet in place.
* Chair the IAM Architecture Guild, fostering a community of practice across distributed identity engineers in US and EU time zones.
* Present identity architecture posture and program progress to the IAM Owner, CISO, and executive leadership.
* Evaluate and govern the IAM toolchain — rationalizing tool overlap, driving consolidation decisions, and managing vendor relationships for identity platforms.


 Our Interview Practices
   

  

*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in\-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI\-generated responses or third\-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*
*Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.*

title: Algorithm Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS\-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market\-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high\-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS\-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost\-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading\-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all\-wafer\-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS\-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Provide technical leadership in algorithm design and development for wafer inspection products.
* Collaborate with system, product, and domain experts to define algorithm performance requirements and deliver customer‑driven solutions.
* Mentor and motivate engineers to solve complex technical and investigative problems.
* Represent the algorithms team during system‑level hardware and software integration.
* Develop, validate, and deploy image processing, computer vision, and machine learning algorithms.
* Support software quality and reliability activities as part of the development lifecycle.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Strong background in image processing and computer vision; working knowledge of machine learning and deep learning.
* Proficient in C/C\+\+ and MATLAB; experience on Unix/Linux platforms.
* Hands‑on experience with object‑oriented and/or functional programming.
* Python and ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow) experience is a plus.
* Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
* Good communication and collaboration skills with emerging technical leadership capability.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 PhD in CS/EE/Math/Physics with 3\+ years of experience, or MTech/MS/BTech/BS in CS/EE with 6\+ years of experience.
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
 Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

title: Provider Management Specialist
description:
**About Amplify Health**




**Who We Are** 




 Amplify Health is Asia’s leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region.
 



  





 We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS\-based products, PaaS\-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS\-based on\-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value\-chain.
 



  





 Our joint\-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match.
 



  





 We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes.
 



  





**Our Vision and Ambition** 




 To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.
 



 Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value\-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.
 



 By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health\-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.
 



  





**The Position**




**Summary** 




 As a Provider Management Specialist, the role is a specialist advisor position supporting private health insurers to improve their claims risk management, primarily through provider contracting strategy, panel optimisation, patient pathway design, and insurance product alignment.
 



 You will work directly with client teams, enabling them to build stronger provider networks, negotiate effectively, utilise data insights, and apply best‑practice provider management strategies within the healthcare and HealthTech ecosystem.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\) On‑Site Client Advisory \& Provider Management Support** 



* Serves as the primary advisor to senior insurer stakeholders to drive and support provider management targets, initiatives and implementations, including, supporting strategic initiatives, contracting cycles, and provider engagement plans.
* Shapes multi‑year provider strategy, including contracting redesign and ecosystem partnerships.
* Develop high‑quality materials for client prep sessions, executive updates, and provider negotiations, ensuring clarity, coherence and insight‑driven storytelling.
* Serve as an embedded advisor supporting the client’s operational and strategic objectives.



**2\) Internal Provider Analytics Product Development** 



* Translate key client needs, pain points, and market insights into product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback to evolve Amplify Health’s provider analytics tools, dashboards and negotiation support solutions.
* Acts as the thought partner to product leadership for long‑term roadmap development.



**3\) Capability Building and Upskilling Client Teams** 



* Identify and prioritize key knowledge gaps and design tailored workshops, demos and training modules to upskill capabilities across client teams.
* Run coaching and role‑play sessions to elevate client teams’ provider negotiation capabilities and commercial acumen to improve negotiations for provider engagements.



  





**Candidate Profile**




**Experience and Qualifications** 



* Over 6 years experience in health insurance, health\-related industries or consulting.
* Demonstrated success in managing cost efficiencies in healthcare, whether at providers, insurers or population health level.
* Proven experience in client advisory work particularly in healthcare related work.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or relevant) strongly preferred.



  





**Competencies \& Core Characteristics:** 




 We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale\-up environment:
 


* **Strategic Architect:** 
 Able to connect disparate information into a cohesive strategy leveraging Amplify Health frameworks. Capable of designing clear, actionable paths for clients navigating complex provider ecosystems.
* **Data\-Driven Decisiveness:** 
 Confidence in working with data, identifying insights, and translating analytics into compelling narratives. Ensures objective, evidence‑based decision‑making in provider negotiations and strategy formulation.
* **Customer‑Obsessed Advocate:** 
 Anticipates client needs and proactively delivers value through insights, structure and advisory support.
* **Resilient Operator:** 
 able to operate in a fluid and changing start\-up environment, flexing between internal work and client facing modes
* **Unifier \& Cross\-Functional Influencer:** 
 Collaborates seamlessly across clinical, analytics, commercial and product teams. Drives alignment and shared understanding between stakeholders.

title: Senior Test Engineer
description:
**About ValGenesis**
 ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
   

  

 Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
   

  

 About the Role:
   

  

 ValGenesis is looking for Senior QA/Test Engineers to join and strengthen our development team. Test engineers will be part of the development scrum teams, and will closely work with the developers, BA/PO to ensure that all digital products are properly verified before reaching the clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop deep expertise in our products and their uses in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Plan and execute computer system verification activities.
* Work with software developers and product managers in an Agile team environment.
* Create testing\-related documentation, including test plans, test cases/scripts, and bug reports assessing quality and associated risk.
* Ability to map data flows in the software as a basis to develop challenging and robust testing.
* Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines.


**Requirements**
* Prior experience/knowledge in Biopharma Industry, specifically pharma regulatory, quality, risk, process validation.
* 5 \- 10 years of experience in Functional flow testing of all test phases.
* Experience of using or testing any pharma validation/quality software systems is a huge plus.
* Experience in leading/guiding junior team members.
* Experience using Jira.
* Proficient in MS Office and Test Design.
* Able to work both collaboratively and independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Able to work with minimal supervision.
* Good understanding of software development life cycle process.
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Robot, Selenium etc) is preferable.


**We’re on a Mission**
 In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance\-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
   

  

 Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end\-to\-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose\-built systems with world\-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.
   

  

**The Team You’ll Join**
 Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
   

  

 We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
   

  

 We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
   

  

 We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in\-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
   

  

 ValGenesis is an equal\-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best\-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
