title: Performance Marketer
description:
Senior Performance Marketing Manager
 



 Location: Chennai
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time, Work From Office
 



 Experience: 4\+ years
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



  





 Department: Performance Marketing
 



  





 Reporting To: CEO
 



  





 About Spinta Digital
 



 Spinta Digital is a full\-service digital marketing and creative agency working with ambitious brands across healthcare, D2C, wellness, real estate, education, SaaS and technology.
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior Performance Marketer who has strong hands\-on experience across both Lead Generation and E\-commerce campaigns, with a deep understanding of tracking, attribution and conversion optimisation.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role for someone who understands that performance marketing is not simply about running ads — it is about building the complete journey from tracking and targeting to acquisition, conversion and revenue.
 



  





 The Role
 



 You will be responsible for planning, executing, managing and optimising paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads, covering both lead\-generation and e\-commerce businesses.
 



  





 A critical part of this role is having strong technical knowledge of conversion tracking and measurement, including Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google Enhanced Conversions, GA4, Google Tag Manager and server\-side/event\-based tracking.
 



  





 You should be comfortable getting into the technical side of tracking rather than depending entirely on developers or analytics teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Paid Media Management
 


* Plan and execute performance marketing strategies across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Manage both Lead Generation and E\-commerce campaigns.
* Develop campaign structures based on business objectives, customer journey and funnel stages.
* Manage budgets and optimise campaigns to achieve CPA, CPL, ROAS, CAC and revenue targets.
* Develop audience strategies including prospecting, retargeting, lookalikes and customer audiences.
* Manage campaign testing across audiences, creatives, offers, landing pages and messaging.
* Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while maintaining efficiency.
* Continuously monitor campaign performance and take corrective action when targets are not being achieved.



  





 E\-commerce Performance
 


* Manage campaigns focused on product purchases and revenue generation.
* Work with Shopify and other e\-commerce platforms.
* Understand the complete funnel from Landing Page → Product View → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase.
* Optimise campaigns based on ROAS, CAC, AOV, conversion rate and contribution margin.
* Work with product feeds and Google Merchant Center.
* Understand Shopping / Performance Max / Search / Display / YouTube campaign ecosystems.
* Identify funnel leakage and work with CRO/creative teams to improve conversion rates.



  





 Lead Generation
 


* Build and optimise campaigns for lead generation across multiple industries.
* Work with different lead\-generation objectives including enquiries, consultations, registrations, applications and qualified leads.
* Understand the difference between Lead, MQL, SQL and actual revenue.
* Optimise campaigns based on lead quality and downstream conversion rather than simply CPL.
* Work with CRM data to understand which campaigns, audiences and keywords are generating actual business.
* Develop strategies for improving lead quality while maintaining acquisition efficiency.



  





 Tracking \& Attribution — Critical Requirement
 


* The candidate must have hands\-on experience implementing and troubleshooting conversion tracking, not just using dashboards to read campaign results.



  





 You should have experience with:
 



  




* Meta
* Meta Pixel implementation
* Meta Conversions API (CAPI)
* Event setup and mapping
* Event deduplication
* Browser \+ server\-side event tracking
* Event Match Quality
* Advanced Matching
* Purchase, Lead, ViewContent, AddToCart and other standard events
* Meta Events Manager
* Diagnosing discrepancies between Meta and website/CRM data
* Google
* Google Enhanced Conversions
* Google Ads conversion tracking
* GA4
* Google Tag Manager
* Google Analytics events and conversions
* Google Merchant Center
* Google Ads ↔ GA4 integration
* Offline conversion imports where applicable
* Understanding GCLID / UTM parameters and attribution
* Analytics \& Attribution
* GA4
* Google Tag Manager
* UTM strategy
* Cross\-channel attribution
* Understanding discrepancies between Meta, Google Ads, GA4 and Shopify/CRM
* Ability to audit tracking setups and identify data gaps
* Understanding first\-party and server\-side tracking concepts
* Experience working with tools such as Elevar, Northbeam or similar attribution/tracking platforms is a strong advantage.



  





 Creative \& CRO Understanding
 



 A strong performance marketer should understand creative — not just media buying.
 



  





 You will:
 



  




* Analyse which creatives are driving CTR, CVR and conversions.
* Work with designers and copywriters to develop better\-performing ads.
* Identify creative fatigue.
* Recommend new creative concepts based on campaign data.
* Provide clear briefs for new ad creatives.
* Analyse landing pages and identify potential conversion issues.
* Work with the creative and development teams to improve the overall customer journey.
* Reporting \& Analysis
* Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards.
* Analyse campaign performance at campaign, ad set/ad group, keyword, creative and audience levels.
* Identify the why behind performance changes rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Provide clear recommendations and action plans.



 Track key metrics including:
 


* ROAS
* CAC
* CPA
* CPL
* CTR
* CPC
* CPM
* Conversion Rate
* AOV
* Revenue
* Lead Quality
* Funnel Conversion Rates



 Requirements
 


* 4–7 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience.
* Strong experience managing both Lead Generation and E\-commerce campaigns.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Proven experience managing meaningful advertising budgets.
* Strong understanding of conversion tracking and attribution.
* Hands\-on implementation experience with Meta CAPI.
* Hands\-on implementation experience with Google Enhanced Conversions.
* Strong understanding of GTM and GA4\.
* Experience with Shopify/e\-commerce platforms is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently identify performance issues and implement solutions.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between media buying, creative, landing pages, tracking and conversion rates.



  





 Good to Have
 


* Experience with Shopify and D2C brands.
* Experience with healthcare, wellness, education, real estate or SaaS lead generation.
* Experience with CRM integrations and offline conversion tracking.
* Experience with Elevar, Northbeam or similar attribution platforms.
* Experience with Google Merchant Center and Performance Max.
* Experience with Looker Studio.
* Basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript and data layers.
* Experience with server\-side tracking.
* Experience managing large monthly advertising budgets.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to boost campaigns or set up ads based on a checklist.
 



  





 We want someone who can look at a business and answer:
 



  





 Where are the customers coming from?
 



  





 Which campaigns are actually generating revenue?
 



  





 Where are we losing customers?
 



  





 Is the tracking reliable?
 



  





 What should we change?
 



  





 And how do we scale without destroying efficiency?
 



  





 You should be comfortable going deep into campaign data, tracking systems and customer journeys.
 



  





 You should also be willing to get your hands dirty with GTM, Events Manager, GA4 and conversion tracking implementations when required.
 



  





 Why Join Spinta Digital?
 


* Work across both Lead Generation and E\-commerce accounts.
* Exposure to multiple industries and business models.
* Work closely with creative, strategy, technology and analytics teams.
* Opportunity to work on sophisticated tracking and attribution setups.
* Exposure to large\-scale performance marketing campaigns.
* Opportunity to grow into a Performance Marketing Lead / Growth Director role.
* Work in a fast\-moving agency environment where performance and commercial outcomes matter.



  





 Apply (Mail to hr@spintadigital.com, with the subject line as Performance Marketing Linkedin)
 



  





 Please share your CV along with examples of campaigns you have managed, including the industries, approximate budgets, objectives and results achieved.

**Qualifications**

 From the moment you start with us, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can grow together with the company. We have identified the following qualifications and skills that will contribute to your success in the role. Therefore, it will be an advantage if you can relate to most of the following points:
   

  

  

* Engineer with experience in SCADA, SRO, and network systems, including IEC 61850–based substation automation
* Experience applying relevant standards and legislation within SCADA/ICS/DCS and networks, including IEC 62443, NIS2, IEC 61508, ISO/IEC 27001, and related frameworks
* Practical experience with converter technologies such as STATCOM, HVDC (including rectifier and inverter stations), and other power electronics–based systems
* Strong background in network principles and cyber security for critical infrastructure
* Experience with tendering processes, specifications, and technical evaluations
* Relevant professional experience from consulting, utilities, OEMs, or system suppliers is an advantage

* Should have the experience of 15 to 20 years

* Experience in working on US and European projects preferred.
* Experienced in performing technical, economic and environmental studies
* Excellent in English skills oral and written is very important and a requirement
* Skilled user of Microsoft office – Excel, Word


**Personal competences**
* Engineering skills with analytical approach
* Work as a team member with good interpersonal skills
* Structured working style with result\-oriented approach
* Should be able to build and maintain good relationships with clients and colleagues
* Excellent in English skills oral and written is very important and a requirement


**Additional Information**

 To work at Ramboll means being part of a people organisation. We are focused on knowledge sharing and collaboration across competence areas and geography, and we aim for a strong diversity among our employees. This enables us to solve a broad range of projects, and we firmly believe that cross\-collaboration leads to creative and longstanding solutions. Thus, the possibilities at Ramboll are many and diverse –we invest a lot in the development of people and offer career paths tailored for each individual.

 Ramboll is at the forefront of addressing the green transition and offers a holistic approach to energy that supports the sector on the journey towards more sustainable solutions. title: Workday Techno Functional Consultant
description:
**About Poshmark**
**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self\-expression, and human connection.** 
 Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one\-of\-a\-kind vintage and luxury.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and analytically driven
 **Senior Specialist II, HR Technology** 
 (Workday Techno\-functional consultant) to join our People team. In this role, you will serve as a senior subject matter expert at the intersection of HR systems and people analytics, helping to optimize our HR technology ecosystem while enabling data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
   

  

 While you will bring deep expertise in Workday HCM—our current HR platform—your value extends beyond any single tool. You are an HR technology and people analytics professional who can build scalable reporting and analytics solutions, support workforce planning through data\-driven insights, and translate complex workforce data into actionable recommendations for HR and business leaders. You contribute to the development of analytics frameworks and predictive analyses while helping ensure that our people data ecosystem remains scalable, reliable, and adaptable as technology evolves.
   

  

 You will partner closely with HR, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to enhance system capabilities, improve data quality, streamline processes, and deliver meaningful workforce insights that support organizational goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* People Analytics \& Workforce Insights
* Develop and maintain workforce dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports that support HR and business decision\-making.
* Analyze workforce trends across headcount, attrition, recruiting, diversity, performance, engagement, and employee lifecycle metrics.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and business leaders to understand reporting needs and provide actionable insights.
* Build and maintain data visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism Analytics, or equivalent platforms.
* Support workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives through data analysis and reporting.
* Contribute to the development of people analytics frameworks and predictive analyses that support talent and workforce decisions.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of workforce metrics by adhering to established reporting standards and governance practices.
* HR Systems Administration (Workday)
* Administer, configure, and maintain Workday HCM modules including Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Benefits, Time \& Absence, and Helpdesk.
* Configure and support business processes, workflows, notifications, security roles, and system controls in alignment with HR policies and operational requirements.
* Develop and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and composite reports.
* Support Workday biannual releases by assessing impacts, testing enhancements, and coordinating deployment activities.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues while ensuring timely communication and resolution for stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Operations and IT teams to continuously optimize system functionality, user experience, and process efficiency.
* HR Data Governance \& Quality
* Maintain high standards of HR data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across HR systems.
* Conduct regular audits and validation activities to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
* Support compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and applicable data privacy regulations.
* Document reporting definitions, system configurations, business processes, and operating procedures.
* Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of HR data governance standards and data quality processes.
* Support efforts to improve trust, transparency, and accessibility of people data across the organization.
* Systems Integration \& Technical Support
* Support integrations between Workday and connected systems including payroll, benefits, talent, learning, and finance platforms.
* Assist with data imports, exports, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) processes, and interface monitoring activities.
* Partner with IT teams and external vendors to troubleshoot integration issues and implement system enhancements.
* Participate in testing activities for integrations, system upgrades, new functionality, and process changes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, and knowledge base materials to support operational continuity.
* Process Optimization \& Stakeholder Enablement
* Identify opportunities to automate manual HR processes and improve operational efficiency through technology solutions.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable system configurations, reports, and process improvements.
* Serve as a trusted resource for HR technology questions, providing guidance and support to stakeholders across the organization.
* Deliver training, user documentation, and knowledge\-sharing sessions to improve system adoption and proficiency.
* Participate in HR technology projects, implementations, and continuous improvement initiatives from planning through execution.
* Build strong partnerships with HR, IT, Finance, and business teams to ensure technology solutions align with organizational needs.


**Qualifications**
**Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in HR Technology, HRIS, People Analytics, or related functions within complex and growing organizations.
* Hands\-on experience administering and configuring Workday HCM, including Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Benefits, Time \& Absence, and related modules.
* Proven experience developing HR reporting, dashboards, workforce analytics, and data\-driven insights that support business and talent decisions.
* Experience supporting HR system implementations, enhancements, testing, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience working with HR system integrations, data management processes, and vendor\-supported technology solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex projects and deliver technical solutions while effectively partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Analytics \& Technical Skills**
* Strong proficiency in Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and reporting capabilities.
* Experience with data visualization platforms such as Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism Analytics, or equivalent tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret workforce data and communicate findings effectively.
* Working knowledge of SQL and data querying concepts; familiarity with Python or R is a plus.
* Understanding of system integration concepts including APIs, EIBs, SFTP, and data transformation processes.
* Knowledge of HR data structures, reporting methodologies, and data governance best practices.


**Domain \& Compliance Knowledge**
* Strong understanding of core HR processes and employee lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of compensation, recruiting, talent management, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness concepts.
* Understanding of HR data privacy, security, and compliance requirements including GDPR, CCPA, and applicable local regulations.
* Familiarity with global HR operations and governance practices is preferred.


**Soft Skills \& Ways Of Working**
* Strong customer\-service orientation with a commitment to delivering high\-quality stakeholder support.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language.
* Detail\-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy, data quality, and process discipline.
* Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative team player who builds productive partnerships across functions and levels.
* Demonstrates initiative, ownership, continuous learning, and a passion for process improvement.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In your first year, you will establish yourself as a trusted HR technology and people analytics partner across the organization. Stakeholders will rely on your expertise to deliver accurate workforce insights, maintain reliable HR systems, and identify opportunities for process improvement. Reporting capabilities will become more efficient and scalable, data quality will improve, and HR teams will have greater confidence in leveraging technology and analytics to make informed decisions. Through your contributions, the HR technology ecosystem will be better optimized, more user\-friendly, and well\-positioned to support the organization's growth and evolving business needs.
   

  

**A Note on Tooling**
 We currently use Workday as our primary HRIS, and deep Workday expertise is required for this role. However, we value professionals whose strengths extend beyond any single platform. Success in this role requires strong capabilities in HR technology, people analytics, workforce reporting, and process optimization that can adapt as systems and business needs evolve over time.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing patterns.
* Experience with data governance practices: RBAC, PII handling, data lineage, data quality frameworks, and enterprise\-scale data management.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments — you have untangled broken pipelines at 2 AM and lived to tell the tale.


**AI \& Agentic Development**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications — RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns — when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.


**Software Engineering**
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.


**Data Engineering \& Platforms**
* Ability to build and maintain data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments.


**Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)**
* Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus — not a requirement.
* Experience with or curiosity about platforms like Kinaxis, SAP IBP, o9, or Blue Yonder is welcome context.


**Experience \& Background**
* 3 – 6 years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, software engineering, or a technical\-founder role. Strong candidates at either end of that range are welcome to apply.
* Prior exposure to customer\-facing technical roles — solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats — is a strong signal, though not a requirement.


**How You Will Succeed In This Role**
* You measure your own success in business outcomes — efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements — not lines of code shipped.
* You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
* You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision.
* You are curious and pragmatic — you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.
* You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders — written, verbal, and in the room.


**\#Fulltime, \#Full\-time** 
**\#Associate**
**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

* Collaborate closely with business analysts developers MES engineers and operations stakeholders to clarify requirements define acceptance criteria and proactively identify risks or gaps that could impact manufacturing continuity or supply chain visibility.
* Analyze test results and production like data patterns to identify systemic defects performance bottlenecks and integration issues then work with technical teams to prioritize and verify fixes that provide measurable operational improvements.
* Create and maintain clear test documentation including test plans test cases traceability matrices and execution reports that support audits and provide transparent evidence of validation coverage for all MES components.
* Provide mentoring and practical guidance to other test professionals on MES validation techniques automated testing practices and integration testing patterns fostering a culture of quality ownership across the delivery team.
* Engage in defect triage sessions and change review activities presenting well reasoned impact analyses and retest strategies that balance quality risk with project timelines for day shift hybrid operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance test automation frameworks test data management and environment stability thereby increasing efficiency across recurring MES validation cycles.
* Partner with manufacturing and supply chain stakeholders to understand process flows and key performance indicators ensuring that test scenarios reflect real operational conditions and help safeguard product quality and service reliability.


**Qualifications**

* Exhibit strong proficiency in manual MES validation activities including requirement analysis test case creation risk based prioritization and evidence collection suitable for regulated manufacturing environments.
* Show advanced skills in testing L4 L3 and L2 integration scenarios across planning manufacturing and shop floor systems with an ability to troubleshoot data flow discrepancies and interface failures effectively.
* Apply practical knowledge of generative AI in the context of software quality engineering using it to enhance test asset creation and analysis while maintaining strict review controls and compliance awareness.
* Demonstrate deep working knowledge of Camstar MES configuration object modeling and workflow behavior enabling precise validation of manufacturing processes and electronic records under varied operational conditions.
* Display solid understanding of manufacturing and supply chain business processes including work order management inventory tracking and quality events so that test coverage aligns with real world operational needs.
* Communicate findings and recommendations clearly in written and spoken form to cross functional teams enabling timely decisions on release readiness and risk mitigation in a hybrid day shift setting.
* Maintain strong analytical and problem solving capabilities supported by a methodical approach to root cause analysis that helps reduce recurring defects and enhances overall MES ecosystem stability.

title: Creative Technologist

**About WPP Production**

title: Shopify CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Shopify CRO Manager to own our end\-to\-end conversion rate optimisation programme.
 



 The role is responsible for the complete process from insight and hypothesis through experiment design, tracking QA, launch, statistical evaluation, winner rollout and measurable CVR/revenue impact.
 



 This position is not limited to marketplace listing optimisation, paid advertising or campaign execution. The successful candidate will improve the Shopify customer journey by working closely with dedicated Data Analyst, UI/UX, development, content and merchandising teams.
 


 Key responsibilities
 * Own the Shopify CRO roadmap across product pages, category/collection pages, search, navigation, cart and checkout.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel performance, device performance, engagement data and commercial results to identify conversion opportunities.
* Create structured hypotheses supported by evidence and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, confidence and effort.
* Define primary KPIs, secondary metrics, guardrail metrics, target audience, test duration and success criteria before each experiment.
* Partner with the Data Analyst to ensure accurate event tracking, dashboards, data quality and reliable post\-test analysis.
* Brief UI/UX, content and development teams with clear experiment requirements and expected customer/business outcomes.
* Conduct pre\-launch QA including tracking validation, mobile/desktop review, browser testing, localisation, merchandising checks and rollback readiness.
* Launch and monitor A/B tests and other controlled experiments without disrupting customer experience or trading performance.
* Evaluate test outcomes using appropriate statistical methods; distinguish meaningful uplift from inconclusive or false\-positive results.
* Roll out confirmed winners, document learning, and ensure results are incorporated into future product and page templates.
* Maintain an experiment backlog, prioritisation framework, testing calendar, QA checklist and executive reporting.
* Present clear recommendations and revenue/CVR impact to senior stakeholders.


 Required qualifications and experience
 * 4\+ years of experience in conversion rate optimisation, e\-commerce growth, digital analytics, product experimentation or a related role.
* Proven experience personally owning website experiments from hypothesis to successful rollout.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and a strong understanding of D2C e\-commerce journeys.
* Strong knowledge of A/B testing, control/variant design, sample size, statistical significance, confidence levels and incremental impact.
* Experience using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify Analytics and reporting tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau.
* Ability to work effectively with Data, UI/UX, developers, content, merchandising and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured communication and project\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritise high\-impact initiatives in a fast\-moving e\-commerce environment.


 Preferred qualifications
 * Experience with experimentation platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Convert, AB Tasty or similar.
* SQL knowledge and experience working with product, customer or web\-behaviour datasets.
* Experience with heatmaps/session\-replay tools such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity or similar.
* Experience improving international e\-commerce stores, localised content or multi\-market Shopify storefronts.
* Experience in fitness, consumer goods, retail or high\-consideration D2C products.


 How success will be measured
 * Conversion\-rate uplift across key Shopify journeys.
* Incremental revenue and profitability generated through experiments.
* Quality and speed of the hypothesis\-to\-launch process.
* Accuracy of tracking, QA and statistical evaluation.
* Number and impact of winning experiments successfully rolled out.
* Clear documentation and adoption of learnings across teams.


 Application requirement
 
 Candidates should share 2\-3 examples of experiments they personally owned, including:
 


* The hypothesis and business problem
* Primary KPI and test setup
* Test duration/sample size approach
* Result and statistical conclusion
* Final rollout decision and measurable business impact

title: RDL Jump Host Admin
description:
Specialist, IT Infrastructure
   

  

 Req ID: 138375
   

  

 Remote Position: Hybrid
   

  

 Hiring Manager: Paul Stanners
   

  

 Band: 08
   

  

 Region: Asia
   

  

 Country: India
   

  

 State/Province: Chennai
   

  

 City: Guindy, Chennai
   

  

**Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced, compliance\-driven RDL Jump Host Administrator to take ownership of the system administration, security, and access control of our global local jump hosts. Reporting directly to the Lead Network Architect, and working in close alignment with the RDL Network Administrator, you will manage secure access pathways into completely isolated, air\-gapped lab networks across multiple HPS Design Centers (including San Jose, Richardson, Thailand, Shanghai, SongShan Lake, Penang, Chennai, and future sites).
   

  

 The primary objective of this role is to ensure that remote connections terminating from corporate Zscaler ZTNA or customer CyberArk vPAM environments are securely processed, authenticated, and audited. Since our environments strictly prohibit Active Directory or domain joins, you will manage decentralized, local authentication configurations, shell environments, and session boundaries.
   

  

 Crucially, you will implement and maintain the strict compliance frameworks required for Export Controlled VLANs—including interactive terms\-of\-use banners, mandatory user acceptance gates for shell access, and tamper\-proof user\-acceptance audit logging.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Jump Host System Administration \& Hardening
* Server Provisioning \& Lifecycle: Deploy, configure, and maintain Linux\-based (Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, CentOS) local jump host virtual machines operating on VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper\-V clusters.
* Operating System Hardening: Apply strict CIS (Center for Internet Security) hardening benchmarks on all jump host operating systems. Ensure that no unauthorized software or corporate agents (e.g., CrowdStrike, ServiceNow, ClearPass, Windows Domain utilities) are installed or active on endpoints installed on the VLAN behind the Jump Host.
* Service Availability: Ensure the high availability, performance, patch status, and storage capacity of jump servers acting as gateways to the core RDL networks.
* Export Control Compliance \& Interactive Gates
* Export Control Shell Banners: Configure and manage interactive, mandatory user agreement screens (e.g., using custom shell login scripts, Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM), or SSH ForceCommand) specifically for systems accessing Export Controlled VLANs.
* User Acceptance Verification: Ensure that users cannot acquire an interactive shell, run commands, or bypass the landing screen without explicitly reading and accepting the export control and NDA terms.
* Tamper\-Proof Acceptance Logging: Implement and maintain robust, structured logging systems (using Rsyslog, Journald, or custom secure local logging scripts) that capture:
+ The authenticated user's local/remote identifier.
+ Source IP and connection timestamp.
+ Explicit timestamped confirmation of the user's compliance acceptance.

* Log Archival \& Integrity: Set up secure, write\-only log forwarding or local hashing protocols to ensure audit logs of export\-control acceptances cannot be modified or deleted by general users.
* Identity, Access, \& Session Management
* Decentralized Local Authentication: Programmatically or manually provision local Unix user accounts, localized Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), and SSH keys on all jump hosts.
* Remote Integration Support: Partner with corporate IT to ensure seamless hand\-offs from Zscaler ZTNA (via local Zscaler App Connectors) and CyberArk vPAM sessions terminating on the jump hosts.
* Session Controls: Configure strict SSH timeouts, idle session terminations, and multi\-factor authentication loops to prevent abandoned active connections.
* Operations, Ticket Resolution \& Collaboration
* Workplace Collaboration: Align daily with the RDL Network Administrator to coordinate VLAN mappings, firewall rule adjustments, and routing protocols necessary for jump host access.
* Engineering Support: Serve as a technical point of contact for HPS design engineers having credentialing, shell, or connection issues when entering secure environments.
* Incident \& Audit Readiness: Assist the Lead Network Architect in pulling audit trails and access reports during compliance reviews, system security audits, or customer security evaluations.


 Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
* Linux Expertise (Expert Level): Mastery of Linux OS administration (Rocky Linux, RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) including shell scripting (Bash, Python), security policies, and package management.
* Secure Access \& Authentication: Comprehensive knowledge of SSH daemon configuration (sshd\_config), PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules) stack configuration, and secure local authentication patterns.

* Access Technologies: Familiarity with Zscaler ZTNA (App Connectors), CyberArk vPAM, and Virtual Private Network (VPN) architectures.

title: System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Data Capability Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Data Capability Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 IT Systems Architecture
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Purpose Of The Role**
 Own and extend the accuracy, completeness, and usability of the service management platform's data — so implementation teams and AI\-driven capabilities can act on it directly, and so priority consumers like vulnerability and exposure management run on complete, trustworthy ground truth. Service mapping and asset data are the anchor domain and immediate priority; the durable mandate is data quality across an increasingly AI\-centric ITSM platform, where automated systems act on data without a human to catch errors first.
   

  

**A data\-capability role, not a security role.**
**Core responsibilities — Anchor domain: Service \& asset data (immediate priority)**
* Ensure existing service mapping is accurate and current across hosts, servers, and applications.
* Extend mapping coverage to data types not well covered today — certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.
* Engage in the workflows that onboard new applications and capabilities into the CMDB so coverage keeps pace rather than drifting.
* Go deeper into discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, the software asset management system, and agent\-based discovery — to raise inventory fidelity.


**Core responsibilities — Broader mandate: Platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**
* Apply the same discipline to other high\-value platform data — service catalog and metadata, ticket routing and assignment\-group data, and the Dataverse structures underneath delivery capabilities such as the AskIT service chatbot.
* Raise data to the standard AI systems require: complete, disambiguated, and semantically clean, so intent classification, catalog matching, and automated routing act on trustworthy inputs rather than amplifying noise.
* Leverage the existing foundation (Dataverse schema, discovery tooling, search indexes already in place) rather than building net\-new infrastructure.
* Make data consumable without re\-verification \- the test is whether an engineer or an automated agent can act on a record without re\-checking it, and turn recurring data problems into repeatable quality practices.


 What this role is not
   

  

* Not remediation coordination or change management
* Not a security function \- it supplies the data; it does not own security decisions.
* Not a net\-new platform build \- leverages and improves the existing foundation.


 Example Success measures
   

  

* Coverage: % of assets, certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS apps mapped to owner and service; extended over time to other platform data domains.
* Data confidence: high enough that implementation teams and AI capabilities don't require re\-verification.
* Time\-to\-onboard a new application or capability into the CMDB.
* Reusability: improvements delivered as repeatable practices, not one\-off fixes.


**Education**
**What You’ll Need:**
 Bachelor's degree in information systems, computer science, data management, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. A candidate with a strong track record in CMDB, discovery, or data\-quality work should not be screened out for lack of the exact degree.
   

  

**Experience**
 Five to eight years in IT data, configuration/asset management, or a data\-engineering\-adjacent role, including demonstrable ownership of a data domain (not just contributing to one). Enough experience to set the standard for how data quality is done, with the judgment to work independently under a Senior Manager's direction rather than needing task\-level supervision.
   

  

**Required Skills And Knowledge**
**Anchor domain — asset \& service data**
* Hands\-on experience with CMDB and service mapping concepts (configuration items, relationships, service dependencies), including keeping mapping accurate as the environment changes.
* Working knowledge of discovery and software\-asset tooling — Lansweeper, agent\-based discovery, and a software asset management system — and what drives inventory fidelity in each.
* Understanding of the asset types the role must extend into: certificates, websites, agents, and SaaS applications.


**Broader mandate — platform \& AI\-consumption data quality**
* Strong data\-quality fundamentals: profiling, deduplication, normalization, and defining and measuring completeness and accuracy.
* Practical experience querying and shaping data in a structured platform (Dataverse or a comparable relational/low\-code data platform), working with existing schema rather than designing greenfield systems.
* Query capability sufficient to investigate, validate, and correct data at scale independently.
* Familiarity with what makes data consumable by AI systems — why completeness, disambiguation, and clean semantics matter for intent classification, matching, and routing. Deep machine\-learning expertise is not required; the relevant skill is data readiness, not model building.


**Ways of working**
* Able to embed quality into existing onboarding workflows and turn recurring problems into repeatable practices, rather than one\-off fixes.
* Communicates data issues and their business impact clearly to both technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Your Advantage**
* Experience in a Microsoft Power Platform environment (Power Automate, Azure AI Search, or similar).
* Exposure to vulnerability or exposure management as a data consumer — understanding what that function needs from asset data, without owning the security decisions.
* ITIL familiarity (service management context), or a data\-management certification (e.g., DAMA/CDMP).

* Basic proficiency in relevant engineering software (e.g., AutoCAD, STAAD, or similar) and MS Office tools.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and commitment to safety and quality standards.
* Good communication skills and willingness to learn from senior civil engineers and project leaders.

description:
**Job title:** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Manager, IT Systems Administration
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**

title: Live Chat Support Associate (1-3 years)
description:
**About Poshmark**
**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self\-expression, and human connection.** 
 Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one\-of\-a\-kind vintage and luxury.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Poshmark is the largest community marketplace for fashion, where anyone can buy, sell, and share their personal style. As a Community Associate, you provide front\-line support to our growing community — today primarily over email, messenger, and social channels, and increasingly through live chat as we roll out this new real\-time channel.
   

  

 You'll triage and resolve time\-sensitive inquiries about orders, accounts, shipping, and payments, and provide product education, all while maintaining a high bar for customer satisfaction. As live chat rolls out, you'll also take on real\-time conversations: understanding intent and writing clearly under time pressure, making routing and escalation calls in the moment, and building up to handling multiple chats at once as you gain experience. The ideal Community Associate...
   

  

* Understands user issues with empathy
* Exercises strong problem\-solving skills
* Is patient in understanding and responding to our users
* Is comfortable switching between async (email) and real\-time (chat) modes of support as needed


 What You'll Do
   

  

 Email \& General Support
   

  

* Engage with Poshmark users via email, messenger, and/or social support
* Respond to users in a timely, friendly, and professional manner
* Demonstrate empathy through thoughtful and prompt resolutions for the community
* Research, troubleshoot, and recommend solutions for open orders and account\-related issues
* Gather feedback and suggestions from the community
* Strive to exceed volume and CSAT (customer satisfaction) goals
* Help with other projects and administrative work as needed


 Live Chat (as rolled out)
   

  

* Respond to live chat conversations promptly and accurately \- helping users with orders, shipping, payments, listings, and account questions in real time
* Understand user intent and write clearly and concisely under time pressure; set expectations during research or hold time (e.g., “Give me one moment while I look into this”) so the customer is never left wondering what's happening
* Apply the escalation framework to each conversation: i) resolve directly, ii) warm\-hand\-off to a specialized team or iii) log an offline case — capturing the right details and keeping the customer informed
* De\-escalate frustrated customers using active listening and ownership language, adapting your approach mid\-conversation as needed
* Navigate the chat platform, knowledge base, order/CRM history, and internal case tools quickly enough to find answers live, without stalling the conversation Progress through a structured concurrency ramp: one chat during training, two after graduation, and up to three in normal production (more during peak sales/seasonal events), advancing only once quality and speed are consistently on target
* Use approved macros and response templates as a starting point, not a script — personalize responses so the conversation still feels human


 Growth \& Accomplishments
   

  

 3\-6\-Month Accomplishments
   

  

* Independently handle email cases with efficiency and accuracy, per guidelines and policy
* Meet daily case goals on a consistent basis
* Complete live chat training and certification; graduate to handling one / two concurrent chats


 6\-12 Month Accomplishments
   

  

* Navigate cases with ease across email and chat
* Handle up to three concurrent chats (more during peak events) while holding quality steady
* Begin providing mentorship and guidance to new team members and peers
* Begin contributing to team projects and process improvements


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Enthusiastic about community and customer service, with endless patience and a positive attitude.
* 1–3 years of total experience, including 6–12 months in customer service; prior live chat experience is a plus (training and a graduation period are provided)
* Exceptional written communication skills: clear, grammatically clean, and warm in tone, even when writing quickly or under time pressure
* Strong computer and typing skills; typing speed of at least 40 WPM at 95%\+ accuracy (50\+ WPM preferred once handling concurrent chats)
* Sound judgment for triaging issues — knowing what to resolve yourself, hand off, or log as a case
* Composure under pressure: calm, empathetic, and solution\-focused with an upset or unpredictable customer
* Comfortable working across multiple tools at once (chat platform, CRM/order system, knowledge base) without losing pace
* Believes that helping users is crucial to the growth and success of the company; values one’s own and team’s success,
* Flexible availability, open to shift rotations, including IST evening/morning hours, and willingness to work on\-site during training / live chat rollout phase.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Live chat experience in e\-commerce or marketplace platforms
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or a comparable chat/CRM platform
* Recent experience already handling 2–3\+ concurrent chats in a previous role
* Experience with dispute resolution, trust \& safety, or fraud\-related support scenarios

**Education and experience:**

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**

 Job Summary :
   

  





 Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day\-to\-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem\-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.
   

  





 Role Definition :
   

  





 Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.
   

  





 Responsibilities :
   

  




* **Client Interaction** 
 \- Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally
* **Client Access Setup –** 
 Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting \-** 
 They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible
* **Issue Resolution** 
 \- Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption
* **Escalation** 
 \- For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level
* **Documentation** 
 \- They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team



 Skills :
   

  





**Broad Knowledge** 
 \- Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.
   

  





**Problem\-Solving** 
 \- They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.
   

  





**Communication** 
 \- Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.
   

  





**Adaptability** 
 \- Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.
   

  





 Tasks :
   

  





**Responding to Cases** 
 \- Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.
   

  





**Performing Diagnostics** 
 \- They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.
   

  





**Providing Solutions** 
 \- Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.
   

  





**Escalating Issues** 
 \- When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.
   

  





**Example Scenario** 
 \- A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:
   

  




1. Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs
2. Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity
3. Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly
4. Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation



 Success metrics :
   

  




* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications
* Handling and Closure of assigned ticket target volume
* Microsoft Dynamics compliance to stated ways of working

**Product Analyst – Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 The Business Analyst cum Product Analyst analyzes business systems, processes, and data to engineer solutions that enhance business capabilities and operational efficiency. As a core member of the product team, this role translates business workflows into clear technical requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria. The analyst also functions as a proxy product owner and subject matter expert, collaborating closely with business stakeholders and technical teams. A strong foundation in requirements engineering, process modeling, Agile practices, and data analysis is essential.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Requirements \& Product Analysis**
* Translate business processes, goals, and terminology into technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Act as a proxy product owner for designated business domains, offering functional expertise and guidance.
* Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to analyze, document, and refine product requirements.
* Manage and prioritize product backlog items in Azure DevOps based on business value, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs.
* Prepare communications, presentations, and documentation on system enhancements, alternatives, and recommended solutions.


**Process \& Data Analysis**
* Analyze business workflows to identify opportunities for process improvement, efficiency gains, and automation.
* Validate, interpret, and analyze data from Mainframe environments, DB2 databases, and SQL queries to support decision\-making.
* Contribute to building business cases by gathering data, identifying issues, and documenting components under senior guidance.


**Agile Delivery \& Project Support**
* Support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Develop schedules of tasks based on overarching project timelines and keep stakeholders informed on progress.
* Participate in system testing, UAT, and production validation to ensure solution accuracy and quality.
* Work independently on projects of low to moderate complexity and with minimal supervision on more complex initiatives.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build, maintain, and enhance strong relationships with business partners through active listening, consistent communication, and accountability.
* Understand stakeholder needs and expectations to deliver clear, value\-driven solutions.
* Demonstrate trust, influence, and adaptability to meet evolving business requirements.


**Reporting \& Documentation**
* Create business and functional requirement documents, process flows, guidelines, and technical communication materials.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and metrics using Microsoft Office tools to track product performance and project progress.
* Seek relevant information to ensure clarity and accuracy of technical communication tailored to different audience groups.


**Continuous Improvement \& Strategy Execution**
* Apply an understanding of financial, ROI, and market principles to support strategy development.
* Identify inefficiencies within work processes and apply innovative ideas or established tools to improve outcomes.
* Continuously pursue opportunities for system, workflow, and product improvements.


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Proven experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role (5–8 years preferred).
* Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps for managing requirements and product backlogs.
* Experience with Mainframe systems, DB2 databases, SQL, and data validation.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe) and cross\-functional team collaboration.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio).
* Exposure to PL/SQL, EDI Mapping, enterprise integration, and data flows across legacy and modern platforms.
* Core competencies: requirements elicitation, process modeling, workshop facilitation, and analytical thinking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder management ability.
* High attention to detail, strong organizational and time\-management skills, and a problem\-solving mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Combination of university education and hands\-on business/domain experience is valued
